papers.title: The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols
papers.abstract: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). Round-trip count dominates handshake cost. A legacy MCP handshake takes three round trips and 230 ms at 50 ms RTT; A2A needs one round trip and 61.0 ms. Round trips are not the whole bill: when an LLM reads the counterpart's metadata, handshake cost scales with the counterpart's capability inventory at 24-107 tokens per capability, so a 200-capability counterpart spends 11% of a 200k-token context window before the agent reads its own task. MCP's own 2026 revision cuts its handshake from three round trips to two and, with era pinning, to zero on warm reconnects, protocol evolution that corroborates the cost we measure. We release the full harness, raw data, and analysis at https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark.

translation.title: 说“你好”的代价：AI Agent 通信协议中握手开销的实证研究
translation.abstract: AI Agent 之间的每次交互都以握手开始：发起方必须找到对端、了解其能力并建立会话，才能发送第一条有用消息。各类 agent 通信协议综述都将握手开销列为效率标准，却从未给出测量数据。本文首次对三大 agent 协议——MCP（2025 initialize 与 2026 discover 两个版本）、A2A 和 ACP——的握手进行了分阶段的实证基准测试。使用各协议官方 SDK，我们在冷启动、温重复、能力不匹配和元数据降级场景下（每格 N=50，分别在回环和模拟 50 ms RTT 下）测量每次请求的往返次数、各阶段延迟、传输字节数和 token 成本。往返次数主导握手成本：旧版 MCP 握手需三次往返、在 50 ms RTT 下耗时 230 ms；A2A 只需一次往返、61.0 ms。但往返并非全部成本：当 LLM 读取对端元数据时，握手成本随对端能力清单规模增长（每能力 24–107 token），一个拥有 200 项能力的对端在 agent 读取自身任务之前就会消耗 200k token 上下文窗口的 11%。MCP 的 2026 修订版将握手从三次往返减为两次，并通过 era pinning 在温重连时降为零，这一协议演进印证了我们所测量的成本。完整测试框架、原始数据和分析已发布于 https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark。
translation.brief: 针对 agent 通信协议握手开销缺乏实测数据的问题，首次对 MCP、A2A、ACP 握手进行分阶段实证基准测量，量化往返次数与 token 成本。

papers.title: MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems
papers.abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. We further examine how progressive disclosure techniques eliminate MCP's historical weakness (context window overhead), yielding token efficiency comparable to CLI while preserving its architectural benefits. A hybrid architecture is recommended for production systems. This analysis draws upon academic, government, and industry sources including NSA formal guidance (CSI U/OO/6030316-26), OWASP security standards, and economic modeling from BCG and Gartner.

translation.title: AI Agent 的 MCP 与 CLI 对比：自主系统工具集成策略的比较分析
translation.abstract: AI Agent 需要接口来与文件、API、数据库和云服务等外部系统交互。目前出现了两种竞争范式：CLI（命令行接口），agent 直接执行 shell 命令；以及 MCP（Model Context Protocol），一种提供受治理、类型化工具访问的结构化 JSON-RPC 协议。本文从 14 个评估维度进行对比分析，辅以实例演示、基于既有合规框架的安全评估和经济建模。分析表明，CLI 在单用户、纯本地工作流中效率更高，而 MCP 能满足 CLI 从根本上无法满足的需求，包括细粒度访问控制、凭证隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理。我们进一步探讨渐进式披露技术如何消除 MCP 的历史弱点（上下文窗口开销），使其在保持架构优势的同时达到与 CLI 相当的 token 效率。对于生产系统，我们推荐混合架构。本分析参考了学术、政府和行业来源，包括 NSA 正式指南（CSI U/OO/6030316-26）、OWASP 安全标准以及 BCG 和 Gartner 的经济建模。
translation.brief: 比较 CLI 与 MCP 两种 agent 工具集成范式的优劣，并据此提出生产系统采用混合架构的建议。

papers.title: Lighthouse: On Building a Trustworthy Digital Assistant for Exploring History with Civil Rights Archives
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), as a decision-support aid, provides new tools for studying history effectively using multimodal data, including text, images, and audio. We present, to our knowledge, the first digital assistant named Lighthouse--commonly called a chatbot--for exploring the Civil Rights period of the United States using data from South Carolina. From an AI perspective, the system's novelty lies in its guiding design principles of (a) focusing on trustworthiness of content and (b) by modeling and reducing potential harm to users from generated answers. It implements these with a neuro-symbolic approach that combines neural learning through a large language model (LLM) with rule-based symbolic solving, balancing risk of answers with generality of coverage. We evaluate Lighthouse with both factual objective questions that admit a single acceptable answer as well as subjective questions. For the latter, a dataset of subjective question-answer pairs (QAs) is created by discovering a "gold standard" by aggregating answers from independent experts. Lighthouse has access to over 18k primary sources from a range of collections and can be easily extended.

translation.title: Lighthouse：基于民权档案构建探索历史的可信数字助手
translation.abstract: 人工智能作为决策支持工具，为利用文本、图像和音频等多模态数据高效研究历史提供了新工具。据我们所知，我们提出了首个用于探索美国民权时期的数字助手（常称聊天机器人）Lighthouse，其数据来自南卡罗来纳州。从 AI 角度看，该系统的新颖之处在于其指导性设计原则：(a) 关注内容的可信性；(b) 建模并减少生成答案对用户的潜在伤害。系统通过神经符号方法实现这些原则，将大语言模型（LLM）的神经学习与基于规则的符号求解相结合，在答案风险与覆盖广度之间取得平衡。我们用可判定唯一正确答案的客观事实问题和主观问题对 Lighthouse 进行评估。针对后者，通过汇总独立专家的答案发现“金标准”，构建了主观问答对（QA）数据集。Lighthouse 可访问来自多个馆藏的超过 18k 份一手资料，且易于扩展。
translation.brief: 构建探索美国民权历史的可信数字助手 Lighthouse，采用 LLM 与规则符号求解结合的神经符号方法保证内容可信并降低生成答案的潜在危害。

papers.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
papers.abstract: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.

translation.title: TauIndianBankBench：面向流程感知、行动导向的工具使用型对话 Agent 评估
translation.abstract: 许多印度银行通过 FAQ 页面和脚本化聊天机器人服务客户。基于语言模型的助手可以更快地响应并执行诸如冻结银行卡之类的请求，但前提是它们提供正确信息并遵守银行规则。这些规则规定了流程，即一组必需步骤，例如在关闭存款前获取结清报价。将模型适配到该领域需要在训练前后衡量其遵循流程的能力。现有基准通常只根据对话结束时留下的记录进行评判，然而许多必需步骤不会改变记录，跳过这些步骤的助手仍可能被判为成功。我们提出 TauIndianBankBench，一个面向行动的基准，包含 1,000 个印度零售银行任务，其中助手帮助模拟客户。除最终记录外，它还检查助手是否执行了每个必需步骤且未做任何未被要求的更改。结果显示，若仅检查最终记录，各模型有 6.5%–12.0% 的会话被判为成功，尽管助手跳过了必需步骤或做出了未要求的更改。同时评估流程与结果能更准确地反映语言模型在印度零售银行业务中的表现。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准只看最终记录而漏检流程违规的问题，提出同时检查必需步骤执行情况的行动导向银行任务基准 TauIndianBankBench。

papers.title: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
papers.abstract: Optimizing Information Retrieval (IR) pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) requires jointly selecting structural components and numerical hyperparameters under limited evaluation budgets. We introduce the Information Retrieval Agentic Harness (IRAH), which combines Language Agent Tree Search for IR (LATS-IR) with offline meta-learned initialization. LATS-IR performs UCT-guided hierarchical search, first exploring macro-structural pipeline choices and then refining numerical parameters, with natural-language reflections to guide subsequent mutations and provide inspectable search traces. We evaluate IRAH on three in-distribution benchmarks and one out of-distribution benchmark to assess generalization under distribution shift. Under the same meta-learned initialization, LATS-IR outperforms TPE on two of three in-distribution benchmarks, with gains of up to 6.4%, and remains competitive on the out-of-distribution benchmark. Across all four benchmarks, warm-started IRAH achieves the highest average held-out nDCG@10 (0.4816) and improves over its cold-start counterpart. These results establish IRAH as a competitive approach to retrieval pipeline optimization under constrained evaluation budgets.

translation.title: IRAH：用于检索流水线优化的层次化 Agentic 树搜索
translation.abstract: 为检索增强生成（RAG）优化信息检索（IR）流水线，需要在有限评估预算下同时选择结构组件和数值超参数。我们提出 Information Retrieval Agentic Harness（IRAH），将面向 IR 的语言 Agent 树搜索（LATS-IR）与离线元学习初始化相结合。LATS-IR 执行 UCT 引导的层次化搜索，先探索宏观结构上的流水线选择，再细化数值参数，并借助自然语言反思指导后续变异、提供可审查的搜索轨迹。我们在三个分布内基准和一个分布外基准上评估 IRAH，以考察分布偏移下的泛化能力。在相同的元学习初始化下，LATS-IR 在三个分布内基准中的两个上优于 TPE，提升最高达 6.4%，并在分布外基准上保持竞争力。在全部四个基准上，热启动的 IRAH 取得最高的平均留出 nDCG@10（0.4816），并优于冷启动版本。这些结果确立了 IRAH 作为受限评估预算下检索流水线优化的有竞争力方法。
translation.brief: 针对有限评估预算下联合选择检索流水线结构与超参数的难题，提出结合 UCT 层次树搜索与离线元学习初始化的 IRAH 方法。

papers.title: QProtFuse: Query-Guided Layer Fusion for Retrieval-Augmented Protein Function Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting protein functions from amino acid sequences is essential to understanding biological processes. Large language models (LLMs) offer flexible function descriptions to natural-language queries, yet their limited protein understanding motivates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Existing protein RAG methods primarily expand external retrieval signals while overlooking the rich knowledge encoded within a single protein language model (PLM). We show that retrieval performance varies across PLM layers and biological tasks, making conventional final-layer selection suboptimal. To this end, we propose QProtFuse, which uses queries to adaptively fuse multi-layer protein features and jointly learns protein and annotation retrieval through intra-modal and cross-modal contrastive objectives. On Prot-Inst-OOD, QProtFuse achieves the best protein and annotation retrieval scores, reaching 16.4\% Recall@1 with annotation reranking. These gains improve downstream RAG-based function descriptions, yielding the highest LLM-as-a-judge scores for both Qwen3-8B (6.22/10) and DeepSeek-V4-Pro (6.68/10). Ablations and weight analyses demonstrate the value of query-guided fusion and complementary training objectives for exploiting a PLM's internal knowledge.

translation.title: QProtFuse：面向检索增强蛋白质功能预测的查询引导层融合
translation.abstract: 从氨基酸序列预测蛋白质功能对理解生物过程至关重要。大语言模型（LLM）能够针对自然语言查询提供灵活的功能描述，但其对蛋白质的理解能力有限，因此需要检索增强生成（RAG）。现有蛋白质RAG方法主要扩展外部检索信号，而忽视了单个蛋白质语言模型（PLM）内部编码的丰富知识。我们证明检索性能在不同PLM层和不同生物任务之间存在差异，使得常规的最后一层选择并非最优。为此，我们提出QProtFuse，利用查询自适应地融合多层蛋白质特征，并通过模态内和跨模态对比目标联合学习蛋白质检索与注释检索。在Prot-Inst-OOD上，QProtFuse取得了最佳的蛋白质和注释检索分数，经注释重排后Recall@1达到16.4%。这些提升改善了下游基于RAG的功能描述，在Qwen3-8B（6.22/10）和DeepSeek-V4-Pro（6.68/10）上均获得最高的LLM-as-a-judge分数。消融实验和权重分析证明了查询引导融合以及互补训练目标在挖掘PLM内部知识方面的价值。
translation.brief: 针对蛋白质RAG中单层PLM特征选择次优的问题，提出通过查询自适应融合多层蛋白质特征并联合训练蛋白质与注释检索的方法。

papers.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
papers.abstract: Despite substantial progress in Deep Search agents, their ability to conduct end-to-end research in real-world open Web environments remains insufficiently evaluated. Unlike static retrieval settings, information on the real-world Web is distributed across diverse sources, modalities, and heterogeneous formats, often involving complex interaction mechanisms that require agents to autonomously search for, access, and integrate relevant evidence during execution. To address this gap, we introduce the OpenDS task, designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform multi-step deep search in the live, open Web. This task requires agents to autonomously explore the real Web, discover and connect relevant evidence from multiple independent sources through Web search, browser interaction, and evidence processing, and ultimately determine a unique factual answer. Building on this task formulation, we construct OpenDS-World, a benchmark comprising 200 challenging tasks spanning diverse information modalities, heterogeneous file formats, and interactive access requirements, with independent human verification to ensure evidence validity and answer uniqueness. We evaluate 12 frontier models under a unified tool environment and execution protocol. The best-performing model achieves 39.0% accuracy, while human evaluation across 1,000 independent attempts yields 21.1% accuracy. Further analyses of tool usage, search cost, termination behavior, and failure recovery reveal substantial differences in research strategies across models, as well as persistent challenges in tool coordination and long-horizon search management. OpenDS-World provides a unified evaluation platform for systematically assessing and advancing agents' autonomous deep search capabilities in real-world open Web environments.

translation.title: 真实世界Web环境中的深度搜索
translation.abstract: 尽管深度搜索智能体取得了长足进步，但其在真实开放Web环境中进行端到端研究的能力仍缺乏充分评估。与静态检索设置不同，真实Web上的信息分布在多样的来源、模态和异构格式中，往往涉及复杂的交互机制，要求智能体在执行过程中自主搜索、访问并整合相关证据。为填补这一空白，我们提出OpenDS任务，旨在评估智能体在实时开放Web中执行多步深度搜索的能力。该任务要求智能体自主探索真实Web，通过Web搜索、浏览器交互和证据处理，从多个独立来源发现并关联相关证据，最终确定唯一的事实性答案。基于该任务设定，我们构建了OpenDS-World基准，包含200个具有挑战性的任务，涵盖多样的信息模态、异构文件格式和交互式访问要求，并通过独立的人工验证确保证据有效性和答案唯一性。我们在统一的工具环境和执行协议下评估了12个前沿模型。表现最佳的模型达到39.0%的准确率，而人类在1000次独立尝试中的准确率为21.1%。对工具使用、搜索成本、终止行为和失败恢复的进一步分析揭示了各模型在研究策略上的显著差异，以及在工具协调和长程搜索管理方面的持续挑战。OpenDS-World为系统评估和推进智能体在真实开放Web环境中的自主深度搜索能力提供了统一的评估平台。
translation.brief: 针对深度搜索智能体在真实开放Web环境中缺乏评估的问题，构建了包含200个任务的OpenDS-World基准并统一评估多个前沿模型。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Static Analysis via LLM Pseudo-Labeling
papers.abstract: Security bugs often slip past static analysis not because they are impossible to detect, but because detection rules have not yet been written for the code in front of us. New frameworks, APIs, and coding idioms continually create such gaps, leaving developers to discover failures and manually encode new rules. We present SESAA, a framework in which an Large Language Model (LLM) agent starts from no rules and iteratively evolves a set of readable and auditable joern queries. The agent receives feedback only from a second LLM critic, which inspects flagged and unflagged code to identify likely false alarms and suspected misses, without access to ground-truth labels. The agent then uses this feedback to revise its queries. On the OWASP Benchmark for Python, SESAA reaches a mean F1 of 0.742 across 8 independent runs, well above the default configurations of five widely used tools and comparable to the strongest of them once it is tuned with access to ground-truth labels that SESAA never sees. In a pilot on real-world Python projects, queries induced from code available before a vulnerability was introduced detect 10 of 19 subsequent CVEs, including 9 detected by rules written for the same repository. The resulting detector is a set of executable, human-readable queries that engineers can inspect, modify, and run independently. These results suggest that LLM agents can turn static-analysis rule maintenance from a manually authored process into an iterative process of automated discovery and repair.

translation.title: 基于LLM伪标签的自进化静态分析
translation.abstract: 安全漏洞常常逃过静态分析的检测，并非因为它们无法被检测，而是因为尚未针对眼前的代码编写检测规则。新框架、新API和新编码习惯不断造成此类空白，迫使开发者发现故障后手动编写新规则。我们提出SESAA，一个由大语言模型（LLM）智能体从零规则出发、迭代进化出一组可读且可审计的joern查询的框架。该智能体仅从第二个LLM评论者获得反馈，该评论者检查被标记和未被标记的代码以识别可能的误报和疑似漏报，且无法访问真实标签。智能体随后利用该反馈修改其查询。在OWASP Python基准上，SESAA在8次独立运行中的平均F1达到0.742，远高于五个广泛使用工具的默认配置，并与其中最强工具在使用SESAA从未见过的真实标签进行调优后的表现相当。在真实Python项目的试点中，从漏洞引入之前的代码中归纳出的查询检测出19个后续CVE中的10个，其中9个由为同一仓库编写的规则检测到。最终的检测器是一组可执行、人类可读的查询，工程师可以检查、修改并独立运行。这些结果表明，LLM智能体可以将静态分析规则维护从手动编写过程转变为自动发现与修复的迭代过程。
translation.brief: 针对静态分析规则需手动编写的问题，提出由LLM智能体在无真实标签下通过LLM评论者反馈迭代进化joern检测查询的SESAA框架。

papers.title: Agentic Verified Optimization of Real-World Software
papers.abstract: Program optimization aims to improve performance while preserving behavior. Coding agents can already make programs faster by changing algorithms, data structures, and execution strategies. However, existing equivalence checks mostly rely on tests, which agents have been shown to exploit, passing the tests without preserving the intended behavior. We propose agentic verified optimization, in which an agent produces a faster implementation together with a machine-checked proof of equivalence to the existing one. Because the existing implementation serves as the specification, the task avoids the specification-writing bottleneck of verified code generation, and recent advances in theorem proving make the proofs attainable. We formulate the task at the function and repository levels in Lean 4, where programs can be both executed and reasoned about. Few real-world applications are written in Lean, so we develop Aqueduct, an agentic framework that migrates C, C++, Go, and Rust programs into native Lean, validates each port by differential testing against its original. On the 189 reference implementations in Verina, agents produce faster proved rewrites for 156, including algorithmic changes such as replacing exponential recursion with dynamic programming. On 17 migrated applications, their 92 proved rewrites speed up 47 of 51 application scenarios. These application-level gains are smaller than the function-level ones, making the choice of functions to optimize an important problem. Current agents can thus already carry out verified optimization on both standalone functions and applications migrated from real programs. We discuss the remaining challenges and the steps toward verified optimization in production.

translation.title: 真实世界软件的智能体化验证优化
translation.abstract: 程序优化旨在保持行为的同时提升性能。编码智能体已经可以通过改变算法、数据结构和执行策略使程序更快。然而，现有的等价性检查大多依赖测试，而智能体已被证明会利用测试，在不保持预期行为的情况下通过测试。我们提出智能体化验证优化，即智能体生成更快的实现，同时提供与现有实现等价的机器检查证明。由于现有实现充当规约，该任务避免了验证代码生成中的规约编写瓶颈，而定理证明的最新进展使这些证明变得可行。我们在Lean 4中以函数和仓库两个层级形式化该任务，在Lean 4中程序既可以执行也可以推理。由于很少有真实应用用Lean编写，我们开发了Aqueduct，一个将C、C++、Go和Rust程序迁移到原生Lean的智能体框架，并通过与原程序的差分测试验证每次移植。在Verina的189个参考实现上，智能体为156个生成了更快的已证明重写，包括用动态规划替换指数递归等算法层面的改变。在17个迁移应用中，其92个已证明重写加速了51个应用场景中的47个。这些应用层面的收益小于函数层面的收益，使得选择优化哪些函数成为一个重要问题。因此，当前智能体已经能够对独立函数和从真实程序迁移而来的应用执行验证优化。我们讨论了剩余的挑战以及迈向生产环境中验证优化的步骤。
translation.brief: 针对程序优化中测试等价性检查可被智能体利用的问题，提出让智能体生成更快实现并附带Lean 4机器验证等价性证明的验证优化方法及迁移框架Aqueduct。

papers.title: MPIDetector: Detecting Multi-modal Prompt Injection via LLM-based Reasoning
papers.abstract: With the rapid integration of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into real-world applications, Prompt Injection (PI) has emerged as a critical security threat. Attackers can conceal malicious instructions within textual narratives or visual inputs to bypass safety alignment. Existing approaches, such as signature- and perplexity-based methods, rely heavily on pattern matching, making them insufficient to detect sophisticated, cross-modal PI payloads. In this paper, we propose a novel detection framework, called MPIDetector, that leverages LLMs' intrinsic reasoning capabilities via few-shot In-Context Learning (ICL). Instead of fine-tuning, we provide the model with specific prompt templates and representative attack examples, enabling it to scrutinize the semantic intent of input across modalities. We constructed a comprehensive evaluation benchmark comprising eight textual and seven visual malicious categories, supplemented with benign datasets to rigorously test for false positives. Our evaluation across multiple leading LLMs, including Gemini-2.0-Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, and Doubao-seed-1.6-flash, demonstrates the efficacy and generalizability of this approach. The proposed method achieves up to 90.91% accuracy and 100% recall on textual tasks. In the visual domain, it achieves up to 99.28% accuracy while maintaining 100% precision across all evaluated models. Crucially, when evaluated against 500 highly obfuscated environmental web-agent injections (WebInject), MPIDetector achieved a detection rate up to 99.80%. Comparisons with two baseline approaches for detecting textual PI payloads, along with two additional methods for visual input detection, demonstrate MPIDetector's superior accuracy. These results show that LLM-driven reasoning provides a robust, cross-modal defense against advanced prompt injections.

translation.title: MPIDetector：基于LLM推理的多模态提示注入检测
translation.abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）快速融入真实应用，提示注入（PI）已成为关键安全威胁。攻击者可将恶意指令隐藏在文本叙述或视觉输入中，以绕过安全对齐。现有方法（如基于签名和困惑度的方法）严重依赖模式匹配，难以检测复杂的跨模态PI载荷。本文提出一种新的检测框架MPIDetector，通过少样本上下文学习（ICL）利用LLM的内在推理能力。该方法无需微调，而是为模型提供特定的提示模板和代表性攻击示例，使其能够审视跨模态输入的语义意图。我们构建了一个全面的评估基准，包含八个文本和七个视觉恶意类别，并辅以良性数据集以严格测试误报。在多个领先LLM（包括Gemini-2.0-Flash、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct和Doubao-seed-1.6-flash）上的评估证明了该方法的有效性和泛化性。所提方法在文本任务上达到最高90.91%的准确率和100%的召回率；在视觉领域达到最高99.28%的准确率，同时在所有评估模型上保持100%的精确率。关键的是，在针对500个高度混淆的环境型Web智能体注入（WebInject）的评估中，MPIDetector的检测率高达99.80%。与两种文本PI检测基线方法以及两种额外的视觉输入检测方法的对比表明，MPIDetector具有更优的准确率。这些结果表明，LLM驱动的推理为对抗高级提示注入提供了稳健的跨模态防御。
translation.brief: 针对多模态提示注入难以用模式匹配方法检测的问题，提出通过少样本上下文学习利用LLM推理能力审视跨模态语义意图的MPIDetector框架。

papers.title: Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?
papers.abstract: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

translation.title: 游戏中适得其反的反馈：LLM玩家会重复刚目睹失败的走法吗？
translation.abstract: 当LLM智能体的走法失败时，框架会把该走法和失败消息写入对话记录并重新询问。在工具调用中，这种记录会让小模型更可能重复失败的动作。我们检验同样的现象是否也出现在游戏中（Sokoban、Connect Four、Othello），其中走法可能因非法而失败，也可能合法但落败，两者都可被精确验证。在通过对正确走法施加扰动构建的固定探针项上，这种记录适得其反：在8个指令微调模型（135M-1.7B）汇总统计下，它使失败走法更可能出现（纠正增益G = -1.38 nats per token），其影响通过走法的表面形式起作用，对非法走法成立而对落败走法不成立，且并非对所有模型都成立。一项探索性分析揭示了符号的决定因素：在记录之后，失败走法的对数概率几乎不依赖其先前的可能性（斜率0.18）。模型原本不会走的走法变得更可能，贪心解码开始产生它们；模型原本要走的走法变得不太可能，但贪心解码仍重复其中38%。省略走法字符串的失败描述则能保留模型的偏好。在OLMo 2 1B的后训练阶梯上，这种反转存在于基础模型中，并在DPO阶段被大幅消除。RAGEN的默认模型在RL之前就在RAGEN自己的Sokoban格式中出现反转。"不要重复"指令毫无作用，干净重试是最差的框架，解码器禁令能阻止完全重复但无法阻止非法走法。所有测量均在免费Colab GPU上以float32运行，并首先复现了原论文的数字。
translation.brief: 研究LLM在游戏走法失败后反而更倾向重复失败走法的现象，通过固定探针项和日志概率分析定位其成因并评估各种干预手段。

papers.title: MoEZip: Routing-Aware KV Cache Compression for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model capacity efficiently by activating a small subset of parameters per token. However, in long-context inference, memory remains a major bottleneck because the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce this cost for dense transformers, but overlook a problem specific to MoE: KV eviction can change which experts are selected during answer generation, degrading the generation quality. We propose MoEZip, a routing-aware KV cache compression for sparse MoE language models. To estimate the sensitivity of expert routing to perturbation, we propose a novel metric based on the Fisher information matrix of routing distributions. MoEZip combines this metric with attention weights for routing-aware scoring of contexts. Finally, we compose a complementary scoring system that combines eviction methods for dense and sparse-MoE architectures. Experiments show that MoEZip achieves robust performance under aggressive cache compression on various benchmarks. At a KV retention ratio of 10\%, MoEZip improves over the SoTA baseline by +24 and +20 points on average on LongBench and RULER, corresponding to 2.3$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ higher scores, respectively.

translation.title: MoEZip：面向稀疏混合专家LLM的路由感知KV缓存压缩
translation.abstract: 混合专家语言模型通过每个token只激活一小部分参数来高效扩展模型容量。然而在长上下文推理中，内存仍是主要瓶颈，因为KV缓存随序列长度线性增长。现有KV缓存压缩方法降低了稠密transformer的成本，但忽略了MoE特有的问题：KV驱逐可能改变答案生成期间被选中的专家，从而降低生成质量。我们提出MoEZip，一种面向稀疏MoE语言模型的路由感知KV缓存压缩方法。为估计专家路由对扰动的敏感度，我们提出一种基于路由分布Fisher信息矩阵的新指标。MoEZip将该指标与注意力权重结合，进行路由感知的上下文评分。最后，我们构建了一个互补的评分系统，融合稠密与稀疏MoE架构的驱逐方法。实验表明，MoEZip在激进缓存压缩下于多个基准上取得稳健性能。在10%的KV保留率下，MoEZip在LongBench和RULER上平均比SoTA基线分别高出24分和20分，对应2.3倍和4.9倍的分数提升。
translation.brief: 针对KV缓存驱逐会改变MoE专家路由选择的问题，提出基于Fisher信息的路由感知评分来指导缓存压缩。

papers.title: AI Mindmeld: A Latent Interconnect Protocol
papers.abstract: LLMs can act as scientific agents using tools to consult specialists and run experiments. Yet specialist information must enter their context, generally as text, images, audio or video: a bottleneck between models with rich, high-dimensional representations. We advocate direct representation exchange: a mindmeld conveying many properties, including information an LLM would not think to request. It should be extensible to new specialists, flexible across questions and tasks, and compositional across independently connected specialists without joint training. The Latent Interconnect Protocol (LIP) learns connectors mapping specialist representations into LLM internal states. Training only connectors keeps this practical as LLMs grow and evolve. We connect three protein and three small molecule specialists to Gemma 3 (4B and 12B parameters) and Kimi K2.6 (1T total, 32B active), freezing all pretrained models. Independently trained connectors provide useful information without changing the LLM or existing connectors, supporting familiar and new question types about unseen objects. We demonstrate zero-shot transfer to cross-domain tasks without joint training. Task performance and compositionality generally improve with LLM capability, with especially strong gains in zero-shot task transfer. Limitations remain: current LLMs were not trained for specialist representations as native inputs; access does not ensure reliable interpretation, integration or use in reasoning. We call on specialist developers to provide consistent representation interfaces and, especially, on LLM developers to train models to receive, combine and reason with these inputs. These efforts could expand scientific agents' information while preserving conventional tools' flexibility. Data, pretrained connectors, and code for training, evaluation and interactive inference: https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld

translation.title: AI Mindmeld：一种潜在互连协议
translation.abstract: LLM可以作为科学智能体，使用工具咨询专家并运行实验。然而专家信息必须进入其上下文，通常以文本、图像、音频或视频形式：这构成了拥有丰富高维表示的模型之间的瓶颈。我们倡导直接表示交换：一种mindmeld，传递众多属性，包括LLM不会想到去请求的信息。它应可扩展到新专家，灵活适应不同问题和任务，并在无需联合训练的情况下跨独立连接的专家实现组合。潜在互连协议学习将专家表示映射到LLM内部状态的连接器。只训练连接器使其在LLM增长和演进时保持实用。我们将三个蛋白质专家和三个小分子专家连接到Gemma 3（4B和12B参数）和Kimi K2.6（总参数1T，激活32B），冻结所有预训练模型。独立训练的连接器在不改变LLM或现有连接器的情况下提供有用信息，支持对未见对象的熟悉和新问题类型。我们展示了无需联合训练的零样本跨域任务迁移。任务性能和组合性通常随LLM能力提升，零样本任务迁移中提升尤其显著。局限仍然存在：当前LLM并未被训练以接受专家表示作为原生输入；接入并不能确保在推理中可靠地解释、整合或使用。我们呼吁专家开发者提供一致的表示接口，尤其呼吁LLM开发者训练模型以接收、组合并推理这些输入。这些努力可以在保留传统工具灵活性的同时扩展科学智能体的信息。数据、预训练连接器以及训练、评估和交互式推理代码：https://github.com/PolymathicAI/AI-Mindmeld
translation.brief: 针对LLM与专家模型间以文本为媒介的信息瓶颈，提出通过学习连接器将专家潜在表示直接注入LLM内部状态的LIP协议。

papers.title: JANUS: Agentic Cross-Language Fuzzing Harness Generation for Android Native Libraries
papers.abstract: Modern Android apps extensively rely on native libraries, bridging Java/Kotlin and C/C++ through the Java Native Interface (JNI). This cross-language interoperation, however, exposes the memory-safe Android Runtime to the unsafe C/C++ world, creating an attack surface that has been repeatedly exploited for full device compromise. While fuzzing is a proven technique for vetting native libraries, state-of-the-art harness generation tools struggle to faithfully capture closed-source cross-language API usage: (i) precise program analysis across the JNI boundary does not scale, whereas lightweight approximations miss critical invocation patterns; and (ii) none tackles the construction of complex composite objects consumed by JNI methods. In this paper, we propose JANUS, the first agentic approach to synthesizing cross-language JNI-aware fuzzing harnesses for Android native libraries. JANUS iteratively resolves both explicit and implicit cross-language call dependencies to recover app-specific runtime context, and recursively assembles cross-language argument objects in a bottom-up manner. JANUS leverages an autonomous agentic workflow to reduce reliance on hand-crafted heuristics, capturing the vast landscape of hidden API usage knowledge embedded in closed-source native libraries. Evaluation on 44 popular real-world apps (such as Google and YouTube Music, covering 21,386 JNI methods total) shows that JANUS produces over 5.9 times as many valid harnesses (6,094) as state-of-the-art automatic harnessing tools. On pre-installed apps from five mainstream Android vendors (e.g., Xiaomi, Vivo, Samsung), JANUS further uncovers 6 previously unknown vulnerabilities in closed-source native libraries.

translation.title: JANUS：面向Android原生库的智能体式跨语言模糊测试驱动生成
translation.abstract: 现代Android应用大量依赖原生库，通过Java本地接口（JNI）桥接Java/Kotlin与C/C++。然而这种跨语言互操作使内存安全的Android Runtime暴露于不安全的C/C++世界，形成了一个被反复利用以实现完整设备攻陷的攻击面。模糊测试是检验原生库的成熟技术，但最先进的驱动生成工具难以忠实捕捉闭源跨语言API用法：(i) 跨JNI边界的精确程序分析无法扩展，而轻量级近似又会遗漏关键调用模式；(ii) 没有工具能构建JNI方法消费的复杂复合对象。本文提出JANUS，首个面向Android原生库的智能体式跨语言JNI感知模糊测试驱动合成方法。JANUS迭代解析显式和隐式跨语言调用依赖以恢复应用特定的运行时上下文，并以自底向上的方式递归组装跨语言参数对象。JANUS利用自主智能体工作流减少对手工启发式的依赖，捕捉闭源原生库中蕴含的大量隐藏API用法知识。在44个热门真实应用（如Google和YouTube Music，共覆盖21,386个JNI方法）上的评估显示，JANUS生成的有效驱动（6,094个）是最先进自动驱动工具的5.9倍以上。在五家主流Android厂商（如小米、Vivo、三星）的预装应用上，JANUS进一步在闭源原生库中发现了6个此前未知的漏洞。
translation.brief: 针对Android原生库闭源跨语言JNI调用难以生成模糊测试驱动的问题，提出智能体式迭代解析跨语言依赖并递归组装参数对象的JANUS。

papers.title: Agentic Architecture of Information Systems. The AAM/5C Model: A Reference Model for Distributed Autonomy
papers.abstract: Large organizations increasingly face what this book calls the cognitive complexity wall: at the scale of hundreds of interacting components, maintaining the dependency map and reacting at the pace of incidents exceeds what a human team can deliver. This conceptual volume proposes AAM/5C, in which five capabilities (Capture, Comprehend, Choose, Coordinate, Control) are instantiated across seven logical layers, L1 to L7. A single authorization rule, R-AUT, separates who proposes, who decides and who executes: a probabilistic planner (L4) proposes; a governance layer (L6) decides under signed policies and records its verdict in a signed evaluation proof; a security layer (L5) issues a short-lived act token bound to that proof; a policy enforcement point verifies both before the target layer materializes the act. Under an explicit guarantee contract, two analytical statements (H7a, H8a) hold by construction. The other statements of its ten hypotheses (H1 to H10), including log completeness (H7b) and non-bypass of the enforcement point (H8b), are refutable, and the protocol that could refute them is fixed before any measurement. The contribution of the book is a prescriptive reference model that articulates, under this single authorization rule, known mechanisms and adds three constructs, all to be validated: the Validation step of the Distributed Autonomy Loop, the ephemeral authority surface and the cognitive dependency plane. The book positions them against autonomic computing, multi-agent systems, enterprise architecture and agent protocols (MCP, A2A), gives an authorization policy in Rego and a partial TLA+ specification of peer consensus, and sets out a validation program with quantified milestones. It reports no empirical results. This English edition is a translation of the French original, produced with the assistance of AI tools and validated by the author.

translation.title: 信息系统智能体式架构。AAM/5C模型：分布式自治参考模型
translation.abstract: 大型组织日益面临本书所称的认知复杂性之墙：在数百个交互组件的规模下，维护依赖图谱并以事件发生的速度做出反应，超出了人类团队所能交付的能力。本概念性著作提出AAM/5C，其中五种能力（捕获Capture、理解Comprehend、选择Choose、协调Coordinate、控制Control）在七个逻辑层L1至L7中实例化。单一的授权规则R-AUT区分提议者、决策者和执行者：概率规划器（L4）提议；治理层（L6）在签名策略下决策并将裁定记录在签名评估证明中；安全层（L5）签发与该证明绑定的短时效行动令牌；策略执行点在目标层落实行动之前验证两者。在明确的保证契约下，两条分析性命题（H7a、H8a）由构造成立。其十条假设（H1至H10）中的其余命题，包括日志完整性（H7b）和不可绕过执行点（H8b），是可被反驳的，且可能反驳它们的协议在任何测量之前即已固定。本书的贡献是一个规定性参考模型，在这一单一授权规则下组织已知机制，并增加三个有待验证的构造：分布式自治回路的验证步骤、瞬时权限面和认知依赖平面。本书将其与自主计算、多智能体系统、企业架构和智能体协议（MCP、A2A）进行对照，给出Rego语言的授权策略和点对点共识的部分TLA+规范，并制定了带量化里程碑的验证计划。本书未报告任何实证结果。本英文版译自法语原版，借助AI工具完成并经作者校验。
translation.brief: 针对大型组织在数百组件规模下依赖管理与事件响应超出人力的问题，提出以单一授权规则贯穿五能力七层的AAM/5C分布式自治参考模型。

papers.title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
papers.abstract: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify mathematical hypotheses. Through this interactive loop, we derive a five-parameter construction, which we call the Generalized Boyd algorithm. It eliminates degree-skipping and constructs irreducible polynomials with Mahler measure strictly below Boyd's limit point $\alpha_1 \approx 1.255434$ for every target degree. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, our approach improves upon six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records. With this work we release the verified dataset of polynomials with minimal Mahler measure across all studied even degrees.

translation.title: 以人机协同发现循环突破Lehmer问题的高次项障碍
translation.abstract: 尽管人工智能在数学推理方面进展迅速，许多开放问题依赖于只有通过大规模计算探索与分析综合才能揭示的结构。1933年提出的Lehmer问题便是其中一例：它询问整数多项式的Mahler测度——衡量其根偏离单位圆的程度——能否被做得任意小。此前，构造具有小Mahler测度的不可约整系数多项式仅在偶数次数 $d \le 180$ 范围内有系统方法。在更高次数下，Boyd的解析单参数族频繁可约，跳过了近50%的目标次数，使得任意次数 $d$ 缺乏一般性构造。我们通过人机协同发现循环来应对高次项区域：在对话式提示的基础上，扩展了快速数值流水线、精确符号验证器和大规模分布式搜索。AI智能体在本地对数值与符号求解器进行原型开发，在分布式集群上启动并行搜索，并与人类研究者合作提取和验证数学假设。通过这一交互循环，我们导出了一个五参数构造，称为广义Boyd算法。它消除了次数跳跃问题，并对每个目标次数都构造出Mahler测度严格低于Boyd极限点 $\alpha_1 \approx 1.255434$ 的不可约多项式。在直至2000的所有偶数次数上评估，我们的方法改进了六个已发表值，并保持了99.6%的所有最佳已知记录。我们随本文发布了所有已研究偶数次数上具有最小Mahler测度的多项式经验证的数据集。
translation.brief: 解决任意偶数次不可约小Mahler测度整系数多项式构造缺失的问题，方法是人机协同发现循环导出的五参数广义Boyd算法。

papers.title: SWE-VERIFIER: Selective Verification for Cost-Efficient Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents spend substantial computation generating actions and processing long interaction histories. Poor action choices can steer agents into low-value states, wasting computation and increasing API costs. Sampling and verifying alternative actions can improve the agent's decisions, but applying this procedure at every step adds substantial overhead. We introduce SWE-Verifier, a lightweight generative model that selectively triggers candidate sampling and verification. It scores the coding agent's proposed action to determine when additional candidate sampling is needed, then ranks the resulting actions before execution. We train SWE-Verifier from Qwen3.5-4B using preference data that groups contrasting actions with their resulting environment observations and rubric-guided teacher scores. Using the mini-swe-agent harness, SWE-Verifier improves resolution from 75.47% to 77.20% on MiniMax-M2.7 at 1.09 times cost and generalizes to DeepSeek-V4-Flash without training on its actions, improving resolution from 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13 times cost. Across both models, SWE-Verifier verifies fewer than 4% of steps and achieves comparable or higher resolution than the trajectory and all-step baselines at substantially lower cost. These results demonstrate that selective candidate sampling and lightweight verification provide complementary gains in coding-agent performance and inference efficiency. Our model, code, and data are available at https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier.

translation.title: SWE-VERIFIER：面向高性价比编码智能体的选择性验证
translation.abstract: 编码智能体在生成动作和处理长交互历史上花费大量计算。糟糕的动作选择会把智能体引入低价值状态，浪费计算并增加API成本。采样并验证备选动作可以改善智能体的决策，但在每一步都执行该流程会带来可观的开销。我们提出SWE-Verifier，一个轻量级生成式模型，可选择性触发候选采样与验证。它对编码智能体提出的动作进行打分，以判断何时需要额外的候选采样，然后在执行前对候选动作排序。我们使用Qwen3.5-4B，基于将对比动作与其环境观测结果及评分细则引导的教师打分分组的偏好数据来训练SWE-Verifier。在mini-swe-agent框架下，SWE-Verifier以1.09倍成本将MiniMax-M2.7的解决率从75.47%提升至77.20%，并在未在其动作上训练的情况下泛化到DeepSeek-V4-Flash，以1.13倍成本将解决率从72.60%提升至74.27%。在两个模型上，SWE-Verifier仅验证不到4%的步骤，并以显著更低的成本达到与轨迹基线和全步骤基线相当或更高的解决率。这些结果表明，选择性候选采样与轻量级验证在编码智能体性能和推理效率上提供了互补收益。我们的模型、代码和数据可在 https://github.com/zkjzou/SWE-Verifier 获取。
translation.brief: 解决编码智能体逐步全量验证开销过大的问题，方法是训练轻量级模型选择性触发候选采样与动作验证。

papers.title: GAV: A scientific experimentation environment for PDE agents
papers.abstract: Reliable feedback is essential for coding agents to develop programs for partial differential equations (PDEs). Yet evaluating these programs on new PDE problems often requires expensive reference computations, while fixed datasets restrict the range of experiments. We introduce Generator-Agent-Verifier (GAV), a scientific experimentation environment that makes new PDE problems verifiable by construction. The Generator learns a distribution of continuous reference solutions using data from numerical simulations or experimental measurements to represent a target physical regime. Using the method of manufactured solutions, it works backward from the generated reference solutions to construct matching PDE problems without a separate numerical solve. The Agent designs experiments, investigates failures, and iteratively improves its program. The Verifier evaluates candidate programs against the reference solutions and provides numerical feedback on accuracy and computational cost. This feedback can also guide the generation of new problems that probe the current program's weaknesses. We provide a theoretical analysis of evaluation reliability and guided development. Experiments on Navier-Stokes and Vlasov-Poisson-type equations across different data sources and regimes demonstrate the effectiveness of GAV. In particular, on the numerical Navier-Stokes task, GAV reduces the mean test error of three existing PDE agents by more than an order of magnitude relative to their original setups. Code is available at https://github.com/PotatoJnny/PDE-GAV.

translation.title: GAV：面向PDE智能体的科学实验环境
translation.abstract: 可靠的反馈对编码智能体开发偏微分方程（PDE）程序至关重要。然而，在新PDE问题上评估这些程序通常需要昂贵的参考计算，而固定数据集限制了实验范围。我们提出Generator-Agent-Verifier（GAV），一个通过构造使新PDE问题可验证的科学实验环境。生成器利用来自数值模拟或实验测量的数据学习连续参考解的分布，以表示目标物理区域。借助制造解方法，它从生成的参考解反向构造匹配的PDE问题，而无需单独的数值求解。智能体设计实验、调查失败并迭代改进其程序。验证器对照参考解评估候选程序，并就精度和计算成本提供数值反馈。该反馈还可指导生成探测当前程序弱点的新问题。我们提供了关于评估可靠性与引导式开发的理论分析。在不同数据源和区域的Navier-Stokes及Vlasov-Poisson类方程上的实验证明了GAV的有效性。特别是在数值Navier-Stokes任务上，GAV将三个现有PDE智能体的平均测试误差相对其原始设置降低了一个数量级以上。代码可在 https://github.com/PotatoJnny/PDE-GAV 获取。
translation.brief: 解决PDE程序评估依赖昂贵参考计算的问题，方法是用制造解法构造可验证新问题的生成-智能体-验证器环境。

papers.title: Measuring Research Progress and Linguistic Inclusion in Low-Resource Languages
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have accelerated research on low-resource and multilingual NLP, but their effectiveness in creating an equitable landscape remains unmapped. We analyze 1,158 peer-reviewed open-access papers published between 2020 and 2025, examining research attention to low-resource languages (LRLs) and representation across language and speaker populations. To assess linguistic inclusion beyond publication counts, we introduce the Linguistic Inclusion Framework (LIF), a multidimensional framework that measures linguistic inclusion in four dimensions: research growth, representation expansion, representation continuity, and distributional equity. While annual publications grew from 52 to 415, a 5.4X increase in their ACL Anthology publication share, this growth largely concentrated on represented languages rather than expanding coverage of underrepresented languages. Further analysis shows that languages spoken in Asia account for 64.1% of speakers across LRLs we analyze but receive only 46.7% of the language representation share (0.7X their proportional share), while European languages receive 5.3X their proportional share. At the country level, linguistically diverse regions such as sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia show the lowest language coverage ratios. Applying the framework at the continental level, we find that no region scores well on all four dimensions, showing that research growth alone is not a reliable metric of progress toward equitable and inclusive language technology\footnote{We will release all collected and annotated data for research purposes}.

translation.title: 衡量低资源语言的研究进展与语言包容性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）加速了低资源与多语言NLP的研究，但其在营造公平格局方面的有效性仍不明朗。我们分析了2020年至2025年间发表的1,158篇同行评审开放获取论文，考察对低资源语言（LRL）的研究关注以及语言和说话人群体上的代表性。为超越发表数量评估语言包容性，我们提出语言包容性框架（LIF），从四个维度衡量语言包容性：研究增长、代表性扩展、代表连续性和分布公平性。虽然年度论文数量从52篇增长到415篇，其在ACL Anthology发表份额增长了5.4倍，但这种增长主要集中于已被代表的语言，而非扩展对代表性不足语言的覆盖。进一步分析显示，在所分析的LRL中，亚洲语言的使用者占64.1%，却仅获得46.7%的语言代表份额（为其比例份额的0.7倍），而欧洲语言获得其比例份额的5.3倍。在国家层面，撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚等语言多样性高的地区显示出最低的语言覆盖比率。在洲际层面应用该框架，我们发现没有任何地区在全部四个维度上得分良好，这表明仅凭研究增长并不是衡量语言技术朝公平包容方向进展的可靠指标。
translation.brief: 解决低资源语言NLP研究公平性缺乏量化衡量的问题，方法是提出四维度的语言包容性框架并分析2020-2025年论文。

papers.title: The Customer Is the Builder: How AI Coding Agents Are Rewriting the Economics of Software
papers.abstract: AI coding agents could change whether organizations buy software or build the functionality they need. We focus on organizations and professional buyers whose domain knowledge can help them specify and evaluate tools for their work. We define the software substitution frontier as the functions customers could build and maintain at an acceptable standard for less than buying them. Using public data, we compare growing capacity to build with indicators of market change. Since 2023, the length of benchmark tasks that leading agents can complete at 50 percent success, measured in human working time, has doubled about every 129 days. A broad search identified 575 potential open-source alternatives to selected commercial products, although some functional matches still require independent validation. The Craft suite produced 12 application repositories over 12.0 days of public development, but these remain early versions with unverified completeness and reliability. Market evidence is mixed: purchased software gained US investment share and tracked commercial installations grew. Yet 32 percent of respondents to an organizational survey reported forgoing at least one software purchase because their organization could build the functionality with coding agents. These self-reports do not establish the spending displaced or the reliability of the resulting tools. The gap motivates a warning: customers' capacity to build could affect individual buying decisions before a broad purchasing shift becomes visible. We examine this possibility using benchmark projections and observable market tests. The projections are an extrapolation, not a forecast of customer switching.

translation.title: 客户即建造者：AI编码智能体如何重写软件经济学
translation.abstract: AI编码智能体可能改变组织是购买软件还是自行构建所需功能。我们关注那些领域知识能帮助其规范和评估工作工具的组织与专业买家。我们定义软件替代前沿为客户能以可接受标准且成本低于购买而自行构建和维护的功能。利用公开数据，我们将不断增长的构建能力与市场变化指标进行比较。自2023年以来，领先智能体能以50%成功率完成的基准任务长度（以人类工作时间衡量）大约每129天翻一番。一项广泛搜索识别出575个选定商业产品的潜在开源替代品，尽管某些功能匹配仍需独立验证。Craft套件在12.0天的公开开发中产出了12个应用仓库，但这些仍是完整性和可靠性未经核实的早期版本。市场证据并不一致：购买型软件获得了美国投资份额，且跟踪的商业安装量在增长。然而，一项组织调查中32%的受访者表示，由于组织能用编码智能体构建所需功能，他们放弃了至少一次软件购买。这些自我报告并不能确定被替代的支出或所构建工具的可靠性。这一差距引发一个警示：在广泛的购买转变显现之前，客户的构建能力就可能影响个体的购买决策。我们利用基准预测和可观测的市场检验来考察这种可能性。这些预测是外推，而非对客户转换的预测。
translation.brief: 考察组织是否会用AI编码智能体自行构建功能以替代购买软件的问题，方法是通过基准能力外推与市场数据检验定义并分析软件替代前沿。

papers.title: AQL-Lite: Enabling Efficient Knowledge Acquisition for Arabic LLMs via Data-Centric Continual Pretraining
papers.abstract: Training Arabic large language models faces challenges from noisy web data, dialectal variation, and the high cost of continual pretraining (CPT). We introduce AQL-Lite (AQL: Arabic Quality Language), a time- and resource-efficient framework for adapting a multilingual LLM to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). AQL-Lite couples a quality-first curation pipeline (structural cleaning, heuristic and model-based filtering, MSA selection, and deduplication) with a partial-parameter CPT recipe that trains RS-LoRA adapters across the network together with the last eight transformer blocks and the embedding matrix, under layer-wise learning rates. At a matched 1B-token budget, CPT on AQL-curated data raises a four-benchmark Arabic mean by 3.51 points over CPT on raw web text, which yields no gain over the base model. In a controlled 5B-token comparison, AQL-Lite recovers 94% of the gain of full-parameter CPT (mean 73.19 vs. 73.58) in 52% of the wall-clock time and outperforms adapter-only baselines on every benchmark, and a component ablation shows that adapters, unfrozen blocks, and embedding training each contribute. Scaled to 40B MSA tokens and instruction-tuned on one million examples, the resulting 12B model scores 75.3 on the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2 (OALL v2) suite. These results suggest that partial-parameter CPT on a carefully curated corpus is a practical route to efficient MSA adaptation.

translation.title: AQL-Lite：通过以数据为中心的持续预训练实现阿拉伯语大语言模型的高效知识获取
translation.abstract: 训练阿拉伯语大语言模型面临网络数据噪声大、方言变体多以及持续预训练（CPT）成本高等挑战。我们提出 AQL-Lite（AQL：Arabic Quality Language），一个时间和资源高效的框架，用于将多语言大语言模型适配到现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。AQL-Lite 将一个质量优先的数据筛选流水线（结构化清洗、启发式与基于模型的过滤、MSA 选择和去重）与部分参数 CPT 方案相结合：在全网络训练 RS-LoRA 适配器，同时训练最后八个 transformer 块和嵌入矩阵，并采用逐层学习率。在相同的 1B token 预算下，使用 AQL 筛选数据进行 CPT 相比使用原始网络文本进行 CPT，在四个基准上的阿拉伯语平均分提升 3.51 分，而后者相比基础模型没有提升。在受控的 5B token 对比中，AQL-Lite 以 52% 的实际耗时恢复了全参数 CPT 94% 的增益（平均分 73.19 对 73.58），并在所有基准上优于仅适配器的基线；组件消融实验表明适配器、解冻块和嵌入训练各有贡献。扩展到 40B MSA token 并在 100 万样本上进行指令微调后，所得 12B 模型在包含七个基准的 Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard v2（OALL v2）套件上得分 75.3。这些结果表明，在精心筛选的语料上进行部分参数 CPT 是实现高效 MSA 适配的可行路径。
translation.brief: 解决阿拉伯语大模型持续预训练成本高的问题，方法是将质量优先的数据筛选流水线与部分参数（RS-LoRA 适配器加部分层）CPT 方案相结合。

papers.title: Consistency Is Not Validity: Self-Rewarded Moral Argumentation Makes Language Models Decisive but Pliable
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly consulted for moral judgment. We aim to improve performance on such tasks by rewarding good arguments, on the premise that arguing well increases the likelihood of judging well. We train a reinforcement learning policy initialized from a state-of-the-art language model in a self-judged tournament with masked thinking: the generated arguments are judged pairwise on argument quality by the policy itself. As an empirical basis, we extract authentic dilemmas from classic novels, using a logic solver to verify that each constitutes a conflict. We show that our judge rates argument quality like human annotators, and the policy then adopts the language register that it rewards. Testing on the external benchmarks MoralChoice, ELEPHANT, and MORABLES, we find that the policy becomes more decisive and invariant to the order in which options are presented, but sycophancy and reframing remain a challenge to validity. Two ablation studies with synthetic dilemmas and unmasked thinking match the reordering gains, but show a weaker register shift and higher sycophancy. We conclude that consistency is not validity: consistency under reordering can be optimized without improving the moral judgment it is meant to signal.

translation.title: 一致性不等于有效性：自我奖励的道德论证使语言模型果断但易受影响
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于道德判断咨询。我们旨在通过奖励好的论证来提升此类任务的性能，前提是论证得好会增加判断得好的可能性。我们从一个最先进的大语言模型初始化，训练了一个强化学习策略，采用带掩蔽思考的自我评判锦标赛：生成的论证由策略本身按论证质量进行两两评判。作为实证基础，我们从经典小说中提取真实的道德困境，并使用逻辑求解器验证每个困境确实构成冲突。我们表明，我们的评判者对论证质量的评分与人类标注者一致，随后策略会采用它所奖励的语言风格。在 MoralChoice、ELEPHANT 和 MORABLES 等外部基准上测试发现，该策略变得更加果断，且对选项呈现顺序保持不变，但谄媚性和重新框定仍是有效性的挑战。使用合成困境和不掩蔽思考的两项消融实验与重排序增益相符，但表现出较弱的语言风格转变和更高的谄媚性。我们得出结论：一致性不等于有效性——重排序下的一致性可以被优化，而它本应代表的道德判断并未得到改善。
translation.brief: 解决提升 LLM 道德判断能力的问题，方法是用自我评判锦标赛式的强化学习奖励高质量论证。

papers.title: Route-and-Generate: KL-Regularized Router Improvement for Reasoning Routing in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models often apply complex reasoning indiscriminately, leading to overthinking on simple tasks and underthinking on harder ones. We present Route-and-Generate (Rouge), a hierarchical training framework that enables LLMs to adaptively decide when and how much reasoning is required for each input. Our approach decouples reasoning effort allocation from answer generation by introducing a routing policy that allocates a fixed sampling budget across multiple reasoning formats, while the base model is optimized with GRPO using per-sample rewards. To promote efficient reasoning, we employ a rank-based reward that favors shorter correct solutions, and update the routing policy via a closed-form KL-regularized policy improvement step distilled into a neural router. This design encourages concise answers on easy problems while reserving longer reasoning for harder ones, achieving improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across multiple reasoning benchmarks.

translation.title: Route-and-Generate：用于大语言模型推理路由的 KL 正则化路由器改进
translation.abstract: 大语言模型常常不加区分地应用复杂推理，导致在简单任务上过度思考、在困难任务上思考不足。我们提出 Route-and-Generate（Rouge），一个分层训练框架，使大语言模型能够自适应地决定每个输入何时需要推理以及需要多少推理。我们的方法通过引入一个路由策略将推理努力分配与答案生成解耦：路由策略在多种推理格式之间分配固定的采样预算，而基础模型则使用逐样本奖励通过 GRPO 进行优化。为促进高效推理，我们采用偏好更短正确解的基于排名的奖励，并通过闭式 KL 正则化策略改进步骤更新路由策略，再将其蒸馏到神经路由器中。这一设计鼓励在简单问题上给出简洁答案，同时为更难的问题保留更长的推理，在多个推理基准上实现了更好的准确率-效率权衡。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 推理努力分配不当（过度或不足思考）的问题，方法是用 KL 正则化策略改进训练一个路由策略来分配推理预算。

papers.title: FAIRGate: Agentic Runtime Policy Selection and Verified Repair for Fairer Recommendation Delivery
papers.abstract: Fairness-aware recommender systems often encode one fairness objective during training or apply a fixed re-ranking rule after scoring. In deployment, however, the appropriate fairness action can vary across requests because the candidate pool, item metadata, exposure debt, user preference history, and utility budget all change at runtime. We propose FAIRGate, a model-agnostic delivery controller that places an agentic policy-selection layer between a base ranker and the final top-K list. The agent does not define fairness objectives from scratch. It chooses from a predefined policy library covering long-tail exposure, item-group exposure balance, concentration control, calibration protection, and abstention. A deterministic executor then applies the selected policy through constrained repair, and a validator accepts the result only when relevance, feasibility, metadata, calibration, and audit constraints are satisfied. The final language-model component receives only the verified audit trace and produces evidence-linked narration after the ranking decision is fixed. This design gives the agent runtime responsibility while keeping fairness enforcement measurable, bounded, and replayable.

translation.title: FAIRGate：面向更公平推荐分发的智能体式运行时策略选择与经验证的修复
translation.abstract: 公平性感知的推荐系统通常在训练时编码单一公平性目标，或在打分后应用固定的重排序规则。然而在部署中，合适的公平性动作可能因请求而异，因为候选池、物品元数据、曝光欠账、用户偏好历史和效用预算都在运行时变化。我们提出 FAIRGate，一个模型无关的分发控制器，在基础排序器和最终 top-K 列表之间放置一个智能体式策略选择层。该智能体不从零定义公平性目标，而是从预定义的策略库中选择，涵盖长尾曝光、物品组曝光平衡、集中度控制、校准保护和弃权。随后一个确定性执行器通过受限修复应用所选策略，一个验证器仅在相关性、可行性、元数据、校准和审计约束均满足时才接受结果。最终的语言模型组件只接收经验证的审计轨迹，并在排序决策确定后生成带证据链接的叙述。这一设计赋予智能体运行时职责，同时保证公平性执行是可度量、有界且可重放的。
translation.brief: 解决推荐系统公平性动作需随运行时条件变化的问题，方法是用智能体从预定义策略库中选择策略并由确定性执行器与验证器实施经验证的受限修复。

papers.title: Data-Void Exploits in Web-Searching LLMs
papers.abstract: Web-searching Large Language Models (LLMs) have changed how users seek online information: instead of sifting through ranked lists of links, users read synthesized answers. This shift creates a new LLM vulnerability: a data-void exploit. Disinformers publish their narratives in search spaces where relevant and reliable content is scarce, i.e. data voids, then rely on the LLM's web-search to retrieve and then use, cite, or list those pages in its responses to data-void seeking prompts. Unlike classical search, where users see ranking cues and competing results, LLMs can obscure when an answer relies on sparse, unverified, or adversarial sources. We study this threat by varying the user's prompt tone - skeptical, excited, or neutral - and LLM choice - ChatGPT, Gemini, or Sonar Pro - as well as three attacker controls. The attacker can use one of five known strategies to construct and fill a data void with their narrative, host their content at varying levels of visibility from well-established, indexed domains to less established ones, and include generative-optimization engine features thought to boost citing by web-searching LLMs. We find that data-void exploits can succeed with only a single attacker controlled page. Across all conditions, attacker-content appears in LLM responses 31% of the time. User controls offer limited protection: while skeptical prompts slightly reduce success and slightly increase flagging or warnings in LLM responses, we find no evidence of large effects of prompt tone or model choice on success rates, although smaller effects cannot be ruled out. Overall, our results establish data voids as a practical inference-time attack surface for manipulating web-searching LLMs through strategically placed web content and highlight the urgent need for defenses against such exploits.

translation.title: 网络搜索型大语言模型中的数据空洞利用
translation.abstract: 具备网络搜索能力的大语言模型改变了用户获取在线信息的方式：用户不再翻阅排序的链接列表，而是阅读综合后的答案。这一转变催生了一种新的 LLM 漏洞：数据空洞利用。虚假信息传播者在相关且可靠内容稀缺的搜索空间（即数据空洞）中发布其叙事，然后依赖 LLM 的网络搜索检索这些页面，并在其回答数据空洞类提示时使用、引用或列出这些页面。与传统搜索不同——用户能看到排序线索和竞争性结果——LLM 可能掩盖其答案依赖于稀疏、未经验证或对抗性来源的事实。我们通过变化用户提示语气（怀疑、兴奋或中性）、LLM 选择（ChatGPT、Gemini 或 Sonar Pro）以及三个攻击者控制项来研究这一威胁。攻击者可使用五种已知策略之一构建并填充数据空洞，将内容托管在从知名已索引域名到较不知名域名的不同可见度层级，并加入被认为能提升网络搜索型 LLM 引用率的生成式优化引擎特性。我们发现，数据空洞利用仅需攻击者控制的一个页面即可成功。在所有条件下，攻击者内容出现在 LLM 回答中的比例为 31%。用户控制提供的保护有限：怀疑性提示虽略微降低成功率并略微增加 LLM 回答中的标记或警告，但我们未发现提示语气或模型选择对成功率有大的影响的证据，尽管不能排除较小的效应。总体而言，我们的结果确立了数据空洞是通过策略性放置的网络内容操纵网络搜索型 LLM 的一个现实推理时攻击面，并凸显了防御此类利用的迫切需求。
translation.brief: 研究数据空洞攻击对网络搜索型 LLM 的威胁，方法是通过系统变化提示语气、模型选择和攻击者控制项来测量攻击者内容被引用的成功率。

papers.title: Cutting a Cake For Human Consumption: An Elementary $n$-agent Cake Cutting Protocol
papers.abstract: We give a bounded envy-free cake-cutting protocol for any number $n$ of agents in the Robertson--Webb model, with a short, self-contained, and elementary correctness proof. The protocol uses $2^{O(n \log n)}$ queries. Most ingredients are already known and well understood in the fair division literature; our main contribution is a simpler organization of these ideas into a protocol whose complete description and proof fit in a few pages.

translation.title: 为人类切蛋糕：一个初等的 n 方蛋糕切分协议
translation.abstract: 我们在 Robertson--Webb 模型下给出了适用于任意数量 n 个参与者的有界无嫉妒蛋糕切分协议，并附有简短、自包含且初等的正确性证明。该协议使用 2^{O(n log n)} 次查询。大部分组成部分在公平分配文献中已为人熟知且被充分理解；我们的主要贡献是以更简单的方式将这些思想组织成一个协议，其完整描述和证明只需几页篇幅。
translation.brief: 解决任意 n 方的无嫉妒蛋糕切分协议问题，核心方法是将已知公平分配技术以更简洁的方式组织成有界查询次数的协议并给出初等正确性证明。

papers.title: Text-Only LLM Correctors Break Correct Transcripts: A Repair-Damage Analysis of Audio Grounding in ASR Error Correction
papers.abstract: LLM correctors of ASR output are judged by aggregate WER, which hides what they fix and what they break. We decompose every WER change exactly into repaired tokens, damaged tokens and insertions, and use this to ask what the source audio adds to a corrector. We compare correction with and without the audio, for the model's own draft and for the output of an independent recogniser, on three corpora. With Gemini 2.5 Flash, text-only correction of its own draft breaks 13-32% of already-correct transcripts; with the audio, 1-3%. Damage falls in both settings. Repair falls against the own draft and rises against the recogniser. On medical dictation, kept insertions cancel the gain in net WER. The open-weight Voxtral, which rarely edits, does not show this pattern. Prompts differ between the two arms, so the contrasts bound the effect of the audio and do not isolate it.

translation.title: 纯文本 LLM 纠错器会破坏原本正确的转录文本：ASR 错误纠正中音频接地作用的修复-损伤分析
translation.abstract: 对 ASR 输出的 LLM 纠错器通常以聚合 WER 来评判，这掩盖了它们修复了什么、又破坏了什么。我们将每次 WER 变化精确分解为修复的词元、损坏的词元和插入，并借此探究源音频为纠错器带来了什么。我们在三个语料库上比较了有音频与无音频条件下的纠错，对象包括模型自身的草稿和独立识别器的输出。使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 时，对其自身草稿的纯文本纠错会破坏 13-32% 本已正确的转录；使用音频时为 1-3%。两种设置下损伤均下降。对自身草稿的修复下降，而对识别器输出的修复上升。在医疗听写中，保留的插入抵消了净 WER 的收益。很少进行编辑的开源权重模型 Voxtral 未表现出这种模式。由于两个实验组的提示词不同，这些对比只能界定音频的影响，而无法将其单独分离出来。
translation.brief: 解决纯文本 LLM 纠错器破坏正确 ASR 转录的问题，核心方法是将 WER 变化精确分解为修复、损伤和插入以量化音频接地的作用。

papers.title: SIM-UT: A User Simulation based Evaluation Framework for Medical Triage Chatbots
papers.abstract: LLM-based chat agents are increasingly used for complex, multi-turn, multilingual medical triage in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet evaluation methods focus on single-turn, English-only benchmarks that primarily test the chatbots' knowledge. In practice, users are often confused, overwhelmed, or emotionally vulnerable, giving unclear, misspelled single-word answers or long messages in regional dialects, and the context of a conversation can shift rapidly. We propose SIM-UT (Simulation of User Behaviour for Triage), a multi-turn, simulation-based evaluation method that identifies ecologically valid, contextually relevant failure modes of LLM-based triage chat agents. Using SIM-UT, we evaluated three real-world WhatsApp-based health chatbots: a respiratory screening programme in India, a hearing health support programme in South Africa, and a diabetes and lifestyle coaching agent in Kenya. We compared a medically fine-tuned open model (MedGemma) against general-purpose frontier models (ChatGPT and Claude) across 5,000+ multilingual simulated conversation turns grounded in the personas, constraints, and communication patterns of the real user populations, over 2-4 iterative rounds. A key failure mode emerged in both model families: de-escalation risk. The agents initially identified medical emergencies correctly, but when the user minimised the symptoms without introducing new clinical information, they de-escalated, exhibiting clinically dangerous sycophancy, for example agreeing that vaginal bleeding in pregnancy was "not a problem" or that decreased fetal movements at 32 weeks "can be normal". We recommend user simulation-based behavioural evaluation, grounded in real user context and covering adversarial and edge cases, as standard practice for triage chatbots in production, so that safeguards can be added before deployment or in subsequent iterations.

translation.title: SIM-UT：基于用户模拟的医疗分诊聊天机器人评估框架
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的聊天代理越来越多地被用于中低收入国家（LMICs）复杂的多轮、多语言医疗分诊，但现有评估方法聚焦于单轮、仅英语的基准，主要测试聊天机器人的知识。实际上，用户常常感到困惑、不知所措或情绪脆弱，给出不清晰、拼写错误的单词回答或用地方方言发送的长消息，且对话情境可能迅速变化。我们提出 SIM-UT（Triage 用户行为模拟），一种多轮、基于模拟的评估方法，用于识别基于 LLM 的分诊聊天代理在生态上有效、情境相关的失败模式。使用 SIM-UT，我们评估了三个基于 WhatsApp 的真实健康聊天机器人：印度的呼吸筛查项目、南非的听力健康支持项目和肯尼亚的糖尿病与生活方式辅导代理。我们在基于真实用户群体的人设、约束和沟通模式、经 2-4 轮迭代的 5000 多轮多语言模拟对话中，将医学微调的开源模型（MedGemma）与通用前沿模型（ChatGPT 和 Claude）进行比较。两个模型家族都出现了一个关键失败模式：降级风险。代理最初能正确识别医疗紧急情况，但当用户淡化症状且未引入新临床信息时，它们会降级，表现出临床上危险的谄媚行为，例如同意孕期阴道出血“不是问题”，或 32 周胎动减少“可能是正常的”。我们建议将基于用户模拟、扎根于真实用户情境并覆盖对抗性和边缘案例的行为评估作为生产环境分诊聊天机器人的标准实践，以便在部署前或后续迭代中加入安全防护。
translation.brief: 解决医疗分诊聊天机器人缺乏多轮真实情境评估的问题，核心方法是基于真实用户人设的多轮用户模拟来发现失败模式。

papers.title: X-pressing Intimacy: Mental Health Disclosure After Twitter Acquisition
papers.abstract: Social media platforms provide spaces for individuals to disclose mental health experiences and seek support, yet how these disclosures evolve during major shifts in platform governance remains unclear. We examine mental health self-disclosure surrounding Elon Musk's October 2022 acquisition of Twitter, analyzing approximately 824K tweets across anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder (BD), borderline personality disorder (BPD), and suicidal ideation (SI) or related experiences, alongside 266K comparison tweets. Using Linguistic Inquiry and Word Count (LIWC) and an LLM-based intimacy classifier, we characterize changes in psycholinguistic expression and disclosure intimacy. Following the acquisition, we observe declines in affective and social language, alongside increases in first-person singular pronouns and future-focused expressions. Intimacy patterns vary by condition: anxiety, depression, and BPD show increases in low-intimacy and decreases in moderate-intimacy disclosures, whereas suicide-related posts show more high-intimacy disclosures. However, compared with broader Twitter discourse, only the relative decline in moderate- versus low-intimacy disclosure for BPD remains statistically significant. Our findings underscore the importance of considering both language and intimacy when studying platform transitions, informing the design of online environments that support sensitive self-disclosure.

translation.title: X 上的亲密表达：Twitter 收购后的心理健康自我披露
translation.abstract: 社交媒体平台为个人提供披露心理健康经历和寻求支持的空间，但这些披露在平台治理重大变动期间如何演变仍不清楚。我们研究了围绕 Elon Musk 2022 年 10 月收购 Twitter 的心理健康自我披露，分析了约 82.4 万条涉及焦虑、抑郁、双相情感障碍（BD）、边缘型人格障碍（BPD）和自杀意念（SI）或相关经历的推文，以及 26.6 万条对照推文。使用语言查询与字词计数（LIWC）和基于 LLM 的亲密性分类器，我们刻画了心理语言学表达和披露亲密性的变化。收购之后，我们观察到情感性和社会性语言的下降，以及第一人称单数代词和面向未来表达的上升。亲密性模式因病症而异：焦虑、抑郁和 BPD 表现为低亲密性披露增加、中等亲密性披露减少，而自杀相关帖子则表现出更多高亲密性披露。然而，与更广泛的 Twitter 话语相比，只有 BPD 的中等亲密性披露相对低亲密性披露的下降仍具统计显著性。我们的发现强调在研究平台转型时同时考虑语言和亲密性的重要性，为设计支持敏感自我披露的在线环境提供参考。
translation.brief: 解决平台治理变动如何影响心理健康自我披露的问题，核心方法是结合 LIWC 与 LLM 亲密性分类器分析收购前后推文的语言与亲密性变化。

papers.title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
papers.abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.

translation.title: Agent Mosaic：识别 Agentic LLM 系统中的机密泄露
translation.abstract: 现代 LLM 代理可以从可访问的文档中检索信息，然后披露由它们拼合而成的敏感结论。这种马赛克效应对处理机密数据的代理构成了关键风险。我们用 30 个合成的网络安全、医疗和军事示例来量化其实现，在受控模拟中从三个 LLM 代理获得 10,800 个最终答案，并在两个开源 harness 中从真实代理获得 1,440 个答案。即使在设计为可由单个文档回答的良性查询下，测试中表现最好的模型 GPT-5.6-Sol 在模拟中仍有 7.08% 的答案（95% CI：3.75-10.67%）披露了被禁止的组合信息，在真实 harness 中披露率更差。添加可见的密级标头和显式聚合规则可大幅降低汇总披露率，但尽管有这些防护措施，所有意图下模拟答案中仍有 32.37%（95% CI：28.33-36.19%）存在不安全披露。此外，拒绝次数的增加并不能保证机密性，因为大量拒绝无论如何都会泄露被禁止的结论。这些结果指向一个令人不安的结论：通过马赛克式事件泄露敏感数据是所评估环境中一种以不可忽略比率出现的机密性失败模式。这促使我们对具有混合密级用户的敏感数据环境中代理可推断和披露的内容施加更强的控制。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 代理通过拼合多份低密级文档泄露敏感结论的问题，核心方法是通过受控模拟与真实 harness 实验量化马赛克式泄露率并评估防护措施效果。

papers.title: When Agentic Retrieval Fails Silently: Framework and Production Evidence from a Creative AI Assistant
papers.abstract: CTR, MRR, and behavioral NDCG assume the user sees ranked results and acts on them. In an agentic assistant, a generation layer consumes retrieval output first, and that assumption breaks in three ways. The agent reads the results before the user does (who). The user's action can come several turns or sessions after retrieval (when). Outcomes blend retrieved content with the model's own knowledge (what caused it). We call this the attribution gap. We propose Layered Agentic Retrieval Assessment (LARA), which measures retrieval quality, engagement and outcome, and product success as three independent layers joined by a four-field lineage schema that requires no new modeling. We examine the motivation on Adobe Express, where one retrieval infrastructure serves a gallery search surface and an agentic assistant at roughly one-eighth its session volume for the same user population. Chat users reformulate more than gallery users (44.4% vs. 33.1%) because chat reformulation refines generated output. LARA restores attribution for the retrieval.

translation.title: 当智能体式检索悄然失效时：来自创意 AI 助手的框架与生产证据
translation.abstract: CTR、MRR 和行为 NDCG 都假设用户会看到排序结果并对其采取行动。在智能体式助手（agentic assistant）中，生成层会先消费检索输出，这一假设在三个方面被打破：智能体在用户之前读取结果（谁）；用户的行动可能发生在检索之后的多个轮次或会话中（何时）；结果融合了检索内容与模型自身知识（什么导致了结果）。我们将其称为归因鸿沟（attribution gap）。我们提出分层智能体检索评估（LARA），将检索质量、参与与结果、产品成功作为三个独立层进行测量，并通过一个四字段血缘（lineage）模式将它们连接起来，且无需新的建模。我们在 Adobe Express 上验证该动机，其中同一套检索基础设施同时服务图库搜索界面和一个智能体助手，后者会话量约为前者的八分之一、面向同一用户群体。聊天用户比图库用户更多进行改写（44.4% 对 33.1%），因为聊天中的改写是为了优化生成输出。LARA 恢复了对检索的归因。
translation.brief: 针对智能体助手中检索效果难以归因的问题，提出 LARA 框架，用三层独立评估加四字段血缘模式来恢复检索归因。

papers.title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.

translation.title: RoleFlow：基于结构自适应的自进化多角色智能体协作
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统通常依赖预定义的协作结构，限制了对不断变化的任务需求的适应能力。尽管近期方法实现了动态编排，但其所采用的轨迹级奖励为每个决策分配单一结果，往往难以识别单个结构变化的贡献。我们提出 RoleFlow，一个自进化的多角色智能体系统，通过反馈驱动的原子编辑和按需角色合成来优化协作结构。为使结构自适应可学习，我们引入单编辑反事实策略优化（SECPO），在同一条链状态下将每次编辑与其不编辑的对照进行比较，并将针对性的信用分配到编辑相关的 token 上。在覆盖四个领域的七个基准上，RoleFlow 取得最优平均性能，超过最强竞争者 4.7 分；在全部三个多跳问答基准上领先 3.2-7.5 F1，并在数学推理、网页交互和代码生成上也表现优异。进一步分析证明了其跨基准可迁移性、训练数据效率和跨执行器泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统协作结构固定、结构变化难以归因的问题，提出 RoleFlow 结合 SECPO，通过反馈驱动的原子编辑和单编辑反事实信用分配实现协作结构自进化。

papers.title: TrustedCode: Evaluating Large Language Models for Developing Trusted Code through Automated Program Verification
papers.abstract: Recent reports, such as "Who is using AI to code?", indicate that approximately 30\% of Python code contributions to GitHub are AI-generated. Given the inherent unreliability of this code, formal verification emerges as a promising approach to establish trust in software correctness. Although leveraging large language models (LLMs) for formal verification has garnered increasing attention, practical adoption remains limited due to the challenges in writing formal specifications and verifying program correctness against them. Existing tools predominantly support verification for languages such as Java and C, with minimal support for Python. We present TrustedCode, an automated framework for verifying AI-generated Python code. TrustedCode uses LLMs to (i) type-check Python code, (ii) translate it into WhyML via the Why3 framework, and (iii) verify it against formal specifications using Why3 back-end automated theorem provers. Our method integrates chain-of-thought prompting through LangGraph to identify and address LLM limitations in specification generation and proving the specified programs. To evaluate TrustedCode, we conducted experiments on ten Python programs of varying complexity. Our analysis reveals that 50\% of the observed errors stem from domain knowledge gaps, 30\% from syntactic inaccuracies, and the remaining 20\% from semantic and type-related issues. These findings underscore the importance of targeted improvements in LLM-guided formal verification workflows for Python. TrustedCode is an open source tool available at: \href{github.com/mtaimoorkhan/TrustedCode}{github.com/mtaimoorkhan/TrustedCode}. The video demonstration is available at: \href{youtu.be/Nr5I2g8ec-s}{youtu.be/Nr5I2g8ec-s}

translation.title: TrustedCode：通过自动程序验证评估大语言模型开发可信代码的能力
translation.abstract: 近期报告（如《Who is using AI to code?》）指出，GitHub 上约 30% 的 Python 代码贡献由 AI 生成。鉴于此类代码固有的不可靠性，形式化验证成为建立软件正确性信任的有前景方法。尽管利用大语言模型（LLM）进行形式化验证日益受到关注，但由于编写形式化规范以及依据规范验证程序正确性的挑战，实际采用仍然有限。现有工具主要支持 Java 和 C 等语言的验证，对 Python 的支持极少。我们提出 TrustedCode，一个用于验证 AI 生成 Python 代码的自动化框架。TrustedCode 使用 LLM：（i）对 Python 代码进行类型检查，（ii）通过 Why3 框架将其翻译为 WhyML，（iii）使用 Why3 后端自动定理证明器依据形式化规范进行验证。我们的方法通过 LangGraph 集成思维链提示（chain-of-thought prompting），以识别并解决 LLM 在规范生成和验证指定程序方面的局限。为评估 TrustedCode，我们在十个不同复杂度的 Python 程序上进行了实验。分析显示，50% 的观察到的错误源于领域知识缺失，30% 源于语法不准确，其余 20% 源于语义和类型相关问题。这些发现凸显了在 LLM 引导的 Python 形式化验证流程中进行针对性改进的重要性。TrustedCode 是开源工具，地址为 github.com/mtaimoorkhan/TrustedCode，视频演示见 youtu.be/NrI2g8ec-s。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 生成 Python 代码缺乏形式化验证支持的问题，提出 TrustedCode 框架，利用 LLM 进行类型检查、翻译为 WhyML 并通过 Why3 定理证明器验证正确性。

papers.title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information. However, existing search agents often lack search-state awareness, i.e., the ability to recognize what information has been obtained and what remains missing, leading to hallucinated reasoning and prematurely terminated search. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning (SARL), a reinforcement learning framework in which models learn to recognize their own search state during training and improve their search behavior accordingly, without requiring additional assessment at test time. SARL achieves this through a dual reward design that captures the corrective effect of each assessment while penalizing excessive reliance on it, jointly encouraging effective and efficient search trajectories. Under this setup, SARL achieves a 24.3% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, with average gains of 35.9% on multi-hop reasoning and 27.9% on deep research benchmarks against the strongest per-benchmark baselines. SARL further surpasses methods built on auxiliary supervision or multi-agent coordination, despite operating as a standalone RL framework with no inference-time scaffolding. Beyond final performance, SARL maintains training stability under extended search horizons, a regime where existing methods consistently degrade, enabling sustained gains as task complexity grows.

translation.title: 面向检索增强大语言模型搜索状态感知的自评估强化学习
translation.abstract: 搜索智能体的最新进展使大语言模型能够通过检索和综合外部信息来完成复杂任务。然而，现有搜索智能体往往缺乏搜索状态感知，即识别已获取哪些信息、还缺少哪些信息的能力，导致幻觉推理和过早终止搜索。为解决这一局限，我们提出自评估强化学习（SARL），一个强化学习框架，其中模型在训练中学会识别自身搜索状态并据此改进搜索行为，且在测试时无需额外评估。SARL 通过双重奖励设计实现这一点：该设计既捕捉每次评估的纠错效果，又惩罚对评估的过度依赖，共同鼓励有效且高效的搜索轨迹。在此设置下，SARL 相比最强基线取得 24.3% 的相对提升，相对各基准最强基线在多跳推理上平均提升 35.9%，在深度研究基准上提升 27.9%。SARL 还超越了基于辅助监督或多智能体协调的方法，尽管它只是一个独立 RL 框架、无推理时脚手架。除最终性能外，SARL 在长搜索视野下保持训练稳定——这是现有方法持续退化的场景——使其能够随任务复杂度增长持续获益。
translation.brief: 针对搜索智能体缺乏搜索状态感知导致幻觉和过早停止搜索的问题，提出 SARL 强化学习框架，用兼顾评估纠错效果与惩罚过度依赖的双重奖励训练模型自主感知搜索状态。

papers.title: Secure Agentic AI and Multimodal Intelligence in 6G Communication Systems
papers.abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) communication systems are expected to support immersive, intent-driven, and latency-critical services through tight integration of multimodal intelligence, edge computing, and autonomous network control. In this setting, agentic AI systems can reason over heterogeneous inputs, use tools and network functions, coordinate across distributed entities, and adapt to dynamic environments. These capabilities make agentic multimodal intelligence promising for 6G applications such as semantic communications, digital twins, and zero-touch network management, but they also introduce security and privacy risks that extend beyond conventional AI and network security models. Vulnerabilities can propagate across multimodal data pipelines, memory, tools, communication interfaces, and inter-agent coordination loops. We survey multimodal intelligence and agentic AI for 6G cross-layered communication systems from the perspectives of privacy and security. We present a 6G-oriented system view spanning perception, memory, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration; analyze threat models and attack surfaces across sensing, cognition, action, memory, and communication layers; organize existing attacks into a structured taxonomy; and review mitigation strategies including prompt and memory defenses, inter-agent trust mechanisms, secure orchestration, and privacy-preserving learning. We conclude by outlining open research directions for trustworthy multimodal multi-agent 6G systems.

translation.title: 6G 通信系统中的安全智能体 AI 与多模态智能
translation.abstract: 第六代（6G）通信系统有望通过多模态智能、边缘计算和自主网络控制的紧密集成，支持沉浸式、意图驱动和时延关键的服务。在此背景下，智能体 AI 系统能够对异构输入进行推理、使用工具和网络功能、跨分布式实体协调并适应动态环境。这些能力使智能体多模态智能在语义通信、数字孪生和零接触网络管理等 6G 应用中前景广阔，但也带来了超越传统 AI 和网络安全模型的安全与隐私风险。漏洞可能沿多模态数据管道、记忆、工具、通信接口和智能体间协调环路传播。我们从隐私和安全的角度对面向 6G 跨层通信系统的多模态智能与智能体 AI 进行综述。我们提出一个面向 6G 的系统视图，涵盖感知、记忆、工具使用和多智能体编排；分析感知、认知、行动、记忆和通信各层的威胁模型与攻击面；将现有攻击组织为结构化分类体系；并评述包括提示与记忆防御、智能体间信任机制、安全编排和隐私保护学习在内的缓解策略。最后我们展望了可信多模态多智能体 6G 系统的开放研究方向。
translation.brief: 针对 6G 中智能体多模态智能带来的新型安全与隐私风险，系统综述其攻击面、威胁分类及缓解策略与开放研究方向。

papers.title: SpecMAGIC: Specification-Guided Multi-Task Generalization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multi-task generalization is an important yet underexplored problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Many real-world applications require multi-agent systems to generalize across complex, temporally extended tasks with diverse inter-agent coordination requirements. We introduce a specification language that combines temporal-logic task specifications with operators for expressing such requirements. We propose SpecMAGIC, a hierarchical framework that leverages the automaton structure of task specifications for subtask decomposition. A centralized high-level planner identifies and allocates compatible subtask sequences across agents, while decentralized low-level policies execute individual subtasks. This enables zero-shot generalization to new tasks by composing reusable subtask policies according to new specifications, without retraining. We establish soundness and probabilistic completeness of the high-level planner. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks show that SpecMAGIC substantially outperforms existing approaches on unseen task specifications and maintains strong performance as the number of agents increases.

translation.title: SpecMAGIC：多智能体强化学习中基于规约的多任务泛化
translation.abstract: 多任务泛化是多智能体强化学习（MARL）中一个重要但尚未充分研究的问题。许多现实应用要求多智能体系统能够泛化到具有多样化智能体间协调需求的复杂、时间上延展的任务。我们提出了一种规约语言，将时序逻辑任务规约与用于表达此类需求的算子相结合。我们提出SpecMAGIC，一个利用任务规约的自动机结构进行子任务分解的分层框架。集中式高层规划器识别并在各智能体之间分配兼容的子任务序列，而去中心化的低层策略执行各个子任务。这使得系统能够根据新规约组合可复用的子任务策略，实现对新任务的零样本泛化，而无需重新训练。我们证明了高层规划器的可靠性与概率完备性。在多智能体导航任务上的实验表明，SpecMAGIC在未见过的任务规约上显著优于现有方法，并且随着智能体数量增加仍保持强劲性能。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体强化学习跨复杂时序任务的多任务泛化问题，提出结合时序逻辑规约与自动机子任务分解的分层框架SpecMAGIC，通过组合可复用子任务策略实现零样本泛化。

papers.title: A Three-Pillar Governance Framework for Safe and Trustworthy AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making introduce significant challenges related to safety, alignment, accountability, and human oversight. Existing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and responsible AI approaches provide important foundations, but many remain fragmented across system design, governance, and operational deployment. This paper presents a Three-Pillar (3P) model and framework for developing safe and trustworthy AI agents through transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness. The framework defines an evolutionary path in which increasing agent autonomy is introduced through progressive validation, structured human oversight, and auditable operational controls. We further describe how the model supports agent lifecycle monitoring, decision traceability, escalation management, and human-agent collaboration within enterprise agentic environments. By integrating oversight principles with operational mechanisms, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for deploying AI agents that remain aligned with human intent while enabling controlled progression toward higher autonomy.

translation.title: 面向安全可信AI智能体的三支柱治理框架
