translation.abstract: 具备自主决策能力的AI智能体带来了安全、对齐、问责和人类监督方面的重大挑战。现有的Human-in-the-Loop（HITL）和负责任AI方法提供了重要基础，但许多方法在系统设计、治理和运营部署之间仍然割裂。本文提出了一个通过透明度、问责性和可信性来开发安全可信AI智能体的三支柱（3P）模型与框架。该框架定义了一条演进路径，通过渐进式验证、结构化的人类监督和可审计的运营控制，逐步引入更高的智能体自主性。我们进一步阐述了该模型如何支持企业级智能体环境中的智能体生命周期监控、决策可追溯性、升级管理和人机协作。通过将监督原则与运营机制相结合，所提出的框架为部署与人类意图保持一致、同时实现向更高自主性受控演进的AI智能体提供了实用基础。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体自主决策带来的安全与治理挑战，提出基于透明度、问责性和可信性的三支柱治理框架，通过渐进验证与可审计控制实现自主性的受控提升。

papers.title: Strategic Arbitrage in Electricity Markets: A Multi-Agent Policy Optimization Framework
papers.abstract: Grid-scale storage and load aggregators are growing quickly in wholesale electricity markets. If highly consolidated, these new participants may distort the competitive market equilibrium through strategic withholding behavior. Traditional market power mitigation techniques are ill-suited to arbitrage-based participants. We provide a multi-agent policy optimization model to study game-theoretic equilibria for real-time markets with consolidated storage and/or aggregators. The model is designed to facilitate natural first-order equilibrium-seeking update rules. We analyze the theoretical properties of different supply functions and their implications on the convergence of the gradient dynamics. Finally, we train equilibrium policies for a modified version of the IEEE RTS-GMLC benchmark across different levels of storage fleet consolidation, to demonstrate the potential of the framework as a tool to characterize and quantify strategic arbitrage.

translation.title: 电力市场中的策略性套利：一种多智能体策略优化框架
translation.abstract: 电网级储能和负荷聚合商在批发电力市场中快速增长。如果高度集中，这些新参与者可能通过策略性持留行为扭曲竞争性市场均衡。传统的市场势力缓解技术并不适用于基于套利的参与者。我们提供了一个多智能体策略优化模型，用于研究含集中式储能和/或聚合商的实时市场的博弈论均衡。该模型旨在促进自然的一阶均衡寻优更新规则。我们分析了不同供给函数的理论性质及其对梯度动力学收敛性的影响。最后，我们在IEEE RTS-GMLC基准的修改版本上，针对不同储能车队集中度水平训练均衡策略，以展示该框架作为刻画和量化策略性套利工具的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对集中式储能与聚合商在电力实时市场中策略性持留扭曲均衡的问题，构建多智能体策略优化模型以求解博弈论均衡并量化策略性套利。

papers.title: Same Beliefs, Different Policies: Learning Reusable Representations for Early Stopping in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reasoning LLMs often continue reasoning after reaching a correct answer, wasting computation and sometimes replacing it with an incorrect one. Deciding when to stop is a metareasoning problem: the model must weigh what further reasoning could achieve against its cost, given what it can already answer. Direct utility training learns a stopping representation at a chosen token price; supporting new prices can require additional controller training. We introduce BELT (BELief-based Termination), which separates outcome prediction from stopping control. It learns beliefs about current and future answers from a frozen LLM's hidden states, then fits a linear stopping policy on the frozen features. The prediction targets are independent of token price, so one probe supports different accuracy-cost trade-offs through CPU policy refitting or threshold adjustment. Averaged over five out-of-distribution (OOD) math benchmarks, BELT reduces generated tokens by 41% on Qwen3-1.7B and 51% on OLMo-3-7B-Think without loss of accuracy. The same math-trained BELT transfers to coding and agentic tasks without training on code or agentic data. In all three domains, its accuracy-cost trade-offs are competitive with or better than those of end-to-end controllers. On OLMo3, its probe has 21.2x fewer parameters than one checkpoint of the strongest baseline, OS-Pruner, and needs 55x fewer training GPU-hours than OS-Pruner's five price-specific checkpoints.

translation.title: 相同信念，不同策略：为LLM推理提前停止学习可复用表示
translation.abstract: 推理型LLM在得出正确答案后往往继续推理，浪费计算资源，有时还会用错误答案替换正确答案。决定何时停止是一个元推理问题：模型必须基于其已能回答的内容，权衡进一步推理的收益与成本。直接效用训练在选定的token价格下学习停止表示；支持新价格可能需要额外的控制器训练。我们提出BELT（BELief-based Termination），将结果预测与停止控制分离。它从冻结LLM的隐藏状态中学习关于当前和未来答案的信念，然后在冻结特征上拟合线性停止策略。预测目标与token价格无关，因此一个探针可通过CPU上的策略重拟合或阈值调整支持不同的准确率-成本权衡。在五个分布外（OOD）数学基准上平均，BELT在Qwen3-1.7B上减少41%的生成token，在OLMo-3-7B-Think上减少51%，且不损失准确率。在数学上训练的同一BELT无需在代码或智能体数据上训练即可迁移到编程和智能体任务。在这三个领域中，其准确率-成本权衡与端到端控制器相当或更优。在OLMo3上，其探针的参数量比最强基线OS-Pruner的一个检查点少21.2倍，训练所需GPU小时数比OS-Pruner的五个特定价格检查点少55倍。
translation.brief: 针对推理型LLM得出正确答案后仍继续推理浪费计算的问题，提出BELT方法，从冻结LLM隐藏状态学习答案信念并拟合线性停止策略，实现与token价格无关的可复用提前停止。

papers.title: Learning to Incentivise: Using Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable Urban Mobility
papers.abstract: Traffic management has traditionally focused on toll-based and road pricing solutions. However, road pricing often raises concerns about accessibility and public dissatisfaction, leading to its prohibition in some places, such as Finland. This study optimises the dynamic allocation of incentives to drivers, encouraging them to reroute onto alternative (potentially longer) paths to achieve greater societal benefit, reduced total travel time (TTT) and total emissions in the transportation network, contributing to sustainable urban mobility. We employ a multi-agent reinforcement learning approach to dynamically assign incentives to drivers to reduce both TTT and emissions, with travel times estimated using traffic simulation software. We demonstrate that, with an unlimited budget and an objective of minimising travel time, the incentive scheme reduces TTT by 16%, compared to the dynamic User-Equilibrium (UE) with a budget equivalent to about 11% of the UE total time. When the goal is to minimise emissions, a 9% reduction in CO2 emissions is observed under an unlimited budget. We demonstrate a critical trade-off: minimising TTT leads to an increase in emissions, while prioritising emission reductions raises TTT. However, with the right combination of weights in the multi-objective function, both TTT and total emissions are improved beyond the baseline.

translation.title: 学习激励：利用强化学习促进可持续城市交通
translation.abstract: 交通管理传统上聚焦于收费和道路定价方案。然而，道路定价常常引发关于可达性和公众不满的担忧，导致其在某些地方被禁止，例如芬兰。本研究优化对驾驶员的激励动态分配，鼓励他们改道至替代（可能更长的）路径，以实现更大的社会效益，即降低交通网络中的总出行时间（TTT）和总排放，促进可持续城市交通。我们采用多智能体强化学习方法动态向驾驶员分配激励，以同时降低TTT和排放，其中出行时间通过交通仿真软件估计。我们证明，在无限预算和最小化出行时间的目标下，该激励方案相比动态用户均衡（UE）将TTT降低了16%，预算约相当于UE总时间的11%。当目标是最小化排放时，在无限预算下观察到CO2排放降低9%。我们展示了一个关键权衡：最小化TTT会导致排放增加，而优先减排则会提高TTT。然而，通过在多目标函数中采用合适的权重组合，TTT和总排放均可优于基线。
translation.brief: 针对道路定价引发公众抵触的问题，采用多智能体强化学习动态向驾驶员分配激励引导其改道，以同时降低总出行时间与排放。

papers.title: Externalise the Memory: A Pre-Registered Study of Where an Embodied Agent's Experience Should Live
papers.abstract: Should an embodied agent's experience be baked into its policy weights, or kept external and retrieved at inference? A memory-augmented teacher (a VLM that retrieves lessons, with their episode images, from its own past attempts) produces trajectories on a vision-conditioned reach task; from the same trajectories we distil LoRA student policies and evaluate them under matched protocols, including one that re-attaches the teacher's frozen retrieval buffer to a fixed set of student weights. We pre-registered the hypotheses, arms, tests, and analysis rules before training and before any p-value. Distilling the memory-augmented behaviour into weights beat an action-only control by +1 pp (n.s.); the registered test proves underpowered for its own minimum effect, so we withdraw - rather than refute - the memory-in-weights claim. Attaching retrieval to a fixed set of student weights added +34 pp (z=5.15), reaching the pooled memory-augmented teacher reference (49.3%); the pre-registered protocol contrast agrees (+23 pp, z=3.36); under a pre-registered auto-reset sensitivity count the two are +36 and +29 pp. An exploratory behavioural probe with pre-registered per-arm predictions is consistent with behavioural distillation transferring the marginal correction but not the conditional, situation-specific correction that retrieval supplies. The recipe that follows is to externalise the memory: in follow-up controls registered before they ran, the same frozen buffer lifts the base model with no adapter to 48% (sensitivity 48%) and the other three adapters from 19-26% to 53-55% (sensitivity 17-21% to 50-55%), and the adapter adds nothing detectable once the buffer is attached. On a second, harder task, the retrieval advantage points the same direction but falls short of significance (+6 pp, 95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]); exploratory diagnostics tie the attenuation to memory coverage.

translation.title: 外置记忆：一项关于具身智能体经验应存放于何处的预注册研究
translation.abstract: 具身智能体的经验应该烘焙进策略权重中，还是保持外部存储并在推理时检索？一个记忆增强的教师（一个能从自身过往尝试中检索经验教训及其回合图像的 VLM）在一个视觉条件抓取任务上生成轨迹；我们从相同轨迹中蒸馏出 LoRA 学生策略，并在匹配的协议下评估它们，其中包括将教师的冻结检索缓冲区重新挂载到固定学生权重上的协议。我们在训练之前、在任何 p 值出现之前，预注册了假设、实验分支、测试和分析规则。将记忆增强行为蒸馏进权重比仅动作对照高 +1 个百分点（不显著）；注册测试对自身最小效应检验力不足，因此我们撤回——而非反驳——记忆入权重的论断。将检索挂载到固定学生权重上带来 +34 个百分点（z=5.15），达到汇总的记忆增强教师参考水平（49.3%）；预注册协议对比结果一致（+23 个百分点，z=3.36）；在预注册的自动重置敏感性计数下两者分别为 +36 和 +29 个百分点。一项带有预注册分支预测的探索性行为探测表明，行为蒸馏转移了边缘修正，但未转移检索所提供的条件性、情境特异性修正。由此得出的方案是外置记忆：在运行前注册的后续对照中，同一冻结缓冲区将无适配器的基础模型提升至 48%（敏感性 48%），并将另外三个适配器从 19-26% 提升至 53-55%（敏感性 17-21% 至 50-55%），而一旦挂载缓冲区，适配器不再带来可检测的增益。在第二个更难的任务上，检索优势方向一致但未达显著（+6 个百分点，95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]）；探索性诊断将这种衰减归因于记忆覆盖范围。
translation.brief: 研究具身智能体经验应存入策略权重还是外置检索，通过预注册对照实验发现外置记忆检索显著优于权重蒸馏，并提出外置记忆的方案。

papers.title: FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization
papers.abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath radix-4 leaves at that precision; and (2) a mixed-precision quantizer that assigns each channel group its bit-width according to the error GPTQ cannot compensate, with a per-input-channel column scaling whose power-of-two normalization keeps the scaled activations out of the FP16 subnormal range, so that the quantized model maps directly onto FIGFLEX's datapath with the same accuracy as on a GPU. On LLaMA-2-7B, FIGFLEX attains 5.85 and 8.77 WikiText-2 perplexity at 3- and 2-bit average precision, lower than GPTQ, AWQ, SliM-LLM, AMQ, and QuIP# (without fine-tuning), while delivering 1.56x and 1.42x higher whole-chip throughput per area on the linear GEMMs of a 3-bit mixed-precision model than AxCore and FIGLUT, respectively.

translation.title: FIGFLEX：与低比特 LLM 量化协同设计的混合精度 FP-INT GEMM 加速器
translation.abstract: Weight-only 量化使 LLM 激活保持浮点数、权重存储为低比特整数，将主要工作负载转变为浮点-整数（FP-INT）通用矩阵乘法。近期的量化器通过混合精度达到 2-3 比特的平均位宽，但硬件未能跟上：GPU 在张量核乘加之前将权重反量化为 FP16，而位并行 FP-INT 加速器只运行在单一权重精度下，因此更少的比特只节省内存而不节省计算。本文提出 FIGFLEX，一个算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度加速器，其位并行数据通路随精度降低而扩展吞吐量。FIGFLEX 的贡献包括：(1) FP-INT 乘法的移位加法、基-4 重新表述，将乘加融合为统一、精度灵活的部分积累加，并将部分积大致减半，同时提出一种新颖的 INT3 优化以在该精度下回收空闲的数据通路基-4 叶节点；(2) 一种混合精度量化器，根据 GPTQ 无法补偿的误差为每个通道组分配位宽，并采用逐输入通道的列缩放，其二进制幂归一化使缩放后的激活值不落入 FP16 次正规范围，从而使量化模型能直接映射到 FIGFLEX 的数据通路上，并保持与 GPU 上相同的精度。在 LLaMA-2-7B 上，FIGFLEX 在 3 比特和 2 比特平均精度下分别取得 5.85 和 8.77 的 WikiText-2 困惑度，低于 GPTQ、AWQ、SliM-LLM、AMQ 和 QuIP#（无需微调），同时在 3 比特混合精度模型的线性 GEMM 上，单位面积整芯片吞吐量分别比 AxCore 和 FIGLUT 高 1.56 倍和 1.42 倍。
translation.brief: 针对低比特 weight-only 量化下硬件无法节省计算的问题，提出算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度 FP-INT GEMM 加速器 FIGFLEX，包含精度灵活的基-4 部分积数据通路和按通道组分配位宽的量化器。

papers.title: Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences
papers.abstract: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.

translation.title: 何必再烦我？面向交互偏好的个人智能体记忆基准测试
translation.abstract: 个人智能系统正在承担日益复杂的日常任务，但重复提问、不必要的确认和不受欢迎的打扰会将得力的助手变成交互负担。减少这种负担需要智能体记住用户希望如何被协助。然而，现有记忆基准关注事实回忆和个性化回答，很少测试智能体如何学习并依据交互偏好行事。我们提出 MemPABench，一个用于个人智能体记忆在线策略评估的交互式环境。MemPABench 设置长时程任务，要求智能体决定何时澄清、确认或自主行动。四个基于真实场景的模拟用户在工作和个人场景中持有 14 项偏好。他们的反馈跨越四个月内的 99 个会话，每位用户有五个事件驱动的偏好变化以测试记忆更新。我们评估偏好选择、执行的行为以及对上下文和偏好变化的敏感性。在四个 LLM 骨干上评估四种记忆系统，我们发现当前记忆在偏好选择上带来的增益有限。基于检索的系统（即 Mem0、MemOS、简单 RAG）并不优于无记忆，而基于文件的记忆提高了准确性但会在无关上下文中应用偏好。我们的分析表明，当前记忆难以检索交互偏好并适应偏好变化。即使正确的偏好可用，覆盖智能体的默认交互习惯仍然困难。环境与数据集见 https://mempabench.com。
translation.brief: 针对现有记忆基准不测试智能体学习交互偏好的问题，构建交互式评估环境 MemPABench，评估发现当前记忆系统在偏好检索与偏好变化适应上表现不佳。

papers.title: From Single-Actor Environments to Multi-Actor Event Worlds: Can LLMs Be Event World Models?
papers.abstract: World models help agents assess the consequences of their actions before acting. Many real systems, however, involve multiple actors who make their own decisions, can evolve even when the agent takes no action, and are only partially observed through event logs. We formalize these systems as event worlds and ask whether large language models can predict future observations from the log and the agent's proposed actions. We build complementary benchmarks from human Diplomacy games and real Polymarket trades. Our hierarchical framework compares prediction with and without other actors' actions, then tests multi-step rollouts, predictions for actions never taken, and usefulness to agents. Fine-tuning and more data improve prediction when all actors' recorded actions are given. With only the agent's action, models struggle when other actors strongly affect the outcome, and larger models and longer histories help little. This gap also limits multi-step prediction and agent decisions, with models overestimating plan success. Yet imagined experience and initialization from world models can still improve policy learning. Anticipating other actors' actions remains a central challenge for event world modeling.

translation.title: 从单智能体环境到多智能体事件世界：LLM 能成为事件世界模型吗？
translation.abstract: 世界模型帮助智能体在行动前评估其行动的后果。然而许多真实系统涉及多个自主决策的参与者，即使智能体不采取行动也会演化，且只能通过事件日志被部分观测。我们将这些系统形式化为事件世界，并探究大语言模型能否从日志和智能体提议的行动预测未来观测。我们基于人类 Diplomacy 对局和真实 Polymarket 交易构建了互补的基准。我们的分层框架比较在有与没有其他参与者行动情况下的预测，然后测试多步推演、对从未采取行动的预测以及对智能体的有用性。当给出所有参与者的记录行动时，微调和更多数据能改善预测。仅有智能体自身行动时，当其他参与者强烈影响结果时模型表现挣扎，而更大的模型和更长的历史帮助甚微。这一差距也限制了多步预测和智能体决策，模型会高估计划成功率。然而，世界模型提供的想象经验和初始化仍能改善策略学习。预判其他参与者的行动仍是事件世界建模的核心挑战。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 能否作为多智能体事件世界的世界模型，基于 Diplomacy 和 Polymarket 数据构建基准，发现预判其他参与者行动是当前模型的核心短板。

papers.title: What the Trace Shows and What the Label Says: Auditing Behavioral Detectors in Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract: LLM agents are often evaluated by reducing execution traces to labels such as final-answer correctness, tool verification, and fault propagation. These labels are measurements produced by parsers, behavioral detectors, and harness rules, and they may not fully capture what the trace shows. We study this in a tool-use setting built on GSM8K, where agents call a calculator whose outputs are occasionally corrupted, giving clear ground truth for what the tool returned, what the model later used, and what the detectors reported. We audit three trace-level detectors across six production models and 30 problems per model. Final correctness, visible re-verification, and fault propagation can disagree in systematic ways. A key failure mode is silent tool-output override: the calculator returns a corrupted value, but the model later uses a different, often correct, value without calling the tool again, so the bad value stops propagating while a verification detector records no re-check. Human review of 90 traces agrees perfectly with the automated labels for final correctness (67/67), fault impact (19/19), and fault relevance (18/18), but only 67/81 for verification; all 14 disagreements fall into four recurring patterns. Execution limits also change the reported result: in an ablation across two models, one ranges from 21/30 to 27/30 correct as step and token budgets change, while the other stays between 27/30 and 29/30. These findings motivate measurement transparency: an automated label should come with the trace evidence behind it, whether the question the detector asks applied to that trace, whether the run was cut off by an execution limit, and any human corrections. Our trace viewer makes this information inspectable alongside the reported results.

translation.title: 轨迹显示了什么而标签说了什么：审计智能体评估中的行为检测器
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体常通过将执行轨迹约简为标签来评估，如最终答案正确性、工具验证和故障传播。这些标签是由解析器、行为检测器和测试框架规则产生的测量结果，可能无法完全捕捉轨迹所显示的内容。我们在一个基于 GSM8K 的工具使用场景中研究这一问题，其中智能体调用一个输出偶尔被损坏的计算器，从而为工具返回了什么、模型随后使用了什么以及检测器报告了什么提供了清晰的真值。我们在六个生产模型上审计三个轨迹级检测器，每个模型 30 个问题。最终正确性、可见的再验证和故障传播可能以系统性的方式不一致。一个关键的失败模式是静默工具输出覆盖：计算器返回损坏的值，但模型随后使用了不同的、通常是正确的值而未再次调用工具，因此坏值停止传播，而验证检测器未记录到再检查。对 90 条轨迹的人工审查与自动标签在最终正确性（67/67）、故障影响（19/19）和故障相关性（18/18）上完全一致，但验证方面仅为 67/81；全部 14 处不一致可归入四种反复出现的模式。执行限制也会改变报告结果：在两个模型的消融中，一个模型的正确数随步数和 token 预算变化在 21/30 到 27/30 之间波动，而另一个保持在 27/30 到 29/30 之间。这些发现促使我们倡导测量透明性：自动标签应附带其背后的轨迹证据，包括检测器所问的问题是否适用于该轨迹、运行是否被执行限制截断，以及任何人工修正。我们的轨迹查看器使这些信息可与报告结果一同查看。
translation.brief: 审计 LLM 智能体评估中行为检测器标签与执行轨迹的不一致问题，基于带真值的计算器工具场景发现静默工具输出覆盖等失败模式，并倡导测量透明性。

papers.title: From Prose to Properties: Testing Research Claims with ARATest for Agent-Native Science
papers.abstract: AI agents now run experiments and report findings, so research produces claims faster than researchers can check them. Each empirical claim implies a property that must hold over its cases, but it states that property only in prose. Without an explicit property, no test can decide which evidence would falsify a claim, so validation cannot keep pace with the claims agents produce. To make claims testable, we approximate a claim's semantics by abstracting its property skeleton, a parameterized relation that recurs across claims. We present ARATest, a property-based testing library that checks these skeletons as executable tests. A typed declaration binds a claim to a skeleton and fixes the claim's compared quantities, cases, scope, and numerical policy. A shared case type makes every generator supply cases in the claim's statistical unit. A three-valued semantics assigns each property one of three verdicts: holds, violated, or inconclusive. Every violation carries a replayable witness. A default generator reads the evidence that agent-native research artifacts (ARA) link to each claim, and auto-research generators dispatch an agent to run released code for fresh cases. Our DissClaimer plugin supplies that agent and runs these generators as continuous testing. Of 243 claims in 33 ARA artifacts, 54 received faithful declarations bound to evidence: 32 held, eight were violated, and 14 remained inconclusive. Two violations exposed errors in published papers that their authors confirmed. ARATest detected all 553 seeded faults without a false alarm on 19 valid controls, outperforming two LLM judges. Fresh runs exposed behaviors that reported evidence could not show. These results suggest that one fixed test can check explicit claim properties against both reported and fresh evidence.

translation.title: 从散文到属性：用 ARATest 测试研究论断以实现 Agent 原生科学
translation.abstract: AI agent 现在可以运行实验并报告发现，因此研究产生论断的速度超过了研究者核查的速度。每个经验性论断都隐含一个必须在其案例上成立的属性，但它只用散文形式陈述该属性。没有显式的属性，任何测试都无法判定何种证据会证伪一个论断，因此验证无法跟上 agent 产生论断的速度。为了使论断可测试，我们通过抽象论断的属性骨架（property skeleton，一种在多个论断中反复出现的参数化关系）来近似论断的语义。我们提出 ARATest，一个基于属性的测试库，将这些骨架作为可执行测试进行检查。类型化声明将论断绑定到骨架，并固定论断的被比较量、案例、范围和数值策略。共享的案例类型使每个生成器以论断的统计单元提供案例。三值语义为每个属性赋予三种判定之一：成立、违反或不确定。每个违反都附带可重放的见证。默认生成器读取 agent 原生研究工件（ARA）链接到每个论断的证据，自动研究生成器则派遣 agent 运行已发布的代码以获取新案例。我们的 DissClaimer 插件提供该 agent，并将这些生成器作为持续测试运行。在 33 个 ARA 工件的 243 个论断中，54 个获得了绑定到证据的忠实声明：32 个成立，8 个被违反，14 个仍不确定。两个违反暴露了已发表论文中的错误，并得到论文作者的确认。ARATest 在 19 个有效对照上无误报地检测出全部 553 个植入故障，优于两个 LLM 评审。新运行暴露了已报告证据无法显示的行为。这些结果表明，一个固定的测试可以针对已报告证据和新证据检查显式的论断属性。
translation.brief: 针对 AI agent 产生的研究论断难以验证的问题，提出 ARATest，通过将论断抽象为可执行的属性骨架并结合证据生成器进行基于属性的持续测试。

papers.title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
papers.abstract: A generally intelligent system acquires new skills efficiently without requiring humans to redesign its software scaffold for every new task. Yet language models rarely act alone. A harness is a symbolic program that orchestrates calls to the model, handling perception, memory, tool use, recovery, and inference allocation on the model's behalf. ARC-AGI-3 is an interactive benchmark in which agents must explore unfamiliar environments, figure out their goals on the fly, and keep learning as they go. On it, human-steered systems already report ceiling scores across the public games, so we know effective designs exist. We ask whether frontier models can build and improve such a harness on their own. Through a fixed coding bootstrap, each model constructs a complete task harness, acts through that harness on five development games, and revises the entire codebase twice. Every version is evaluated on twenty games that never influence adaptation. We measure task performance with Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), which combines level completion with action efficiency relative to human baselines, and record dollar-denominated inference cost as a practical resource measure. Across 27 lineages, harness performance ranges from zero to near-ceiling scores. Two revisions raise mean held-out RHAE by only 2.80 points (95% interval [-1.44,7.35]). Development gains overstate held-out improvement, and reductions in inference cost can come at the expense of task performance. Human-steered systems demonstrate further headroom. These findings reveal a gap between autonomous harness construction and reliable adaptation under this two-revision protocol: even strong task performance does not ensure that subsequent revisions generalize or preserve existing capabilities.

translation.title: LLM 能否改进自己的 Harness？ARC-AGI-3 上的受控研究
translation.abstract: 一个通用智能系统应能高效习得新技能，而无需人类为每个新任务重新设计其软件脚手架。然而语言模型很少单独行动。Harness 是一个符号程序，代表模型编排对模型的调用，处理感知、记忆、工具使用、恢复和推理分配。ARC-AGI-3 是一个交互式基准，agent 必须在其中探索陌生环境、即时弄清目标并持续学习。在该基准上，人类引导的系统已在公开游戏中报告了接近满分的成绩，因此我们知道有效设计是存在的。我们探究前沿模型能否自行构建并改进这样的 harness。通过固定的编码引导流程，每个模型构建一个完整的任务 harness，通过该 harness 在五个开发游戏上行动，并对整个代码库进行两次修订。每个版本都在二十个从未影响适配过程的游戏上评估。我们用相对人类动作效率（RHAE）衡量任务性能，该指标结合了关卡完成度与相对于人类基线的动作效率，并记录以美元计价的推理成本作为实际资源度量。在 27 个谱系中，harness 性能从零分到接近满分不等。两次修订仅将平均保留集 RHAE 提高 2.80 分（95% 区间 [-1.44, 7.35]）。开发集收益高估了保留集改进，而推理成本的降低可能以牺牲任务性能为代价。人类引导的系统显示出进一步的提升空间。这些发现揭示了自主 harness 构建与两次修订协议下可靠适配之间的差距：即使任务性能很强，也不能保证后续修订能泛化或保留现有能力。
translation.brief: 研究前沿 LLM 能否自主构建并迭代改进自己的任务 harness，通过在 ARC-AGI-3 上固定引导流程、两次代码修订及保留集评估进行受控实验。

papers.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of LLM Fact-Checkers
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to answer factual questions, but their answers can contain errors and must be fact-checked claim by claim. Yet the resulting score depends on three design decisions: which questions the claims answer, under what conditions each claim is judged, and which sources count as evidence. No existing benchmark specifies all three. We introduce JSFactCheckBench, a Japanese benchmark that specifies all three, with 1,913 claims from LLM answers to questions about misleading information that circulated on Japanese social media, each annotated for factuality at a reference time and for importance to the question, using evidence from preselected Web sources. Across six LLMs, all verify claims directly answering the question less accurately than supplementary claims, a gap that aggregate scores obscure. Scores also drop when models must locate the relevant content in longer or multiple sources and, for all four open models, when the surrounding question and response are added. These weaknesses are visible only because the benchmark records the conditions behind each label. A benchmark that leaves them implicit cannot reveal them.

translation.title: 重新思考 LLM 事实核查器的评估
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于回答事实性问题，但其答案可能包含错误，必须逐条论断进行事实核查。然而所得分数取决于三个设计决策：论断回答哪些问题、每条论断在何种条件下被判定、以及哪些来源算作证据。现有基准均未同时明确这三者。我们提出 JSFactCheckBench，一个明确这三者的日语基准，包含 1,913 条来自 LLM 对日本社交媒体流传的误导性信息相关问题的答案的论断，每条论断均在参考时间点标注事实性及对问题的重要性，并使用预选 Web 来源的证据。在六个 LLM 上，所有模型对直接回答问题的论断的核查准确率均低于补充性论断，而聚合分数掩盖了这一差距。当模型必须在更长或多个来源中定位相关内容时，分数也会下降；且对全部四个开源模型而言，当加入周围的问题和回答时分数同样下降。这些弱点之所以可见，是因为该基准记录了每个标签背后的条件。一个将这些条件隐含化的基准无法揭示它们。
translation.brief: 针对现有事实核查基准未明确判定条件与证据来源的问题，构建明确三要素的日语基准 JSFactCheckBench，揭示 LLM 核查器在不同条件下的系统性弱点。

papers.title: Behind Aggregate Scores: What Systematically Varying Arena-Hard's LLM Judge Reveals
papers.abstract: LLM judges are used to determine which of two answers is better. Trusting these verdicts requires knowing how repeatable they are and how much they depend on the judge's instructions. We show that similar aggregate scores can conceal substantial changes in individual verdicts, both when the same setup is repeated and when the instructions change. Using 500 Arena-Hard v2.0 prompts with two models' answers held fixed, we run GPT-4.1 as the judge under all eight combinations of criteria, output format and task framing, and repeat every setup unchanged at temperature zero on a pinned model version. Rerunning the default setup moves the aggregate score by about one point but changes the win/tie/loss outcome on 21.2% of prompts. Instruction changes introduce further sensitivity: in one setup, which asks for the verdict without reasoning and also drops several other instructions, outcomes change on 28.2 percentage points more prompts than the two setups' unchanged reruns do on average, and the aggregate score falls by 4.09 points. In another, where the criteria prioritise accuracy, outcomes change on 6.7 percentage points more prompts by the same comparison, while the aggregate score barely moves. A stable aggregate score therefore does not establish that individual verdicts are repeatable. This distinction matters when those verdicts are used as preference labels or to assess individual responses. Evaluations that rely on individual verdicts should repeat each setup they use and report both aggregate scores and prompt-level agreement.

translation.title: 聚合分数背后：系统性改变 Arena-Hard 的 LLM 评审揭示了什么
translation.abstract: LLM 评审被用来判定两个答案中哪个更好。信任这些判定需要知道它们的可重复性以及它们对评审指令的依赖程度。我们表明，相似的聚合分数可能掩盖个别判定的重大变化，无论是在相同设置重复运行时还是在指令改变时。使用 500 个 Arena-Hard v2.0 提示并固定两个模型的答案，我们在标准、输出格式和任务框架的全部八种组合下运行 GPT-4.1 作为评审，并在温度为零、固定模型版本的条件下原样重复每个设置。重新运行默认设置使聚合分数变动约一分，但改变了 21.2% 提示上的胜/平/负结果。指令变化引入了进一步的敏感性：在一个设置中（要求不给出推理直接给出判定并省略若干其他指令），与两个设置原样重跑的平均值相比，结果在多出 28.2 个百分点的提示上发生变化，聚合分数下降 4.09 分。在另一个标准优先考虑准确性的设置中，按同样比较结果在多出 6.7 个百分点的提示上变化，而聚合分数几乎不动。因此，稳定的聚合分数并不能证明个别判定是可重复的。当这些判定被用作偏好标签或用于评估个别回答时，这一区分至关重要。依赖个别判定的评估应重复其使用的每个设置，并同时报告聚合分数和提示级一致性。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 评审判定的可重复性及其对指令的敏感性，通过系统性改变 Arena-Hard 评审设置并重复运行，揭示聚合分数掩盖的提示级判定波动。

papers.title: Beyond End-to-End Recovery: Towards a Better Understanding of LLM Steganography via Rolewise Decomposition
papers.abstract: In large language model (LLM) steganography, an encoder hides a private message in an otherwise ordinary response, as text transmitted to a decoder, who attempts to recover it. The success of this private-message transmission is commonly measured through end-to-end (E2E) recovery, which checks whether the decoder correctly reconstructs the private message. However, E2E recovery cannot distinguish encoding failures from decoding failures or reveal how the private message is represented in the encoder's transmitted text. To address these limitations, we introduce a rolewise decomposition framework that separately examines how private messages are represented in encoder transmitted texts, what decoders recover, and what deterministic verification can establish. Across 7,200 encoder responses, we identify 168 verifiable encodings missed by decoders and 706 responses containing private messages reconstructed through word-length or token-initial patterns not explicitly specified in the encoder's instructions. These findings demonstrate that E2E recovery alone may obscure important distinctions between encoding and decoding, motivating their separate evaluation to better understand and mitigate the safety issues caused by LLM steganography.

translation.title: 超越端到端恢复：通过角色分解更好地理解 LLM 隐写术
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）隐写术中，编码器将私密消息隐藏在看似普通的回复中，作为文本传输给解码器，解码器尝试恢复该消息。这种私密消息传输的成功通常通过端到端（E2E）恢复来衡量，即检查解码器是否正确重建了私密消息。然而，E2E 恢复无法区分编码失败与解码失败，也无法揭示私密消息在编码器传输文本中的表示方式。为解决这些局限，我们引入一个角色分解框架，分别考察私密消息在编码器传输文本中的表示方式、解码器恢复了什么、以及确定性验证能确立什么。在 7,200 个编码器回复中，我们识别出 168 个被解码器遗漏的可验证编码，以及 706 个包含通过编码器指令中未明确指定的词长或词首模式重建的私密消息的回复。这些发现表明，仅靠 E2E 恢复可能掩盖编码与解码之间的重要区别，促使对二者分别评估，以更好地理解和缓解 LLM 隐写术造成的安全问题。
translation.brief: 针对端到端恢复指标无法区分编码与解码失败的问题，提出角色分解框架，分别评估编码器表示、解码器恢复与确定性验证，以深入理解 LLM 隐写术。

papers.title: LLM2Cert: LLM Synthesis of Certificates with SMT/Lean Verification
papers.abstract: Lyapunov functions and barrier certificates give state-space guarantees of stability and safety, but synthesizing and verifying them---especially for nonlinear, high-dimensional systems---remains an open challenge. Existing pipelines verify candidates with numerical solvers (sum-of-squares programs), interval methods, or satisfiability-modulo-theories (SMT) solvers, which often require relaxations, are conservative, or scale poorly with model dimension and nonlinearity. These limitations have also shaped benchmark design: standard test suites are dominated by low-dimensional polynomial systems chosen to suit what solvers can handle rather than what engineering applications require. We address both sides of this challenge. First, we introduce DynaCertBench, a benchmark of 105 instances: 80 non-redundant systems curated from the literature, extended with high-dimensional and control-constrained variants and new nonlinearly coupled systems, comprehensively spanning stability, region-of-attraction, forward-invariance, and safety tasks. Second, we present LLM2Cert, an LLM-driven framework that synthesizes candidate certificates and verifies them against their proof obligations: each obligation is routed to an SMT solver or directly to the Lean Proof-Repair agent. On DynaCertBench, LLM2Cert verifies 81 of 105 instances ($77.1\%$), a $17.1$ percentage point improvement over one-shot proposal without feedback. On the 81 fixed certificates, LLM2Cert verifies 22 that All-SMT leaves unresolved. Code and data are available at https://github.com/FormalCert-AI/llm2cert.

translation.title: LLM2Cert：结合 SMT/Lean 验证的 LLM 证书合成
translation.abstract: Lyapunov 函数和 barrier 证书能够为稳定性和安全性提供状态空间保证，但它们的合成与验证——尤其是对非线性、高维系统——仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。现有流程使用数值求解器（平方和规划）、区间方法或可满足性模理论（SMT）求解器来验证候选证书，这些方法往往需要松弛、较为保守，或随模型维度和非线性程度扩展性差。这些局限也影响了基准测试的设计：标准测试集以低维多项式系统为主，其选择依据是求解器能处理什么，而非工程应用需要什么。我们从两方面应对这一挑战。首先，我们提出 DynaCertBench，一个包含 105 个实例的基准：其中 80 个是从文献中精选的非冗余系统，并扩展了高维和带控制约束的变体以及新的非线性耦合系统，全面涵盖稳定性、吸引域、前向不变性和安全性任务。其次，我们提出 LLM2Cert，一个由 LLM 驱动的框架，它合成候选证书并针对其证明义务进行验证：每条义务被路由到 SMT 求解器或直接交给 Lean Proof-Repair 智能体。在 DynaCertBench 上，LLM2Cert 验证了 105 个实例中的 81 个（77.1%），比无反馈的一次性提议提升了 17.1 个百分点。在 81 个已修复的证书中，LLM2Cert 验证了 22 个 All-SMT 无法解决的实例。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/FormalCert-AI/llm2cert 获取。
translation.brief: 针对非线性高维系统证书合成与验证困难的问题，提出 LLM 驱动的证书合成框架 LLM2Cert，并通过 SMT 求解器与 Lean Proof-Repair 智能体验证证明义务，同时构建了大规模基准 DynaCertBench。

papers.title: IFC-MCQ: Automatically Generating Multiple-Choice Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Agents on IFC Data Retrieval
papers.abstract: Industry Foundation Classes (IFC), the standard for building information exchange in architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC), is increasingly queried through large language models (LLMs) using natural language. Evaluating these systems at scale is difficult because free-text answers require costly human or LLM-based review. We propose IFC-MCQ, a method that automatically generates multiple-choice benchmarks from IFC files for exact option-set grading. The taxonomy covers 15 categories and 36 subtypes across four groups, with answer keys derived from the file and distractors constructed from file-derived values or predefined rules. We applied IFC-MCQ to IFC models of varying sizes and modelling characteristics to assess generation coverage and evaluated two agentic configurations on selected models using tool- and code-based retrieval. The evaluation exposed category-specific failure modes and showed that performance can vary with the source IFC model and retrieval interface. IFC-MCQ enables scalable benchmarking of LLM-based IFC retrieval in AEC workflows.

translation.title: IFC-MCQ：自动生成多选题基准以评估 LLM 智能体在 IFC 数据检索上的表现
translation.abstract: Industry Foundation Classes（IFC）是建筑、工程和施工（AEC）领域建筑信息交换的标准，正越来越多地通过大语言模型（LLM）以自然语言进行查询。由于自由文本答案需要昂贵的人工或基于 LLM 的审查，大规模评估这些系统十分困难。我们提出 IFC-MCQ，一种从 IFC 文件自动生成多选题基准的方法，可实现精确的选项集评分。该分类体系涵盖四组共 15 个类别和 36 个子类型，答案键从文件中导出，干扰项则由文件导出的值或预定义规则构造。我们将 IFC-MCQ 应用于不同规模和建模特征的 IFC 模型以评估生成覆盖率，并使用基于工具和代码的检索在选定模型上评估了两种智能体配置。评估揭示了特定类别的失败模式，并表明性能可能随源 IFC 模型和检索接口而变化。IFC-MCQ 使 AEC 工作流中基于 LLM 的 IFC 检索能够进行可扩展的基准测试。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体 IFC 数据检索难以大规模评估的问题，提出从 IFC 文件自动生成多选题基准 IFC-MCQ 的方法，实现精确的选项集评分。

papers.title: PLE: Physical-Engineering's Last Exam
papers.abstract: Frontier language models now score above 90% on popular knowledge benchmarks and are increasingly deployed as agents that carry out multi-hour professional work. Yet no existing benchmark tests whether they can perform the real-world, economically valuable work of a professional physical engineer, such as modelling physics and legal code requirements across a multi-format project corpus, optimising material and installation costs, and issuing 2D/3D engineering design packages that a licensed reviewer would sign off on. Existing engineering benchmarks focus on textbook question answering, isolated tool calls or self-contained toy design problems. As a result, most of these benchmarks are already saturated by leading agents and solving them is far away from delivering real engineering design. We introduce PLE, a benchmark of 85 long-horizon, agentic tasks in professional physical engineering consisting of electrical, civil, structural and mechanical engineering, where solving a task means completing a realistic, billable engineering deliverable. PLE combines two complementary curation paths. Expert-Authored tasks are created end to end by practising engineers from a professional data provider's expert pool. Co-Authored tasks start from problem statements written by practising engineers; an adversarial Creator-Solver agent pipeline constructs each task's realistic project environment, executable grader and reference deliverables before sending them to expert engineers for validation and difficulty intensification. We evaluate a variety of frontier LLMs under seven publicly available agent harnesses. Even the strongest configuration reaches a mean score of only 50.6%, while spending 27M tokens and 63 minutes per task on average, demonstrating the substantial gap between current agents and autonomous physical engineering design.

translation.title: PLE：物理工程的最后考试
translation.abstract: 前沿语言模型在流行的知识基准上得分已超过 90%，并越来越多地被部署为执行数小时专业工作的智能体。然而，目前尚无基准测试它们能否完成专业物理工程师所做的真实、具有经济价值的工作，例如在多格式项目语料库中对物理和法规要求进行建模、优化材料和安装成本，以及出具能获得持证审查人签字认可的 2D/3D 工程设计包。现有的工程基准侧重于教科书式问答、孤立的工具调用或自包含的玩具设计问题。因此，这些基准大多已被领先的智能体饱和，解决它们与交付真实工程设计相去甚远。我们提出 PLE，一个包含 85 个长时程、智能体化专业物理工程任务的基准，涵盖电气、土木、结构和机械工程，其中解决一个任务意味着完成一个真实的、可计费的工程交付物。PLE 结合了两条互补的构建路径。专家编写（Expert-Authored）任务由来自专业数据提供商专家库的执业工程师端到端创建。共同编写（Co-Authored）任务从执业工程师撰写的问题陈述出发，由对抗性的 Creator-Solver 智能体流水线构建每个任务的真实项目环境、可执行评分器和参考交付物，然后送交专家工程师进行验证和难度强化。我们在七个公开可用的智能体框架下评估了多种前沿 LLM。即使最强的配置平均得分也仅为 50.6%，且每个任务平均消耗 2700 万 token 和 63 分钟，这表明当前智能体与自主物理工程设计之间存在巨大差距。
translation.brief: 针对现有工程基准无法测试 LLM 智能体完成真实物理工程设计工作的问题，构建了包含 85 个长时程智能体化任务的基准 PLE，任务由专家编写或通过对抗性 Creator-Solver 流水线共同构建。

papers.title: Atlas: Making Sense of Long Horizon Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract: AI agents can now search literature, generate hypotheses, analyze datasets, and run experiments at a scale difficult for researchers to match. Yet scaling scientific execution does not automatically scale researchers' ability to make sense of what agents produce. When researchers return to a long-horizon run, they must evaluate work they did not monitor: what the agent produced, which decisions shaped those outputs, and whether those decisions served the research goal. We frame this post-run sensemaking as a representation problem across three linked levels: goal, decision, and artifact. From this framework we developed Atlas, an agentic workspace with a trajectory tree, which renders the run as a branching structure showing what the agent chose and set aside, and artifact projections over six representations. In a within-subjects study (N=14), participants reported higher decision transparency, artifact sensemaking, and goal connection with Atlas than with a standard baseline, together with substantially lower subjective workload.

translation.title: Atlas：理解长时程智能体轨迹
translation.abstract: AI 智能体现在能够以研究人员难以匹敌的规模搜索文献、生成假设、分析数据集和运行实验。然而，扩展科学执行能力并不能自动扩展研究人员理解智能体产出的能力。当研究人员回顾一次长时程运行时，他们必须评估自己未曾监控的工作：智能体产出了什么、哪些决策塑造了这些产出，以及这些决策是否服务于研究目标。我们将这种运行后的意义建构（sensemaking）框架化为跨越三个相互关联层次——目标、决策和产出物——的表示问题。基于该框架，我们开发了 Atlas，一个带有轨迹树的智能体工作区，它将运行过程渲染为分支结构，展示智能体选择了什么、搁置了什么，并提供六种表示形式之上的产出物投影。在一项被试内研究（N=14）中，参与者报告称与标准基线相比，使用 Atlas 时决策透明度、产出物意义建构和目标关联度更高，同时主观工作负荷显著降低。
translation.brief: 针对研究人员难以理解长时程智能体运行产出的意义建构问题，基于目标-决策-产出物三层表示框架开发了带轨迹树和产出物投影的智能体工作区 Atlas。

papers.title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
papers.abstract: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent

translation.title: 面向自主投资的可治理自进化：具有不变核心的多智能体 LLM 系统
translation.abstract: 基于实时 Web 数据行动的 LLM 智能体必须整合异构证据、记住自己做过什么，并从结果中改进而不削弱自身的安全防护。我们在自主投资领域研究这一问题，其中每个行动都是不可逆的且基于不可信的 Web 内容。我们提出 Steward，一个在类型系统中划定自进化边界的多智能体 LLM 系统。首先，九个角色专门化的智能体共同决策：四个分析师阅读新闻源、SEC 文件、宏观经济序列和市场数据并输出类型化报告，投资组合经理（Portfolio Manager）据此设定目标仓位，由受保护的风险经理（Risk Manager）审计。其次，由代码从系统自身记录组装的七层共享记忆，为每个决策提供仓位上下文、市场叙事、校准信息和智能体的过往决策。第三，系统通过审查实现自我改进：代码每晚对每笔交易和预测进行评分并将评分写入记忆，每季度一个反思器（reflector）提出提示词学习，由确定性门控以可逆方式应用，并通过重放记录的输入进行验证。这三者都围绕一个由序数算术、风险规则和纪律智能体提示词组成的不变核心运行，任何自我编辑都无法触及该核心。在为期五个月的实盘部署（102 个交易日，1,632 次 LLM 调用）中，系统将 24.6% 的行业回撤控制在 0.3% 的损失；在对其记录输入的重放中，给定相同原始数据的单个模型交易更频繁，并在联合设计无显著损失的五天内相对市场亏损 1.35 个百分点，且没有任何注入指令被遵循；2015-2026 年的回测显示，仅核心就能在所有 50 种随机入场策略下降低最大回撤。反思器将主要失败追溯到其根本原因，门控应用了一项学习成果，智能体在触发之夜采纳了它，而在无控制的夜晚则没有。代码：https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent
translation.brief: 针对基于不可信 Web 数据的自主投资中 LLM 智能体需安全自进化的问题，提出多智能体系统 Steward，通过角色分工、七层共享记忆和带确定性门控的反思机制，围绕不可自我编辑的不变核心运行。

papers.title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.

translation.title: 当新闻变旧时：基于强化学习与大语言模型的投资组合配置
translation.abstract: 金融新闻在发布后很久仍可能影响投资决策。及时的新闻可能在价格完全调整之前到达投资者，而较旧的新闻可能已反映在价格中。我们研究了处理老化信号的两种方式：保留它们并向投资组合策略提供时间信息，或在投资组合选择之前将其过滤掉。一个固定的大语言模型（LLM）从公开的 SEC 披露文件中提取信号。我们在强化学习（RL）策略和直接选择投资组合的 LLM 中比较这些处理方式。我们在 2023-2025 年的历史测试中评估扣除交易成本后的收益。在一个受控测试中，RL 的选择会对时间信息做出响应，但历史收益显示加入时间信息并无一致的好处。对于 LLM，过滤旧新闻产生了最高的平均净收益，当新闻延迟四周送达时达到每年 18.43%。这超过了所有使用新闻的 RL 策略的收益。
translation.brief: 研究如何处理老化新闻信号对投资组合配置的影响，通过对比保留时间信息与过滤旧新闻两种方式在 RL 策略和 LLM 中的表现来选择更优方案。

papers.title: Beyond Better Ideas: How Human-AI Collaboration Shapes Scientific Ideas and Human Perceptions
papers.abstract: As AI increasingly becomes a collaborator in scientific research, its impact may extend beyond improving ideas to reshaping how they are evaluated, attributed, and perceived by humans. Yet existing research has largely examined these dimensions in isolation. We present a unified empirical study of Human-AI scientific ideation, investigating two complementary perspectives: i) how AI collaboration shapes scientific ideas and their evaluation, and ii) how firsthand collaboration reshapes human perceptions of AI. Through a shared experimental setting involving Human-AI and Human-Human research teams, human and LLM evaluators, collaboration-provenance analysis, and participant surveys, we uncover several counterintuitive findings. First, AI collaboration shows no significant advantage in human-evaluated idea quality, while iterative revision consistently improves quality. Second, AI judges can approximate human scores yet disagree on idea rankings; notably, an AI judge favors AI-assisted proposals without a corresponding advantage in human evaluations. Third, collaboration provenance remains only partially detectable, revealing substantial overlap between Human-AI and Human-Human scientific outputs. Finally, firsthand AI collaboration is associated with greater perceived usefulness but smaller efficiency gains than expected, suggesting a nuanced recalibration of human expectations. Overall, our findings challenge the notion that AI's value in scientific ideation lies primarily in producing better ideas, revealing instead its broader influence on scientific creation, evaluation, attribution, and human perceptions.

translation.title: 超越更好的想法：人机协作如何塑造科学想法与人类认知
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 日益成为科学研究的协作者，其影响可能不仅限于改进想法，还会重塑想法被评估、归属和感知的方式。然而现有研究大多孤立地考察这些维度。我们对人机科学构思进行了统一的实证研究，考察两个互补的视角：i) AI 协作如何塑造科学想法及其评估；ii) 亲身协作如何重塑人类对 AI 的认知。通过一个共享的实验设置，包括人机与人人研究团队、人类与 LLM 评估者、协作来源分析以及参与者调查，我们发现了若干反直觉的结果。首先，AI 协作在人类评估的想法质量上没有显著优势，而迭代修订则持续提升质量。其次，AI 评审可以近似人类评分但在想法排名上存在分歧；值得注意的是，AI 评审偏爱 AI 辅助的提案，而人类评估中并无相应优势。第三，协作来源只能被部分检测出来，揭示了人机与人人科学产出之间存在大量重叠。最后，亲身的 AI 协作与更高的感知有用性相关，但效率提升低于预期，表明人类期望需要细致的重新校准。总体而言，我们的发现挑战了 AI 在科学构思中的价值主要在于产生更好想法的观念，揭示了其对科学创造、评估、归属和人类认知的更广泛影响。
translation.brief: 通过统一实验研究人机协作对科学想法质量、评估、来源检测及人类对 AI 认知的影响，揭示 AI 协作在想法质量上无显著优势但影响更广泛的多维效应。

papers.title: Stale Instruction Files Override the Code in Coding Agents: A One-Sentence Fix
papers.abstract: Purpose: Coding agents follow a project's instruction file, such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, even when it disagrees with the existing code and even when they notice the disagreement. We measure this behaviour and test whether one sentence in the user's own instruction file makes agents follow the code instead. Methods: We built 40 Python projects in which the instruction file asks for one convention while the existing code uses another, for example print instead of logging. Claude Code and Codex CLI added a feature to each project, with and without a sentence in the user-level instruction file that gives the existing code precedence, in 320 runs. Results: Without the sentence, 90.1% of the agents' choices followed the stale file. Claude Code pointed out the conflict in 79 of 80 runs and still followed the file. Codex CLI rewrote the existing code to match the file in 20 of 80 runs, and the project's own tests then failed in 17 of them. The sentence raised the share of choices that follow the code from 4.2% to 91.4%, stopped the rewrites and raised the test pass rate from 89.4% to 100%. Conclusion: We attribute the behaviour to how agents receive the two sources: the instruction file reaches the model as an instruction and the code as tool output, which models are trained to rank lower. Users can add the sentence today, and makers of agents and models can build the same rule into their products.

translation.title: 过时的指令文件覆盖代码：一句修复
translation.abstract: 目的：编码智能体会遵循项目的指令文件（如 CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md），即使它与现有代码不一致，甚至即使它们注意到了这种不一致。我们测量了这种行为，并测试在用户自己的指令文件中加入一句话是否能让智能体遵循代码。方法：我们构建了 40 个 Python 项目，其中指令文件要求一种约定而现有代码使用另一种，例如用 print 而非 logging。Claude Code 和 Codex CLI 为每个项目添加了一个功能，在用户级指令文件中带有或不带有赋予现有代码优先权的一句话，共进行 320 次运行。结果：没有这句话时，90.1% 的智能体选择遵循过时的文件。Claude Code 在 80 次运行中有 79 次指出了冲突，但仍然遵循该文件。Codex CLI 在 80 次运行中有 20 次重写了现有代码以匹配文件，其中 17 次导致项目自身的测试失败。这句话将遵循代码的选择比例从 4.2% 提高到 91.4%，阻止了重写，并将测试通过率从 89.4% 提高到 100%。结论：我们将这种行为归因于智能体接收两种来源的方式：指令文件作为指令到达模型，而代码作为工具输出到达模型，模型被训练为将后者排在较低优先级。用户今天就可以添加这句话，智能体和模型的制造商也可以将同样的规则内置到他们的产品中。
translation.brief: 测量编码智能体遵循过时指令文件而非现有代码的行为，并提出在用户指令文件中加入一句赋予代码优先权的话来修复该问题。

papers.title: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Unlike conventional GUI agents, personalized GUI agents require user preferences to guide sequential execution over changing GUI states. This raises two challenges: determining HOW each preference should alter execution strategy and WHEN it should take effect along the interaction trajectory. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate overall task success, offering limited insight into these questions. We introduce PrefDiag-Bench with two components: (1) a categorization of preferences into five types, characterizing HOW they affect execution; and (2) a stage-wise diagnostic framework with 1,664 probes, tracing WHEN preferences should take effect and where failures occur. We evaluate eleven GUI agent systems, including end-to-end agents and agentic workflows, under two forms of user context: explicit user profiles and behavioral memory logs. Although existing agents achieve relatively high completion rates on non-personalized tasks, performance is substantially lower on preference-personalized tasks. Even the best-performing model, Seed-2.0-Pro, achieves only 47.17% on Process preferences under explicit user profiles. Agents struggle particularly with Ranking and Process preferences. Further analysis reveals two key capability bottlenecks: selecting relevant evidence from user history and recognizing when preferences should take effect during execution. Controlled interventions that explicitly provide relevant evidence improve end-to-end task success by up to 7.06%. PrefDiag-Bench offers a more systematic evaluation of GUI agents' personalization capabilities beyond overall task success. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zhixin-L/PrefDiag-Bench.

translation.title: 诊断移动 GUI 智能体的个性化失败
translation.abstract: 与传统的 GUI 智能体不同，个性化 GUI 智能体需要用户偏好来指导在不断变化的 GUI 状态上的顺序执行。这带来了两个挑战：确定每个偏好应如何（HOW）改变执行策略，以及它应在交互轨迹的何时（WHEN）生效。现有基准主要评估整体任务成功率，对这些问题的洞察有限。我们引入 PrefDiag-Bench，包含两个组件：(1) 将偏好分为五种类型的分类法，刻画它们如何影响执行；(2) 一个包含 1,664 个探针的分阶段诊断框架，追踪偏好应何时生效以及失败发生在何处。我们在两种用户上下文形式（显式用户画像和行为记忆日志）下评估了十一个 GUI 智能体系统，包括端到端智能体和智能体工作流。尽管现有智能体在非个性化任务上达到相对较高的完成率，但在偏好个性化任务上的表现明显较低。即使表现最好的模型 Seed-2.0-Pro，在显式用户画像下的 Process 偏好上也仅达到 47.17%。智能体在 Ranking 和 Process 偏好上尤其困难。进一步分析揭示了两个关键能力瓶颈：从用户历史中选择相关证据，以及识别偏好应在执行过程中的何时生效。显式提供相关证据的受控干预可将端到端任务成功率提高最多 7.06%。PrefDiag-Bench 提供了超越整体任务成功率的 GUI 智能体个性化能力的更系统评估。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/Zhixin-L/PrefDiag-Bench 获取。
translation.brief: 提出 PrefDiag-Bench 基准，通过偏好分类与分阶段诊断探针系统定位移动 GUI 智能体在个性化执行中的失败类型与能力瓶颈。

papers.title: Know When to Escalate: Critic-Guided Adaptive Execution for Cloud-Local Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Recent advances in foundation-model agents have enabled increasingly capable embodied systems for long-horizon planning and interaction. However, embodied agents require fast, closed-loop decisions as they continuously perceive and act on a changing environment. Deploying strong cloud agents leaves the platform idle for seconds between consecutive actions, while lightweight local models respond quickly but are more vulnerable to errors. Existing hierarchical architectures typically assign models fixed roles, whereas conventional model routers make stateless per-request decisions. We present CARE, a critic-guided adaptive execution framework that dynamically determines when to escalate control from a local executor to a stronger cloud model. A lightweight critic model monitors execution reliability and triggers escalation when local execution becomes unreliable; once escalated, control persists until the agent recovers, avoiding step-wise switching. To support such control transfer, a shared handoff memory maintains execution context and task-level progress across executors, enabling the model to intervene without restarting from scratch. Across diverse embodied benchmarks, CARE improves task success by 6.3-18.3 percentage points over the strongest evaluated collaboration baseline. CARE further approaches or exceeds Cloud-only success while reducing median time-between-action latency by 28.8-82.6%.

translation.title: 知道何时升级：面向云-本地具身智能体的评论者引导自适应执行
translation.abstract: 基础模型智能体的最新进展使具身系统在长程规划与交互方面能力日益增强。然而，具身智能体在持续感知并作用于变化环境时需要快速、闭环的决策。部署强大的云端智能体会在连续动作之间使平台闲置数秒，而轻量级本地模型响应迅速但更容易出错。现有的分层架构通常为模型分配固定角色，而传统的模型路由器则做出无状态的逐请求决策。我们提出 CARE，一个评论者引导的自适应执行框架，动态决定何时将控制从本地执行器升级到更强的云端模型。一个轻量级评论者模型监控执行可靠性，并在本地执行变得不可靠时触发升级；一旦升级，控制将持续保持直到智能体恢复，避免逐步切换。为支持这种控制转移，一个共享的交接记忆在执行器之间维护执行上下文和任务级进度，使模型能够介入而无需从头开始。在多样的具身基准上，CARE 将任务成功率比最强的评估协作基线提高了 6.3-18.3 个百分点。CARE 进一步接近或超过仅云端的成功率，同时将动作间中位延迟降低 28.8-82.6%。
translation.brief: 提出 CARE 框架，用轻量级评论者模型监控本地执行可靠性并动态升级到云端模型，结合共享交接记忆解决云-本地具身智能体的控制转移问题。

papers.title: Visual Grounding First, Multimodal In-context Learning Follows
papers.abstract: LLMs have shown strong in-context learning (ICL) capability, but extending it to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) remains challenging. Prior multimodal ICL methods often rely on ICL-specific datasets for additional training or task vector extraction, which can improve performance on the same ICL benchmark used for adaptation. However, they do not generalize well to other benchmarks and often induce forgetting in previously well-solved tasks. For this reason, we identify 'visual grounding' as the key bottleneck in multimodal ICL; MLLMs often fail to attend to task-relevant visual evidence in demonstrations, instead over-relying on textual cues and producing hallucinated outputs. To address this, we propose ProCoRe to enhance visual grounding through contrastive reinforcement learning on multimodal contrastive data for improving multimodal ICL. ProCoRe generates captions for contrastive image pairs, decomposes them into propositions, and optimizes contrastive rewards that encourage alignment with corresponding images while discouraging mismatched ones. Despite never seeing ICL-formatted training examples, ProCoRe improves average multimodal ICL classification accuracy by 5.6% and captioning ROUGE-L by 13.8% over the off-the-shelf Qwen-VL-3-8B model, outperforming ICL-data-dependent state of the arts across benchmarks. Finally, we introduce PICL, a personalized multimodal ICL captioning benchmark that tests whether MLLMs genuinely understand visual demonstrations rather than relying on pre-trained semantic priors.

translation.title: 先视觉定位，多模态上下文学习随之而来
translation.abstract: LLM 已展现出强大的上下文学习（ICL）能力，但将其扩展到多模态 LLM（MLLM）仍具挑战性。以往的多模态 ICL 方法通常依赖专门的 ICL 数据集进行额外训练或任务向量提取，这虽能提升用于适配的同一 ICL 基准上的性能，却难以泛化到其他基准，且常导致在原本已良好解决的任务上出现遗忘。基于此，我们识别出'视觉定位'是多模态 ICL 的关键瓶颈：MLLM 往往无法关注演示中与任务相关的视觉证据，而是过度依赖文本线索并产生幻觉输出。为解决这一问题，我们提出 ProCoRe，通过对多模态对比数据进行对比强化学习来增强视觉定位，从而改进多模态 ICL。ProCoRe 为对比图像对生成描述，将其分解为命题，并优化对比奖励，鼓励与相应图像对齐、抑制不匹配的图像。尽管从未见过 ICL 格式的训练样本，ProCoRe 相较开箱即用的 Qwen-VL-3-8B 模型，将多模态 ICL 分类准确率平均提升 5.6%，描述任务的 ROUGE-L 提升 13.8%，在各基准上超越了依赖 ICL 数据的最先进方法。最后，我们提出 PICL，一个个性化多模态 ICL 描述基准，用于检验 MLLM 是否真正理解视觉演示，而非依赖预训练的语义先验。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 多模态上下文学习中忽视任务相关视觉证据的瓶颈，提出 ProCoRe，通过对比强化学习增强视觉定位能力。

papers.title: TT-SAX: A Two-Track Time Series Symbolization for Natural Language Shape Querying
papers.abstract: Natural language querying for time series databases aims to let users find what they need in long histories of data by asking in plain language. Shape queries ask how a series moves. They are the main challenge of this task. Recent work makes them feasible by using symbolization as a bridge between the query and the long history. However, existing symbolizations were designed for compression, similarity indexing, or classification. What a symbolization should provide for natural language querying has not been systematically studied. We therefore examine the definitions of six classical symbolizations against this task and identify three limitations. (1) Direction is missing from the string, (2) direction is measured at too small a scale, and (3) the letters are arbitrary. Three design principles follow. We follow these principles and make a minimal redesign of SAX called TT-SAX (two-track SAX). The level letters stay. Each segment gains a trend letter. It is measured across neighboring segments rather than inside one, and graded to match the adjectives that queries use. We conduct extensive experiments on the public NLQTSBench benchmark, comparing TT-SAX with the six classical symbolizations across six LLMs. TT-SAX outperforms all six on shape queries, and ablations trace its gains back to the three limitations one by one. This paper is the first systematic study of time series symbolization with natural language querying as the design goal. It provides a foundation for future research on this task. Our code is available at https://github.com/Atlamtiz/tt-sax.

translation.title: TT-SAX：面向自然语言形状查询的双轨时间序列符号化方法
translation.abstract: 时间序列数据库的自然语言查询旨在让用户通过自然语言提问，从漫长的历史数据中找到所需内容。形状查询关注序列的走势形态，是该任务的主要挑战。近期工作通过将符号化作为查询与长历史之间的桥梁使其变得可行。然而，现有符号化方法是为压缩、相似性索引或分类设计的，尚未有研究系统考察符号化应为自然语言查询提供什么。因此，我们对照该任务审视了六种经典符号化的定义，识别出三个局限：（1）字符串中缺失方向信息；（2）方向的度量尺度过小；（3）字母符号任意。由此得出三条设计原则。我们遵循这些原则对 SAX 进行了最小化重设计，提出 TT-SAX（双轨 SAX）：保留水平字母，为每个分段增加一个趋势字母，该字母跨相邻分段而非在单个分段内部度量，并分级以匹配查询中使用的形容词。我们在公开的 NLQTSBench 基准上，将 TT-SAX 与六种经典符号化在六个 LLM 上进行了广泛比较。TT-SAX 在形状查询上超越全部六种方法，消融实验将其增益逐一归因于三个局限。本文是首个以自然语言查询为设计目标的时间序列符号化系统研究，为该任务的后续研究奠定了基础。代码已开源：https://github.com/Atlamtiz/tt-sax。
translation.brief: 针对自然语言形状查询中现有时间序列符号化的三大局限，提出在 SAX 基础上加入跨分段趋势字母的双轨符号化方法 TT-SAX。

papers.title: Better Reasoning, Not Just Bigger Models: A Structure-Grounded Framework for Efficient and Reliable Inference
papers.abstract: Scaling large language models has substantially improved linguistic fluency, yet reliable autonomous agents require more than fluent generation. In multi-turn inference, current agentic systems often produce semantically plausible but structurally ungrounded reasoning, especially under incomplete observations. We propose Structure-Grounded Uncertainty Reduction (SGUR), a training-free framework that complements token-level generation with active uncertainty reduction over structured hypothesis spaces. SGUR represents incomplete observations as a query graph and aligns them with candidate hypothesis graphs through a prior-weighted partial graph matching mechanism, where database-derived empirical priors assign greater importance to decision-relevant relations rather than treating all graph edges uniformly. The resulting inference state is iteratively refined by an active information-gain strategy that selects the next most informative node to query, systematically pruning the candidate space. We instantiate SGUR on a challenging PrimeKG-derived sequential medical diagnosis benchmark, demonstrating that structural grounding can partially substitute for model scale: starting from only two observed symptoms, SGUR achieves 92.5% Hit@3, outperforming the strongest Graph-RAG baseline by 9.4 percentage points while using approximately 5x fewer tokens. Notably, SGUR enables smaller backbone models to match or exceed the performance of models up to 10x larger, suggesting that structural grounding provides a more robust and efficient paradigm for scaling agent performance than relying exclusively on increasing model size.

translation.title: 更好的推理，而非仅仅更大的模型：一个面向高效可靠推理的结构接地框架
translation.abstract: 扩展大语言模型显著提升了语言流畅性，但可靠的自主智能体需要的远不止流畅的生成。在多轮推理中，当前的 agentic 系统常产生语义上合理但结构上缺乏依据的推理，尤其在观测不完整时。我们提出结构接地不确定性消减（SGUR），一个免训练框架，在 token 级生成之外，通过在结构化假设空间上进行主动不确定性消减来补充生成。SGUR 将不完整观测表示为查询图，并通过先验加权的部分图匹配机制将其与候选假设图对齐，其中来自数据库的经验先验赋予决策相关关系更高的重要性，而非对所有图边一视同仁。由此得到的推理状态通过主动信息增益策略迭代精炼，选择下一个信息量最大的节点进行查询，系统性地剪枝候选空间。我们在基于 PrimeKG 构建的具有挑战性的顺序医疗诊断基准上实例化 SGUR，证明结构接地可以部分替代模型规模：仅从两个已观测症状出发，SGUR 达到 92.5% 的 Hit@3，以约 5 倍更少的 token 超越最强 Graph-RAG 基线 9.4 个百分点。值得注意的是，SGUR 使较小的骨干模型达到甚至超过规模大至 10 倍的模型的性能，表明结构接地为扩展智能体性能提供了比单纯依赖扩大模型规模更稳健高效的范式。
translation.brief: 针对多轮推理中结构性依据缺失的问题，提出免训练的 SGUR 框架，通过先验加权图匹配和主动信息增益查询策略在结构化假设空间中消减不确定性。

papers.title: Future of Time Series Anomaly Detection: From Historical Review to Unified Outlook
papers.abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is a foundational problem in data mining, aiming to identify observations that deviate significantly from nominal temporal patterns. Driven by escalating data volumes and application complexity, recent research has yielded diverse architectures, including diffusion models, state space models, and large language models (LLMs). However, existing surveys provide limited coverage of these emerging designs and lack a unified treatment of multivariate anomalies, cross-domain unified modeling, metric reliability, and contemporary evaluation challenges. To bridge these gaps, this survey delivers three core contributions: (1) We establish a refined anomaly categorization and a structured taxonomy of paradigms reflecting modern advances, comparing detection mechanisms and charting developmental trajectories across paradigms. (2) We provide an extensive analysis of evaluation methodologies and conduct comprehensive experiments to assess metric fidelity, complemented by an open-source benchmark repository encompassing algorithms, datasets, and evaluation tools. (3) We outline key open challenges, offering forward-looking perspectives on dynamic thresholding, model interpretability, zero-shot transfer, multi-modal alignment, and foundational models for time series. By addressing existing theoretical and empirical limitations, this survey establishes a coherent framework to guide future TSAD research and practical deployments.

translation.title: 时间序列异常检测的未来：从历史回顾到统一展望
translation.abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）是数据挖掘中的基础问题，旨在识别显著偏离正常时间模式的观测。在数据规模和应用复杂性不断攀升的推动下，近期研究产生了多样的架构，包括扩散模型、状态空间模型和大语言模型（LLM）。然而，现有综述对这些新兴设计的覆盖有限，且缺乏对多变量异常、跨域统一建模、指标可靠性和当代评估挑战的统一处理。为弥合这些差距，本综述做出三项核心贡献：（1）建立了精细的异常分类和反映现代进展的结构化范式分类体系，比较各检测机制并绘制各范式的发展轨迹。（2）对评估方法进行了广泛分析，并开展全面实验以评估指标保真度，同时提供了涵盖算法、数据集和评估工具的开源基准仓库。（3）梳理了关键开放挑战，对动态阈值、模型可解释性、零样本迁移、多模态对齐以及时间序列基础模型提供了前瞻性视角。通过解决现有理论与实证的局限，本综述建立了一个连贯的框架，以指导未来 TSAD 研究和实际部署。
translation.brief: 针对现有 TSAD 综述覆盖不足的问题，提供包含精细化分类体系、评估方法分析与开放挑战展望的统一综述框架。

papers.title: Large language models show systematic failures in incorporating evolving medical knowledge
papers.abstract: Medical knowledge evolves as clinical guidelines revise recommendations, yet whether large language models (LLMs) faithfully incorporate such changes remains unclear. We introduce ChronoEvo, comprising 1,709 recommendation-level revisions across 12 forms of medical knowledge change, to distinguish recognition of revised guidance from incorporation into clinical recommendations. In the primary model, 90.8% of responses recognized revisions and 80.2% were clinically correct, but only 58.5% fully incorporated guidance, yielding a 32.3-percentage-point recognition-incorporation gap. This dissociation persisted across 14 models and was corroborated by two clinicians' adjudicated assessment of 300 responses, yielding a 40.3-percentage-point gap in the validation sample. Changes in recommendation strength and patient eligibility were associated with retention of outdated guidance. A revision-salience intervention reduced outdated-content retention and improved clinical correctness but did not significantly improve full incorporation. These findings identify faithful incorporation of evolving medical knowledge as a distinct challenge for clinical LLM reliability, even when updated guideline evidence is available.

translation.title: 大语言模型在融入演化医学知识方面存在系统性失败
translation.abstract: 医学知识随着临床指南修订推荐而不断演化，但大语言模型（LLM）是否忠实地融入这些变化仍不清楚。我们提出 ChronoEvo，包含 12 种医学知识变化类型下的 1,709 项推荐层面的修订，以区分对修订指南的识别与将其融入临床推荐。在主模型中，90.8% 的回复识别了修订，80.2% 临床正确，但仅有 58.5% 完全融入指南，产生 32.3 个百分点的识别-融入差距。这一分离现象在 14 个模型中持续存在，并由两位临床医生对 300 条回复的裁定评估所证实，验证样本中的差距达 40.3 个百分点。推荐强度和患者资格的变化与过时指南的保留相关。一项修订显著性干预降低了过时内容的保留并提升了临床正确性，但未显著改善完全融入。这些发现表明，即使更新的指南证据可用，忠实地融入演化中的医学知识仍是临床 LLM 可靠性面临的一个独特挑战。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 能否忠实融入修订后医学指南的问题，构建 ChronoEvo 基准，通过区分'识别'与'融入'揭示两者间系统性差距。

papers.title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. The leaderboard's ranking is robust to removing the affected tests, but they shift scores within repositories and favour agents that reproduce upstream names. Across four further benchmarks, prevalence appears to follow construction: a third or more of the tasks are affected where specifications are release notes or LLM summaries, almost none where tasks are screened or written for their tests; how much a gap costs depends on how the harness grades. We release the audit, corrected filter lists and specification addenda.

translation.title: 规范未言明之事：测试评分型编码智能体基准中的规范-测试预言机鸿沟
translation.abstract: 编码智能体基准通常用自然语言描述任务，却用来自上游项目的测试来评分。通过这些测试可能需要描述中从未提及的信息：某个常量的名称、某个模块路径、某条精确的消息。我们将其称为规范-预言机鸿沟：只要它存在，基准就同时衡量智能体是否复现了上游实现细节。我们对这一鸿沟进行了形式化，包括依赖任务链带来的不一致性，并构建了一个覆盖五种语言的静态审计工具，对每个计分测试的名称级、路径级和字面量级依赖进行分类（留出集精确率89.2%，召回率92.9%）。在SWE-Milestone（98个评分里程碑、35次已发布运行）上，有25个里程碑包含依赖未言明且不可推断的名称或路径的测试。具有此类依赖的构建单元在80.6%的运行中失败，而无此依赖的可比单元失败率为48.4%；从参考实现中隐去单个隐藏名称，会导致其单元的测试在128个案例中的126个无法编译。排行榜排名在移除受影响测试后依然稳健，但这些测试会改变仓库内的得分，并偏向复现上游命名的智能体。在另外四个基准上，鸿沟的普遍程度似乎取决于构建方式：当规范是发布说明或LLM摘要时，三分之一或更多的任务受影响；而当任务经过筛选或为其测试专门编写时，几乎不受影响；鸿沟的代价大小取决于评测框架如何评分。我们发布了该审计工具、修正后的过滤列表和规范补充说明。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体基准中任务描述与测试预言机之间隐藏依赖导致的评分偏差问题，提出形式化定义与多语言静态审计方法来检测和量化规范-预言机鸿沟。

papers.title: Asking Less, Adapting Better: Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions and navigate to target locations. However, current VLN agents often suffer severe performance degradation in unseen environments due to distribution shifts. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm to bridge this gap, yet existing methods that rely on unsupervised entropy minimization can propagate errors through the trajectory, causing cascading failures in navigation. Recent methods mitigate this by incorporating human feedback, but they apply trajectory-level supervision uniformly across all steps without localizing the actions is truly informative, leading to inefficient feedback utilization and mismatched optimization granularity. To address these limitations, we propose FETA, a Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation method that improves both feedback efficiency and optimization reliability. To reduce unnecessary human interventions, we introduce a hierarchical sample selection strategy to localize informative samples. Specifically, we first filter trajectories whose normalized policy entropy exhibits large fluctuations. Within each selected trajectory, we further select the critical action via an entropy-gradient saliency criterion and query a single binary feedback on its correctness. A discrepancy-aware entropy optimization objective then updates the policy only at the queried step, with adaptive scaling that assigns larger relative weights to samples with greater prediction-feedback discrepancy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FETA achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer human interventions, while remaining robust under noisy feedback and continual adaptation settings.

translation.title: 少问多适应：面向视觉语言导航的反馈高效测试时自适应
translation.abstract: 视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体遵循指令导航至目标位置。然而，现有VLN智能体在未见环境中常因分布偏移而性能严重下降。测试时自适应（TTA）为弥合这一差距提供了有前景的范式，但依赖无监督熵最小化的现有方法会在轨迹中传播错误，导致导航中的级联失败。近期方法通过引入人类反馈来缓解此问题，但它们在所有步骤上统一施加轨迹级监督，而未定位真正有信息量的动作，导致反馈利用低效且优化粒度不匹配。为解决这些局限，我们提出FETA，一种反馈高效的测试时自适应方法，同时提升反馈效率与优化可靠性。为减少不必要的人类干预，我们引入分层样本选择策略来定位有信息量的样本。具体而言，我们首先过滤归一化策略熵波动较大的轨迹；在每条被选轨迹中，进一步通过熵梯度显著性准则选择关键动作，并就其正确性查询单次二元反馈。随后，一个差异感知的熵优化目标仅在所查询步骤更新策略，并采用自适应缩放，为预测-反馈差异更大的样本赋予更大的相对权重。在多个基准上的大量实验表明，FETA以更少的人类干预达到最先进性能，同时在噪声反馈和持续自适应设置下保持鲁棒。
translation.brief: 针对VLN测试时自适应中人类反馈利用低效的问题，提出通过熵波动筛选轨迹、熵梯度定位关键动作并仅在该步骤进行差异感知熵优化的反馈高效方法FETA。

papers.title: Anticipating Social Consequences with Distributional World Models
papers.abstract: Social world models predict how interactions develop after an action, helping agents negotiate, cooperate and mediate. In these situations, one action can lead to several plausible futures, hence predicting only one future can overlook consequential alternatives, while exploring them through repeated simulations increases inference cost. We propose DSWM, a Distributional Social World Model that predicts alternative responses, their probabilities and immediate and final outcome values in one output per candidate action. We train a 4B model on repeated simulations using supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. At inference time, the actor uses these possible consequences to choose an action. Across three seen and two unseen environments, with interaction backbones absent from training collection, DSWM achieves the best average performance on 13 of 15 metrics. Ablations show that retaining multiple futures and their predicted probabilities improves outcomes in all five environments.

translation.title: 用分布式世界模型预判社会后果
translation.abstract: 社会世界模型预测一个动作之后交互如何发展，帮助智能体进行谈判、合作与调解。在这些情境中，一个动作可能导向多个合理的未来，因此只预测一个未来可能忽略重要的替代可能，而通过反复模拟探索它们又会增加推理成本。我们提出DSWM，一个分布式社会世界模型，对每个候选动作用一次输出预测多个替代响应、它们的概率以及即时和最终结果价值。我们使用监督微调和GRPO在重复模拟上训练一个4B模型。在推理时，行动者利用这些可能的后果来选择动作。在三个已见和两个未见环境中，即使交互骨干模型不在训练收集范围内，DSWM也在15项指标中的13项上取得最佳平均性能。消融实验表明，保留多个未来及其预测概率在所有五个环境中都能改善结果。
translation.brief: 针对社会交互中单一未来预测忽略替代可能的问题，提出分布式社会世界模型DSWM，一次输出预测多个候选响应、概率及结果价值以辅助动作选择。

papers.title: A Topology-Guided GeoAI Agentic Framework for Urban Flood Screening
papers.abstract: Open-world geographic artificial intelligence (GeoAI) agents can transform public geospatial data into accessible decision support for real-world challenges, but must balance autonomous reasoning with reliable spatial analysis and human oversight. We present a topology-guided GeoAI agentic framework for urban flood screening that takes a place name, drawn region, or uploaded boundary and returns ranked candidate basins with an interactive map and report. A deterministic controller retrieves public elevation, rainfall, soil, land-cover, exposure, and infrastructure layers, extracts terrain depressions with discrete Morse theory, and ranks basins with a relative flood-priority score. The language model acts only at recorded decision points: selecting a persistence threshold from a precomputed candidate table, drafting recommendations from computed evidence, and reviewing each recommendation against the same evidence. Three human-in-the-loop checkpoints let users revise the threshold, factor weights, or recommendation. In a College Park, Maryland case study, the selected threshold reduced 278 raw terrain minima to 70 basins, with 77% of these basins' lowest points also identified as sinks by a separately computed eight-direction (D8) flow-routing model. Across four further study areas, agreement ranged from 61% to 83%. By combining open data, explicit spatial reasoning, traceable evidence, and human oversight, the framework enables transparent first-pass flood screening while keeping consequential recommendations inspectable and user-controlled.

translation.title: 面向城市洪水筛查的拓扑引导GeoAI智能体框架
translation.abstract: 开放世界地理人工智能（GeoAI）智能体可以将公共地理空间数据转化为面向现实挑战的易用决策支持，但必须在自主推理、可靠空间分析与人类监督之间取得平衡。我们提出一个面向城市洪水筛查的拓扑引导GeoAI智能体框架，它接受地名、绘制区域或上传的边界，返回排序后的候选流域，并附带交互式地图和报告。一个确定性控制器检索公共高程、降雨、土壤、土地覆盖、暴露度和基础设施图层，利用离散Morse理论提取地形洼地，并用相对洪水优先级评分对流域排序。语言模型仅在记录在案的决策点发挥作用：从预计算的候选表中选择持久性阈值、基于计算出的证据起草建议、并对照同一证据审查每条建议。三个人机协同检查点允许用户修改阈值、因子权重或建议。在马里兰州College Park的案例研究中，所选阈值将278个原始地形极小值缩减为70个流域，其中77%的流域最低点也被单独计算的八方向（D8）汇流模型识别为汇水点。在另外四个研究区域中，一致率介于61%至83%之间。通过结合开放数据、显式空间推理、可追溯证据和人类监督，该框架实现了透明的初筛洪水筛查，同时使关键建议可检查且由用户控制。
translation.brief: 针对城市洪水初筛中自主推理与可靠空间分析难以平衡的问题，提出由确定性控制器结合离散Morse理论提取洼地、语言模型仅在记录决策点介入并设人机协同检查点的拓扑引导GeoAI智能体框架。

papers.title: Group Relative Policy Optimisation Improves Multilingual Speech Recognition in Low-Resource Languages
papers.abstract: Autoregressive encoder-decoder speech recognition models trained with teacher forcing can suffer from exposure bias, limiting their ability to recover from their own prediction errors at inference time. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves speech recognition in major languages with LLM-based models. We extend this line of work to smaller, non-LLM encoder-decoder ASR models, using Whisper-large-v3 as a case study across 51 African languages. The benefits of this approach are most pronounced when training data is scarce or when input audio is noisy or degraded. Our resulting model, SunflowerASR, achieves the best published macro-averaged WER on the AfriVox-v2 (0.227) and SimbaBench (0.372) benchmarks, and is publicly available.

translation.title: 组相对策略优化提升低资源语言的多语言语音识别
translation.abstract: 使用教师强制训练的自回归编码器-解码器语音识别模型可能遭受曝光偏差，限制了其在推理时从自身预测错误中恢复的能力。近期工作表明，使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习可以提升基于LLM的模型在主要语言上的语音识别性能。我们将这一工作扩展到更小的、非LLM的编码器-解码器ASR模型，以Whisper-large-v3为案例研究，覆盖51种非洲语言。当训练数据稀缺或输入音频嘈杂、质量退化时，该方法的优势最为明显。我们得到的模型SunflowerASR在AfriVox-v2（0.227）和SimbaBench（0.372）基准上取得了已发表的最佳宏平均WER，并已公开发布。
translation.brief: 针对自回归ASR模型的曝光偏差问题，将GRPO强化学习应用于非LLM的编码器-解码器模型（Whisper-large-v3），提升51种非洲低资源语言的识别性能。

papers.title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on $84$--$89\%$ of questions --- every instrumented divergence a floating-point near-tie --- and cuts control latency by $35$--$47\%$ versus token-wise serial decoding and $6$--$7\%$ versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.

translation.title: 将自回归LLM控制编译为策略精确的并行推理以用于层次化RAG
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地在结构化决策流水线中充当控制器，但其决策仍由自回归文本解码执行。层次化RAG正是这样一种场景：在文档树的每个前沿节点，LLM需在依赖输入的动作语法下从k个章节中提交b个选择，其执行方式要么是易出错的自由格式JSON，要么是可靠但严格串行的语法约束生成。我们证明，对于有界视野的控制而言，这种串行化是不必要的：可达的未来构成一棵浅层动作前缀树，我们将其编译——一次根节点prefill加上一次树因果探测——即可用与串行解码相同的token、位置和因果祖先来评估每个前缀条件下的动作分布。一个前缀状态引理使编译后的控制在精确算术下达到策略精确：同一策略，关键路径仅两次前向传播，且零输出token。再进行一次探测即可认证精确的序边缘化MAP集合。在主设备MetaX上的四个文档不相交划分和两种规模下，编译控制与串行策略在84%–89%的问题上保持一致——所有被监测到的分歧均为浮点近似平局——且相比逐token串行解码将控制延迟降低35%–47%，相比理想化的分块引擎降低6%–7%；在H800上的重复实验保持了相同的排序。
translation.brief: 解决层次化RAG中LLM控制决策被串行自回归解码执行导致的延迟问题，方法是将可达动作前缀树编译为一次prefill加树因果探测的并行推理，实现策略精确等价。

papers.title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. OneLatent first introduces Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT), which creates diverse, high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. Building on pretrained FRMs, it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize CoT traces into learnable latent tokens. Finally, a multistage curriculum-based post-training strategy activates latent-token reasoning for downstream recommendation tasks. Experiments on an industrial-scale Kuaishou dataset and the public Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark show that OneLatent consistently outperforms explicit CoT-based methods and traditional baselines. Compared with the Think and No-Think variants of FRMs, OneLatent improves SID@64 by 17.44% and 9.33%, respectively, while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. We further develop a production serving system for scalable, real-time FRM inference. An online A/B test in Kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows that deploying OneLatent with this system yields an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines, including OneRec and OneReason.

translation.title: OneLatent：面向高效基础推荐模型的潜在推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的推理能力，促使其被用作基础推荐模型（FRM）的骨干。现有方法通过Think-then-Answer范式下的显式思维链（CoT）推理来增强推荐效果。然而，显式CoT因生成冗长的推理轨迹而带来巨大的推理开销，且依赖人工设计的模板，难以捕捉多样、动态的用户兴趣。我们提出OneLatent，一个高效的潜在推理框架，将显式推理轨迹压缩为若干可学习的潜在token，实现Latent-Reason-then-Answer推理而无需生成冗长轨迹。OneLatent首先引入多视角自适应CoT（MV-ACoT），通过从多个视角探索用户兴趣并自动调整每个实例的推理复杂度，生成多样且高质量的教师监督信号。基于预训练的FRM，它随后采用三阶段潜在token对齐范式，将CoT轨迹逐步内化为可学习的潜在token。最后，多阶段课程式后训练策略激活潜在token推理以完成下游推荐任务。在工业规模的快手数据集和公开的Kuaishou LLM-Rec基准上的实验表明，OneLatent持续优于基于显式CoT的方法和传统基线。与FRM的Think和No-Think变体相比，OneLatent分别将SID@64提升17.44%和9.33%，同时实现超过17倍的在线推理吞吐量。我们进一步开发了一个用于可扩展、实时FRM推理的生产服务系统。在快手本地生活服务广告场景的在线A/B测试中，使用该系统部署OneLatent相比包括OneRec和OneReason在内的强在线基线带来约9.6%的收入提升。
translation.brief: 解决显式CoT推理在推荐模型中开销大且模板难以捕捉动态用户兴趣的问题，方法是将推理轨迹压缩为可学习潜在token并通过多视角自适应CoT与三阶段对齐实现潜在推理。

papers.title: WikiOriginQA: Automated Construction of a QA Dataset with Knowledge Origins for Analyzing Cultural Bias
papers.abstract: Existing datasets on cultural knowledge have been typically created by human annotators familiar with each culture. However, the process requires considerable human effort, presenting a significant challenge to scalability. To address this challenge, we introduce WikiOriginQA, a QA dataset automatically constructed by objectively representing the origins of knowledge through the creation dates of different Wikipedia language editions. Experimental results with the created dataset confirm that LLM performance tends to be biased toward Anglophone cultures. Furthermore, the results suggest the importance of knowledge propagation into the Anglosphere. These findings demonstrate the validity of our automated approach, enabling cultural bias evaluations with superior scalability across diverse languages without extensive manual annotation.

translation.title: WikiOriginQA：基于知识来源的自动化QA数据集构建用于分析文化偏见
