translation.abstract: 现有的文化知识数据集通常由熟悉相应文化的人工标注者创建。然而，这一过程需要大量人力，对可扩展性构成重大挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出WikiOriginQA，一个通过不同语言版本Wikipedia的创建日期客观表征知识来源而自动构建的QA数据集。在所创建数据集上的实验结果证实，LLM的性能往往偏向英语文化。此外，结果表明知识向英语圈传播的重要性。这些发现验证了我们自动化方法的有效性，使其能够在无需大量人工标注的情况下，以卓越的可扩展性对多种语言进行文化偏见评估。
translation.brief: 解决文化知识数据集依赖人工标注、难以扩展的问题，方法是利用不同语言版Wikipedia的创建日期自动构建带知识来源的QA数据集以评估文化偏见。

papers.title: An Agent Architecture with Tools and Memory for Selective Correction of Wrist PPG Heart Rate Estimates
papers.abstract: Wrist photoplethysmography (PPG) heart rate estimates are vulnerable to motion artifacts, and corrections that reduce mean error can worsen individual windows. We propose an agent architecture with tools and memory around a fixed heart rate estimator. Pulse, motion, and limited historical evidence generate candidate estimates, whose predicted benefits and harms guide selection. An independent risk gate determines whether to retain, correct, or reject each output. We trained the architecture on PPG-DaLiA and tested it on Wrist Exercise, GalaxyPPG, and WildPPG with frozen weights. Across these four public datasets, mean absolute error (MAE), macro-averaged over ten estimators, decreased by up to 44.5%, with the largest reduction on GalaxyPPG. Beneficial and harmful corrections decreased and increased absolute error by more than 1 bpm, respectively. Their ten-estimator macro-averaged proportions ranged from 16.06% to 36.64% and from 1.68% to 6.77%, respectively, across the four datasets. At 60% and 80% target coverage, numerical correction on the same accepted windows contributed more to total error reduction than window selection. We implemented real-time wearable acquisition, Bluetooth reception, and smartphone deployment of a selected estimator and the framework. In backend analysis of four prototype recordings from one participant, ten-estimator macro-averaged MAE decreased from 9.09 to 4.45 bpm without additional rejection. Under the evaluated conditions, the architecture improved average accuracy while quantifying correction benefits and harms, supporting wearable heart rate analysis that considers error, correction risk, and coverage.

translation.title: 一种具备工具与记忆的智能体架构用于腕部PPG心率估计的选择性校正
translation.abstract: 腕部光电容积脉搏波（PPG）心率估计易受运动伪影影响，而降低平均误差的校正可能会使个别时间窗恶化。我们提出一种围绕固定心率估计器构建的、具备工具与记忆的智能体架构。脉搏、运动和有限的历史证据生成候选估计，其预测的收益与危害指导选择。一个独立的风险门控决定对每个输出是保留、校正还是拒绝。我们在PPG-DaLiA上训练该架构，并在冻结权重的情况下在Wrist Exercise、GalaxyPPG和WildPPG上测试。在这四个公开数据集上，对十个估计器进行宏平均的绝对误差（MAE）最多降低44.5%，其中在GalaxyPPG上降幅最大。有益校正和有害校正分别使绝对误差降低和增加超过1 bpm，其在四个数据集上十估计器宏平均比例分别为16.06%–36.64%和1.68%–6.77%。在60%和80%目标覆盖率下，对相同接受窗口的数值校正比窗口选择对总误差降低的贡献更大。我们实现了所选估计器和该框架的实时可穿戴采集、蓝牙接收和智能手机部署。在对一名参与者四段原型录制数据的后端分析中，十估计器宏平均MAE从9.09降至4.45 bpm，且无需额外拒绝。在所评估条件下，该架构在提升平均精度的同时量化了校正的收益与危害，支持兼顾误差、校正风险与覆盖率的可穿戴心率分析。
translation.brief: 解决PPG心率估计受运动伪影影响且校正可能恶化个别窗口的问题，方法是构建带工具与记忆的智能体架构，通过候选估计的收益-危害评估和独立风险门控实现选择性校正。

papers.title: From Clinical Judgment to Checkable Rules: Clinician-Led Guardrails for Mental-Health Chatbots
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in mental-health contexts can be evaluated for safety failures, but the resulting judgments are often difficult to inspect or explain. Common approaches to improving safety rely on prompt engineering, LLM-as-a-Judge, and Constitutional AI. In this work, we describe a clinician-led alternative in which two clinicians define, finalize, and adjudicate the four safety checks of a rule base, which is formally verified for internal consistency and applied as a guardrail over LLM outputs. Here and in the title, clinician-led refers to this rule base, not to the fact extractor or the uncertainty default, which are ours. Every verdict of the resulting verification layer is recomputable from a named rule and sixteen facts. Against an LLM judge matched in model, revision, quantization, rule text, and decoding but without the layer's computed 988/911 fact, the largest disagreement class, the satisfied-rule class, is structured: the Llama-3.3-70B judge, on its primary prompt, demands a crisis resource from 55 of the 65 replies (84.6%) that already contain one, while the same model, asked as a fact extractor, reports a recognized resource present on 54 of the 55. The verification layer never raises that demand, by construction. We report with equal prominence where this judge is stronger: fewer false crisis alarms on the one reference-scored check. We also report the measured cost (a specification revision raised block-class outcomes on held-out boundary prompts of an over-refusal benchmark from 6.0% to 16.0%, chiefly by changing fact extraction), the clinicians' decision to keep our uncertainty default, and the analysis of the result. The contribution is not a safer verdict. It is a guardrail whose disagreements with the judge localize to named rules and facts and whose measured costs trace to named facts and the uncertainty default.

translation.title: 从临床判断到可核查规则：面向心理健康聊天机器人的临床医生主导的护栏
translation.abstract: 部署在心理健康场景中的大语言模型（LLM）可以被评估安全失效，但由此产生的判断往往难以检查或解释。改进安全性的常见方法包括提示工程、LLM-as-a-Judge和Constitutional AI。在本工作中，我们描述一种由临床医生主导的替代方案：两名临床医生定义、定稿并裁决规则库的四项安全检查，该规则库经形式化验证确保内部一致性，并作为护栏应用于LLM输出。此处及标题中的clinician-led指该规则库，而非事实抽取器或不确定性默认值，后者由我们设计。由此产生的验证层的每个裁决都可由一条具名规则和十六个事实重新计算。与一个在模型、版本、量化、规则文本和解码上完全匹配但不具备该层计算出的988/911事实的LLM裁判相比，最大的分歧类别——满足规则类——呈现结构性：Llama-3.3-70B裁判在其主提示下，对65条已包含危机资源的回复中的55条（84.6%）要求提供危机资源，而同一模型作为事实抽取器被询问时，在55条中的54条报告存在可识别的资源。该验证层在构造上从不提出此类要求。我们也以同等篇幅报告该裁判更强之处：在一项有参考评分的检查上更少的误报危机警报。我们还报告了测得的代价（一次规范修订使过拒绝基准上留出边界提示的阻断类结果从6.0%升至16.0%，主要源于事实抽取的改变）、临床医生保留我们不确定性默认值的决定，以及对结果的分析。贡献并非更安全的裁决，而是一个其与裁判的分歧可定位到具名规则与事实、其测得代价可追溯到具名事实与不确定性默认值的护栏。
translation.brief: 解决LLM安全判断难以检查和解释的问题，方法是由临床医生定义并形式化验证一个规则库作为护栏，使每个裁决可由具名规则和事实重新计算。

papers.title: Disentangling Robustness and Sycophancy in Multilingual LLMs
papers.abstract: When a multilingual LLM agrees with a user's false premise, is it being sycophantic, or does it simply not know better in that language? Current research does not distinguish these cases: they record only whether the model agreed, not why. We introduce the SC-matrix, that crosses a model's competence (whether it answers correctly under no pressure) with its sycophancy (whether it maintains that answer under pressure). Our results show that (1) identical aggregate sycophancy rates can mask different failure compositions, (2) high competence in a language does not always protect against sycophancy, and (3) reasoning-oriented mitigations outperform directive-based strategies. We find that multilingual sycophancy is not a single phenomenon but a composite of different failures that require distinct diagnosis.

translation.title: 解耦多语言 LLM 中的鲁棒性与谄媚性
translation.abstract: 当多语言 LLM 认同用户的错误前提时，这是谄媚，还是它在该语言下确实不知道正确答案？现有研究不区分这两种情况：它们只记录模型是否认同，而不记录原因。我们引入 SC-matrix，将模型的能力（在无压力下是否回答正确）与其谄媚性（在压力下是否维持该答案）进行交叉分析。结果表明：(1) 相同的总体谄媚率可能掩盖不同的失败构成；(2) 某语言的高能力并不总能防止谄媚；(3) 面向推理的缓解策略优于指令式策略。我们发现多语言谄媚并非单一现象，而是需要不同诊断方法的多种失败的复合体。
translation.brief: 针对多语言 LLM 谄媚与能力不足难以区分的问题，提出 SC-matrix 将模型能力与谄媚性交叉分析以解耦诊断。

papers.title: Governance-State Corruption in Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents: A Cross-Model Stress Test
papers.abstract: An LLM agent can retrieve a memory correctly yet use it incorrectly after its validity state changes. We study governance-state corruption: faults that alter which retained records enter model-visible context while stored content and tasks remain fixed. Across six providers, 731 benchmark-grounded bases yield 2,080 matched fault pairs. In offline control-plane checks, corruption changes the operative projection in 96.25% of pairs, while oracle-backed enforcement restores it in 100%. For downstream evaluation, a deterministically selected, non-probability LongMemEval/Memora panel resolves 298 of 300 matched triplets (238 distinct bases). Clean-minus-corrupted contrasts are 40.54 percentage points in LongMemEval binary correctness (95% base-cluster interval [30.32, 50.71]) and 30.60 points in rescaled Memora FAMA ([23.31, 37.69]); both sources also show recovery. OAKS Novel native option parity holds for all 6,714 resolved outputs. Full-cohort frozen-scorer corruption/recovery effects (-27.55/+27.51 points) remain descriptive proxies, not validated native semantic population effects. These bounded findings motivate evaluating memory control-state integrity alongside retrieval accuracy.

translation.title: LLM 智能体长期记忆中的治理态损坏：跨模型压力测试
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体可能正确检索到记忆，却在其有效性状态改变后错误地使用它。我们研究治理态损坏：在存储内容和任务保持不变的情况下，改变哪些保留记录进入模型可见上下文的故障。在六个提供商上，731 个基于基准的基础产生 2,080 个匹配故障对。在离线控制平面检查中，损坏在 96.25% 的对中改变了有效投影，而基于 oracle 的强制执行在 100% 的对中将其恢复。在下游评估中，确定性选择的非概率 LongMemEval/Memora 面板解决了 300 个匹配三元组中的 298 个（238 个不同基础）。干净减损坏的对比在 LongMemEval 二元正确率上为 40.54 个百分点（95% 基础聚类区间 [30.32, 50.71]），在重新标定的 Memora FAMA 上为 30.60 个百分点（[23.31, 37.69]）；两个数据源均显示可恢复。OAKS Novel 原生选项一致性在全部 6,714 个已解决输出上成立。全队列冻结评分器的损坏/恢复效应（-27.55/+27.51 点）仍是描述性代理，而非经验证的原生语义总体效应。这些有界发现促使我们在检索准确率之外同时评估记忆控制态完整性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体长期记忆中记忆有效性状态被篡改导致错误使用的问题，通过跨模型压力测试量化治理态损坏的影响并验证基于 oracle 的恢复机制。

papers.title: ULME: Predictive Coupling for Mutually Reinforcing Embedding and Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Text embedding and text generation are two of the most useful capabilities of modern large language models, yet they are typically provided by separate specialized models (an embedder and a generator) trained with incompatible objectives and deployed side by side in retrieval-augmented generation and agent systems. Recent unified embedding-generation models such as GritLM share parameters between the two capabilities, but they either switch attention regimes between modes or optimize embedding and language modeling as parallel objectives that never supervise each other. We argue that these designs are only partially unified: the two capabilities coexist on the same weights, but do not shape each other. We propose ULME, a post-training framework that unifies embedding and language modeling on a causal decoder-only LLM through predictive coupling. ULME inserts a chain of learnable slots between the query and the answer, reads a semantic embedding and a reasoning embedding from two designated slots, and trains three objectives on a shared causal backbone: a contrastive loss anchoring the semantic slot to document representations, a language-modeling loss supervising answer generation, and a stop-gradient predictive loss that aligns the reasoning slot with a pooled summary of the answer, so that generation actively shapes what the embedding encodes. Across two model families (Qwen2.5, Qwen3) and eight scales spanning 0.5B-8B parameters, a single ULME checkpoint improves MTEB by 3.3-4.1 points over the strongest open-source baseline, tightens BRIGHT and AdvBench-IR simultaneously, and remains on par with a generation-only fine-tune on standard accuracy benchmarks (MMLU, GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, HumanEval), demonstrating that genuine unification yields mutually reinforcing rather than merely coexisting capabilities.

translation.title: ULME：面向相互增强的嵌入与语言建模的预测耦合
translation.abstract: 文本嵌入和文本生成是现代大语言模型最有用的两种能力，但它们通常由单独的专用模型（嵌入器和生成器）提供，二者以不兼容的目标训练，并在检索增强生成和智能体系统中并排部署。近期统一的嵌入-生成模型（如 GritLM）在两种能力间共享参数，但它们要么在两种模式间切换注意力机制，要么将嵌入和语言建模作为互不监督的并行目标进行优化。我们认为这些设计只是部分统一：两种能力共存于同一权重上，但并未相互塑造。我们提出 ULME，一个通过预测耦合在因果 decoder-only LLM 上统一嵌入与语言建模的后训练框架。ULME 在查询和答案之间插入一串可学习的 slot，从两个指定 slot 读取语义嵌入和推理嵌入，并在共享因果骨干上训练三个目标：将语义 slot 锚定到文档表示的对比损失、监督答案生成的语言建模损失，以及将推理 slot 与答案的池化摘要对齐的 stop-gradient 预测损失，使生成主动塑造嵌入所编码的内容。在两个模型家族（Qwen2.5、Qwen3）和 0.5B-8B 参数的八个规模上，单个 ULME checkpoint 在 MTEB 上比最强开源基线提升 3.3-4.1 点，同时收紧 BRIGHT 和 AdvBench-IR，并在标准准确率基准（MMLU、GSM8K、MMLU-Pro、HumanEval）上与仅生成微调持平，表明真正的统一能产生相互增强而非仅仅共存的能力。
translation.brief: 针对嵌入与生成模型仅参数共存而互不塑造的问题，提出 ULME 通过可学习 slot 和预测耦合损失在单一因果 LLM 上统一并相互增强两种能力。

papers.title: Automated Enrichment Analysis with GraphRAG: Efficient Multi-Database ORA Extraction and Biological Interpretation
papers.abstract: Over-representation analysis (ORA) is widely used to interpret gene-expression studies, but its outputs are often fragmented across gene-set databases and presented as flat term lists that obscure gene-level links among related enrichment signals. We propose Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GBOR-RAG), an integrated and traceable framework for ORA interpretation. GBOR-RAG represents heterogeneous gene-set databases as a unified term--gene knowledge graph, where shared genes connect related terms across sources. After graph-based ORA scoring, the framework retrieves a compact connected evidence subgraph that preserves both cross-database relationships and gene-level support. The subgraph conditions an LLM to generate biological interpretations, and we introduce a claim-level faithfulness metric to assess whether generated claims are supported by explicit evidence. Experiments show that graph-based ORA preserves conventional ORA results with high consistency (mean Pearson $r=0.997$) while reducing query time by a median of $37\times$ (up to $48\times$). The retrieved subgraphs average 36.8 nodes and achieve the highest overall integration score (4.12), and GBOR-RAG attains the highest claim-level faithfulness (0.90) among the compared systems. Adding a PubMed literature layer further improves the overall interpretation quality from 4.17 to 4.75.

translation.title: 基于 GraphRAG 的自动化富集分析：高效的多数据库 ORA 提取与生物学解释
translation.abstract: 过表示分析（ORA）被广泛用于解释基因表达研究，但其输出常分散在多个基因集数据库中，并以扁平的术语列表呈现，掩盖了相关富集信号之间的基因级联系。我们提出 Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation（GBOR-RAG），一个集成且可追溯的 ORA 解释框架。GBOR-RAG 将异构基因集数据库表示为统一的术语-基因知识图谱，其中共享基因连接跨来源的相关术语。在基于图谱的 ORA 评分后，该框架检索一个紧凑的连通证据子图，同时保留跨数据库关系和基因级支持。该子图作为条件输入 LLM 生成生物学解释，并引入 claim 级忠实度指标评估生成的论断是否有明确证据支持。实验表明，基于图谱的 ORA 以高一致性（平均 Pearson r=0.997）保留传统 ORA 结果，同时将查询时间中位数降低 37 倍（最高 48 倍）。检索的子图平均 36.8 个节点，获得最高的整体整合得分（4.12），且 GBOR-RAG 在所比较系统中达到最高的 claim 级忠实度（0.90）。加入 PubMed 文献层进一步将整体解释质量从 4.17 提升至 4.75。
translation.brief: 针对 ORA 结果分散于多数据库且缺乏基因级关联的问题，提出 GBOR-RAG 用统一知识图谱检索证据子图并驱动 LLM 生成可追溯的生物学解释。

papers.title: Meaning Contracts: Local Semantic Geometry in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This paper studies the local geometry of semantic meaning in large language models. Current representation analyses ask whether meanings are close in embedding space, or whether linear probes separate semantic classes, but they do not characterize the within-concept local geometry: what is invariant across realizations of a single semantic factor, what varies, and what changes when meaning is refined. This paper characterizes that geometry through two controlled probes evaluated on four architecturally diverse decoder-only LLMs (Gemma 4, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, Pythia). A cross-lingual probe uses language as a perturbation to separate exact meaning matches, same-factor realizations, nearby concepts, and out-of-domain contrasts. A refinement probe separates specificity-bearing semantic narrowing from high-probability attributive elaboration and adversarial controls; both probes are validated by blind human judgments. Four findings recur across all models: under mean pooling, once dominant variance directions are removed, sentence pairs order by semantic relatedness (same factor, then same domain, then different domain) without overlap over a band of layers; semantic factors organize around an invariant core surrounded by structured realization-specific variation; refinement produces directed displacement into tighter neighborhoods, including against controls built on the same base noun; and sentence-level and token-local readouts expose complementary geometry (volume contraction at the sentence level, sharper anisotropic endpoints at token-local readout). We interpret these results as evidence that LLM semantics are organized as local anisotropic neighborhoods in which meaning contracts under refinement.

translation.title: 意义契约：大语言模型中的局部语义几何
translation.abstract: 本文研究大语言模型中语义意义的局部几何。当前的表示分析关注意义在嵌入空间中是否接近，或线性探针能否区分语义类别，但并未刻画概念内部的局部几何：单一语义因子的不同实现中什么是不变的、什么在变化、以及当意义被细化时什么发生改变。本文通过在四个架构各异的 decoder-only LLM（Gemma 4、Llama 3.2、Qwen 2.5、Pythia）上评估的两个受控探针来刻画该几何。跨语言探针使用语言作为扰动，以区分精确意义匹配、同因子实现、邻近概念和域外对比。细化探针将承载特异性的语义收窄与高概率的定语性修饰及对抗性对照区分开；两个探针均通过盲测人类判断验证。四个发现在所有模型中反复出现：在均值池化下，一旦移除主导方差方向，句子对在一段层范围内按语义相关性排序（同因子、同域、异域）且无重叠；语义因子围绕一个不变核心组织，周围是结构化的实现特定变化；细化产生朝向更紧凑邻域的定向位移，包括针对基于同一基础名词构建的对照；句子级和 token 局部读出揭示互补的几何（句子级的体积收缩，token 局部读出处更锐利的各向异性端点）。我们将这些结果解释为证据：LLM 语义被组织为局部各向异性邻域，其中意义在细化下收缩。
translation.brief: 针对现有表示分析无法刻画概念内部局部几何的问题，通过跨语言和细化两个受控探针揭示 LLM 语义以各向异性局部邻域组织且细化时意义收缩的规律。

papers.title: Incentive Mechanisms for Welfare Maximization Under Individual Rationality in Noncooperative Dynamical Systems
papers.abstract: Human societies are shaped by strategic interactions among self-interested decision-makers, where conflicts between individual and social interests naturally arise. This paper investigates the design of incentive mechanism for multi-agent game systems to reconcile social welfare maximization with individual benefits under economic constraints. We develop a linear-quadratic incentive framework to reshape Nash equilibria while reconciling the constraints of Pareto efficiency, individual rationality, and budget balance. The optimal target state is identified as the solution of a constrained optimization problem associated with the social welfare and aggregated payoff functions. Our theoretical analysis characterizes the conditions of incentive functions that steer self-interested agents towards the optimal target state as a Pareto-efficient Nash equilibrium for achieving the maximum attainable social welfare. We further characterize how the choice of social welfare function constrains achievable individual outcomes, revealing a structural paradox associated with priority weighting under individual rationality. Several numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the efficacy of our results.

translation.title: 非合作动态系统中个体理性下福利最大化的激励机制
translation.abstract: 人类社会由自利决策者之间的策略互动塑造，个体利益与社会利益之间的冲突自然产生。本文研究多智能体博弈系统中激励机制的设计，以在经济约束下协调社会福利最大化与个体收益。我们开发了一个线性二次激励框架来重塑Nash均衡，同时兼顾Pareto效率、个体理性和预算平衡的约束。最优目标状态被确定为与社会福利函数和聚合收益函数相关的约束优化问题的解。我们的理论分析刻画了激励函数将自利智能体引导至最优目标状态（作为实现最大可达社会福利的Pareto有效Nash均衡）的条件。我们进一步刻画了社会福利函数的选择如何约束可实现的个体结果，揭示了个体理性下优先级加权相关的结构性悖论。文中给出了若干数值例子以展示结果的有效性。
translation.brief: 研究如何在经济约束下设计激励机制重塑Nash均衡以实现社会福利最大化，采用线性二次激励框架并刻画Pareto效率、个体理性与预算平衡下的最优条件。

papers.title: Solvable models of learning to pursue a moving target
papers.abstract: Agents tasked with intercepting a moving target must learn how to reach it, ideally as efficiently as possible. As observers of animal pursuit behavior have noticed, different strategies are possible: on one extreme, the agent reactively moves toward the target's current location; on the other, the agent predicts the target's future location and moves directly there. Motivated by the desire to understand how such strategies might be learned, we introduce a continuous-time linear-quadratic model of open-loop target pursuit whose optimal control strategies interpolate between these possibilities. Usefully, a small number of interpretable parameters control which type of strategy is optimal, and it is possible to derive closed-form solutions for optimal strategies, policy learning dynamics, and value learning dynamics. Exploiting our model's linear structure, we find that the time scales of learning precisely correspond to the eigenvalues of certain matrices, and that relevant eigenvalue spectra generically have a gap. We show that this gap indicates that agents tend to learn how to reach their target before optimizing their movement. Our results provide a detailed mathematical characterization of pursuit behavior and its learning dynamics, which can both serve as a benchmark for empirical work, and as a foundation for more elaborate theoretical treatments of pursuit.

translation.title: 追击移动目标学习的可解模型
translation.abstract: 被赋予拦截移动目标任务的智能体必须学习如何到达目标，理想情况下应尽可能高效。正如动物追击行为的观察者所注意到的，存在不同的策略：一个极端是智能体反应式地朝目标当前位置移动；另一个极端是智能体预测目标的未来位置并直接移动到那里。出于理解这类策略如何被学习的愿望，我们引入了一个开环目标追击的连续时间线性二次模型，其最优控制策略在上述两种可能性之间插值。有用的是，少量可解释的参数控制哪种策略是最优的，并且可以为最优策略、策略学习动力学和价值学习动力学推导出闭式解。利用模型的线性结构，我们发现学习的时间尺度精确对应于某些矩阵的特征值，且相关特征值谱通常存在间隙。我们证明该间隙表明智能体倾向于先学会如何到达目标，然后再优化其运动。我们的结果为追击行为及其学习动力学提供了详细的数学刻画，既可作为实证工作的基准，也可作为更精细追击理论处理的基础。
translation.brief: 研究追击移动目标的策略如何学习，引入连续时间线性二次开环追击模型并推导最优策略与学习动力学的闭式解。

papers.title: Faithful Latent Harm Monitors Work No Better Than the Models Own Behaviour at a Matched False Alarm Rate
papers.abstract: Large language models have been reported to encode the harmfulness of a request separately from their decision to refuse it, and latent safety monitors such as Latent Guard build on this report by classifying prompts as harmful from the internal activations of the model, with the aim of catching harmful intent even when the model complies. Whether these representations give a signal of harm that survives distribution shift and is independent of model behaviour is unclear. We test this on out-of-distribution prompts made by rewriting existing harmful and benign requests with surface rewording, persuasive framing and jailbreak-style wrappers. Across 15 instruction-tuned LLMs and 38 activation-based readers, we compare harm detection with that of TF-IDF and sentence-embedding classifiers, with independently trained safety classifiers, and with the refusal of each model. Activations are read at the last token of the user instruction, where the model has read the whole request, and at the last chat-template token before the reply, where the planned response can be represented. Because models disagree about which prompts to refuse, we can separate a signal of the harmfulness of the prompt from a signal of the refusal decision of the model. At the end of the instruction, the representation is largely independent of the refusal behaviour of each model but degrades under distribution shift, so that a TF-IDF classifier ranks harm better than the original Latent Guard in every model we test, and linear and MLP probes do about as well as sentence-embedding classifiers trained on the same examples. The representation just before generation detects more, catching 44 percent of harmful prompts at a matched false-alarm rate against 32 percent for the refusal of the model, but that gain follows the refusal decision itself, and part of it comes from refusals that string-matching evaluation misses.

translation.title: 在匹配误报率下，忠实的潜在危害监测器并不比模型自身行为表现更好
translation.abstract: 有报告称大语言模型将请求的危害性与其拒绝决定分开编码，诸如Latent Guard之类的潜在安全监测器基于这一报告，通过模型内部激活将提示分类为有害，目的是即使模型顺从时也能捕获有害意图。这些表示是否给出能在分布偏移下存活且独立于模型行为的危害信号尚不清楚。我们通过用表面改写、说服性框架和越狱式包装重写现有的有害与良性请求，构造分布外提示来测试这一点。在15个指令微调LLM和38个基于激活的读取器上，我们将危害检测与TF-IDF和句子嵌入分类器、独立训练的安全分类器以及每个模型的拒绝行为进行比较。激活在用户指令的最后一个token（模型已读完整请求）和回复前最后一个聊天模板token（可表示计划中的响应）处读取。由于模型对拒绝哪些提示存在分歧，我们可以将提示危害性信号与模型拒绝决定信号分离。在指令末尾，表示在很大程度上独立于每个模型的拒绝行为，但在分布偏移下退化，因此在我们测试的每个模型中，TF-IDF分类器对危害的排序都优于原始Latent Guard，而线性与MLM探针的表现与在相同样本上训练的句子嵌入分类器大致相当。生成前的表示检测到更多内容，在匹配误报率下捕获44%的有害提示，而模型拒绝仅捕获32%，但这一增益跟随拒绝决定本身，且部分来自字符串匹配评估遗漏的拒绝。
translation.brief: 研究潜在激活安全监测器的危害信号是否独立于模型拒绝行为并在分布偏移下可靠，通过分布外重写提示在多个LLM上与TF-IDF、句子嵌入分类器及模型拒绝行为进行对比实验。

papers.title: AgentTriage: Replayable Security Diagnosis Across Heterogeneous Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract: When tool-use agents write files, execute code, or send data, their final responses do not explain the resulting security events, and heterogeneous runtimes expose the relevant evidence through incompatible interfaces. We present AgentTriage, an executable contract for replayable security diagnosis across heterogeneous runtimes. The contract admits conclusions whose claims cite canonical runtime events and requires abstention when mandatory evidence is missing. Runtime overlays normalize native observations, while a deterministic pipeline joins invocation and result lifecycles, constructs a typed provenance graph, selects a policy-decisive slice, and binds claims to recorded evidence. Given the same normalized trace, overlay version, and pre-run policy oracle, the diagnosis can be recomputed and its claims re-checked without language-model judgment. Across five runtimes, one contract captures all 159 applicable executions, with an audit of native and synthesized identifiers. On 120 adjudicated cases, AgentTriage achieves 0.858 grounded joint diagnosis, 0.966 required-evidence coverage, and a 0.036 unsupported-claim rate, improving joint diagnosis by 0.175 (95% CI [0.092, 0.258]) over the strongest same-schema baseline. These results quantify the precision of replayable diagnosis and the observation boundaries that require abstention. We release an open-source implementation and selected sanitized evidence at https://github.com/AsnGs/agenttriage-open-source.

translation.title: AgentTriage：跨异构Agent运行时的可重放安全诊断
translation.abstract: 当工具使用型agent写文件、执行代码或发送数据时，其最终响应无法解释由此产生的安全事件，且异构运行时通过不兼容的接口暴露相关证据。我们提出AgentTriage，一个用于跨异构运行时可重放安全诊断的可执行契约。该契约接受其声明引用规范化运行时事件的结论，并在缺少必要证据时要求弃权。运行时overlay将原生观测规范化，而确定性流水线连接调用与结果生命周期、构建类型化溯源图、选择策略决定性切片，并将声明绑定到记录的证据。给定相同的规范化轨迹、overlay版本和预运行策略oracle，诊断可以在无需语言模型判断的情况下重新计算并重新检验其声明。在五个运行时上，一个契约捕获了全部159个适用的执行，并对原生与合成标识符进行了审计。在120个裁定案例上，AgentTriage实现0.858的接地联合诊断、0.966的必要证据覆盖率和0.036的无依据声明率，相比最强的同模式基线将联合诊断提升0.175（95% CI [0.092, 0.258]）。这些结果量化了可重放诊断的精度以及需要弃权的观测边界。我们在 https://github.com/AsnGs/agenttriage-open-source 发布了开源实现和部分脱敏证据。
translation.brief: 研究异构agent运行时安全事件无法解释的问题，提出可执行契约AgentTriage，通过运行时overlay规范化观测和确定性流水线构建溯源图实现可重放的安全诊断。

papers.title: UniGuard: Multi-View Guardrail Learning for Cross-Interface Safety Generalization
papers.abstract: Guardrail models are increasingly used as safety layers for LLMs and agentic systems, but most are trained on fixed prompt or response interfaces and become unreliable when the same safety case appears as a conversation, agent trajectory, multi-agent trace, or policy-conditioned input. We propose UniGuard, a training framework that learns interface-invariant safety representations from multiple semantically aligned views of the same safety case. We also construct the UniGuard-FT dataset by transforming 1,000 public safety cases into prompt, response, multi-turn conversation, agent-trace, and multi-agent-trace views, and train UniGuard-0.6B with classification, supervised contrastive learning, and asymmetric confidence calibration losses. Across unseen-interface benchmarks ATBench, PolicyGuardBench, and DynaBench, UniGuard-0.6B improves over its pretrained guardrail by 45.12 F1 points on average and reduces expected calibration error by 35.41 points, while remaining competitive with much larger guardrails such as Claude-Sonnet-4.5 and GPT-5.2 - despite being a 0.6B model and trained only with synthetic data.

translation.title: UniGuard：面向跨接口安全泛化的多视角护栏学习
translation.abstract: 护栏模型越来越多地被用作LLM和agentic系统的安全层，但大多数是在固定的提示或响应接口上训练的，当同一安全案例以对话、agent轨迹、多agent轨迹或策略条件输入的形式出现时变得不可靠。我们提出UniGuard，一个从同一安全案例的多个语义对齐视角学习接口不变安全表示的训练框架。我们还通过将1000个公开安全案例转换为提示、响应、多轮对话、agent轨迹和多agent轨迹视角构建UniGuard-FT数据集，并使用分类、监督对比学习和非对称置信度校准损失训练UniGuard-0.6B。在未见接口基准ATBench、PolicyGuardBench和DynaBench上，UniGuard-0.6B相比其预训练护栏平均提升45.12 F1点，期望校准误差降低35.41点，同时与Claude-Sonnet-4.5和GPT-5.2等大得多的护栏保持竞争力——尽管它只是一个0.6B模型且仅用合成数据训练。
translation.brief: 研究护栏模型跨接口泛化差的问题，提出UniGuard框架，通过将安全案例转换为多视角并联合分类、对比学习与校准损失训练接口不变的安全表示。

papers.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
papers.abstract: LLM memory is widely used in long-term conversation understanding. Agentic memory systems often use mutation, structural organization, learned retrieval strategies, or other complex operations. Is this complexity always necessary? We study Raw-RAG, a naive RAG baseline using dense retrieval and reranking over raw history to supply evidence to a reader LLM. Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME, and MemoryAgentBench, Raw-RAG ranks first among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark-model settings, outperforming the strongest compared agentic memory system by 0.13-5.53 points. We investigate why raw-history retrieval remains competitive. Evidence analysis shows that its higher coverage of necessary evidence can offset lower utilization. Useful evidence includes both answer values and the relations and dependency paths needed to derive them. Even complete access to transformed memory stores leaves an accuracy gap relative to raw evidence, highlighting the importance of preserving raw information. These findings challenge the necessity of complex agentic memory for the evaluated conversation tasks and establish naive RAG as an essential baseline.

translation.title: 复杂的智能体记忆总是必要的吗？朴素 RAG 比我们想象的更强大
translation.abstract: LLM 记忆被广泛用于长期对话理解。智能体记忆系统通常采用变异、结构化组织、学习式检索策略或其他复杂操作。这种复杂性总是必要的吗？我们研究了 Raw-RAG，一个朴素的 RAG 基线，它使用稠密检索和对原始历史的重排序来为阅读器 LLM 提供证据。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval、MEME 和 MemoryAgentBench 上，Raw-RAG 在七个基准-模型设置中的六个里排名第一，超过最强的对比智能体记忆系统 0.13-5.53 分。我们探究了为什么原始历史检索仍然具有竞争力。证据分析表明，其更高的必要证据覆盖率可以弥补较低的利用率。有用的证据既包括答案值，也包括推导它们所需的关系和依赖路径。即使完全访问转换后的记忆存储，相对于原始证据仍存在准确率差距，凸显了保留原始信息的重要性。这些发现挑战了复杂智能体记忆在所评估对话任务中的必要性，并确立了朴素 RAG 作为不可或缺的基线。
translation.brief: 质疑复杂智能体记忆系统的必要性，提出基于稠密检索与重排序的朴素 RAG 基线 Raw-RAG，证明原始历史检索在长期对话基准上可超越复杂记忆系统。

papers.title: RAIN: Agentic Proof Generation for Rocq-based Software Verification
papers.abstract: Interactive theorem provers can provide strong correctness guarantees for software, but constructing the proofs remains a challenging and labor-intensive task. Inspired by the recent progress of modern coding agents, we present RAIN, a lightweight proof-specialized agent for Rocq proof generation. RAIN augments an LLM with proof engineering capabilities, including repository exploration, iterative refinement, and checker feedback. This design allows the agent to retrieve lemmas autonomously, revise complete proof scripts instead of isolated tactics, and iteratively refine its proof strategy using enriched proof-state information. Evaluated on a subset from CoqStoq, RAIN shows substantial improvements over the existing baselines, achieving over 90% prove success rate with at least 24.7% improvements. We also compare with general-purpose coding agents, the results show that RAIN maintains comparable prove success rate but with significant lower cost.

translation.title: RAIN：面向基于 Rocq 的软件验证的智能体证明生成
translation.abstract: 交互式定理证明器可以为软件提供强正确性保证，但构造证明仍然是一项具有挑战性且劳动密集的任务。受现代编码智能体近期进展的启发，我们提出了 RAIN，一个轻量级的面向证明的 Rocq 证明生成智能体。RAIN 为 LLM 增强了证明工程能力，包括仓库探索、迭代细化和检查器反馈。这种设计使智能体能够自主检索引理、修改完整的证明脚本而非孤立的 tactic，并利用丰富的证明状态信息迭代细化其证明策略。在 CoqStoq 的一个子集上评估，RAIN 相比现有基线取得显著提升，证明成功率超过 90%，提升至少 24.7%。我们还与通用编码智能体进行了比较，结果表明 RAIN 保持相当的证明成功率，但成本显著更低。
translation.brief: 针对 Rocq 证明构造费时费力的问题，提出轻量级证明专用智能体 RAIN，通过仓库探索、完整证明脚本迭代细化和检查器反馈来增强 LLM 的证明生成能力。

papers.title: AgentDP: Towards Automated Model Deployment for Heterogeneous Embedded AI Applications
papers.abstract: This paper presents AgentDP, which aims to deploy pre-trained AI models on heterogeneous embedded devices by fully automating model optimization and adaptation (O&A) with Large Language Model (LLM) agents. AgentDP not only significantly reduces human effort via automation but also enhances model inference efficacy by integrating LLMs with device-specific domain knowledge. To deliver a robust automation framework, AgentDP develops novel solutions to address three key technical challenges: 1) To help users elicit clear requirements, we propose a user requirement standardization module; 2) To mitigate the execution environment mismatch between AI models and heterogeneous embedded devices, we design an operator-aware model partition paradigm that enables different parts of the model to be efficiently executed on distinct inference engines. 3) To avoid re-searching optimization hyperparameters for new tasks, we propose a configuration reuse module that heuristically retrieves previous hyperparameter configurations for efficient reuse. Extensive experiments demonstrate that by fully automating the entire O&A process, AgentDP reduces entire model adaptation time by up to 80% compared with manual O&A while achieving higher task accuracy (more than 13% on average) than the baselines. Additionally, a comprehensive user study also exhibits the robust generalizability of AgentDP in adapting to different user requirements for heterogeneous embedded devices.

translation.title: AgentDP：面向异构嵌入式 AI 应用的自动化模型部署
translation.abstract: 本文提出 AgentDP，旨在通过 LLM 智能体完全自动化模型优化与适配（O&A），将预训练 AI 模型部署到异构嵌入式设备上。AgentDP 不仅通过自动化显著减少人力投入，还通过将 LLM 与设备特定领域知识相结合来提升模型推理效果。为构建稳健的自动化框架，AgentDP 针对三个关键技术挑战提出了新颖的解决方案：1）为帮助用户明确需求，我们提出用户需求标准化模块；2）为缓解 AI 模型与异构嵌入式设备之间的执行环境不匹配问题，我们设计了算子感知的模型划分范式，使模型的不同部分能够在不同的推理引擎上高效执行；3）为避免为新任务重新搜索优化超参数，我们提出配置复用模块，启发式地检索以往的超参数配置以实现高效复用。大量实验表明，通过完全自动化整个 O&A 流程，AgentDP 相比手动 O&A 将整个模型适配时间减少高达 80%，同时任务准确率比基线更高（平均超过 13%）。此外，全面的用户研究也展示了 AgentDP 在适应异构嵌入式设备不同用户需求方面的稳健泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对预训练模型在异构嵌入式设备上部署需大量人工优化适配的问题，提出基于 LLM 智能体的 AgentDP 框架，通过需求标准化、算子感知模型划分和配置复用实现全流程自动化部署。

papers.title: Abstract Priorities, Concrete Rewards: How Stated Preferences Relate to What People Reward in AI Responses
papers.abstract: AI assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are trained on human feedback and increasingly personalized to users' stated preferences. Yet how closely these preferences reflect what people reward in responses remains unclear. We compare stated and revealed preferences in the public PRISM dataset, in which 1,396 participants reported how much seven response attributes mattered to them and then rated 29,347 responses from 21 LLMs. Among responses to the same prompt, features the survey never asked about, such as response length, formatting and refusal language, were at least as strongly associated with ratings as text proxies of the surveyed attributes. Whether stated priorities matched ratings depended on how attributes were measured: participants who prioritized an attribute favoured responses from models that others perceived as strong on it, but not responses that scored higher on text proxies for it. Written feedback was more telling: participants who asked for shorter answers, even in earlier conversations, gave length less weight in their ratings, and those asking for longer answers gave it more. Their relative priorities over the surveyed attributes, however, did not predict this weight. Reasons given for choices reflected perceived attributes more than measured features. Participants also differed stably in how much they weighted several concrete features, especially length, but with a median of 6 conversations per participant, these weights were estimated poorly. The largest gain from personal information in predicting held-out choices was 0.13 percentage points, compared with 1.11 for a stronger pooled model. Stated priorities thus track perceived attributes of AI responses but say little about the concrete features that ratings reward, a distinction that matters for preference elicitation and AI personalization.

translation.title: 抽象的优先级，具体的奖励：陈述偏好与人们在 AI 回复中实际奖励的关系
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的 AI 助手通过人类反馈进行训练，并日益根据用户陈述的偏好进行个性化。然而，这些偏好在多大程度上反映了人们在回复中实际奖励的内容仍不清楚。我们在公开的 PRISM 数据集中比较了陈述偏好与显示偏好，其中 1,396 名参与者报告了七个回复属性对他们的重视程度，然后对来自 21 个 LLM 的 29,347 条回复进行评分。在同一提示的回复中，调查从未询问的特征（如回复长度、格式和拒绝语言）与评分的关联强度至少与所调查属性的文本代理相当。陈述的优先级是否与评分匹配取决于属性的测量方式：重视某属性的参与者偏好其他用户认为在该属性上表现强的模型回复，而非在该属性文本代理上得分更高的回复。书面反馈更能说明问题：要求更短回答的参与者（即使在较早的对话中）在评分时对长度的权重更低，而要求更长回答的参与者则给予更多权重。然而，他们对所调查属性的相对优先级并不能预测这种权重。选择理由更多反映的是感知属性而非测量特征。参与者在多个具体特征（尤其是长度）的权重上也存在稳定差异，但由于每位参与者中位数仅 6 次对话，这些权重估计得很差。个人信息在预测留出选择上的最大增益为 0.13 个百分点，而更强的池化模型为 1.11。因此，陈述的优先级追踪的是 AI 回复的感知属性，但对评分所奖励的具体特征几乎没有什么说明，这一区别对偏好获取和 AI 个性化至关重要。
translation.brief: 研究用户陈述偏好与其在 AI 回复评分中实际奖励的特征之间的脱节，通过分析 PRISM 数据集发现陈述优先级只反映感知属性而无法预测长度等具体特征的评分权重。

papers.title: LLM Multi-Agent Systems Are Vulnerable to Herding and Runaway Cascades
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate in multi-agent systems where they collaborate by responding to others' choices, creating endogenous feedback loops with vulnerability to social influence, herding behavior and runaway cascades. Following the design of the classic Music Lab experiment, we tested this vulnerability in large populations of LLM agents that recommended unfamiliar songs, with or without exposure to cumulative recommendation counts. Exposure led to runaway cascades that generated extreme and unpredictable collective recommendations increasingly divergent from a song's intrinsic appeal. Compared to humans, LLM populations were generally far more susceptible to herding behavior, and unlike humans, LLM cascades were less able to self-correct. This vulnerability has implications for multi-agent collaboration in recommender systems, automated evaluation, complex problem-solving, and unauthorized conspiracies.

translation.title: LLM 多智能体系统易受羊群效应和失控级联的影响
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地在多智能体系统中运行，通过响应他人的选择进行协作，形成易受社会影响、羊群行为和失控级联影响的内生反馈循环。借鉴经典 Music Lab 实验的设计，我们在大量 LLM 智能体中测试了这种脆弱性，这些智能体推荐不熟悉的歌曲，有或没有接触累积推荐计数。接触导致失控级联，产生极端且不可预测的集体推荐，越来越偏离歌曲的内在吸引力。与人类相比，LLM 群体通常更容易受羊群行为影响，而且与人类不同，LLM 级联的自纠正能力较弱。这种脆弱性对推荐系统、自动化评估、复杂问题求解和未经授权的合谋中的多智能体协作具有影响。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 多智能体系统中的社会影响脆弱性，借鉴 Music Lab 实验设计测试发现 LLM 群体比人类更易产生羊群效应和失控级联且难以自我纠正。

papers.title: ABRA: Agent-Bound UI for Human-Agent Communication beyond Chat with Reusable Views
papers.abstract: Agents can create rich representations, yet these representations are rarely used as a medium for expressing user intent. We present Agent-Bound UI, an interaction model that separates reusable interaction structures from task-specific meanings. Agents bind task-specific meanings to interactions in reusable views and publish the resulting bindings as shared state, enabling humans and agents to understand and act on shared surfaces whose meanings vary across tasks. We implement ABRA, a framework-agnostic prototype of Agent-Bound UI, in which users and agents collaborate through chat and shared interactive canvases. We demonstrate ABRA through a representative use case and evaluate four LLM-backed agents on canvas authoring, owner-side consequence resolution, and cross-agent invocation. The code and demo video are available at https://github.com/megagonlabs/abra.

translation.title: ABRA：基于可复用视图、超越聊天的面向Agent的UI人机通信
translation.abstract: Agent能够创建丰富的表示，但这些表示很少被用作表达用户意图的媒介。我们提出Agent-Bound UI，一种将可复用交互结构与任务特定含义分离的交互模型。Agent将任务特定含义绑定到可复用视图中的交互上，并将产生的绑定发布为共享状态，使人类和Agent能够在含义随任务变化的共享界面上理解并采取行动。我们实现了ABRA，一个与框架无关的Agent-Bound UI原型，用户和Agent通过聊天和共享交互画布进行协作。我们通过一个代表性用例展示ABRA，并在画布创作、所有者侧后果解析和跨Agent调用方面评估了四个基于LLM的Agent。代码和演示视频见 https://github.com/megagonlabs/abra。
translation.brief: 解决Agent与人类共享交互界面缺乏表达用户意图媒介的问题，提出将可复用交互结构与任务特定含义分离并通过绑定发布为共享状态的Agent-Bound UI交互模型。

papers.title: Invisibilization as a Source of Probability Bias in Language Models
papers.abstract: Language models are aligned to avoid using protected attributes such as race, ethnicity, and gender to inform their responses. Therefore, they increasingly refuse or hedge when such attributes appear in a prompt. However, if a system must decide how much to learn from what people tell it, it is costly to refuse valuable information because of its source. In this article, we measure the cost of declining information in a two-urn game with an exact Bayesian answer. We present leading LLM models from two developers (OpenAI and Anthropic) with a prompt that requires them to decide how far to trust an unverifiable report from a participant whose description we randomize across ten configurations (6,600 sessions). We show that leading models often decline to assess the reporter, treating information as worthless at rates set by the description rather than by the evidence. At its widest, models decline a Black-described reporter 46% of the time and a white-described reporter 9%; yet, when they do assess the information, the Black-described reporter receives slightly more trust. The bias is invisible to audits that compare average trust or look only at assessed cases. It grows with reasoning effort, follows words rather than categories (models invoke race for "Black" but not for its Spanish translation negro, and never for "Indigenous"), and worsens under warning instructions a practitioner would try first. We also present a scoring option that reduces the refusal rate bias. When a model's trust is scored against revealed truth over repeated rounds, it credits identical records equally. In four of five configurations from Anthropic and OpenAI, the racial gap in trust falls below 0.02 by the last rounds.

translation.title: 不可见化：语言模型中概率偏差的一个来源
translation.abstract: 语言模型被对齐以避免使用种族、民族和性别等受保护属性来影响其回答。因此，当这些属性出现在提示中时，它们越来越多地拒绝或回避。然而，如果一个系统必须决定从人们告诉它的内容中学习多少，因信息来源而拒绝有价值的信息是有代价的。本文在一个具有精确贝叶斯答案的双瓮游戏中测量拒绝信息的代价。我们向来自两家开发商（OpenAI和Anthropic）的领先LLM模型呈现一个提示，要求它们决定在多大程度上信任来自某个参与者的不可验证报告，该参与者的描述在十种配置中随机化（6,600次会话）。我们表明，领先模型经常拒绝评估报告者，以由描述而非证据决定的比率将信息视为毫无价值。最严重时，模型在被描述为黑人的报告者的情况下46%的时间拒绝评估，而被描述为白人时仅为9%；然而，当它们确实评估信息时，被描述为黑人的报告者反而获得略多的信任。这种偏差对比较平均信任度或仅查看已评估案例的审计是不可见的。它随推理努力增长，跟随词语而非类别（模型对"Black"调用种族概念，但对其西班牙语翻译negro不会，对"Indigenous"也从不），并且在从业者会首先尝试的警告指令下变得更糟。我们还提出一种降低拒绝率偏差的评分选项。当模型的信任度在多轮中根据揭示的真实结果进行评分时，它对相同记录给予同等信任。在来自Anthropic和OpenAI的五个配置中的四个里，到最后一轮时种族信任差距降至0.02以下。
translation.brief: 解决LLM因报告者种族描述而拒绝有价值信息导致的隐性概率偏差问题，通过带精确贝叶斯答案的双瓮游戏实验测量该偏差并提出基于揭示真实结果的评分方法来降低偏差。

papers.title: An Introduction to World Models for Generalist Agents
papers.abstract: World models have recently emerged as a promising direction toward developing generalist agents capable of understanding, predicting, and interacting with diverse environments. However, despite growing interest, the concept of a world model remains loosely defined, encompassing approaches ranging from predictive dynamics models and learned simulators to models that jointly generate future observations and actions. This introductory paper aims to clarify the concept of world models and provide a unified perspective on their role in developing generalist agents. Starting from the partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) framework, we connect world modeling to classical control, dynamical systems, signal processing, and reinforcement learning. We introduce different approaches to world modeling, emphasizing the knowledge they capture, their learning objectives, and how they support decision-making. We further explore the relationship between world modeling and policy learning, highlighting how these capabilities can be unified through conditional prediction without requiring separate models. Rather than offering an exhaustive survey of existing methods, this paper focuses on fundamental concepts, modeling principles, and connections, with the goal of providing an accessible and unified introduction to world models for generalist agents.

translation.title: 面向通用Agent的世界模型导论
translation.abstract: 世界模型近来已成为开发能够理解、预测并与多样环境交互的通用Agent的一个有前景的方向。然而，尽管兴趣日益增长，世界模型的概念仍然定义松散，涵盖从预测动力学模型、学习型模拟器到联合生成未来观测和动作的模型等多种方法。本导论论文旨在澄清世界模型的概念，并提供其在开发通用Agent中作用的统一视角。从部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）框架出发，我们将世界建模与经典控制、动力系统、信号处理和强化学习联系起来。我们介绍不同的世界建模方法，强调它们捕获的知识、学习目标以及如何支持决策。我们进一步探讨世界建模与策略学习之间的关系，强调这些能力如何通过条件预测统一起来而无需单独的模型。本文并非对现有方法的详尽综述，而是聚焦于基本概念、建模原则和联系，目标是为通用Agent的世界模型提供一个易于理解且统一的导论。
translation.brief: 解决世界模型概念定义松散的问题，从POMDP框架出发将其与经典控制、强化学习等领域联系，为通用Agent的世界模型提供统一的概念性导论。

papers.title: Agentic Knowledge-Model Co-Evolution via Consistency Regularization
papers.abstract: LLM agents can evolve by learning from accumulated experience. Existing approaches extract reusable external knowledge, such as skills and memories, from experience to guide subsequent task solving, with some further internalizing this knowledge through model training. However, different ways of analyzing and transforming the same experience can yield knowledge with substantially different utility, even when the resulting guidance appears reasonable. Inspired by consistency regularization, we identify consistent utility gains across different ways of analyzing the same experience, rather than relying on any single way of analyzing it. We introduce SPLICE, a framework for consistency-regularized knowledge-model co-evolution. It constructs evolution views by perturbing how the same experience is analyzed, producing different knowledge candidates. Knowledge updates are then guided by common gain, which accounts for utility gains and their consistency across views. During model evolution, self-distillation internalizes the evolved knowledge alongside reinforcement learning, using knowledge associated with consistent utility degradation as a contrastive reference. The two processes interleave, with model updates driving further knowledge evolution. Experiments across diverse domains show that SPLICE outperforms knowledge evolution and model training baselines by up to 7.1 and 4.6 points in average accuracy, while its evolved knowledge reduces output tokens per correct solution by up to 44% and transfers across model sizes and families.

translation.title: 基于一致性正则化的Agent知识-模型协同演化
translation.abstract: LLM Agent可以通过从积累的经验中学习而演化。现有方法从经验中提取可复用的外部知识（如技能和记忆）来指导后续任务求解，一些方法还通过模型训练将这些知识内化。然而，对同一经验的不同分析和转换方式可能产生效用差异巨大的知识，即使由此产生的指导看起来合理。受一致性正则化启发，我们识别跨不同分析同一经验方式的一致效用增益，而非依赖任何单一分析方式。我们提出SPLICE，一个一致性正则化的知识-模型协同演化框架。它通过扰动对同一经验的分析方式构建演化视图，产生不同的知识候选。知识更新随后由共同增益引导，该增益考虑效用增益及其跨视图的一致性。在模型演化过程中，自蒸馏与强化学习一起内化演化后的知识，并将与一致效用退化相关的知识用作对比参考。两个过程交替进行，模型更新推动进一步的知识演化。跨多个领域的实验表明，SPLICE在平均准确率上分别超越知识演化和模型训练基线最多7.1和4.6分，同时其演化后的知识将每个正确解的输出token减少最多44%，并可跨模型规模和家族迁移。
translation.brief: 解决从经验提取知识时因单一分析方式导致知识效用不稳定的问题，提出SPLICE框架，通过扰动分析方式构建演化视图并以跨视图一致效用增益引导知识更新与模型训练的协同演化。

papers.title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. Our insight is that, to reduce KV cache writes without hurting KV cache hit rate, one need to not only consider the access pattern, but also application-level information such as the attention type of KV cache. Leveraging this observation, we propose Gandalf , the first SSD KV cache offloading system with SSD life time awareness. Gandalf prioritize the admission of full-attention KV cache into SSD over the cache generated by other types of attention, which significantly increases SSD lifetime without sacrificing cache hit rate. Our evaluation shows that Gandalf extends the SSD lifetime by 7.3X on average, while having negligible impact on cache hit rate across multiple workload traces and wide range of hardware capacity. Gandalf design can be extended to other flash-based storage, such as High Bandwidth Flash (HBF).

translation.title: Gandalf：Flash不应消亡！提升LLM服务中KV Cache卸载的闪存存储寿命
translation.abstract: KV caching降低了大语言模型（LLM）的服务成本，但不断增长的KV cache占用日益超出GPU和主机内存容量。因此，人们使用SSD以高I/O带宽扩展KV cache存储容量。然而，在生产LLM工作负载（如多轮对话和LLM Agent）中，KV cache写入总量显著超过SSD容量，将SSD寿命从数年缩短至数月。为提升SSD寿命，一个自然的解决方案是通过历史访问模式对KV cache写入进行门控以减少写入。然而，这会显著降低KV cache命中率（并增加LLM服务成本），因为来自不同注意力类型的KV cache可能具有相同的历史访问模式但不同的未来访问模式。我们的洞察是，要在不损害KV cache命中率的情况下减少KV cache写入，不仅需要考虑访问模式，还需要考虑应用级信息，如KV cache的注意力类型。基于这一观察，我们提出Gandalf，首个具备SSD寿命感知的SSD KV cache卸载系统。Gandalf优先将全注意力（full-attention）KV cache准入SSD，而非其他类型注意力生成的cache，从而在不牺牲cache命中率的情况下显著延长SSD寿命。我们的评估表明，Gandalf平均将SSD寿命延长7.3倍，同时在多种工作负载轨迹和宽范围硬件容量下对cache命中率的影响可忽略不计。Gandalf的设计可扩展到其他基于闪存的存储，如高带宽闪存（HBF）。
translation.brief: 解决LLM服务中KV cache卸载写入过多导致SSD寿命骤降的问题，提出Gandalf系统，利用注意力类型等应用级信息优先准入全注意力KV cache以延长SSD寿命且不降低命中率。

papers.title: Trace2World: Reconstructing App Worlds from Real Interaction Traces for Scalable GUI Agent Training
papers.abstract: Scaling GUI reinforcement learning requires environments that preserve real-app behavior. Yet coupling behavior inference with coding can turn partial traces into runnable mocks with incorrect state transitions. We introduce \textbf{Trace2World}, which separates global behavior reconstruction from implementation. It reconciles traces into a shared, source-linked app model, then compiles an executable environment. Independent replay of source workflows localizes mismatches for bounded implementation repair. Validated worlds then support learner-adaptive task and environment augmentation within source-supported behavior. From 1,570 traces, Trace2World constructs 50 environments. On 200 workflows across ten apps, 91.1% are reproduced end to end, versus 59.8% for the strongest matched task-local baseline. Source-grounded validation retains 94.0% of simulated training gains on real devices, versus 54.7% under self-validation. Learner guidance raises benchmark success from 56.9% to 61.1%. Training in Trace2World further improves the model by 20.2 points on our benchmark, 5.4--16.2 points across four external GUI benchmarks, and 16.3 points on 100 real-device tasks. Reliable reconstruction separates what behavior source evidence supports from whether the implementation preserves it.

translation.title: Trace2World：从真实交互轨迹重构应用世界以实现可扩展的GUI智能体训练
translation.abstract: 扩展GUI强化学习需要能保留真实应用行为的环境。然而将行为推断与编码耦合在一起，可能把部分轨迹变成状态转移错误的可运行模拟。我们提出Trace2World，将全局行为重构与实现分离。它将多条轨迹调和为一个共享的、与来源关联的应用模型，然后编译为可执行环境。对来源工作流的独立重放可定位不匹配之处，进行有界的实现修复。经验证的世界随后支持在来源支持的行为范围内进行学习器自适应的任务与环境增强。Trace2World从1,570条轨迹构建了50个环境。在十个应用的200个工作流上，91.1%可端到端复现，而最强的匹配任务局部基线仅为59.8%。基于来源的验证在真实设备上保留了94.0%的模拟训练收益，而自我验证仅为54.7%。学习器引导将基准成功率从56.9%提升到61.1%。在Trace2World中训练进一步使模型在我们基准上提升20.2分，在四个外部GUI基准上提升5.4–16.2分，在100个真实设备任务上提升16.3分。可靠的重构将行为来源证据所支持的内容与实现是否保留它分离开来。
translation.brief: 为解决GUI智能体训练环境难以忠实还原真实应用行为的问题，提出将行为重构与环境实现分离、由交互轨迹构建可验证可执行环境的Trace2World框架。

papers.title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high inference efficiency using optimized GPU kernels generated by just-in-time (JIT) compilation frameworks such as Triton. Triton compiles GPU kernels through an MLIR/LLVM-based pipeline. We investigate whether a Rowhammer-induced bit-flip in the CPU's DRAM can degrade GPU-based LLM inference performance while preserving output correctness. We present LLVMhammer, the first Rowhammer attack that causes LLM inference slowdown by inducing a bit-flip in Triton's compilation pipeline. A bit-flip in a performance-critical optimization pass causes Triton to generate a functionally identical but suboptimal GPU kernel. Since Triton caches the generated kernel on disk, a single successful bit-flip causes persistent slowdown across subsequent inference executions. Triton's target-independent stages are shared across GPU vendors, which makes our attack GPU vendor-agnostic. To identify exploitable bit-flip locations without manual inspection, we build Karnage, a tool that isolates useful bit-flip locations in Triton's target-independent compilation pipeline. We evaluate LLVMHammer across a diverse set of LLMs, including Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Deepseek-llm-7B-chat, across NVIDIA RTX 4090 and AMD RX 7900 XTX GPUs. LLVMhammer increases inference latency of an LLM inference server running on a single GPU by 4-16\%, which, in turn, can translate into additional annual operating costs at the scale of multi-GPU deployments. We further show that LLVMhammer can also corrupt LLM outputs across different GPU vendors, reducing BERTScore to as low as 25\%, illustrating the broader security implications of bit-flips in Triton's compilation pipeline.

translation.title: 通过Rowhammer攻击放大LLM推理的延迟与成本
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）借助Triton等即时（JIT）编译框架生成的优化GPU内核实现高效推理。Triton通过基于MLIR/LLVM的流水线编译GPU内核。我们研究CPU DRAM中的Rowhammer位翻转是否能在保持输出正确性的同时降低基于GPU的LLM推理性能。我们提出LLVMhammer，这是首个通过在Triton编译流水线中诱导位翻转来导致LLM推理变慢的Rowhammer攻击。性能关键优化pass中的位翻转使Triton生成功能相同但次优的GPU内核。由于Triton将生成的内核缓存到磁盘，一次成功的位翻转即可导致后续所有推理执行持续变慢。Triton的与目标无关的阶段在GPU厂商间共享，使我们的攻击不依赖GPU厂商。为无需人工检查即可找到可利用的位翻转位置，我们构建了Karnage工具，用于隔离Triton目标无关编译流水线中有用的位翻转位置。我们在多种LLM（包括Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3和Deepseek-llm-7B-chat）以及NVIDIA RTX 4090和AMD RX 7900 XTX GPU上评估了LLVMhammer。LLVMhammer使单GPU上运行的LLM推理服务器推理延迟增加4–16%，在多GPU部署规模下可转化为额外的年度运营成本。我们进一步表明LLVMhammer还能在不同GPU厂商间破坏LLM输出，使BERTScore降至最低25%，说明Triton编译流水线中位翻转的更广泛安全影响。
translation.brief: 针对LLM推理安全问题，提出利用Rowhammer位翻转篡改Triton编译流水线中的优化pass，生成次优GPU内核从而持续增加推理延迟与成本的攻击LLVMhammer。

papers.title: What Lies Beyond Perception: A Partition Theory of the Limits of AI Evaluation and Oversight
papers.abstract: Replacing the judge can move a benchmark score, and models can be trained to hide capabilities. Both put the evaluator in question: what can it certify? We develop a partition theory of evaluation from one principle: judgement is bounded by perception. An agent's discrimination is the partition of its inputs into classes it cannot tell apart. Discrimination is necessary for capability but not sufficient, so bounds on it bear directly on whether evaluation can show that a model lacks an ability. We prove a one-sided bound. An examinee whose partition refines its evaluator's has the discrimination to pass every test the evaluator can grade, provided each input has an acceptable reply. We define the echo test, which accepts any reply the evaluator perceives as identical to the input, and show that it is complete for the tests the evaluator can grade. Passing therefore certifies at most a floor on discrimination, never a ceiling, and only a sharper evaluator can raise it. Used to detect concealment, echo-test failure points the wrong way: under exhaustive probing it flags every honestly weaker examinee and no concealer that presents as the evaluator's peer. Exact imitation of a weaker model is undetectable by any behavioural evaluator. We extend the bound to ensembles of monitors and to channels a model controls, explain published findings on judge disagreement and sandbagging, and derive testable predictions. A safety case that argues from behavioural evaluation alone that a model lacks an ability must assume the model's cooperation.

translation.title: 感知之外是什么：AI评估与监督极限的划分理论
translation.abstract: 更换评判者可以改变基准分数，模型也可以被训练来隐藏能力。这两者都使评估者本身受到质疑：它能证明什么？我们从一个原则出发建立评估的划分理论：判断以感知为界。一个智能体的辨别力是其输入被划分为它无法区分的类别的方式。辨别力是能力的必要条件但非充分条件，因此对它的限制直接关系到评估能否证明模型缺乏某种能力。我们证明了一个单侧界。若被考者的划分细化了评估者的划分，且每个输入都存在可接受的回应，则被考者具备通过评估者所能出的所有测试的辨别力。我们定义了回声测试，它接受评估者感知为与输入相同的任何回应，并证明它对评估者所能出的测试是完备的。因此通过测试最多证明辨别力的下界，而非上界，只有更敏锐的评估者才能提高这一界限。用于检测隐藏能力时，回声测试失败会指向错误方向：在穷举探测下，它会标记每个诚实的较弱被考者，却不会标记任何表现为与评估者同等水平的隐藏者。对较弱模型的精确模仿无法被任何行为评估者检测到。我们将该界限扩展到监视器集合和模型可控制的信道，解释了已发表的关于评判者分歧与sandbagging的研究结果，并推导出可检验的预测。仅凭行为评估论证模型缺乏某种能力的安全案例必须假设模型的合作。
translation.brief: 针对AI评估与监督的能力证明极限问题，提出基于“判断以感知为界”的划分理论，证明行为测试只能给出辨别力下界、无法排除隐藏能力。

papers.title: A Weakly Group Strategy-Proof and Pareto-Stable Matching Mechanism with Two-Sided Indifferences under Gross Substitutes
papers.abstract: We study finite many-to-one matching markets with indifferences on both sides and publicly known firm preferences over sets of workers. A standard approach breaks ties uniformly at random and runs deferred acceptance, which is strategy-proof for workers but may select a weakly stable matching that is Pareto dominated under the agents' original preferences. For the broad class of markets in which each firm's preferences admit a gross substitutes (GS) representation, we construct a deterministic generalized deferred acceptance mechanism that is weakly stable, Pareto efficient with respect to both sides, worker weakly group strategy-proof, and implementable in strongly polynomial time given value oracles for the GS representations. This domain includes nonresponsive firm preferences, such as additive scores under matroid constraints and assignment values. Our analysis bridges ordinal matching with indifferences and competitive equilibria under imperfectly transferable utility. Although the mechanism uses only ordinal comparisons, it returns a seller-optimal equilibrium matching of a tiered auxiliary market, and the equilibrium structure of this market yields the stability, efficiency, and incentive guarantees.

translation.title: 在Gross Substitutes条件下具有双边无差异的弱群策略防操纵与Pareto稳定匹配机制
translation.abstract: 我们研究双边均存在无差异、且企业对工人集合的偏好公开已知的有限多对一匹配市场。标准做法是均匀随机打破平局并运行延迟接受算法，这对工人是策略防操纵的，但可能选出在代理人原始偏好下被Pareto占优的弱稳定匹配。对于每家企业偏好都可用gross substitutes（GS）表示的广泛市场类别，我们构造了一个确定性的广义延迟接受机制，它是弱稳定的、对双方均Pareto有效的、工人弱群策略防操纵的，并且在给定GS表示的价值预言机时可在强多项式时间内实现。该领域包括非响应型企业偏好，如拟阵约束下的加性分数和指派值。我们的分析将带无差异的序数匹配与不可完全转移效用下的竞争均衡联系起来。尽管该机制仅使用序数比较，它返回一个分层辅助市场的卖方最优均衡匹配，而该市场的均衡结构给出了稳定性、效率与激励保证。
translation.brief: 针对双边无差异匹配市场中随机打破平局导致Pareto劣势的问题，在gross substitutes偏好类上构造了弱稳定、Pareto有效、弱群策略防操纵且强多项式时间可实现的确定性广义延迟接受机制。

papers.title: Global Convergence of Detailed Balanced Mass Action Systems
papers.abstract: We give a self-contained proof that, for a finite detailed balanced mass-action system with positive rate constants, each positive stoichiometric compatibility class contains exactly one positive equilibrium and every positive trajectory converges to it, together with a Lean 4 formalization of the complete argument from persistence to convergence. Boundedness and persistence come from the barrier argument of OpenAI (2026) for weakly reversible systems: an arbitrary-tolerance affine approximation yields a finite-minimum barrier whose superlevel sets confine trajectories and give one logarithmic bound for all solutions from a given initial state. The Horn-Jackson dissipation identity identifies the positive equilibria as an exponential family with parameters in the orthogonal complement of the stoichiometric subspace, which gives uniqueness in each class. A bounded-speed descent argument replaces LaSalle's invariance principle; it uses neither uniqueness of solutions nor continuous dependence on initial data, and it places every cluster point in that family. The route given here is direct and elementary, and its main theorem is checked by the Lean kernel against explicit definitions. The proofs, the Lean development, and the manuscript were produced in ClawsGO Science, an agent harness that packages a complete research environment: Claude Opus 5.5 made the research decisions, GPT 6 Astra carried them out, and the Lean kernel checked every formal step.

translation.title: 细致平衡质量作用系统的全局收敛性
translation.abstract: 我们给出了一个自包含的证明：对于具有正速率常数的有限细致平衡质量作用系统，每个正化学计量相容类恰含一个正平衡点，且每条正轨迹都收敛到它，并附带从持续性到收敛的完整论证的Lean 4形式化。有界性与持续性来自OpenAI（2026）针对弱可逆系统的屏障论证：任意容差的仿射近似给出一个有限最小值屏障，其超水平集约束轨迹，并对来自同一初始状态的所有解给出一个对数界。Horn-Jackson耗散恒等式将正平衡点识别为参数位于化学计量子空间正交补中的指数族，从而给出每个相容类中的唯一性。一个有界速度下降论证取代了LaSalle不变性原理；它既不用到解的唯一性，也不用到对初始数据的连续依赖，并将每个聚点放入该指数族。这里给出的路径直接且初等，其主定理由Lean内核对照显式定义进行检验。证明、Lean开发与手稿均由ClawsGO Science产生——这是一个打包完整研究环境的智能体框架：Claude Opus 5.5做出研究决策，GPT 6 Astra执行，Lean内核检验每一个形式化步骤。
translation.brief: 针对细致平衡质量作用系统正平衡点唯一性与轨迹全局收敛问题，给出基于屏障论证、耗散恒等式与有界速度下降论证的自包含证明，并用Lean 4完成完整形式化验证。

papers.title: Breaking the Coupling: Efficient Concurrency Fuzzing for Linux Kernel Data Race Detection
papers.abstract: Detecting data races in the Linux kernel requires exploring both the input space and the thread-interleaving space. Existing kernel concurrency fuzzers couple these two searches by exploring interleavings during fuzzing, often spending substantial scheduling effort on inputs with little potential to trigger real races. In this paper, we present a new concurrency fuzzing paradigm that decouples concurrent-input generation from thread-interleaving exploration, enabling expensive scheduling to focus on promising inputs. To identify inputs that warrant targeted scheduling, we introduce May Race Pairs (MRPs), which represent conflicting memory-access pairs observed within a dynamically determined time threshold. Our framework first generates and executes concurrent syscall groups without controlled scheduling, collecting MRPs to guide further input mutation and identify schedule-worthy inputs. It then uses a separate scheduling instance to explore targeted interleavings and confirm real data races. To improve the effectiveness of both stages, we incorporate LLM-assisted semantic mutation for generating diverse syscall groups, backpressure-guided dynamic threshold control for balancing candidate production and scheduling consumption, and history-aware context recovery, context-aware interleaving scheduling, and candidate MRP prioritization for efficient race confirmation. We implement our framework for the Linux kernel and evaluate it on eight common kernel modules in Linux 6.17. It discovers 187 unique real-world data races, including 59 harmful races. Under the same testing budget, our approach detects substantially more data races than existing kernel concurrency fuzzers, including SegFuzz and CONZZER. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of decoupling concurrent-input generation from interleaving exploration and concentrating scheduling effort on promising candidates.

translation.title: 打破耦合：面向 Linux 内核数据竞争检测的高效并发模糊测试
translation.abstract: 检测 Linux 内核中的数据竞争需要同时探索输入空间和线程交错空间。现有的内核并发模糊测试工具将这两种搜索耦合在一起，在模糊测试过程中探索交错，往往将大量调度开销花费在几乎不可能触发真实竞争的输入上。本文提出一种新的并发模糊测试范式，将并发输入生成与线程交错探索解耦，使昂贵的调度能够专注于有前景的输入。为识别值得进行针对性调度的输入，我们引入 May Race Pairs（MRP），表示在动态确定的时间阈值内观察到的冲突内存访问对。我们的框架首先在无受控调度的情况下生成并执行并发系统调用组，收集 MRP 以指导后续输入变异并识别值得调度的输入；然后使用独立的调度实例探索针对性交错并确认真实数据竞争。为提升两个阶段的有效性，我们引入了 LLM 辅助的语义变异以生成多样的系统调用组、背压引导的动态阈值控制以平衡候选生成与调度消耗，以及历史感知的上下文恢复、上下文感知的交错调度和候选 MRP 优先级排序以实现高效竞争确认。我们在 Linux 内核上实现了该框架，并在 Linux 6.17 的八个常见内核模块上进行评估。它发现了 187 个独特的真实数据竞争，其中 59 个为有害竞争。在相同测试预算下，我们的方法检测到的数据竞争显著多于现有内核并发模糊测试工具，包括 SegFuzz 和 CONZZER。这些结果证明了将并发输入生成与交错探索解耦并将调度精力集中于有前景候选者的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对内核并发模糊测试中输入生成与线程交错探索耦合导致的调度浪费问题，提出通过 May Race Pairs 引导、将两者解耦并集中调度资源于有前景输入的并发模糊测试框架。

papers.title: TESSA: A Governance-Oriented Custom GPT for SME Guidance under the EU AI Act: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation
papers.abstract: The increasing adoption of generative AI presents new opportunities while raising AI governance and regulatory challenges, particularly for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) navigating the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act). To support AI governance education, this study developed TESSA, a governance-oriented educational artifact within the OpenAI Custom GPT environment. Following a design science research approach, TESSA was evaluated against baseline ChatGPT using 100 benchmark scenarios through governance alignment assessment, human expert review, and consistency testing. Preliminary LLM-assisted assessment showed governance alignment rates of 90% for TESSA and 83% for baseline ChatGPT, while independent validation by an AI regulation law practitioner yielded 71% and 70%, respectively. Human expert review indicated that both systems provided generally strong governance guidance, while TESSA maintained high consistency across repeated executions. The findings suggest that governance-oriented grounding can support structured, practical, and stable AI-assisted compliance guidance for SMEs. The study contributes (i) a governance-oriented Custom GPT artifact for AI governance education, (ii) a human-validated regulatory update mechanism, and (iii) a multidimensional evaluation framework for governance-oriented AI artifact.

translation.title: TESSA：面向治理的 Custom GPT，用于中小企业应对欧盟 AI 法案的指导：设计、实现与评估
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 的日益普及带来了新机遇，同时也引发了 AI 治理与监管挑战，对于正在应对欧盟《人工智能法案》（EU AI Act）的中小企业（SME）尤为突出。为支持 AI 治理教育，本研究在 OpenAI Custom GPT 环境中开发了 TESSA，一个面向治理的教育性制品。遵循设计科学研究方法，TESSA 通过治理对齐评估、人类专家评审和一致性测试，基于 100 个基准场景与基线 ChatGPT 进行了对比评估。初步的 LLM 辅助评估显示 TESSA 的治理对齐率为 90%，基线 ChatGPT 为 83%；而由一位 AI 监管法律从业者进行的独立验证结果分别为 71% 和 70%。人类专家评审表明两个系统均提供了总体较强的治理指导，而 TESSA 在多次重复执行中保持了高度一致性。研究结果表明，面向治理的接地可以支持面向中小企业的结构化、实用且稳定的 AI 辅助合规指导。本研究的贡献包括：(i) 一个面向 AI 治理教育的治理导向 Custom GPT 制品，(ii) 一个经人类验证的法规更新机制，(iii) 一个面向治理 AI 制品的多维评估框架。
translation.brief: 针对中小企业理解欧盟 AI 法案的困难，基于设计科学研究方法构建了治理导向的 Custom GPT 教育制品 TESSA，并通过多维评估框架验证其合规指导能力。

papers.title: Bezier-Guided Adaptive Flow for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation aims to alleviate data sparsity and cold-start problems by transferring useful preference knowledge across domains. However, users exhibit varying degrees of preference consistency across domains, while existing methods often rely on global alignment objectives or coarse-grained transfer strategies. Such approaches may introduce irrelevant information and provide limited flexibility in adapting semantic representations to individual user preferences. To address these challenges, we propose BGAFlow, a personalized framework that combines state-adaptive semantic evolution with user-specific transfer control. BGAFlow first establishes a shared semantic space through unified dual-domain pretraining with user profiles inferred by a large language model (LLM). Based on latent interest overlap, it then estimates a personalized horizon to determine the appropriate transfer extent for each user. To enable semantic adaptation, BGAFlow constructs a conditional Bezier curve as a geometric reference and learns a residual flow that progressively refines the trajectory based on intermediate preference states. The learned flow incorporates dynamic preference feedback to adjust transfer directions, while recommendation supervision and trajectory regularization encourage effective and smooth adaptation. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that BGAFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the benefits of personalized transfer control and state-adaptive semantic evolution.

translation.title: Bezier 引导的自适应流用于跨域序列推荐
translation.abstract: 跨域序列推荐旨在通过跨域迁移有用的偏好知识来缓解数据稀疏和冷启动问题。然而，用户在不同域之间表现出不同程度的偏好一致性，而现有方法往往依赖全局对齐目标或粗粒度迁移策略。这类方法可能引入无关信息，并且在将语义表示适配到个体用户偏好方面灵活性有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 BGAFlow，一个结合状态自适应语义演化与用户特定迁移控制的个性化框架。BGAFlow 首先通过统一的双域预训练建立共享语义空间，并利用大语言模型（LLM）推断的用户画像。基于潜在兴趣重叠，它随后估计一个个性化视界，以确定每个用户合适的迁移程度。为实现语义适配，BGAFlow 构建条件 Bezier 曲线作为几何参考，并学习一个残差流，基于中间偏好状态逐步细化轨迹。学习到的流融入动态偏好反馈以调整迁移方向，同时推荐监督和轨迹正则化促进有效且平滑的适配。在真实数据集上的大量实验表明，BGAFlow 持续优于最先进的基线方法，验证了个性化迁移控制和状态自适应语义演化的优势。
translation.brief: 针对跨域推荐中全局对齐和粗粒度迁移忽略用户个性化差异的问题，提出结合 LLM 用户画像、个性化迁移视界与 Bezier 曲线引导残差流的 BGAFlow 框架。

papers.title: TutorCaseBench: A Case-Grounded Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Tutors in Supporting Students with Challenging Behaviors
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as AI tutors, yet existing benchmarks overlook the challenging behaviors common among students with learning and behavioral difficulties. We introduce TutorCaseBench, a benchmark that grounds AI-tutor evaluation in qualitative case studies from pedagogy, educational psychology, and special education. Our pipeline converts documented student categories into case-specific scenarios, tutor-student dialogues, and rubrics grounded in source evidence. The benchmark contains 923 dialogues across five challenge types, evaluated through open-ended response generation (1,560 items) and multiple-choice selection (2,537 items). Across 11 state-of-the-art LLMs, even the strongest model satisfies a rubric criterion in only 55.8% of open-ended cases, while models are better at selecting appropriate strategies than generating situated responses. These results reveal a gap between intervention recognition and context-specific adaptation, especially for open-weight models. All data are publicly available at https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench.

translation.title: TutorCaseBench：一个基于案例的基准，用于评估 LLM 导师对有挑战性行为学生的支持能力
translation.abstract: LLM 正越来越多地被用作 AI 导师，但现有基准忽视了有学习与行为困难学生中常见的挑战性行为。我们提出 TutorCaseBench，一个将 AI 导师评估建立在来自教育学、教育心理学和特殊教育的定性案例研究之上的基准。我们的流程将记录在案的学生类别转化为基于源证据的案例特定场景、师生对话和评分标准。该基准包含五种挑战类型下的 923 段对话，通过开放式回答生成（1,560 项）和多项选择（2,537 项）进行评估。在 11 个最先进的 LLM 中，即使是最强的模型在开放式案例中也仅有 55.8% 满足评分标准，而模型在选择合适策略方面优于生成情境化回应。这些结果揭示了干预识别与情境特定适配之间的差距，对开放权重模型尤为明显。所有数据公开于 https://github.com/kixlab/TutorCaseBench。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准忽视学习与行为困难学生挑战性行为的问题，基于教育学和特殊教育案例构建了包含 923 段对话的 TutorCaseBench 基准，用于评估 LLM 导师的情境化应对能力。

papers.title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
papers.abstract: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. On top of our state-of-the-art retriever, optimized query rewriting further improves MathlibQR retrieval. On unlabeled queries from human and coding-agent interactions, Lean Finder V2 is ranked as the strongest system. Integrated with Claude Code, Lean Finder V2 improves proof success on downstream theorem-proving task. Lean Finder V2 is available at: https://leanfinder.github.io/

translation.title: Lean Finder V2：通过消歧用户查询实现 Mathlib 的语义搜索
translation.abstract: 我们提出 Lean Finder V2，一个针对 Mathlib 的语义搜索框架，通过互补的模型级对抗训练和输入级查询重写来消歧用户查询。人类数学家和编码代理很少通过提供详细上下文来搜索 Mathlib。实践中，他们查询简短的性质、记号、别名或假设，留下大量隐含的数学意图。相比之下，现有的 Mathlib 搜索引擎不切实际地假设查询具有丰富上下文。缺乏与真实 Mathlib 陈述配对的真实世界短查询使这种歧义更加难以处理。我们认为这本质上是一个数据问题。通过对抗训练，我们扩展了带标签的短且模糊查询的生成，并在模型级微调和输入级查询重写两个层面学习消歧用户查询。在人工整理的 MathlibQR 基准上，我们的 Lean Finder V2 创造了新的最先进水平，相比此前最佳的 Mathlib 语义搜索引擎至少提升 11%（相对）。在我们最先进的检索器之上，优化的查询重写进一步提升了 MathlibQR 检索效果。在来自人类和编码代理交互的无标签查询上，Lean Finder V2 被评为最强系统。与 Claude Code 集成后，Lean Finder V2 提升了下游定理证明任务的证明成功率。Lean Finder V2 可访问：https://leanfinder.github.io/
translation.brief: 针对 Mathlib 搜索中用户短查询歧义且缺乏标注数据的问题，通过对抗训练扩展歧义短查询数据，并结合模型级微调与输入级查询重写实现查询消歧的语义搜索框架。

papers.title: ADAPT for Science: A Multi-Agent System for Self-Evolving Scientific Optimization
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery often requires identifying a small number of high-performing designs in vast, constrained search spaces. This is difficult when evaluations are costly, feasible solutions are sparse, parameters are strongly coupled, and physical constraints are strict. Recent AI for AI methods can automatically improve algorithms and optimization procedures. However, general purpose approaches are not designed around scientific priors, physical constraints, and limited evaluation budgets. We introduce ADAPT for Science, a multi-agent framework that treats scientific optimization as two coupled decisions: where to search and how to search. ADAPT uses historical designs to identify promising and diverse initial conditions, progressively concentrates computation on favorable search directions, and evolves the optimization procedure from execution feedback. We evaluate ADAPT on the design of gravitational wave detectors using a differentiable physics simulator and eight unseen detector topologies. Under matched scientific evaluation budgets, ADAPT achieves a mean loss of 0.204 +/- 0.101, reducing loss by 54.9% relative to the best classical optimizer and by 62.2% relative to the best general purpose agentic evolution baseline. ADAPT achieves the lowest loss on all unseen topologies among the evaluated baselines. ADAPT provides a step toward scientific optimization systems that continuously learn from prior experience and their own search outcomes.

translation.title: ADAPT for Science：一种自我进化的科学优化多智能体系统
translation.abstract: 科学发现往往需要在巨大且受约束的搜索空间中识别出少数高性能设计。当评估成本高昂、可行解稀疏、参数强耦合且物理约束严格时，这一任务尤为困难。近期的 AI for AI 方法可以自动改进算法和优化流程，但通用方法并非围绕科学先验、物理约束和有限的评估预算而设计。我们提出 ADAPT for Science，一个将科学优化视为两个耦合决策（在哪里搜索以及如何搜索）的多智能体框架。ADAPT 利用历史设计识别有前景且多样的初始条件，逐步将计算集中于有利的搜索方向，并根据执行反馈进化优化流程。我们在可微物理模拟器和八种未见过的探测器拓扑上，于引力波探测器设计任务中评估了 ADAPT。在匹配的科学评估预算下，ADAPT 取得 0.204 +/- 0.101 的平均损失，相对于最佳经典优化器降低损失 54.9%，相对于最佳通用智能体进化基线降低 62.2%。在所有评估基线中，ADAPT 在所有未见拓扑上均取得最低损失。ADAPT 为能够持续从先验经验和自身搜索结果中学习的科学优化系统迈出了一步。
translation.brief: 解决昂贵评估下科学设计优化问题，采用将搜索位置与搜索方式作为耦合决策的多智能体自适应框架。

papers.title: Consensus-Based Distributed Filtering for Angles-Only Tracking in Cislunar Space
papers.abstract: This paper investigates consensus-based distributed filtering strategies for multi-observer angles-only navigation in the cislunar space. The objective is to estimate the inertial state of a target spacecraft using only line-of-sight measurements collected by a network of observer spacecraft. This problem is particularly relevant for autonomous cislunar navigation, where ground support may be limited, and centralized fusion architectures may be problematic due to communication and computational constraints, and single-point failure risks. Three distributed filtering approaches are considered: the Distributed Extended Kalman Filter, the Information-Weighted Consensus Filter, and the Kalman Consensus Filter. All methods share the same local prediction and measurement-processing steps, but differ in the way information is exchanged and fused across the network. Their performance is evaluated and compared to a centralized Extended Kalman Filter, adopted as benchmark, and independent local filters in a high-fidelity cislunar scenario. Numerical simulations show that the distributed approaches significantly improve estimation accuracy with respect to independent filters. Monte Carlo sensitivity analyses are then conducted to characterize the robustness of the considered methods to finite consensus iterations and prior misalignment among the agents.

translation.title: 面向地月空间纯角度跟踪的基于共识的分布式滤波
translation.abstract: 本文研究了地月空间中多观测器纯角度导航的基于共识的分布式滤波策略。其目标是仅利用观测器航天器网络收集的视线测量来估计目标航天器的惯性状态。该问题对自主地月导航尤为重要，因为地面支持可能有限，且集中式融合架构可能因通信与计算约束以及单点故障风险而存在问题。本文考虑三种分布式滤波方法：分布式扩展卡尔曼滤波器、信息加权共识滤波器和卡尔曼共识滤波器。所有方法共享相同的局部预测与测量处理步骤，区别在于信息在网络中的交换与融合方式。在高保真地月场景中，它们的性能被评估并与作为基准的集中式扩展卡尔曼滤波器以及独立局部滤波器进行比较。数值仿真表明，分布式方法相比独立滤波器显著提升了估计精度。随后进行蒙特卡洛敏感性分析，刻画了所考虑方法对有限共识迭代次数和智能体间先验失配的鲁棒性。
translation.brief: 解决多观测器纯角度导航的目标状态估计问题，采用三种基于共识的分布式滤波方法并与集中式滤波对比。

papers.title: Separate Field Scoring Protects Unused Tools When Agents Pool Tool-Use Experience
papers.abstract: Agents that call tools from a shared catalog can pool what they learn about which tool serves which request. We measure what pooled usage examples do to tool retrieval, reporting separately the held-out tools, for which no agent has usage, and all other tools. Adding usage examples to the index as extra entries for used tools raises Hit@5 (whether a gold tool is in the top five) for those tools and lowers it for held-out tools, by a large margin on two of three catalogs and with both embedders we tested. Giving used tools the same number of equally long entries filled with other tools' text lowers held-out Hit@5 about as much, but gives little or none of the gain. We call our method of scoring usage as its own field SYNAPSE. On StableToolBench, the held-out gold tool appears in its top five more often than with a router that reserves slots for usage (0.785 against 0.683), and this held-out lead holds on all three catalogs with both embedders. This protection persisted when we replaced each tool's usage with other tools' text, and a constant score offset for tools with usage gives similar held-out Hit@5 in most settings. The gain for tools with usage, in contrast, needs usage about the right tool. The router keeps more of the gain on labeled queries on TOUCAN with both embedders and on ToolRet with one, so the better choice depends on the workload. Splitting the usage among ten simulated agents shows that pooling helps exactly as much as giving one agent the same records.

translation.title: 独立字段评分在智能体汇集工具使用经验时保护未使用工具
translation.abstract: 从共享目录调用工具的智能体可以汇集它们关于哪个工具服务哪种请求的经验。我们测量汇集的使用示例对工具检索的影响，并分别报告无任何智能体使用记录的留出工具和其他工具。将使用示例作为已使用工具的额外条目加入索引，会提升这些工具的 Hit@5（金标工具是否位于前五），但会在三个目录中的两个以及我们测试的两种嵌入器上大幅降低留出工具的 Hit@5。给已使用工具填充相同数量、相同长度但内容为其他工具文本的条目，对留出工具 Hit@5 的降低程度相近，却几乎不带来增益。我们将这种将使用记录作为独立字段进行评分的方法称为 SYNAPSE。在 StableToolBench 上，留出金标工具进入其前五的频率高于为使用记录保留槽位的路由器（0.785 对 0.683），且这一留出优势在所有三个目录和两种嵌入器上均成立。当我们将每个工具的使用记录替换为其他工具的文本时，这种保护仍然存在；在大多数设置下，对有使用记录的工具施加恒定分数偏移可得到相近的留出 Hit@5。相比之下，已使用工具的增益需要使用记录与正确工具相关。该路由器在 TOUCAN 的带标签查询（两种嵌入器）和 ToolRet（一种嵌入器）上保留了更多增益，因此更好的选择取决于工作负载。将使用记录分给十个模拟智能体的实验表明，汇集带来的帮助与让单个智能体拥有相同记录完全一致。
translation.brief: 解决工具经验汇集导致未使用工具检索性能下降的问题，提出将使用记录作为独立字段评分的 SYNAPSE 方法。

papers.title: ATLAS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Lifting Binary to Canonical Compiler IR
papers.abstract: Lifting stripped, heavily optimized binaries to a canonical, pre-optimization LLVM intermediate representation (IR) is essential for downstream security analysis and legacy software migration when source code is unavailable. However, aggressive compiler optimizations rewrite control and data flow, remove structural metadata, and introduce type-erased low-level idioms, causing current lifters to produce malformed or semantically divergent IR. We present ATLAS, a multi-agent framework designed to reconstruct formally valid and canonical LLVM IR from optimized disassembly.ATLAS combines (i) Structure-aware, region-level retrieval, which utilizes pseudo-probe attribution to align optimized instructions with canonical IR exemplars, and (ii) a collaborative refinement loop that closes the gap between probabilistic generation and deterministic compiler constraints. Concretely, a Lift agent generates an initial IR draft conditioned on retrieved exemplars, an Advisor agent interprets LLVM verifier/compilation diagnostics and static checks to propose localized repair actions, and a Validation agent applies the edits, re-runs toolchain verification and (when available) runtime checks, and feeds the resulting diagnostics back to the Advisor. The agents iterate until the IR is verifier-clean and behaviorally consistent, or a budget limit is reached. On HumanEval-Decompile and MBPP, ATLAS outperforms seven baselines on lifting LLVM IR, achieving 91.8% re-executability and 89.4% CFG similarity across ARM, x86-64, and RISC-V binaries. Moreover, our evaluation demonstrates that ATLAS also outperforms the Binary to C to IR pipelines in pointer-flow precision and downstream analyzability. By recovering a well-formed, machine-centric representation, ATLAS enables practical cross-ISA recompilation and verifiable binary-only migration workflows.

translation.title: ATLAS：一种将二进制程序提升为规范化编译器 IR 的多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 在源代码不可得时，将剥离符号、高度优化的二进制程序提升为规范化的、优化前的 LLVM 中间表示（IR），对下游安全分析和遗留软件迁移至关重要。然而，激进的编译器优化会重写控制流和数据流、移除结构元数据，并引入类型擦除的低级惯用法，导致现有提升器产生格式错误或语义偏离的 IR。我们提出 ATLAS，一个旨在从优化后的反汇编中重构形式有效且规范化 LLVM IR 的多智能体框架。ATLAS 结合了（i）结构感知的区域级检索，利用伪探针归因将优化后的指令与规范 IR 示例对齐；（ii）协作式精炼循环，弥合概率生成与确定性编译器约束之间的差距。具体而言，Lift 智能体基于检索到的示例生成初始 IR 草稿，Advisor 智能体解读 LLVM 验证器/编译诊断和静态检查以提出局部修复动作，Validation 智能体应用修改、重新运行工具链验证和（可用时的）运行时检查，并将诊断结果反馈给 Advisor。各智能体迭代直至 IR 通过验证器且行为一致，或达到预算上限。在 HumanEval-Decompile 和 MBPP 上，ATLAS 在 LLVM IR 提升任务中优于七个基线，在 ARM、x86-64 和 RISC-V 二进制上实现 91.8% 的可重执行率和 89.4% 的 CFG 相似度。此外，评估表明 ATLAS 在指针流精度和下游可分析性上也优于二进制到 C 再到 IR 的流水线。通过恢复良构的、面向机器的表示，ATLAS 使实用的跨 ISA 重编译和可验证的纯二进制迁移工作流成为可能。
translation.brief: 解决从优化二进制重构规范化 LLVM IR 的问题，采用结构感知检索与多智能体协作精炼循环的框架。

papers.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data.
