We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.

translation.title: 继承而非发明：追踪推理模型中 Wait 的来源
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）被认为教会了推理模型在重新审视某一步之前写下 {wait}，然而 RL 带来的大幅准确率提升并不需要这个词。这种观点可能混淆了 RL 所发现的内容与模型从训练数据中继承的内容。我们通过开放模型的训练历史追踪这个词，使用基于采样输出计算的无标签指标（频率、位置、形式和用法）以及注入错误测试来分析它。我们发现 zero-RL 几乎从不创造该标记：在缺乏该词的基座上，RL 大幅提升 MATH-500 准确率，而 {wait} 仍近乎缺席。它随训练数据而来：在 OLMo-3 的中期训练中出现，而对推理轨迹的微调将其植入大多数原本缺乏该词的模型。当基座已使用该词时，两种已发布的 RL-Zero 配方（OLMo-3、MiMo）会使其数量倍增，而来自同一基座的无 KL 的 GRPO 则不会；OLMo-3 的配方会磨损其形式，使其成为更敏感但更宽松的警报；监督微调之后的 RL 几乎不改变它，而我们的 GRPO 配方会抹除由微调植入的标记。最后，我们表明仅凭标记频率并不能指示 RL 诱发的推理，并警告不要使用 LLM-as-a-judge 的修订指标，因为自动评判者可能逆转人工标注的趋势。
translation.brief: 解决推理模型中 {wait} 标记来源归属问题，通过无标签指标和注入错误测试追踪其在训练历史中的出现。

papers.title: Building Presentation Intelligence for High-Quality Slide Generation
papers.abstract: PowerPoint presentations (PPTs) are a dominant medium for communication across diverse domains, yet high-quality PPT generation still depends heavily on labor-intensive human effort. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for agentic tasks have created both new opportunities and challenges (Chen et al., 2026) for automatic PPT generation. In this work, we present a unified training framework for automatic PPT generation toward presentation intelligence, integrating cross-validated data synthesis, guided teacher enhancement, and verifiable reward optimization. We first construct a cross-validated pipeline for data synthesis, with explicit control over both difficulty and validity. We then develop a teacher-enhancement framework grounded in rules and prior knowledge to substantially strengthen the instructional capacity of teacher models. Building on this, we further improve supervised fine-tuning (SFT) through a mixed-teacher strategy and a lightweight outcome-driven trajectory filtering method. Finally, based on the resulting SFT models, we introduce a suite of verifiable aesthetic metrics together with a GRPO-based reinforcement learning framework to optimize slide-level visual attributes beyond text-only supervision. Experiments show that our enhanced SFT pipeline improves Qwen-3.6-27B and Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B by 7.45 and 9.35 points on PresentBench, respectively, surpassing GLM-5.2 while maintaining strong generalization. Reinforcement learning further improves performance across five aesthetic dimensions, compensating for the limitations of SFT in visual refinement. Overall, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for high-quality PPT generation.

translation.title: 构建面向高质量幻灯片生成的演示智能
translation.abstract: PowerPoint 演示文稿（PPT）是各领域沟通的主流媒介，但高质量的 PPT 生成仍然高度依赖大量人力。大语言模型（LLM）在智能体任务上的最新进展为自动 PPT 生成带来了新的机遇与挑战（Chen et al., 2026）。本文提出一个面向演示智能的自动 PPT 生成统一训练框架，整合了交叉验证的数据合成、引导式教师增强以及可验证奖励优化。我们首先构建了一个对难度和有效性具有显式控制的交叉验证数据合成流水线。随后，我们开发了一个基于规则和先验知识的教师增强框架，以大幅提升教师模型的教学能力。在此基础上，我们通过混合教师策略和轻量级的基于结果的轨迹过滤方法进一步改进监督微调（SFT）。最后，基于所得的 SFT 模型，我们引入一套可验证的美学指标以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习框架，以在纯文本监督之外优化幻灯片级别的视觉属性。实验表明，我们增强后的 SFT 流水线使 Qwen-3.6-27B 和 Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B 在 PresentBench 上分别提升 7.45 和 9.35 分，超越 GLM-5.2，同时保持良好的泛化能力。强化学习进一步在五个美学维度上提升性能，弥补了 SFT 在视觉精修方面的不足。总体而言，结果证明了我们的框架在高质量 PPT 生成上的有效性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决自动生成高质量 PPT 的问题，核心方法是构建包含交叉验证数据合成、教师增强、混合教师 SFT 与基于 GRPO 强化学习的统一训练框架。

papers.title: Working Through Representation: Malleable Workspaces for Human-Agent Knowledge Work
papers.abstract: Generative AI supports knowledge work, yet conversational histories may not capture the evolving organization that guides subsequent action. We introduce the Malleable Workspace, a conceptual model of how humans and agents form and revise a Work Representation and use its organization to advance work within a wider Work Environment. We developed it iteratively through conceptual analysis, comparison of 58 papers, and the construction and three-month longitudinal study of MalleableSpace with seven experienced agent users. Systems varied in what they represented as units and relations. System-assembled context was common; more systems supported local incorporation of agent outputs than reorganization, and fewer supported consequential agent-driven changes beyond the representation. The field study showed how representational roles and organization developed in use. These observations refined the model's account of how representation-grounded action depends on and can change the Work Environment. We contribute a conceptual and analytic foundation for representation-centered human--agent design.

translation.title: 在表示中工作：面向人-智能体知识工作的可塑工作区
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 支持知识工作，但对话历史可能无法捕捉引导后续行动的、不断演化的组织结构。我们提出可塑工作区（Malleable Workspace）这一概念模型，描述人类与智能体如何形成和修订工作表示（Work Representation），并利用其组织结构在更广泛的工作环境（Work Environment）中推进工作。我们通过概念分析、58 篇论文的对比，以及构建 MalleableSpace 并对七位经验丰富的智能体用户开展为期三个月的纵向研究，对该模型进行了迭代开发。各系统在所表示的单元和关系上存在差异；系统组装的上下文很常见，支持对智能体输出进行局部整合的系统多于支持重组的系统，而支持表示之外由智能体驱动的实质性变更的系统更少。实地研究展示了表示角色与组织结构如何在使用中发展。这些观察细化了模型对基于表示的行动如何依赖并改变工作环境的解释。我们为以表示为中心的人-智能体设计贡献了概念与分析基础。
translation.brief: 该论文解决对话历史无法承载知识工作组织结构的问题，核心方法是通过概念分析与三个月纵向用户研究提出并验证可塑工作区这一概念模型。

papers.title: Silicon Samples Match the Answers but Not the Respondents
papers.abstract: Silicon sampling generates survey respondents by having a large language model (LLM) answer a survey as a person with given demographic attributes, and the resulting synthetic populations are increasingly used in place of human ones. Existing evaluations focus on individual-answer accuracy, per-question answer distributions, and correlations across questions. None of these compares the respondents themselves, so a generator whose respondents have combinations of answers found in no human respondent can still score well if it reproduces every answer distribution. We propose the respondent coverage gap (RCG), which represents each respondent as a point defined by their complete answer profile and measures how far each human respondent is from the nearest generated one, relative to the distance between human samples. On two US social surveys, all six LLMs we evaluate leave human respondents uncovered, and under our main settings, they fall behind a baseline that samples each answer independently from the human marginals. Across the prompting and inference settings we test, every LLM has a higher RCG than a Gaussian copula fitted to the human data.

translation.title: 硅基样本匹配答案但不匹配受访者
translation.abstract: 硅基采样（Silicon sampling）通过让大语言模型（LLM）以具有特定人口统计属性的人的身份回答问卷来生成调查受访者，由此得到的合成人群正日益被用于替代人类人群。现有评估聚焦于个体答案准确性、逐题答案分布以及跨题相关性，这些方法都不比较受访者本身，因此一个生成的受访者拥有任何人类受访者都不具备的答案组合的生成器，只要能复现每个答案分布，仍可获得高分。我们提出受访者覆盖差距（respondent coverage gap, RCG），将每个受访者表示为由其完整答案画像定义的一个点，并衡量每个人类受访者与最近生成受访者之间的距离相对于人类样本间距离的大小。在两项美国社会调查上，我们评估的六个 LLM 全部未能覆盖人类受访者，且在主要设置下，它们落后于从人类边际分布独立抽取每个答案的基线。在我们测试的所有提示与推理设置中，每个 LLM 的 RCG 都高于拟合人类数据的高斯 copula。
translation.brief: 该论文解决现有评估无法发现 LLM 合成受访者与真实受访者分布差异的问题，核心方法是提出以完整答案画像衡量受访者覆盖差距的 RCG 指标。

papers.title: Same molecule, Different Knowledge: Cross-Identifier Binding Failures in LLMs For chemistry
papers.abstract: Chemical AI workflows routinely represent the same molecule through multiple co-referring identifiers, including trivial names, IUPAC names, and SMILES, implicitly assuming that these representations provide interchangeable access to an LLM's knowledge. To test this assumption, we first introduce a controlled benchmark and show that it does not hold. Across foundation models spanning 7B to 72B parameters, even chemistry-specialized models, co-referring molecular identifiers consistently expose different subsets of the model's knowledge. We then conduct a series of controlled behavioral, representational, and causal analyses to characterize this failure. We show that even when a model can identify a molecule from its SMILES and retrieve a fact through the corresponding name, the same fact can remain inaccessible directly from SMILES. We term this phenomenon \emph{cross-identifier binding failure}. Further analysis of internal representations, conflicting identifiers, and parameter editing shows that neither improved chemical representation competence nor modification of individual facts is sufficient to establish reliable access across identifiers. Together, these results indicate that the core failure lies in the binding between an identifier and knowledge already present in the model. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce Binding Self-Distillation, a simple mitigation that uses lexical identity during training to transfer the model's existing knowledge access to the structural route. This enables factual retrieval directly from SMILES at inference time, without requiring a name lookup or training the underlying model from scratch.

translation.title: 同一分子，不同知识：LLM 化学中的跨标识符绑定失败
translation.abstract: 化学 AI 工作流通常通过多个共指标识符（包括俗名、IUPAC 名称和 SMILES）表示同一分子，并隐含地假设这些表示可以互换地访问 LLM 的知识。为检验这一假设，我们首先引入一个受控基准，并证明该假设不成立。在参数量从 7B 到 72B 的基础模型（包括化学专用模型）上，共指的分子标识符始终暴露出模型知识的不同子集。随后，我们进行了一系列受控的行为、表示和因果分析来刻画这一失败。我们表明，即使模型能够从 SMILES 识别分子并通过相应名称检索事实，同一事实仍可能无法直接从 SMILES 获得。我们将这一现象称为跨标识符绑定失败（cross-identifier binding failure）。对内部表示、冲突标识符和参数编辑的进一步分析表明，无论是提升化学表示能力还是修改单个事实，都不足以建立跨标识符的可靠访问。这些结果共同表明，核心失败在于标识符与模型中已有知识之间的绑定。基于这一诊断，我们提出绑定自蒸馏（Binding Self-Distillation）这一简单缓解方法，在训练中利用词法同一性将模型已有的知识访问迁移到结构路径上，从而在推理时直接从 SMILES 进行事实检索，无需名称查找或从头训练底层模型。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 对同一分子的不同标识符（如 SMILES 与名称）无法互换访问知识的问题，核心方法是通过行为、表示与因果分析诊断跨标识符绑定失败并提出绑定自蒸馏缓解方法。

papers.title: Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver programs, but reliably producing correct formulations and implementations remains challenging. Existing approaches improve optimization modeling through agentic workflows or task-specific post-training. This raises a practical question: can a lightweight harness using a single model role achieve competitive performance without additional training? We introduce OPTICYCLE and OPTISTATE, two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling, and evaluate them on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems using 11 Qwen variants spanning 0.6B-27B parameters. Our results show that execution-guided revision consistently improves macro accuracy over direct generation for all evaluated models, with gains of up to 49.46 percentage points. Despite their simplicity, both harnesses outperform six adapted agentic workflows in same-model comparisons and four evaluated post-trained optimization models at comparable model sizes, without additional training. Explicit formulation state provides further but model-dependent improvements, suggesting that additional structure is not universally beneficial.

translation.title: 将语言模型用作优化建模智能体
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以将自然语言优化问题翻译为求解器程序，但可靠地生成正确的建模与实现仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通过智能体工作流或任务特定的后训练来改进优化建模。这引出一个实际问题：仅使用单一模型角色的轻量级 harness 能否在不进行额外训练的情况下取得有竞争力的性能？我们提出 OPTICYCLE 和 OPTISTATE 两个轻量级优化建模推理 harness，并在包含 2,634 个问题的九个基准上，使用参数量从 0.6B 到 27B 的 11 个 Qwen 变体进行评估。结果表明，执行引导的修订在所有评估模型上都能持续提升相对直接生成的宏平均准确率，提升幅度最高达 49.46 个百分点。尽管结构简单，两个 harness 在同模型比较中优于六个改造后的智能体工作流，并在相近模型规模下优于四个经过后训练的优化模型，且无需额外训练。显式的建模状态提供了进一步但依赖模型的改进，表明额外结构并非普遍有益。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 可靠生成优化问题求解器程序的问题，核心方法是提出无需额外训练的轻量级推理 harness OPTICYCLE 和 OPTISTATE，利用执行引导的修订提升建模准确率。

papers.title: Low-Latency MoE Inference in Space Data Centers: A Wireless-Power-Transfer Perspective
papers.abstract: Space data centers (SpaceDCs) are emerging as platforms for large language models (LLMs), supported by continuous solar-energy harvesting and high-speed interconnections. The mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture supports distributed LLM inference by deploying experts across satellites. However, skewed expert activation creates uneven computation power demands despite uniform solar-power supply at the dawn-dusk sun-synchronous orbit (SSO). Consequently, active experts remain power-constrained while harvested power at idle experts is underused. These reduce inference efficiency and increase latency. To address this supply-demand mismatch, we propose the SpaceWPT framework, which uses inter-satellite laser-based wireless power transfer (WPT) to redistribute harvested power. The key design challenge is to balance the computation demands of power-donating and power-receiving satellites under WPT losses: transferring more power accelerates computation at the receiver but leaves less power for the donor. After deriving design principles that simplify WPT control, we characterize the resulting latency tradeoff through a tractable surrogate of average inference latency. Minimizing the surrogate yields a novel two-sided water-filling strategy that determines whether each active expert donates, retains, or receives power according to the water level and its WPT link efficiency. Simulations with Mixtral-8x7B and Phi-3.5-MoE show up to 29.25% lower inference latency than without WPT, with larger gains under more compact formations and higher transfer efficiencies.

translation.title: 空间数据中心中的低时延 MoE 推理：无线能量传输视角
translation.abstract: 空间数据中心正借助持续的太阳能采集和高速互联，成为承载大语言模型的平台。混合专家架构通过将专家分布在多颗卫星上支持分布式 LLM 推理。然而，尽管在晨昏太阳同步轨道上太阳能供给均匀，专家激活的偏斜却造成计算功耗需求不均。这导致活跃专家受功率限制，而空闲专家采集的功率被闲置，从而降低推理效率并增加时延。为解决这种供需失配问题，我们提出 SpaceWPT 框架，利用星间激光无线能量传输来重新分配采集的功率。关键设计挑战在于在 WPT 损耗下平衡供电卫星与受电卫星的计算需求：传输更多功率可加速接收方计算，但会减少供方的可用功率。在推导出简化 WPT 控制的设计原则后，我们通过一个可处理的平均推理时延替代量来刻画由此产生的时延权衡。最小化该替代量得到一种新颖的双侧注水策略，根据水位和 WPT 链路效率决定每个活跃专家是捐出、保留还是接收功率。基于 Mixtral-8x7B 和 Phi-3.5-MoE 的仿真显示，相比无 WPT 情形推理时延最多降低 29.25%，且在更紧凑的编队和更高的传输效率下收益更大。
translation.brief: 解决空间数据中心 MoE 推理中卫星间太阳能供需失配问题，提出利用星间激光无线能量传输和双侧注水策略重新分配功率以降低推理时延。

papers.title: REGATTA: A Cross-Domain Measurement Framework and Fault-Injection Harness for Enterprise AI Agents
papers.abstract: Enterprise AI-agent evaluation needs evidence about whether test suites expose specified faults and whether their reference rules are trustworthy. We introduce REGATTA (Regulatory Evaluation of Agents via Two-stage Testing and Assurance), a measurement framework with three instruments. A 125-item source-cited checklist spans five industry-by-jurisdiction cells across the United States and Vietnam. A 25-fault corpus covers five categories, and a harness scores suite-level fault detection at the design and execution stages. We examine four measurement diagnostics on 180 generated suites (5,400 scenarios) from three LLM generators. A source audit finds 24 items misstating the rule in force, 46 additional citation defects, 31 items with only non-binding, unidentifiable, or unverifiable sources, and 24 verified clean. Only initially substance-flagged items received author review; all 24 clean rows received AI review only. Results therefore describe the instruments as written, not legal compliance. Item coverage varies, execution-stage fault profiles are stable across generators, and the historical stages agree on $66$--$69\%$ of fault--suite pairs. A current-model US-insurance retest finds stage disagreement above repeated-execution variation, but stage agreement $.536$ falls below pooled chance $.549$, failing V3's lower inequality. Blind adjudication by one expert supports the design-stage judging protocol ($\kappa=.72$, 95% interval $[.52,.88]$); 40 current-model execution probes give $\kappa=.75$. The instruments, audit, and reusable code are released.

translation.title: REGATTA：面向企业级 AI 智能体的跨领域测量框架与故障注入工具
translation.abstract: 企业级 AI 智能体评估需要证据来说明测试套件是否暴露了特定故障，以及其参考规则是否可信。我们提出 REGATTA（通过两阶段测试与保障的智能体法规评估），这是一个包含三种工具的测量框架。一份含 125 条带来源引用的清单覆盖美国和越南的五个行业-辖区单元；一个 25 个故障的语料库覆盖五个类别；一个测试工具在设计和执行两个阶段对套件级故障检测进行评分。我们在来自三个 LLM 生成器的 180 个生成套件（5,400 个场景）上考察了四项测量诊断。来源审计发现 24 条错误陈述了现行规则，另有 46 处引用缺陷，31 条仅有非约束性、不可识别或不可验证的来源，24 条经核实无误。只有最初被标记存在实质问题的条目接受了作者评审；全部 24 条无误行仅接受了 AI 评审。因此结果描述的是这些工具本身的书面内容，而非法律合规性。条目覆盖率存在差异，执行阶段故障特征在各生成器间保持稳定，两个历史阶段在 66%–69% 的故障-套件对上意见一致。对当前模型美国保险任务的复测发现阶段分歧超过重复执行变异，但阶段一致性 .536 低于合并随机水平 .549，未通过 V3 的下不等式检验。由一名专家进行的盲评支持设计阶段的评判协议（κ=.72，95% 区间 [.52,.88]）；40 个当前模型执行探针给出 κ=.75。工具、审计和可复用代码均已发布。
translation.brief: 解决企业级 AI 智能体评估中测试套件可靠性与参考规则可信度难以验证的问题，提出包含来源引用清单、故障语料库和两阶段故障注入评测工具的测量框架 REGATTA。

papers.title: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
papers.abstract: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark containing 64,729 session trajectories from 11,010 users, spanning 566,102 items and 13 action types. UserArena pairs these trajectories with an interactive environment and supports offline validation against outcomes from a controlled production A/B test, enabling five-level evaluation from output validity and local decisions to sequential behavior, personalization, and outcomes. To improve simulator fidelity over these long-horizon interactions, we further propose On-Policy Trajectory Distillation (OPTD), which uses trajectory-level intent to provide dense teacher targets on student-generated rollouts. Experiments show that OPTD achieves the strongest overall fidelity among the evaluated simulators under UserArena's evaluation protocol and most closely reproduces the production policy effect in offline simulation.

translation.title: UserArena：面向长时程购物智能体的交互式用户模拟基准
translation.abstract: 智能体推荐通过一系列依赖上下文的决策来追求购物者目标。开发与评估这类策略需要忠实的推荐世界模型，既能刻画交互式购物环境，也能刻画用户在长时交互中的行为响应。现有资源很少提供长时程、细粒度的真实用户轨迹，也难以支持轨迹级评估以及与生产 A/B 结果的离线验证。我们提出 UserArena，一个真实电商交互基准，包含来自 11,010 名用户的 64,729 条会话轨迹，涵盖 566,102 个商品和 13 种动作类型。UserArena 将这些轨迹与交互环境配对，并支持与受控生产 A/B 实验结果的离线验证，实现从输出有效性、局部决策到序列行为、个性化和结果的五级评估。为提升模拟器在长时程交互中的保真度，我们进一步提出在线策略轨迹蒸馏，利用轨迹级意图在学生生成的 rollout 上提供密集的教师目标。实验表明，在 UserArena 的评估协议下，OPTD 在所评估的模拟器中取得最强的整体保真度，并在离线模拟中最接近地复现了生产策略效果。
translation.brief: 解决长时程购物智能体缺乏真实交互用户模拟基准的问题，构建大规模真实电商轨迹基准 UserArena，并提出在线策略轨迹蒸馏（OPTD）提升模拟器保真度。

papers.title: ReflectPO: Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: With external tools, large language models (LLMs) can tackle complex tasks through sustained environmental interaction. LLM-based agents are therefore increasingly used to tackle complex long-horizon tasks in real-world environments. However, these tasks involve sequential, interdependent decisions and changes in environmental states. Early execution errors affect subsequent interaction histories and environmental states, and their effects accumulate along the decision chain. To address this challenge, we propose Reflection-Guided Policy Optimization (ReflectPO), a reinforcement learning framework for autonomous error recovery in long-horizon tasks. ReflectPO comprises two core components. The first is Reflection-Guided Sampling. We use branch differences and repeated visits in interaction trajectories to construct hints for error recovery. The second is Tree-Structured Credit Assignment. We organize sampled trajectories into trees and assign action-level credit using parent--child reward differences and recovery gains. Experiments over two long-horizon tool-use benchmarks show that ReflectPO outperforms multiple existing baselines in most domains. It also achieves the best overall performance on average. Further analyses show that ReflectPO effectively improves agents' ability to recognize their own deviations, recover from erroneous states, and continue making progress toward task completion.

translation.title: ReflectPO：面向长时程 LLM 智能体的反思引导策略优化
translation.abstract: 借助外部工具，大语言模型可以通过持续的环境交互解决复杂任务。因此基于 LLM 的智能体越来越多地被用于处理真实环境中的复杂长时程任务。然而，这些任务涉及序列化、相互依赖的决策和环境状态变化。早期执行错误会影响后续的交互历史和环境状态，其影响沿决策链不断累积。为应对这一挑战，我们提出反思引导策略优化，这是一个面向长时程任务中自主错误恢复的强化学习框架。ReflectPO 包含两个核心组件。第一是反思引导采样，利用交互轨迹中的分支差异和重复访问来构造错误恢复提示。第二是树结构信用分配，将采样轨迹组织成树，并利用父子奖励差和恢复增益进行动作级信用分配。在两个长时程工具使用基准上的实验表明，ReflectPO 在大多数领域优于多个现有基线，并取得最佳平均整体性能。进一步分析显示，ReflectPO 有效提升了智能体识别自身偏差、从错误状态恢复并继续推进任务完成的能力。
translation.brief: 解决长时程 LLM 智能体任务中早期错误的累积影响问题，提出结合反思引导采样与树结构信用分配的强化学习框架 ReflectPO 以实现自主错误恢复。

papers.title: PAIR: Preference-Aligned Intent Retrieval for Premium People Recommendation at LinkedIn
papers.abstract: General-purpose embeddings trained on profile similarity often misrank candidates in professional networks, where relevance is inherently complementary rather than symmetric. For example, job seekers usually engage with recruiters rather than peers with similar credentials. Current user recommendation systems are often built on profile similarity or social signals such as shared connections, which are effective in friend-oriented social networks where users tend to connect with similar people or within existing social circles. However, this does not hold in professional platforms like LinkedIn, where interactions are often goal-driven and cross-role interactions, requiring matching based on complementary intents rather than similarity or social proximity. In this paper, we propose Preference-Aligned Intent Retrieval, a retrieval framework that is designed to model user intent preference instead of profile similarity. Our approach is inspired by the preference-learning perspective of Direct Preference Optimization, but instantiates preference learning as an exposure-conditioned multi-negative contrastive objective over embeddings. This formulation simplifies training and scales efficiently to large candidate sets without requiring an explicit reference model. Furthermore, we incorporate user interaction history by aggregating click histories with positional encoding to capture temporal order, which enables constant-cost updates of user representations over a fixed history window, allowing new interactions to be incorporated without re-encoding history. As a result, personalization can be updated efficiently using lightweight CPU operations without repeated LLM inference during serving. We evaluate PAIR on LinkedIn's Premium retrieval task. A 0.6B parameter model achieves a MAR@100 of 0.45.

translation.title: PAIR：LinkedIn 高级会员人群推荐中的偏好对齐意图检索
translation.abstract: 基于画像相似性训练的通用嵌入在专业网络中常常错误排序候选者，因为这类场景中的相关性本质上是互补而非对称的。例如，求职者通常与招聘人员互动，而非与资历相似的同行互动。当前的用户推荐系统往往建立在画像相似性或共享连接等社交信号之上，这在以朋友为导向的社交网络中有效，因为用户倾向于与相似的人或在现有社交圈内建立联系。然而，在 LinkedIn 这样的专业平台上并不成立，其交互往往是目标驱动和跨角色的，需要基于互补意图而非相似性或社交接近度进行匹配。本文提出偏好对齐意图检索，一个旨在建模用户意图偏好而非画像相似性的检索框架。我们的方法受 Direct Preference Optimization 的偏好学习视角启发，但将偏好学习实例化为嵌入上的曝光条件化多负例对比目标。这一形式简化了训练，并能高效扩展到大规模候选集，无需显式参考模型。此外，我们通过带位置编码的点击历史聚合来纳入用户交互历史以捕捉时间顺序，从而支持在固定历史窗口上以常数代价更新用户表示，使新交互无需重新编码历史即可纳入。因此在服务过程中，个性化可通过轻量级 CPU 操作高效更新，而无需反复进行 LLM 推理。我们在 LinkedIn 的 Premium 检索任务上评估 PAIR，一个 0.6B 参数模型取得了 MAR@100 为 0.45 的结果。
translation.brief: 解决专业社交网络中基于画像相似性的检索无法刻画互补意图的问题，提出基于曝光条件化多负例对比目标的偏好学习检索框架 PAIR，并支持高效的个性化更新。

papers.title: Metacognitive Scaffolds Create Productive Friction for AI-Assisted Knowledge Work
papers.abstract: Generative AI imposes new metacognitive demands on knowledge workers as their work shifts from production to planning, evaluation, and orchestration. In a randomized, between-subjects experiment on AI-assisted writing (297 workers, 594 essays), we test dynamically-generated metacognitive scaffolds supporting goal specification and task decomposition. We find that scaffolds improve writing quality, with this boost persisting in short-lag transfer when scaffolds are removed. We also find evidence of improved topic recall three days later. These effects are consistent with observed changes in how people learn to prompt AI systems after exposure to scaffolding. However, scaffolded participants rate the AI as less helpful and more cognitively demanding even as they perform better, suggesting that subjective ease can understate the value of support. Our findings make the case for metacognitive scaffolds in AI-assisted knowledge work, revealing a productive friction worth designing for as workers increasingly delegate work to agentic AI.

translation.title: 元认知脚手架为AI辅助知识工作创造生产性摩擦
translation.abstract: 生成式AI使知识工作者的工作重心转向规划、评估与编排，带来了新的元认知需求。在一项关于AI辅助写作的随机被试间实验（297名工作者、594篇作文）中，我们测试了动态生成的元认知脚手架，用于支持目标设定与任务分解。我们发现脚手架能提升写作质量，且在移除脚手架后的短延迟迁移中这一提升仍然持续。我们还发现三天后主题回忆能力有所改善的证据。这些效应与人们在接触脚手架后学习如何向AI系统提问的观察到的变化相一致。然而，使用脚手架的被试尽管表现更好，却认为AI帮助较小、认知负担更重，这表明主观易用性可能低估了支持的价值。我们的发现为AI辅助知识工作中的元认知脚手架提供了依据，揭示了一种值得设计的生产性摩擦，因为工作者越来越多地将工作委托给agentic AI。
translation.brief: 针对AI辅助写作中元认知需求上升的问题，通过随机实验测试动态生成的元认知脚手架（支持目标设定与任务分解）对写作质量与学习迁移的影响。

papers.title: Tracing Hallucinations in LLM Reasoning for UML Class Diagram Generation: An Empirical Taxonomy and Mitigation Study
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate UML class diagrams from natural language requirements, but hallucinations may compromise the correctness and completeness of the resulting diagrams. Existing evaluations mostly assess the final diagram, without examining the intermediate traces of reasoning-capable LLMs, which can reveal where these hallucinations arise. We develop an empirical taxonomy of eleven hallucination sub-types organised into three dimensions: Prompt Faithfulness (deviations between requirements and reasoning), Code Faithfulness (discrepancies between reasoning and generated PlantUML code), and Reasoning Quality (problems within the reasoning). The taxonomy was derived from 60 manually annotated DeepSeek-R1 traces, applied to 120 further DeepSeek-R1 traces through a dual-LLM annotation pipeline, and examined on 20 DeepSeek-V4-Pro traces. Code Faithfulness was the most frequent dimension for DeepSeek-R1 in both datasets, whereas Prompt Faithfulness dominated for DeepSeek-V4-Pro, suggesting model-dependent failure patterns. In the manually annotated traces, reasoning-trace length showed no significant monotonic association with hallucination frequency, whereas requirement complexity was negatively associated with it, particularly for Prompt Faithfulness errors. In a mitigation experiment on 13 Golden UML ModelSet cases with three Qwen3-based models, adding Prompt Faithfulness and Reasoning Quality constraints to the generation prompt raised the pooled mean F1 score by 4.0 percentage points, whereas a post-hoc Code Faithfulness review provided no consistent further benefit. Relationship modelling remained the lowest-scoring element throughout. These results suggest that localising hallucinations within the generation process can inform targeted, prompt-based mitigation. Whether these findings generalise beyond the DeepSeek and Qwen3 model families remains to be tested.

translation.title: 追踪LLM在UML类图生成推理中的幻觉：实证分类体系与缓解研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以从自然语言需求生成UML类图，但幻觉可能损害生成图的正确性与完整性。现有评估大多只评估最终图，而未考察具备推理能力的LLM的中间推理轨迹，而这些轨迹可以揭示幻觉产生于何处。我们构建了一个包含十一种幻觉子类型、分为三个维度的实证分类体系：Prompt Faithfulness（需求与推理之间的偏差）、Code Faithfulness（推理与生成的PlantUML代码之间的差异）和Reasoning Quality（推理内部的问题）。该分类体系源自60条人工标注的DeepSeek-R1轨迹，通过双LLM标注流水线应用于另外120条DeepSeek-R1轨迹，并在20条DeepSeek-V4-Pro轨迹上进行检验。在两个数据集中，Code Faithfulness是DeepSeek-R1最频繁的维度，而Prompt Faithfulness在DeepSeek-V4-Pro中占主导，表明失败模式依赖于具体模型。在人工标注的轨迹中，推理轨迹长度与幻觉频率无显著单调关联，而需求复杂度与幻觉频率呈负相关，尤其是Prompt Faithfulness类错误。在一项使用三个基于Qwen3的模型、针对13个Golden UML ModelSet案例的缓解实验中，在生成提示中加入Prompt Faithfulness和Reasoning Quality约束使合并平均F1分数提高了4.0个百分点，而事后Code Faithfulness审查未带来一致的进一步收益。关系建模始终是得分最低的部分。这些结果表明，在生成过程中定位幻觉可以指导有针对性的、基于提示的缓解。这些发现能否推广到DeepSeek和Qwen3模型族之外仍有待检验。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成UML类图中的幻觉问题，通过分析推理轨迹构建三维度幻觉分类体系，并据此设计基于提示的针对性缓解方法。

papers.title: RetiJev: Fast and Source-Grounded Ophthalmic Decision Models
papers.abstract: Ophthalmic clinical decision support requires fast, accurate, and privacy-preserving inference, yet autoregressive large language models (LLMs) incur substantial latency and computational overhead for decisions among predefined actions. We therefore investigate a decision-oriented alternative to generative reasoning. Specifically, we first introduce RetiJev-Data, a source-grounded ophthalmology corpus comprising 78,158 clinical-decision and diagnosis questions derived from articles in PubMed Central and a MeSH vocabulary covering 531 eye diseases, and 50,074 guideline-grading questions spanning 11 grading systems, along with a 24,662-question evaluation benchmark. Based on this, we develop RetiJev, a family of 0.8B-9B decision models that directly score candidate answers without autoregressive decoding. Across all model sizes, RetiJev outperforms both a 27B LLM and the commercial Jev 1.13 decision model on guideline grading by 10.4-23.0 points. RetiJev-9B further achieves the highest accuracy on clinical decisions, improving over both baselines by 5.4-6.5 points while matching them on diagnosis. It answers a case in 158 ms on one GPU, 3.5x faster than LLM generation and 470x faster than reasoning. Models are released at https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev.

translation.title: RetiJev：快速且具备来源依据的眼科决策模型
translation.abstract: 眼科临床决策支持需要快速、准确且保护隐私的推理，然而自回归大语言模型（LLM）在从预定义动作中做决策时会产生显著的延迟和计算开销。因此我们研究一种面向决策的生成式推理替代方案。具体而言，我们首先介绍RetiJev-Data，一个具备来源依据的眼科语料库，包含从PubMed Central文章派生的78,158道临床决策与诊断题目、覆盖531种眼病的MeSH词汇表，以及涵盖11种分级系统的50,074道指南分级题目，并附带一个24,662道题目的评估基准。基于此，我们开发了RetiJev，一系列0.8B-9B的决策模型，无需自回归解码即可直接对候选答案打分。在所有模型规模上，RetiJev在指南分级上超越27B LLM和商业Jev 1.13决策模型10.4-23.0分。RetiJev-9B还在临床决策上取得最高准确率，比两个基线提升5.4-6.5分，同时在诊断上与它们持平。它在单块GPU上158毫秒即可回答一个病例，比LLM生成快3.5倍，比推理快470倍。模型已在https://github.com/Awenbocc/RetiJev发布。
translation.brief: 针对自回归LLM在眼科临床决策中延迟高、开销大的问题，构建来源依据的眼科语料库并训练直接对候选答案打分的非自回归决策模型。

papers.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
papers.abstract: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.

translation.title: IQuest-Q1：推进Agentic CLI系统的基础能力
translation.abstract: 我们提出IQuest-Q1，一个总参数量320B（激活15B）的稀疏Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）agentic基础模型。IQuest-Q1通过三阶段流程开发：（1）稳定高效的预训练，结合Stable SplitNorm、Muon和muP，并采用两阶段课程，其第二阶段增加代码数据配比，在安全与最优学习率之间保持较宽的稳定裕度；（2）精细的中期训练，跨领域和格式扩展数据配比并逐步扩展上下文；（3）多脚手架多版本后训练，结合SFT、领域专用RL和MOPD，跨多种脚手架整合互补的训练信号并强化agentic编码能力。此外，模型合并结合来自不同阶段的不同专家和检查点，同时缓解其参数更新之间的冲突。最终的IQuest-Q1在编码和通用任务上均展现出能力。我们将IQuest-Q1作为开源模型发布，以支持社区的研究与开发。
translation.brief: 针对agentic CLI系统基础模型能力不足的问题，通过三阶段训练流程（稳定预训练、精细中期训练、多脚手架后训练）与模型合并构建稀疏MoE基础模型。

papers.title: ReDence: A Hybrid Agentic and Decision-Model Framework for Rapid, Evidence-Grounded Detection of Modern Social Engineering Scams
papers.abstract: Detecting online social engineering (SE) scams often requires examining website workflows, verifying claims against external sources, and connecting evidence across multiple pages. Existing detectors provide limited support for these investigations, leaving analysts to manually gather and validate evidence, which inevitably delays detection and subsequent takedown of these attacks. To address this gap, we present ReDence, an open-source hybrid framework for adaptive, evidence-grounded detection across diverse SE scam categories. ReDence combines two locally hosted models with complementary responsibilities: a fine-tuned multimodal agentic Investigator (Qwen3.5-4B) that performs investigative planning, evidence interpretation, and reporting, and a specialized Decider (Tev1) that handles binary and multiple-choice tasks, including browser-action selection, evidence assessment, and decisions about whether to continue an investigation. By delegating discrete decisions to a specialized model, ReDence reduces reliance on lengthy language-model responses, while preserving the reasoning capabilities required for complex investigations. Our evaluation demonstrates that ReDence achieves 96\% accuracy in detecting scams across twelve SE scam categories, substantially outperforming existing detectors while being at least four times faster than comparable agentic models without compromising investigative depth. ReDence also produces structured, evidence-grounded reports that document investigative actions, supporting and contradictory evidence, and collected artifacts, which allow analysts to independently audit detection decisions and utilize the collected evidence to support subsequent mitigation and takedown efforts.

translation.title: ReDence：用于快速、有证据依据地检测现代社工诈骗的混合Agentic与决策模型框架
translation.abstract: 检测在线社会工程（SE）诈骗通常需要检查网站工作流程、对照外部来源核实声明，并跨多个页面关联证据。现有检测器对这些调查的支持有限，使分析人员不得不手动收集和验证证据，这不可避免地延迟了这些攻击的检测和后续处置。为填补这一空白，我们提出ReDence，一个开源的混合框架，用于跨多种SE诈骗类别的自适应、有证据依据的检测。ReDence结合两个本地托管的、职责互补的模型：一个微调的多模态agentic Investigator（Qwen3.5-4B），负责调查规划、证据解释和报告；一个专用的Decider（Tev1），处理二元和多项选择任务，包括浏览器动作选择、证据评估以及是否继续调查的决策。通过将离散决策委托给专用模型，ReDence减少了对冗长语言模型响应的依赖，同时保留了复杂调查所需的推理能力。我们的评估表明，ReDence在检测十二类SE诈骗时达到96%的准确率，大幅超越现有检测器，同时比同类agentic模型至少快四倍且不牺牲调查深度。ReDence还生成结构化、有证据依据的报告，记录调查动作、支持与矛盾证据以及收集的工件，使分析人员能够独立审计检测决策，并利用收集的证据支持后续的缓解与处置工作。
translation.brief: 针对在线社工诈骗检测中证据收集与验证依赖人工的问题，提出混合框架，由多模态agentic Investigator负责调查推理、专用Decider模型处理离散决策。

papers.title: LAST-V2X: Language-Driven Adaptive Scenario Synthesis and Testing for Communication-Induced Failures in V2X Safety Applications
papers.abstract: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication enables connected vehicles to make safety-critical decisions, but delayed, missing, or incorrect information can compromise driving safety. Systematically testing such failures is challenging because traffic interactions, communication conditions, and application responses must be jointly configured to produce meaningful scenarios. This paper presents LAST-V2X, a language-driven, adaptive framework for automated scenario synthesis and safety testing of V2X applications. LAST-V2X leverages large language models (LLMs) to translate natural-language test descriptions into executable scenarios grounded in roadway geometry, V2X communication semantics, and vehicle behavior. The framework integrates physical traffic simulation with spatially aware communication modeling and message-level fault injection to evaluate how information degradation affects vehicle decisions. To establish whether an observed safety failure is caused by communication rather than the underlying traffic conditions, LAST-V2X employs matched executions under degraded and ground-truth information. Furthermore, an execution-guided refinement mechanism combines parameter search and LLM self-reflection to identify ineffective test configurations, improve scenario effectiveness, and produce minimal reproducible failure cases. Experiments across diverse CARLA environments and V2X safety applications demonstrate the framework's ability to generate reliable scenarios, distinguish communication-induced failures from unrelated safety violations, and substantially improve failure discovery through adaptive refinement. These results establish LAST-V2X as a systematic approach to language-driven, causally verified, and adaptive safety testing for connected vehicle systems.

translation.title: LAST-V2X：面向V2X安全应用中通信诱发故障的语言驱动自适应场景合成与测试
translation.abstract: 车联网（V2X）通信使联网车辆能够做出安全关键决策，但延迟、丢失或错误的信息可能危及驾驶安全。系统性测试此类故障具有挑战性，因为必须联合配置交通交互、通信条件和应用响应才能产生有意义的场景。本文提出LAST-V2X，一个语言驱动的自适应框架，用于V2X应用的自动化场景合成与安全测试。LAST-V2X利用大语言模型（LLM）将自然语言测试描述转化为可执行场景，这些场景基于道路几何、V2X通信语义和车辆行为。该框架将物理交通仿真与空间感知的通信建模和消息级故障注入相结合，以评估信息退化如何影响车辆决策。为确定观察到的安全故障是由通信而非底层交通条件引起的，LAST-V2X在退化信息和真实信息下采用匹配执行。此外，一种执行引导的细化机制结合参数搜索和LLM自我反思，识别无效的测试配置，提高场景有效性，并产生最小可复现的故障案例。在多种CARLA环境和V2X安全应用上的实验表明，该框架能够生成可靠场景，区分通信诱发的故障与无关的安全违规，并通过自适应细化显著提升故障发现能力。这些结果确立了LAST-V2X作为联网车辆系统语言驱动、因果验证和自适应安全测试的系统性方法。
translation.brief: 针对V2X通信故障难以系统测试的问题，提出利用LLM将自然语言描述转化为可执行场景，并结合通信建模、故障注入与匹配执行进行因果验证和自适应细化的测试框架。

papers.title: A Reality Check of Inference-Time Context Augmentation Methods
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often fail to utilise the context given in the input, resulting in hallucinations or a fallback to parametric knowledge. Context augmentation methods aim to improve model performance by modifying the input, from inserting filler tokens that add computational time to adding relevant content such as elaboration of a context during inference. However, these methods have been evaluated in isolation and only by their performance gains, leaving it unclear how they compare and whether they reliably improve performance. In this paper, we present an evaluation framework spanning five methods that differ in how informative the inserted content is and apply them at the sentence level across seven models spanning multiple sizes on three datasets. We find that accuracy gains are not always genuine improvements but undirected perturbations: the methods correct some predictions while breaking others, particularly when the inserted text allows only for more computational time. Our analysis reveals that methods that bring no additional content primarily change model predictions near the decision boundary. Our findings highlight the need to evaluate the reliability of the accuracy gains before adopting them in practice.

translation.title: 推理时上下文增强方法的现实检验
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）常常未能利用输入中给出的上下文，导致幻觉或退回到参数化知识。上下文增强方法旨在通过修改输入来提升模型性能，从插入增加计算时间的填充token，到在推理时添加相关内容（如对上下文的详细阐述）。然而，这些方法此前都是被孤立评估的，且仅以性能增益为标准，导致它们之间如何比较以及是否可靠地提升性能尚不清楚。本文提出一个涵盖五种方法的评估框架，这些方法在插入内容的信息量上有所不同，并在三个数据集上对七个不同规模的模型在句子层面应用这些方法。我们发现准确率提升并不总是真正的改进，而是无方向的扰动：这些方法在纠正某些预测的同时破坏了其他预测，尤其是当插入的文本仅提供更多计算时间时。我们的分析揭示，不带来额外内容的方法主要改变模型在决策边界附近的预测。我们的发现强调，在实践中采用这些方法之前，需要评估其准确率增益的可靠性。
translation.brief: 针对上下文增强方法缺乏统一比较和可靠性验证的问题，构建跨五种方法、七个模型、三个数据集的评估框架，发现其准确率增益多为无方向的扰动而非真正改进。

papers.title: ColaBench: Evaluating Memory-Guided Knowledge Acquisition in Personal Agents
papers.abstract: Personal agents need to draw on long-term interaction history to retrieve and apply external knowledge suited to a user's current request. Even an answer grounded in relevant documents can be unsuitable when it overlooks the user's circumstances. This creates two connected challenges: using historical conditions to identify the knowledge needed for a new request, and applying that knowledge to the user's situation. Existing benchmarks advance memory recall, personalized retrieval, and memory-guided action, while the joint evaluation of these two challenges remains underexplored. We introduce ColaBench, a synthetic benchmark in health and daily living, with 349 tasks across 10 Profiles and a knowledge base of 13,033 documents. Its Evidence Graph connects personal conditions to their disclosures across public interaction sessions, records prior document exposure, and links answer requirements to personal and newly acquired document evidence. We also introduce MemKB, which uses state summaries to inform queries and rule application, and memory-document links to retrieve knowledge associated with the user's history. MemKB achieves 86.25% Accuracy with an average of 4.07 interaction rounds per task. Task-level analysis finds larger gains on tasks integrating information across multiple historical Facts; error analysis further identifies unsupported personal assumptions and rule misapplication as obstacles to using retrieved evidence. ColaBench provides traceable tasks and an evaluation framework for studying how memory guides knowledge acquisition and rule application.

translation.title: ColaBench：评估个人智能体中记忆引导的知识获取
translation.abstract: 个人智能体需要利用长期交互历史来检索并应用适合用户当前请求的外部知识。即使答案基于相关文档，如果忽视了用户的具体情况，也可能不合适。这带来两个相互关联的挑战：利用历史条件识别新请求所需的知识，以及将该知识应用于用户的情况。现有基准推进了记忆召回、个性化检索和记忆引导行动，而对这两个挑战的联合评估仍待探索。我们提出ColaBench，一个健康与日常生活领域的合成基准，包含跨10个Profile的349个任务和13,033篇文档的知识库。其证据图（Evidence Graph）将个人状况与其在公开交互会话中的披露相连接，记录先前的文档接触，并将答案要求与个人及新获取的文档证据相链接。我们还提出MemKB，它使用状态摘要来指导查询和规则应用，并利用记忆-文档链接检索与用户历史相关联的知识。MemKB达到86.25%的准确率，平均每个任务4.07轮交互。任务级分析发现，在整合多个历史事实信息的任务上收益更大；错误分析进一步识别出无依据的个人假设和规则误用是使用检索证据的障碍。ColaBench为研究记忆如何引导知识获取和规则应用提供了可追溯的任务和评估框架。
translation.brief: 针对个人智能体中记忆引导的知识识别与应用缺乏联合评估的问题，构建包含证据图的健康与日常生活合成基准ColaBench，并提出基于状态摘要和记忆-文档链接的MemKB方法。

papers.title: Truthful by Omission: Click Thinning for LLM-Native Advertising
papers.abstract: Generative AI assistants are becoming an advertising medium, embedding sponsored content in their answers. This setting departs from classical position auctions in two ways: an ad's click-through rate depends on the passage that hosts it, and because users stop at their first click, earlier ads take clicks from later ones. This competition for clicks makes truthfulness delicate: a higher bid can reshape the allocation and put a competitor ahead of the bidder, reducing the bidder's clicks. Existing mechanisms either attain a constant fraction of the optimal welfare (advertisers' total click value) but are not known to be truthful, or are truthful but their welfare guarantee degrades as the number of passages grows. We achieve both even when the answer and its editorial order are fixed before bidding. Assuming each ad's click-through rate when reached is known and unaffected by omitting other ads, we give a computationally efficient mechanism that is truthful in expectation and attains at least half the optimal welfare under free reordering. Our key idea, click thinning, omits ads at random, showing earlier ads less often so that each ad's overall click probability no longer depends on the order of the ads. Welfare maximization then reduces to a tractable matching problem, and solving it exactly with VCG-style payments makes truthful bidding optimal in expectation. Characterizing the click probabilities that omission can achieve sharpens the approximation factor from $2$ to $2-(1-\delta)^{K-1}$ when at most $K$ ads are shown and each click-through rate is at most $\delta$. This factor is the best possible for any order-preserving rule, even one that ignores incentives and computation, so truthfulness and computational efficiency incur no additional worst-case loss.

translation.title: 通过省略实现真实性：面向LLM原生广告的点击稀疏化
translation.abstract: 生成式AI助手正在成为一种广告媒介，在其回答中嵌入赞助内容。这一设定在两个方面不同于经典的位置拍卖：广告的点击率取决于承载它的段落，且由于用户在首次点击后即停止，靠前的广告会夺走靠后广告的点击。这种对点击的竞争使真实性变得微妙：更高的出价可能重塑分配，使竞争对手排在出价者之前，从而减少出价者的点击。现有机制要么获得最优福利（广告商总点击价值）的常数比例但未知是否真实，要么是真实的但福利保证随段落数量增长而退化。即使在出价前回答及其编辑顺序已固定的情况下，我们也同时实现了两者。假设每个广告在被触达时的点击率已知且不受省略其他广告的影响，我们给出一个计算高效的机制，在期望意义上真实，并在自由重排序下达到至少一半的最优福利。我们的核心思想——点击稀疏化（click thinning）——随机省略广告，减少靠前广告的展示频率，使每个广告的总体点击概率不再依赖于广告的顺序。福利最大化由此简化为一个可解的匹配问题，用VCG式支付精确求解它使真实出价在期望上最优。刻画省略所能实现的点击概率，将近似因子从$2$锐化为$2-(1-\delta)^{K-1}$（当最多展示$K$个广告且每个点击率至多为$\delta$时）。该因子对任何保序规则都是最优的，即使是忽略激励和计算的规则，因此真实性和计算效率不会带来额外的最坏情况损失。
translation.brief: 针对LLM原生广告中点击竞争导致拍卖机制难以兼顾真实性与福利保证的问题，提出点击稀疏化机制，通过随机省略广告使点击概率与顺序无关，从而将福利最大化归约为可解的匹配问题。

papers.title: SecLog-Bench: A Scalable Benchmark for Cybersecurity Log Reasoning with Scaffolded Evidence
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for cybersecurity, leading to growing interest in LLM-based automated cybersecurity log analysis. However, current datasets (1) are limited in scale; (2) rely mainly on single-source evidence; and (3) have only binary or multi-class attack labels, without dense annotations of the reasoning process. To address these limitations, SecLog-Bench has three key features. First, we build an extensible simulation platform that covers 29 attack scenarios, supports repeated execution and the integration of new scenarios, and enables scalable generation of cybersecurity logs with attack-stage labels. Second, we use multi-source logs, including audit logs, application logs, and network traffic, to jointly analyze cyber attacks. Third, we annotate each sample with the essential context for cybersecurity log reasoning and a structured step-by-step evidence chain. We evaluate eight mainstream LLMs on this benchmark for post-detection attack-progress reasoning. Results show that, when provided with scaffolded evidence, current LLMs exhibit modest capability in attack-progress reasoning, with the best model achieving only 44.44% accuracy and 45.07% Macro-F1. Their reasoning remains unreliable; i.e., the highest Stage Reasoning F1 (SRF1) score is only 54.87%. Moreover, even correct predictions may be accompanied by flawed reasoning, and reasoning quality is often misaligned with prediction accuracy.

translation.title: SecLog-Bench：一个具有脚手架式证据的可扩展网络安全日志推理基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在网络安全方面展现出强大潜力，使得基于LLM的自动化网络安全日志分析受到越来越多的关注。然而，当前数据集（1）规模有限；（2）主要依赖单一来源证据；（3）仅有二分类或多分类攻击标签，缺乏对推理过程的密集标注。为解决这些局限，SecLog-Bench具有三个关键特性。首先，我们构建了一个可扩展的仿真平台，涵盖29个攻击场景，支持重复执行和新场景的集成，并能可扩展地生成带有攻击阶段标签的网络安全日志。其次，我们使用多源日志，包括审计日志、应用日志和网络流量，来联合分析网络攻击。第三，我们为每个样本标注网络安全日志推理所需的关键上下文和结构化的逐步证据链。我们在该基准上评估八个主流LLM的检测后攻击进展推理能力。结果表明，在提供脚手架式证据的情况下，当前LLM在攻击进展推理方面能力有限，最佳模型仅达到44.44%的准确率和45.07%的Macro-F1。它们的推理仍不可靠，即最高的阶段推理F1（SRF1）分数仅为54.87%。此外，即使预测正确也可能伴随有缺陷的推理，且推理质量常与预测准确率不一致。
translation.brief: 针对现有网络安全日志数据集规模小、证据单一且缺乏推理过程标注的问题，构建可扩展仿真平台生成多源日志并标注结构化证据链，形成SecLog-Bench基准以评估LLM的攻击进展推理能力。

papers.title: Matching Tasks to Agents: Mechanism Design for Multi-Agent Contracts
papers.abstract: We study task assignment under adverse selection and moral hazard. In the single-task setting, agents privately know their types, which determine their success probabilities and effort costs. Based on the agents' reported types, the principal selects an agent to perform the task and offers a success-contingent payment. Although optimal Bayesian contract design is generally computationally intractable and Myerson's characterization does not directly extend to settings with hidden actions and multidimensional private information, we show that the single-task problem admits a simple Myerson-style characterization. Our key insight is that incentive constraints depend only on the ratio between effort cost and success probability. We characterize an optimal mechanism and show that it can be computed in polynomial time. We also establish a tight $\Theta(1/(NK))$ worst-case bound on the ratio between the optimal profit and the full-information benchmark, where $N$ is the number of agents and $K$ is the number of types per agent. We then extend our analysis to multiple tasks, showing that an optimal mechanism may not exist. Nevertheless, for a constant number of agents, we provide a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the supremum profit.

translation.title: 任务与智能体匹配：多智能体合同的机制设计
translation.abstract: 我们研究逆向选择与道德风险下的任务分配问题。在单任务设定中，智能体私有地知道自己的类型，类型决定其成功概率和努力成本。委托人根据智能体报告的类型选择一个智能体执行任务，并提供与成功与否挂钩的报酬。尽管最优贝叶斯合同设计通常是计算上不可解的，且 Myerson 的刻画无法直接推广到含隐藏动作和多维私有信息的设定，我们证明单任务问题存在一个简单的 Myerson 式刻画。我们的关键洞察是：激励约束仅取决于努力成本与成功概率之比。我们刻画了最优机制，并证明其可在多项式时间内计算。我们还建立了最优利润与完全信息基准之比的紧致最坏情况界 Θ(1/(NK))，其中 N 为智能体数量，K 为每个智能体的类型数。随后我们将分析扩展到多任务情形，证明最优机制可能不存在。尽管如此，对于常数数量的智能体，我们给出了针对上确界利润的多项式时间近似方案。
translation.brief: 研究逆向选择与道德风险下的任务分配机制设计，通过发现激励约束仅依赖努力成本与成功概率之比，给出单任务最优机制的 Myerson 式刻画与多项式时间算法，并扩展到多任务近似方案。

papers.title: Agri-SCHOLAR: Simulation-Grounded In-Season Rolling Advisories for Agricultural Crops Using LLM-Bounded Optimization
papers.abstract: Existing agricultural advisories to farmers suffer from several limitations: (a) remain largely expert-driven, (b) do not adequately account for in-season weather, and (c) do not scale to individual farms. In this paper, our objective is to close these gaps by developing Agri-SCHOLAR (Simulation-Grounded Crop Harvest Optimization with LLM-Guided In-Season Advisory Rollouts). Agri-SCHOLAR is a rolling, in-season advisory framework that issues, at intervals of every few days or every week, a personalized advisory using the following information: soil and crop properties, observed weather to date, short-range forecast of weather, and a season extrapolation of weather based on historical analogs. The novelty and depth of Agri-SCHOLAR lies in each advisory being produced by a closed-loop system which couples multiple LLM agents with a powerful crop simulator (such as APSIM in our case). The simulator crucially serves as an evaluation oracle. In Agri-SCHOLAR, the LLM agents propose agronomically sound and feasible bounds on actionable parameters and an optimizer searches within those bounds against a multi-objective reward spanning yield, resource utilization, and economic feasibility. We conduct a detailed 11-year analysis of the maize crop in two selected locations of South Asia and show that Agri-SCHOLAR consistently outperforms the region's standard packages of practice and satisfactorily addresses the limitations of existing agricultural advisories.

translation.title: Agri-SCHOLAR：基于 LLM 有界优化的农作物生长季滚动模拟咨询系统
translation.abstract: 现有面向农民的农业咨询存在诸多局限：(a) 主要由专家驱动，(b) 未充分考虑生长季内的天气，(c) 无法扩展到单个农场。本文旨在通过开发 Agri-SCHOLAR（Simulation-Grounded Crop Harvest Optimization with LLM-Guided In-Season Advisory Rollouts）来弥补这些差距。Agri-SCHOLAR 是一个滚动式生长季咨询框架，每隔几天或每周发布一次个性化咨询，其依据包括：土壤和作物属性、迄今观测到的天气、短期天气预报，以及基于历史相似年份的天气季节外推。Agri-SCHOLAR 的新颖性和深度在于每条咨询由一个闭环系统生成，该系统将多个 LLM 智能体与强大的作物模拟器（如本文使用的 APSIM）耦合。模拟器关键地充当评估 oracle。在 Agri-SCHOLAR 中，LLM 智能体为可操作参数提出农艺上合理且可行的边界，优化器在这些边界内针对涵盖产量、资源利用和经济可行性的多目标奖励进行搜索。我们对南亚两个选定地点的玉米作物进行了详细的 11 年分析，结果表明 Agri-SCHOLAR 持续优于该地区的标准种植方案，并令人满意地解决了现有农业咨询的局限。
translation.brief: 针对现有农业咨询不个性化、不结合生长季天气的问题，提出将多个 LLM 智能体与 APSIM 作物模拟器闭环耦合的滚动咨询框架，由 LLM 设定参数边界、优化器在模拟器评估下搜索多目标最优方案。

papers.title: Mitigating Saliency Collapse: Robust Saliency-Aware Long-Text Image-Text Alignment
papers.abstract: Long-text image-text alignment is essential for fine-grained scene understanding, yet existing methods mainly focus on extending context length or improving local alignment. We identify an overlooked failure mode, saliency collapse, where models over-rely on text that features visual prominence while underutilizing non-salient context. Consequently, retrieval performance degrades sharply when salient content is reduced, despite that the non-salient context remains informative. To address this, we propose RoSA, a saliency-aware finetuning framework that decomposes image-text pairs into complementary salient and contextual views, enabling joint learning of prominent and contextual semantics. We propose a modality-independent decomposition strategy to combine object-level visual saliency estimation with LLM-based text decomposition to bridge vision and language. We employ auxiliary objectives to explicitly align these views, ensuring robust representation with both salient and contextual features. RoSA greatly improves long-text retrieval and demonstrates strong robustness to saliency collapse across benchmarks. Moreover, our auxiliary objectives are plug-and-play, bringing consistent gains to existing tuning methods. Code and checkpoints are available at: https://github.com/intelligolabs/RoSA

translation.title: 缓解显著性坍塌：鲁棒的显著性感知长文本图文对齐
translation.abstract: 长文本图文对齐对细粒度场景理解至关重要，但现有方法主要关注扩展上下文长度或改进局部对齐。我们发现了一种被忽视的失败模式——显著性坍塌（saliency collapse），即模型过度依赖具有视觉显著性的文本，而未充分利用非显著上下文。因此，当显著内容被削减时，检索性能急剧下降，尽管非显著上下文仍然包含丰富信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出 RoSA，一个显著性感知的微调框架，它将图文对分解为互补的显著视图和上下文视图，实现显著语义与上下文语义的联合学习。我们提出一种与模态无关的分解策略，将对象级视觉显著性估计与基于 LLM 的文本分解相结合，以桥接视觉与语言。我们采用辅助目标显式对齐这些视图，确保表示同时具备显著特征和上下文特征的鲁棒性。RoSA 大幅提升了长文本检索性能，并在多个基准上展现出对显著性坍塌的强鲁棒性。此外，我们的辅助目标即插即用，能为现有微调方法带来一致提升。代码和模型权重见：https://github.com/intelligolabs/RoSA
translation.brief: 针对长文本图文对齐中模型过度依赖显著文本的显著性坍塌问题，提出 RoSA 框架，将图文对分解为显著与上下文互补视图并用辅助目标联合对齐学习。

papers.title: Formal-Informal Mathematical Alignment through and beyond Human Annotations
papers.abstract: Formalized mathematics libraries such as Lean's \texttt{mathlib} provide machine-verifiable representations of mathematical knowledge, including definitions, theorems, and their relationships. If effectively connected to informal mathematical resources, formal mathematics could help uncover previously implicit links between mathematical concepts and improve access to existing formalizations. However, connections between informal and formal mathematics libraries are currently sparse and unsystematic. In this paper, we make first strides towards better formal integration. We construct a dataset linking informal statements from the Stacks Project to their formalizations in \texttt{mathlib} by exploiting expert annotations. We evaluate retrieval, LLM-based reranking, and LLM-assisted verification to discover new unannotated informal-to-formal links. To facilitate exploration and reuse of formalized knowledge, we integrated the newly discovered alignments into the MaRDI knowledge graph, enabling mathematicians to find formal counterparts to informal mathematical content. We discuss the difficulties and challenges in using LLMs for linking formal and informal mathematical content. All code and data necessary for reproducing this paper can be found at: https://github.com/AnkitSatpute/Formal-Informal-Mathematical-Alignment

translation.title: 通过及超越人工标注的形式化-非形式化数学对齐
translation.abstract: 以 Lean 的 mathlib 为代表的形式化数学库为数学知识（包括定义、定理及其关系）提供了机器可验证的表示。如果能与非形式化数学资源有效连接，形式化数学可以帮助揭示数学概念之间此前隐含的联系，并改善对现有形式化的访问。然而，非形式化与形式化数学库之间的连接目前稀疏且不成体系。本文朝着更好的形式化集成迈出了第一步。我们利用专家标注构建了一个数据集，将 Stacks Project 中的非形式化陈述与其在 mathlib 中的形式化关联起来。我们评估了检索、基于 LLM 的重排序以及 LLM 辅助验证，以发现新的未标注的非形式化到形式化链接。为便于形式化知识的探索与复用，我们将新发现的对齐集成到 MaRDI 知识图谱中，使数学家能够找到非形式化数学内容的形式化对应物。我们讨论了使用 LLM 连接形式化与非形式化数学内容的困难与挑战。复现本文所需的全部代码和数据见：https://github.com/AnkitSatpute/Formal-Informal-Mathematical-Alignment
translation.brief: 针对非形式化与形式化数学库之间连接稀疏的问题，利用专家标注构建 Stacks Project 与 mathlib 的对齐数据集，并用检索、LLM 重排序与验证发现新链接并集成到 MaRDI 知识图谱。

papers.title: AERIAL: Mission-Aware LLM Selection for Language-Driven UAV Control in Flying Networks
papers.abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in Flying Networks (FNs) increasingly require mechanisms to translate high-level natural language objectives into executable missions. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated the feasibility of language-driven UAV control, existing approaches typically rely on static model configurations and overlook mission-aware performance variability. This paper presents AERIAL, a benchmark-driven framework for adaptive LLM selection in hybrid edge-cloud UAV control. AERIAL separates systematic model benchmarking from mission execution, deriving empirical scenario-model mappings and applying them at runtime for mission-aware selection. Evaluation across 720 automated simulation runs spanning navigation, spatial reasoning, and algorithm invocation revealed significant performance variability depending on scenario-model pairing. A case study integrating AERIAL with a FNs placement algorithm further validated the framework's ability to interface with domain-specific optimization modules through natural language. These results validate the effectiveness of AERIAL's adaptive model selection in improving reliability and operational robustness for autonomous UAV control in FNs.

translation.title: AERIAL：面向飞行网络中语言驱动无人机控制的任务感知 LLM 选择
translation.abstract: 飞行网络（FNs）中的无人机（UAV）日益需要将高层自然语言目标转化为可执行任务的机制。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已证明语言驱动无人机控制的可行性，但现有方法通常依赖静态模型配置，忽视了任务感知的性能差异。本文提出 AERIAL，一个用于混合边云无人机控制中自适应 LLM 选择的基准驱动框架。AERIAL 将系统性的模型基准测试与任务执行分离，推导出经验性的场景-模型映射，并在运行时将其应用于任务感知的模型选择。在涵盖导航、空间推理和算法调用的 720 次自动化仿真运行中的评估显示，不同场景-模型配对之间存在显著的性能差异。一个将 AERIAL 与 FNs 部署算法相结合的案例研究进一步验证了该框架通过自然语言与领域特定优化模块对接的能力。这些结果验证了 AERIAL 自适应模型选择在提升 FNs 中自主无人机控制的可靠性与运行鲁棒性方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对语言驱动无人机控制中静态 LLM 配置忽视任务差异的问题，提出 AERIAL 框架，通过离线基准测试建立场景-模型映射并在运行时进行任务感知的自适应 LLM 选择。

papers.title: CANNBot-CAKE: Collaborative Agentic Kernel Evolution for Ascend NPU
papers.abstract: Efficient custom operators are essential for modern deep learning workloads, yet developing high-performance kernels for Ascend NPUs remains slow, expert-intensive, and difficult to automate. Although AI agents now approach expert performance on GPU kernel benchmarks, current models remain less capable of generating AscendC kernels for NPUs, potentially reflecting the relative scarcity of relevant training data. We thus present CAKE, a CANN-native system for deployable custom operators that combines adaptive multi-DSL routing, separate Generation and Evolution modes, and reviewed knowledge reuse through CAKE Book and a Self-Evolving Agent. On 53 CANN-Bench v1.1 operators on Ascend 950PR, CAKE's aggregated results achieve $100\%$ case pass rate on the standard set (1,060/1,060) and $98.28\%$ on the hidden set (4,167/4,240), with an overall mean score of 78.63 out of 100 and an average performance speedup of $1.334\times$ over the baseline. Evolution then pushes correct operators further: EngramGateFusion cuts aggregate device time by $46.6\%$ over 20 rounds and roughly halves the mean roofline gap. These results offer a practical path toward closing Ascend's AI-for-kernel capability gap.

translation.title: CANNBot-CAKE：面向 Ascend NPU 的协作式智能体算子进化
translation.abstract: 高效的自定义算子对现代深度学习工作负载至关重要，但为 Ascend NPU 开发高性能 kernel 仍然缓慢、依赖专家且难以自动化。尽管 AI 智能体在 GPU kernel 基准上已接近专家水平，当前模型在为 NPU 生成 AscendC kernel 方面能力仍较弱，这可能反映了相关训练数据的相对稀缺。因此我们提出 CAKE，一个面向可部署自定义算子的 CANN 原生系统，它结合了自适应多 DSL 路由、分离的 Generation 与 Evolution 模式，以及通过 CAKE Book 和 Self-Evolving Agent 实现的经审核知识复用。在 Ascend 950PR 上的 53 个 CANN-Bench v1.1 算子中，CAKE 的聚合结果在标准集上达到 100% 用例通过率（1,060/1,060），在隐藏集上达到 98.28%（4,167/4,240），总体平均分为 78.63/100，相对基线的平均性能加速为 1.334 倍。Evolution 进一步优化正确的算子：EngramGateFusion 在 20 轮内将聚合设备时间降低 46.6%，并将平均 roofline 差距大致减半。这些结果为缩小 Ascend 在 AI-for-kernel 能力上的差距提供了可行路径。
translation.brief: 针对 Ascend NPU 上高性能算子开发困难的问题，提出 CANN 原生的多智能体系统 CAKE，通过多 DSL 路由、生成与进化分离及知识复用来自动生成和优化 AscendC 算子。

papers.title: Algorithmic drift in generative adaptive learning
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence promises to democratize personalized tutoring, yet the longitudinal stability of adaptive systems remains under-theorized. Current ethical discourse focuses on static bias. This paper argues that a distinct threat lies in algorithmic drift: a feedback loop in which minor, demographically asymmetric observation errors compound over time into systemic inequities. We make three contributions. First, we formalize algorithmic drift as a coupled learner--tutor dynamical system. Second, we corroborate this theory with an agent-based Monte Carlo simulation in which either a transparent online tracker or an LSTM deep-knowledge-tracing network drives an IRT-based curriculum policy. Third, we introduce the temporal fairness stabilizer (TFS), a targeted intervention that periodically re-probes learner capability, and benchmark it against standard exploration baselines with explicit group-fairness metrics and replication-level inference. Within the modeled environment, TFS closes the achievement gap where generic exploration does not, and we characterize the conditions under which it succeeds. We separate what is established analytically, what is demonstrated in simulation, and what remains to be validated with real learners. Our results reframe algorithmic fairness in education as a temporal property of a closed loop rather than a deployment-time checkbox.

translation.title: 生成式自适应学习中的算法漂移
translation.abstract: 生成式人工智能有望普及个性化辅导，但自适应系统的纵向稳定性仍缺乏理论化研究。当前的伦理讨论聚焦于静态偏见。本文论证了一个独特的威胁在于算法漂移：一种反馈循环，其中微小的、在人口群体上不对称的观测误差会随时间累积为系统性不公。我们做出三项贡献。第一，我们将算法漂移形式化为学习者—导师耦合动力系统。第二，我们通过基于智能体的 Monte Carlo 仿真验证该理论，其中由透明的在线追踪器或 LSTM 深度知识追踪网络驱动基于 IRT 的课程策略。第三，我们引入时间公平稳定器（TFS），一种周期性重新探测学习者能力的针对性干预，并以显式的群体公平性指标和复制级推断将其与标准探索基线进行基准比较。在所建模的环境中，TFS 能消除通用探索无法消除的成绩差距，并刻画了其成功的条件。我们区分了分析上已确立的内容、仿真中已证明的内容以及尚待真实学习者验证的内容。我们的结果将教育中的算法公平性重新定义为闭环系统的时间属性，而非部署时的检查项。
translation.brief: 针对自适应学习系统中微小不对称误差随时间累积为系统性不公的算法漂移问题，将其形式化为学习者—导师动力系统并提出周期性重探测的时间公平稳定器（TFS）干预。

papers.title: Directing to Diversify: Multi-Directional Search for Automatic Heuristic Design
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential to automate heuristic design for NP-hard combinatorial optimization (CO) tasks without human intervention. Recent methods predominantly rely on evolutionary computation (EC) frameworks, where heuristic diversification is mainly induced through EC-like operators or downstream selection, while the direction of heuristic transformation remains largely unharnessed. In this paper, we propose a multi-directional Perturbation-Rewrite Search (PRS) framework for automatic heuristic design that factorizes heuristic transformation through directional search primitives at the generation level. Specifically, PRS operates on heuristic ideas through three complementary directions: expansion toward richer and more expressive designs, compression toward simpler and less specialized designs, and steering for fine-grained refinement, together enabling broader and more sustained exploration of diverse regions in the heuristic design space. PRS further organizes candidate exploration within a breadth-first search-based process with adaptive operator control, which ensures thorough candidate utilization and sustained exploration, and maintains strong search dynamics while preventing premature convergence. Extensive empirical results across diverse CO tasks show that PRS consistently discovers high-quality heuristics, demonstrating the effectiveness and generality of explicitly directional exploration design.

translation.title: 导向多样化：用于自动启发式设计的多方向搜索
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已展现出在无需人工干预的情况下为 NP 难组合优化（CO）任务自动设计启发式的强大潜力。近期方法主要依赖进化计算（EC）框架，其中启发式多样化主要通过类 EC 算子或下游选择来诱导，而启发式变换的方向在很大程度上未被利用。本文提出用于自动启发式设计的多方向 Perturbation-Rewrite Search（PRS）框架，它在生成层面通过方向性搜索原语对启发式变换进行分解。具体而言，PRS 通过三个互补方向操作启发式想法：向更丰富、更具表达力设计的扩展，向更简单、更少特化设计的压缩，以及用于细粒度精炼的引导，从而共同实现对启发式设计空间中多样区域更广泛、更持续的探索。PRS 进一步在基于广度优先搜索的过程内组织候选探索，并辅以自适应算子控制，确保候选的充分利用和持续探索，在保持强搜索动态的同时防止过早收敛。在多种 CO 任务上的大量实证结果表明，PRS 持续发现高质量启发式，证明了显式方向性探索设计的有效性和通用性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 自动设计组合优化启发式时多样化不足的问题，提出多方向 Perturbation-Rewrite Search（PRS）框架，通过扩展、压缩、引导三个方向性原语结合广度优先搜索实现更充分的启发式空间探索。

papers.title: Cross-Region Cooperation of UAV Swarms Towards Air-Ground ISAC via Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: The limited communication resources and sensing perspectives of a single uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) motivate UAV swarms for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) in air-ground networks. However, in multi-region scenarios, regional UAV allocations may not match vehicle demand, while local observations may lack sufficient diversity for accurate sensing. To address these issues, this paper proposes a cross-region cooperation framework for UAV swarms. For communication, cross-region UAV reallocation reduces service disparities by matching resources to vehicle demand. For sensing, combining UAV observations from different regions increases observation diversity, while adaptive handshaking guided by marginal Cram\'er--Rao bound (CRB) utilities balances phase synchronization gains against handshaking energy consumption. Joint optimization of UAV positions and transmit power within each region then further improves communication service and sensing performance. These coupled decisions are coordinated by a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning (H-MARL) approach through slow-timescale inter-region UAV reallocation and fast-timescale intra-region UAV control. Under the considered simulation settings, reallocation can improve quality of service (QoS) by over 20 percentage points compared with retaining the initial allocation under severe resource-demand mismatches. Cooperative sensing with adaptive handshaking incurs only about a 5.0% increase in mean CRB relative to perfect synchronization.

translation.title: 基于分层多智能体强化学习的无人机集群跨区域协作实现空地 ISAC
translation.abstract: 单架无人机（UAV）有限的通信资源和感知视角促使无人机集群在空地网络中实现通感一体化（ISAC）。然而，在多区域场景中，区域无人机分配可能与车辆需求不匹配，且局部观测可能缺乏足够多样性以实现准确感知。为解决这些问题，本文提出无人机集群的跨区域协作框架。在通信方面，跨区域无人机重新分配通过将资源与车辆需求匹配来减少服务差异。在感知方面，结合来自不同区域的无人机观测可增加观测多样性，而由边际 Cramér–Rao 界（CRB）效用引导的自适应握手在相位同步增益与握手能耗之间取得平衡。对每个区域内无人机位置和发射功率的联合优化进一步提升了通信服务和感知性能。这些耦合决策由分层多智能体强化学习（H-MARL）方法协调，通过慢时间尺度的区域间无人机重新分配和快时间尺度的区域内无人机控制实现。在所考虑的仿真设置下，在严重的资源—需求失配情况下，重新分配相比保留初始分配可将服务质量（QoS）提升超过 20 个百分点。采用自适应握手的协作感知相对于完美同步仅带来约 5.0% 的平均 CRB 增加。
translation.brief: 针对多区域场景下无人机资源分配与车辆需求不匹配及观测多样性不足的问题，提出跨区域协作框架，用分层多智能体强化学习在慢时间尺度重分配无人机、快时间尺度控制区域内位置与功率。

papers.title: Diagnosing the Explicit-to-Applied Theory of Mind Gap in LLMs
papers.abstract: As large language models are deployed in high-stakes roles such as therapy, education, and personal assistance, their social cognition must be assessed reliably. Current Theory of Mind (ToM) benchmarks report aggregate scores that conflate two distinct competencies: explicit ToM (recognizing what someone believes) and applied ToM (using that belief to predict behavior). Building on this distinction, we investigate the gap and its recoverability using four structurally diverse benchmarks. Aggregate reporting obscures uneven competence: on SimpleToM, Llama-3.1-8B scores 51.5 percent overall while recognizing mental states at 99.4 percent and predicting behavior at only 28.9 percent. To assess recovery, we compare structured prompting, matched in-context learning, and our proposed Belief-State Test-Time Training (BSTTT), which adapts lightweight parameters on answered support questions through action reconstruction. Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and GPT-oss-20B, recovery depends on the model, task, and intervention. On SimpleToM, reminders combined with BSTTT improve Llama's behavior prediction by 40.8 percentage points; reminders account for most of the overall improvement, with BSTTT adding 1.3 to 5.5 points beyond reminders across models. Contextual examples often outperform weight updates, while BSTTT remains stronger in specific model-benchmark settings. Temporal belief tracking remains difficult despite partial recovery. These findings show that aggregate ToM scores can overstate applied competence while hiding performance recoverable through targeted assistance. We recommend decomposed reporting of explicit and applied accuracy alongside intervention comparisons that establish which failures are recoverable and under what conditions.

translation.title: 诊断 LLM 中从显式到应用的心智理论差距
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型被部署于治疗、教育和个人助理等高风险角色，其社会认知必须得到可靠评估。当前的心智理论（ToM）基准报告的聚合分数混淆了两种不同的能力：显式 ToM（识别某人的信念）和应用 ToM（利用该信念预测行为）。基于这一区分，我们使用四个结构多样的基准研究该差距及其可恢复性。聚合报告掩盖了不均衡的能力：在 SimpleToM 上，Llama-3.1-8B 总体得分 51.5%，而识别心理状态达 99.4%，预测行为仅 28.9%。为评估恢复效果，我们比较了结构化提示、匹配的上下文学习以及我们提出的 Belief-State Test-Time Training（BSTTT），后者通过动作重构在已回答的支持问题上适配轻量参数。在 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B 和 GPT-oss-20B 上，恢复效果取决于模型、任务和干预方式。在 SimpleToM 上，提醒结合 BSTTT 将 Llama 的行为预测提升 40.8 个百分点；提醒贡献了大部分整体提升，BSTTT 在各模型上额外带来 1.3 至 5.5 个百分点。上下文示例往往优于权重更新，而 BSTTT 在特定模型—基准设置中仍更强。尽管有部分恢复，时间性信念追踪仍然困难。这些发现表明，聚合 ToM 分数可能高估应用能力，同时掩盖了可通过针对性辅助恢复的性能。我们建议分解报告显式与应用准确率，并进行干预比较以确定哪些失败可恢复以及在何种条件下可恢复。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在显式心智理论（识别信念）与应用心智理论（用信念预测行为）之间的能力差距问题，通过多基准诊断并提出 Belief-State Test-Time Training（BSTTT）等干预手段评估该差距的可恢复性。

papers.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
papers.abstract: Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.

translation.title: SCOPE：将自然语言策略编译为神经符号化谓词程序
translation.abstract: LLM智能体的策略执行已从单轮内容审核转向在多轮对话记录和工具调用轨迹上评估的复合、应用特定策略。微调的护栏模型效率高但在复合策略上表现下降，而LLM-as-a-judge方法虽然准确率更高，却带来高昂的推理成本且预测不稳定。神经符号方法提供了一种自然的替代方案，将策略分解为在显式逻辑下组合的窄域神经决策。然而，现有符号层缺乏所需的表达能力，且是针对固定数据而非策略本身进行优化。为此，我们提出SCOPE，将策略编译为由小模型、确定性抽取器和组合其输出的代码执行的可执行神经谓词程序。该程序与其训练数据联合优化，利用针对程序偏离策略之处的对抗性反例生成。我们在真实世界策略任务基准上，对比提示优化、任务分解和工作流生成方法评估SCOPE，在所有任务和模型上取得最高平均准确率。用最弱执行器优化的程序无需进一步优化即可迁移到其他模型。这使其可以部署在生产环境中的廉价模型上，并达到与前沿推理模型相当的准确率。与这些单体模型不同，SCOPE产生明显更稳定的预测，且每个判定都可以通过产生它的谓词输出进行解释。此外，我们通过消融实验验证了方法的关键组件。SCOPE从而在生产规模上实现了可靠、可解释且高效的策略执行。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体复合策略执行中准确率与成本、稳定性难以兼顾的问题，核心方法是将自然语言策略编译为可联合优化的神经谓词程序并利用对抗性反例生成进行训练。

papers.title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
papers.abstract: World Models (WMs) can support Multimodal Agents (MAs) through simulated experience, while Agent trajectories can inform World Model refinement. Evaluating this interaction requires separate evidence about action selection and state evolution. We introduce Dual Exam, which tests Agents under fixed environment response mechanisms and World Models under fixed action interventions across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. The Agent track compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories. The World Model track contains 400 cases across eight scenarios; 15 configurations have full coverage and one covers six scenarios. GPT 6 Astra leads the case-weighted Agent Index at 31.3, and GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall at 21.7. These scores use different tasks and metrics and are not directly comparable. A 150-case pilot of one coupled pairing records zero task successes and motivates component-level diagnosis. Results reveal uneven task performance and failures to preserve task-relevant state. Their value for predicting coupled success or sustained reciprocal learning remains to be established.

translation.title: 双重考试：多模态智能体与世界模型的可控评估
translation.abstract: 世界模型（WM）可以通过模拟经验支持多模态智能体（MA），而智能体轨迹可以为世界模型的改进提供信息。评估这种交互需要关于动作选择和状态演化的独立证据。我们提出Dual Exam，在固定的环境响应机制下测试智能体，在固定的动作干预下测试世界模型，涵盖物理、数字、社会和科学领域。智能体赛道在15个报告类别中对1,088个条目比较了10种配置。世界模型赛道包含8个场景的400个案例；15种配置具有全覆盖，一种覆盖六个场景。GPT 6 Astra以31.3的案例加权智能体指数领先，GPT-Image-2以21.7的全覆盖WM总分领先。这些分数使用不同的任务和指标，不可直接比较。对一个耦合配对的150案例试点记录了零任务成功，这促使我们进行组件级诊断。结果揭示了任务表现的不均衡以及无法保持任务相关状态的失败。它们对预测耦合成功或持续互惠学习的价值仍有待确立。
translation.brief: 解决多模态智能体与世界模型缺乏分别评估动作选择和状态演化能力的问题，核心方法是在固定环境响应和固定动作干预下分别对两者进行受控基准测试。

papers.title: nnInteractive Agent: General-Purpose AI Agents as 3D Image Annotators
papers.abstract: Interactive 3D segmentation models such as nnInteractive turn a few spatial prompts (points, scribbles, boxes) into accurate volumetric masks, but a human still does the annotation work: finding each structure, placing prompts, checking the result and correcting it. General-purpose AI agents can now interpret images, call tools and write code. We show that such agents can take over this work without additional training: the user makes a request in plain language, and the agent works out what has to be segmented, locates the targets, prompts nnInteractive, inspects the 3D result, corrects it and responds to feedback. Asked for 'the muscles used for chewing', an agent identifies and segments the masseters and pterygoids; asked to count liver lesions, it writes its own code to find candidates and splits a merged lesion on request. Our open-source nninteractive-agent provides nnInteractive as tools over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), together with a skill that encodes how experienced users prompt it. On a benchmark spanning CT, MRI, PET and micro-CT of humans, a mouse and an ant (14 images; 51 targets from organs and tumours to muscles, foot bones, vessel trees and an insect brain), Claude Code and Codex reach a mean Dice of 0.81 and 0.84 from the request alone; when told where each target is, both reach 0.85 and prompt nearly as effectively as an oracle that places prompts using the reference segmentation. A text-prompted 3D model (VoxTell) is more accurate on most standard radiological targets but less robust: it returns an empty mask for one of them and fails on the leg muscles, the foot bones, the mouse and the ant, where the agents remain accurate. Code: https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nninteractive-agent

translation.title: nnInteractive Agent：作为3D图像标注器的通用AI智能体
translation.abstract: nnInteractive等交互式3D分割模型可以将少量空间提示（点、涂鸦、框）转化为精确的体素掩码，但标注工作仍需人工完成：寻找每个结构、放置提示、检查结果并进行修正。通用AI智能体现在可以理解图像、调用工具并编写代码。我们证明这类智能体无需额外训练即可接管这项工作：用户用自然语言提出请求，智能体自行确定需要分割什么、定位目标、提示nnInteractive、检查3D结果、进行修正并响应反馈。当被要求分割'用于咀嚼的肌肉'时，智能体识别并分割出咬肌和翼肌；当被要求计数肝脏病灶时，它编写自己的代码寻找候选，并按要求拆分一个融合的病灶。我们的开源nninteractive-agent通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）将nnInteractive作为工具提供，并附带一个编码了经验丰富的用户如何提示它的技能。在涵盖人、小鼠和蚂蚁的CT、MRI、PET和micro-CT基准（14张图像；51个目标，从器官、肿瘤到肌肉、足骨、血管树和昆虫大脑）上，Claude Code和Codex仅凭请求即达到0.81和0.84的平均Dice；当告知每个目标的位置时，两者均达到0.85，提示效果几乎与使用参考分割放置提示的oracle相当。文本提示的3D模型（VoxTell）在大多数标准放射学目标上更准确但鲁棒性较差：它对其中一个目标返回空掩码，并在腿部肌肉、足骨、小鼠和蚂蚁上失败，而智能体在这些情况下仍保持准确。代码：https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nninteractive-agent
translation.brief: 解决交互式3D分割仍需人工执行标注流程的问题，核心方法是用通用AI智能体通过MCP将nnInteractive封装为工具，实现从自然语言请求到自动定位、提示、检查与修正的端到端标注。

papers.title: MQAScore: Fine-Grained Text-Music Alignment Evaluation via Large Audio Language Model
papers.abstract: Text-to-music alignment is commonly evaluated by the global similarity between text and audio embeddings, which collapses all described attributes into a single score and obscures which ones are missing. We instead introduce MQAScore, which verifies each atomic musical concept along five clip-level dimensions (genre, instrument, mood/theme, vocal, and usage) by the probability that a large audio language model (LALM) answers affirmatively to a binary question. To assess evaluator reliability, we construct verification labels from presence/absence annotations and LLM-guided concept substitutions, and propose the Sensitivity-Invariance Ratio, which measures how selectively an evaluator responds to meaning-changing substitutions. Experiments show that concept-level scoring improves both question-answering and similarity-based evaluators, and MQAScore can be a more reliable and interpretable fine-grained complement to global similarity for evaluating text-to-music alignment.

translation.title: MQAScore：基于大型音频语言模型的细粒度文本-音乐对齐评估
translation.abstract: 文本到音乐的对齐通常通过文本与音频嵌入的全局相似度来评估，这将所有描述的属性压缩为单一分数，掩盖了缺失的属性。我们转而提出MQAScore，通过大型音频语言模型（LALM）对二元问题给出肯定回答的概率，沿五个片段级维度（流派、乐器、情绪/主题、人声和用途）验证每个原子音乐概念。为评估评估器的可靠性，我们从存在/缺失标注和LLM引导的概念替换构建验证标签，并提出敏感性-不变性比率（Sensitivity-Invariance Ratio），衡量评估器对改变含义的替换的选择性响应程度。实验表明，概念级评分同时改进了问答型和基于相似度的评估器，MQAScore可以作为全局相似度的一种更可靠、更可解释的细粒度补充，用于评估文本到音乐的对齐。
translation.brief: 解决全局相似度评估无法揭示文本-音乐对齐中缺失属性的问题，核心方法是利用大型音频语言模型对逐个原子音乐概念的二元问答概率进行细粒度验证。

papers.title: Co-Recursive Semantic Self-Extension: A Mathematical Foundation for Open-Ended Intelligence
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced through scale, data, and computation, yet remains bounded by its representational framework. We ask what makes intelligence open-ended. Every inferential system selects meaningful distinctions, limiting what it can learn. Within a fixed purpose, performance reaches a ceiling set by its semantic domain. Teleological succession, in which purposes arise from earlier ones, faces a similar limit: Boolean-closed purpose-transformations exhaust their reachable semantic territory. We shift from purposes to inferential systems. Drawing on Kant and G\"odel, we model cognitive states as partial evaluations over a formal language. Unresolved propositions may be undecided or undecidable. Reasoning can resolve the former but not the latter, leaving a frontier for extension. Non-trivial reductions of undecidable propositions expose undecidable intermediate premises whose reflective reification supports multiple decisive extensions. Finite trace-guided generation remains fallible, requiring meta-level selection and polycontextural exploration. Using Kolmogorov complexity, we show that no architecture with a fixed state description, transition mechanism, and initial condition can generate histories incorporating irreducible algorithmic information. Because physical systems are fixed in this sense, we examine collectives. Coupling finitely many finite agents does not remove the bound. Extension requires persistent external memory preserving semantic content and historical coordinates. Collective generative capacity depends on balancing overlap for transfer with difference for generation. We propose semantic self-extension as a design principle: intelligence should not merely resolve ambiguity within existing meanings, but transform unresolved structures into new spaces of meaning, generating new distinctions, questions, representations, and purposes.

translation.title: 协同递归语义自我扩展：开放式智能的数学基础
translation.abstract: 人工智能通过规模、数据和算力不断进步，但仍受其表示框架的限制。我们追问是什么使智能具有开放性。每个推理系统都会选择有意义的区分，从而限制其可学习的内容。在固定目的下，性能会达到由其语义域设定的上限。目的的目的论继承——即目的从先前的目的中产生——面临类似的限制：布尔封闭的目的变换会穷尽其可达的语义领域。我们将焦点从目的转向推理系统。借鉴Kant和Gödel，我们将认知状态建模为形式语言上的部分赋值。未决命题可能未判定或不可判定。推理可以解决前者但无法解决后者，从而留下可扩展的前沿。不可判定命题的非平凡归约会暴露不可判定的中间前提，其反思性具体化支持多种决定性的扩展。有限的轨迹引导生成仍是可错的，需要元层选择和多语境探索。利用Kolmogorov复杂度，我们证明任何具有固定状态描述、转移机制和初始条件的架构都无法生成包含不可约算法信息的历史。由于物理系统在此意义上是固定的，我们转而考察集体。耦合有限个有限智能体并不能消除该界限。扩展需要持久的外部记忆来保存语义内容和历史坐标。集体的生成能力取决于在用于迁移的重叠与用于生成的差异之间取得平衡。我们提出语义自我扩展作为设计原则：智能不应仅仅在现有含义内消解歧义，而应将未解决的结构转化为新的意义空间，生成新的区分、问题、表示和目的。
translation.brief: 解决智能受固定表示框架限制而无法开放式发展的问题，核心方法是提出将认知状态建模为形式语言部分赋值的语义自我扩展数学框架，论证需借助持久外部记忆和集体差异平衡实现不可判定前沿的扩展。

papers.title: Who Is the Influencer? Consensus Dynamics in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly used in practice, but their behavior is complex and hard to understand. We design a simple task to ask which model has the most influence on the final consensus when several models are mixed in one system. Experimentally, across seven model families, we find that the opinions of the other models are absorbed into the opinion of the stronger model, the one with more parameters.
