This happens even though the task requires no pretraining knowledge and has no correct answer. To understand this phenomenon, we interpret the agents as weighted particles moving on a simplex. Larger models carry a larger weight and therefore occupy a deeper well in the energy landscape. A large weight means strong in-context learning: a model with a large weight amplifies the majority of its context. Larger models are generally better at in-context learning, and this is what makes the larger model the influencer. We hope that this work helps to interpret multi-agent systems, whose behavior is becoming too complex for humans to understand.

translation.title: 谁是影响者？多智能体系统中的共识动力学
translation.abstract: 多智能体 LLM 系统在实践中应用日益广泛，但其行为复杂且难以理解。我们设计了一个简单任务，探究当多个模型混合在同一系统中时，哪个模型对最终共识的影响最大。实验上，跨越七个模型家族，我们发现其他模型的观点会被吸收进更强模型（即参数更多的模型）的观点中。即使该任务不需要预训练知识且没有正确答案，这一现象依然发生。为理解这一现象，我们将智能体解释为在单纯形上移动的加权粒子。更大的模型携带更大的权重，因此在能量景观中占据更深的势阱。大权重意味着强的 in-context learning：权重大的模型会放大其上下文中的多数意见。更大的模型通常更擅长 in-context learning，这正是使大模型成为影响者的原因。我们希望这项工作有助于解释多智能体系统，因为其行为正变得复杂到人类难以理解。
translation.brief: 研究多模型混合的多智能体系统中哪个模型主导最终共识，通过将智能体建模为单纯形上的加权粒子，揭示参数更多的模型凭借更强的 in-context learning 吸收其他模型观点。

papers.title: Learning What to Ask for Tomorrow: Active Preference Acquisition for Long-Term Personalized Web Agents
papers.abstract: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.

translation.title: 为明天学习该问什么：面向长期个性化 Web 智能体的主动偏好获取
translation.abstract: Web 智能体越来越多地在重复的在线任务（如预订旅行、购物和日程安排）中服务同一用户，因此其长期效用取决于对用户偏好的了解程度。被动记忆和个性化方法无法获取用户从未透露的偏好，而以对当前任务的收益来评估提问价值的澄清方法则忽视了答案在后续任务中被复用的收益。我们研究主动偏好获取（APA）：哪些缺失的偏好值得付出提问的成本？我们将缺失偏好的前瞻性个性化价值（PPV）定义为其在未来任务上的期望累积效用增益减去提问的努力成本和披露风险成本，并在每次交互预算下选择问题。我们刻画了尽管单任务收益不足、累积复用仍能证明获取合理性的条件，并通过初始画像诊断评估这一情形。APA 利用智能体自身的任务求解器在公开任务原型上计算每个候选偏好的反事实增益，并按每个任务族的期望复用率进行聚合。我们在 ActiveWebPref 上评估该方法，这是一个受控纵向基准，包含隐藏但可查询的用户画像和精确的任务效用。在 20 个任务的时间跨度上，预算可行的有价值缺失偏好中有 34.4% 依赖于摊销；APA 获取了其中 80.3%，而基于当前任务的信息价值仅获取 5.1%。在与 APA 实际支出相匹配的每用户提问成本上限下，APA 比四个启发式选择基线获得更高的净效用。在我们的成本设定下，询问所有未知偏好产生的净效用低于不询问，而 APA 以 27.6% 的问题恢复了 84.2% 的效用增益。获取用户偏好的价值应考虑其在未来任务中的复用，而不仅是对当前任务的收益。
translation.brief: 解决 Web 智能体应主动询问哪些缺失用户偏好的问题，提出以未来任务累积复用价值（PPV）为核心的选择方法，用任务原型上的反事实增益与期望复用率聚合来决策提问。

papers.title: Can AI Co-Design Structures? An AI Agent for Early-Stage Structural Design
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models and agentic workflows offer a new paradigm to early-stage structural design translating design intent into structural models. Although text-to-3D approaches have demonstrated that natural language can be used to produce visual, mesh-based geometric models, structural design requires domain-specific geometric arrangements and semantically rich data types. This paper introduces a proof-of-concept workflow for prompt-to-structure generation using an AI agent connected to a COMPAS-based structural modelling API through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Through controlled modelling operations, the agent creates and modifies a graph-based structural data model composed of explicit building elements. The resulting artifacts can be inspected, modified, serialised, and further connected to downstream AEC workflows. The approach is demonstrated through selected prompt-to-structure examples and by progressive and editable design sequences that resemble typical iterative structural design workflows. The results are preliminary, but demonstrate the possibility of combining natural language, agentic workflows, and domain-specific structural data structures as a first step toward AI-assisted structural co-design.

translation.title: AI 能协同设计结构吗？一个面向早期结构设计的 AI 智能体
translation.abstract: 大语言模型和 agentic workflow 的最新进展为早期结构设计提供了一种新范式，可将设计意图转化为结构模型。尽管 text-to-3D 方法已证明自然语言可用于生成视觉化的、基于网格的几何模型，但结构设计需要领域特定的几何布置和语义丰富的数据类型。本文介绍了一个 prompt-to-structure 生成的概念验证工作流，使用一个通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器连接到基于 COMPAS 的结构建模 API 的 AI 智能体。通过受控的建模操作，智能体创建并修改由显式建筑构件组成的基于图的结构数据模型。生成的产物可以被检查、修改、序列化，并进一步连接到下游 AEC 工作流。该方法通过精选的 prompt-to-structure 示例以及类似典型迭代结构设计工作流的渐进式、可编辑设计序列进行演示。结果是初步的，但展示了将自然语言、agentic workflow 和领域特定结构数据结构相结合的可能性，作为迈向 AI 辅助结构协同设计的第一步。
translation.brief: 探索用 AI 智能体将自然语言设计意图转化为结构模型，通过 MCP 服务器连接 COMPAS 结构建模 API，以受控建模操作生成可编辑的图结构数据模型。

papers.title: ProductWebBench: Evaluating Website Continuity Beyond Task Completion
papers.abstract: Frontend coding agents are usually graded on one question: did the requested target get built. Real engineering changes carry a second obligation, because the rest of the site has to keep working. We call that second obligation website continuity, and introduce ProductWebBench, a benchmark that scores both on living frontend repositories: 320 Change tasks over existing code and 80 long-horizon Build tasks. Every task freezes a repository snapshot, staged requirements, browser evidence and deterministic checks before evaluation, and enters only once a reference passes every check and plausible-wrong ones fail. A simulated user reveals the requirements one stage at a time, and every check cleared earlier stays armed for the rest of the run. Across 8,737 runs from 13 models the two come apart: of the Change runs passing every requested-work check, 28.2% still fail a continuity check -- a blank route, horizontal overflow, console errors -- and 10.8% push a browser state they had already passed back to failing. Because the same checks also run on the untouched repository, each regression carries exact provenance, not a post-hoc label: on the 586 runs where both readings exist, 18.3% are caught breaking a verified state. Interaction is a further blind spot, failing in 29.5% of runs whose static DOM already passes. ProductWebBench therefore scores a patch against the living system it lands in, not the target alone.

translation.title: ProductWebBench：超越任务完成的网站连续性评估
translation.abstract: 前端 coding agent 通常只按一个问题评分：请求的目标是否被构建出来。真实的工程变更还带有第二项义务，因为网站的其他部分必须继续正常工作。我们将这第二项义务称为网站连续性（website continuity），并引入 ProductWebBench，一个在活跃前端代码仓库上对两者同时评分的基准：320 个针对现有代码的 Change 任务和 80 个长时程 Build 任务。每个任务在评估前冻结仓库快照、分阶段需求、浏览器证据和确定性检查，且只有当参考实现通过所有检查而合理的错误实现失败时才纳入。模拟用户逐阶段揭示需求，且此前通过的每项检查在整个运行过程中保持生效。在来自 13 个模型的 8,737 次运行中，两者出现分化：在通过所有请求工作检查的 Change 运行中，28.2% 仍然未通过某项连续性检查——空白路由、水平溢出、控制台错误——并且 10.8% 将其已通过的浏览器状态推回失败。由于同样的检查也在未修改的仓库上运行，每个回归都有精确的来源，而非事后标签：在两种读数都存在的 586 次运行中，18.3% 被发现破坏了已验证的状态。交互是另一个盲点，在静态 DOM 已通过的运行中有 29.5% 失败。因此，ProductWebBench 是针对补丁所落地的活跃系统而非仅目标本身进行评分。
translation.brief: 解决前端 coding agent 只评目标完成而忽视网站其余部分是否被破坏的问题，构建 ProductWebBench 基准，在活跃仓库上同时用确定性检查评估变更任务与网站连续性。

papers.title: Constraint Reasoning and Large Language Models Join Forces: Providing Contrastive Explanations for Real-World Optimisation-Based Applications
papers.abstract: We focus on optimisation-based Decision Support Systems in real-world applications. In this context, we aim to provide contrastive explanations that answer users' questions about recommendations based on the solution of an optimisation problem, specifically a Mixed-Integer Program (MIP). Addressing this endeavour is crucial to ensure human oversight of the decisions implemented, as required by international guidelines on trustworthy and responsible automated decision-making systems. We propose a novel methodology that combines constraint reasoning techniques and Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate contrastive explanations for optimisation problems encoded as MIPs. Although LLMs have shown impressive capabilities in Natural Language processing, they can produce incorrect answers due to reasoning limitations. To overcome these limitations, we leverage constraint reasoning techniques to distil the information necessary to produce an explanation, which is then passed as input to an LLM as the so-called graph of reasons. Such a graph captures the semantics and the relationships among constraints of the optimisation problem. Results on real-world scheduling domains show that incorporating constraint reasoning improves explanations generated by the LLM. In particular, using the graph of reasons enables the LLM to produce natural-language explanations that include more relevant reasons while reducing errors compared to explanations generated without this structure.

translation.title: 约束推理与大语言模型联手：为现实世界中基于优化的应用提供对比性解释
translation.abstract: 我们关注现实应用中基于优化的决策支持系统。在此背景下，我们旨在提供对比性解释，回答用户关于基于优化问题（具体为混合整数规划 MIP）解的推荐的问题。解决这一问题对于确保人类对所实施决策的监督至关重要，这是国际可信和负责任自动化决策系统指南所要求的。我们提出一种新颖的方法，结合约束推理技术和大语言模型（LLM），为编码为 MIP 的优化问题生成对比性解释。尽管 LLM 在自然语言处理方面展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但由于推理局限，它们可能产生错误答案。为克服这些局限，我们利用约束推理技术提炼生成解释所需的信息，然后将其作为所谓的推理图（graph of reasons）输入给 LLM。该图捕捉了优化问题的语义以及约束之间的关系。在现实调度领域的结果表明，引入约束推理可以改进 LLM 生成的解释。特别是，使用推理图使 LLM 能够生成包含更多相关原因的自然语言解释，同时与没有该结构生成的解释相比减少了错误。
translation.brief: 解决为 MIP 优化决策生成可靠对比性解释的问题，提出用约束推理技术提炼约束间关系的推理图，再交给 LLM 生成自然语言解释以减少错误。

papers.title: Post-Audit Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Offline Agent Verification
papers.abstract: Offline tests can fail to reveal whether an agent update will remain safe after deployment. We operationalize this post-audit mirage using matched safe and harmful lifecycles that expose identical verifier-visible evidence while an isolated scorer records opposite deployment truth. Our theorem applies standard observational-equivalence and indistinguishability ideas to this executable audit boundary and states the resulting error-abstention tradeoff. The Post-Audit Mirage benchmark makes that boundary executable across authorization, scheduling, and shared-capacity environments. IdentifiedRangeMonitor uses fresh group-labelled harm outcomes to return deploy, hold, cannot determine, or unsupported. Experiments show that monitoring can recover the missing distinction in favorable settings but may remain undecided for rare groups, small effects, or missing observations. Verifier-agent evaluation must therefore test both calculation validity and whether the available evidence supports the deployment decision.

translation.title: 审计后幻象：离线智能体验证的可辨识性极限
translation.abstract: 离线测试可能无法揭示智能体更新在部署后是否仍然安全。我们利用匹配的安全与有害生命周期来操作化这一“审计后幻象”：这些生命周期向验证器暴露完全相同的可见证据，而一个隔离的评分器记录相反的部署真实结果。我们的定理将标准的观测等价与不可区分性思想应用于这一可执行的审计边界，并给出由此产生的错误-弃权权衡。Post-Audit Mirage 基准将该边界在授权、调度和共享容量环境中变为可执行。IdentifiedRangeMonitor 利用新鲜组标注的有害结果，返回 deploy、hold、cannot determine 或 unsupported。实验表明，在有利环境下监控可以恢复缺失的区分，但对于稀有组、小效应或缺失观测可能仍无法判定。因此，验证器-智能体评估必须同时检验计算有效性以及可用证据是否支持部署决策。
translation.brief: 针对离线验证无法区分部署后安全性的可辨识性极限问题，构建匹配的安全/有害生命周期基准并给出错误-弃权权衡定理与组标注监控方法。

papers.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
papers.abstract: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

translation.title: 超越观看与搜索：面向以视频为中心的深度研究报告的智能体基准测试
translation.abstract: 深度研究智能体能将开放网络证据综合为长篇报告，但现有基准并未评估以源视频为中心的研究。我们提出以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成任务：给定视频和用户请求，智能体需识别研究问题、检索外部多模态证据，并生成与相关视频时刻链接的交互式报告。该任务具有直接的实用价值，可帮助用户定位相关时刻、验证论断、复现演示流程并基于视频内容做出决策。我们提出基于技能的工作流和 OmniDR-Bench 基准。评估方面，我们提出 Omni Atomic Rubric Trees（Omni-ARTs），每棵树包含三个维度、23 个共享方向和任务特定的原子二元判据，方向涵盖视听定位、多模态证据使用和交互式呈现。Audited Rubric Construction（ARC）通过独立证据收集、自动检查、行为校准和迭代人工审查构建这些判据树。OmniDR-Bench 包含 50 个中英文任务，覆盖 19 个真实世界子类别，共 6,414 条判据。在 18 种智能体配置中，最佳系统得分为 63.3/100。当前智能体仍需更广的内容覆盖、更强的跨模态因果与逻辑分析以及更准确的引用支持。我们进一步分析了模型、harness、技能配置、视频类别和研究轨迹。代码与数据发布于 https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench。
translation.brief: 为填补缺乏以源视频为中心的深度研究评估的空白，提出视频为中心的报告生成任务、技能工作流和基于原子判据树的 OmniDR-Bench 基准。

papers.title: SARIA: Persistence-Aware KV Caching with Coordinated DRAM--SSD Reload for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-turn LLM agents usually reuse long context prefixes, making key value (KV) caching crucial for reducing prefill latency. SSDs provide a low-cost extension to limited DRAM capacity but introduce two key challenges. Eagerly persisting all KV cache blocks incurs substantial write traffic and rapidly consumes finite SSD endurance. Meanwhile, the small number of SSDs provisioned in typical GPU servers limits aggregate reload bandwidth, making SSD-resident KV cache much slower to retrieve than that in DRAM and inflating prefill latency. We present \textsc{Saria} (Selective Admission and Reload for Inference Acceleration), a KV caching system that jointly manages DRAM and SSD by exploiting the session-level temporal locality of LLM agents to reduce SSD writes and accelerate cache reload. On the write path, \textsc{Saria} uses eviction and reuse history to selectively persist KV cache blocks that exhibit reuse opportunities beyond their DRAM residency, avoiding unnecessary writes for KV cache already hosted in DRAM. On the read path, \textsc{Saria} promotes selected SSD-hit KV cache blocks from GPU memory into DRAM after prefill, allowing subsequent reuse within the same session to reduce SSD read traffic while limiting DRAM contention. A transfer coordinator paces DRAM reads while SSD transfers are active, allowing both paths to make progress and efficiently share GPU ingress bandwidth. We implement \textsc{Saria} on LMCache MP and evaluate it using workloads from TraceLab and WEKA, covering both full-attention and hybrid-attention models. The results show that \textsc{Saria} reduces SSD writes by 57.1--58.9\% compared with popular full duplicate caching and the mean time to first token (TTFT) by 42.3--79.7\% over DRAM-only caching.

translation.title: SARIA：面向 LLM 智能体的持久性感知 KV 缓存与 DRAM-SSD 协同重载
translation.abstract: 多轮 LLM 智能体通常复用长上下文前缀，使键值（KV）缓存对降低 prefill 延迟至关重要。SSD 为有限的 DRAM 容量提供了低成本扩展，但带来两个关键挑战：急切地持久化所有 KV 缓存块会产生大量写流量并迅速消耗有限的 SSD 寿命；同时，典型 GPU 服务器配置的少量 SSD 限制了聚合重载带宽，使 SSD 上的 KV 缓存检索远慢于 DRAM，推高 prefill 延迟。我们提出 Saria（Selective Admission and Reload for Inference Acceleration），一个通过利用 LLM 智能体的会话级时间局部性来联合管理 DRAM 与 SSD、减少 SSD 写入并加速缓存重载的 KV 缓存系统。在写路径上，Saria 利用淘汰与复用历史，仅选择性持久化在 DRAM 驻留之外仍存在复用机会的 KV 缓存块，避免对已在 DRAM 中的 KV 缓存进行不必要写入。在读路径上，Saria 在 prefill 后将选定的 SSD 命中 KV 缓存块从 GPU 内存提升至 DRAM，使同一会话内的后续复用减少 SSD 读流量，同时限制 DRAM 争用。传输协调器在 SSD 传输活跃时调节 DRAM 读取节奏，使两条路径都能推进并高效共享 GPU 入口带宽。我们在 LMCache MP 上实现 Saria，并使用来自 TraceLab 和 WEKA 的工作负载进行评估，覆盖全注意力和混合注意力模型。结果显示，与流行的全量复制缓存相比，Saria 将 SSD 写入减少 57.1–58.9%；与仅 DRAM 缓存相比，将平均首 token 时间（TTFT）降低 42.3–79.7%。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体 KV 缓存受 DRAM 容量与 SSD 带宽限制的问题，提出利用会话级时间局部性、选择性持久化与 DRAM-SSD 协同重载的 KV 缓存系统 Saria。

papers.title: Prompting Strategy Effects Depend on the Judge: A Multilingual Study of LLM-as-a-Judge Robustness
papers.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation is increasingly applied to multilingual tasks, yet prompting strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Role Conditioning are recommended based solely on English benchmarks. Whether their effectiveness transfers across judge models and languages remains unknown: prompt-sensitivity studies are largely English-centric, while existing multilingual judge studies fix the prompt template. In this work, we address this gap by measuring this interaction through a benchmark of 9 prompting strategies, 4 open-weight judges, 27 languages, and 4 tasks across 13 datasets, yielding over 1M pointwise scores on gold-reference outputs, validated against human judgments. We find that prompting strategies are not transferable: the choice of the judge model dominates the choice of prompting strategy, strategy effects reverse direction across judges, and stability degrades in low-resource languages, where these effects are concealed by aggregate reporting. These findings show that prompting effects in multilingual evaluation are conditioned on the judge, task, and language. Consequently, prompting strategies should be validated for the intended evaluation setting, and cross-study comparisons should account for both judge and prompt configuration.

translation.title: 提示策略效果取决于评审模型：LLM-as-a-Judge 多语言鲁棒性研究
translation.abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge 评估正日益应用于多语言任务，然而 Chain-of-Thought 和 Role Conditioning 等提示策略仅基于英文基准被推荐。其有效性能否跨评审模型和语言迁移仍属未知：提示敏感性研究大多以英文为中心，而现有多语言评审研究又固定了提示模板。我们通过一个涵盖 9 种提示策略、4 个开源权重评审模型、27 种语言、13 个数据集上的 4 项任务的基准来测量这种交互，产生超过 100 万个针对金标准参考输出的逐点评分，并经人工判断验证。我们发现提示策略不可迁移：评审模型的选择主导提示策略的选择，策略效应在不同评审模型间方向逆转，且稳定性在低资源语言中下降，而这些效应被汇总报告所掩盖。这些发现表明，多语言评估中的提示效应受评审模型、任务和语言制约。因此，提示策略应在目标评估设置中验证，跨研究比较也应同时考虑评审模型与提示配置。
translation.brief: 针对提示策略在多语言 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估中是否可迁移的问题，构建大规模多语言基准并发现策略效应由评审模型、任务和语言共同决定。

papers.title: Large Language Models Meet Bayesian Optimization: Towards Self-evolving Wireless Digital Twins
papers.abstract: Wireless digital twins (DTs) are increasingly integrated with artificial intelligence to support online modeling, prediction, and network optimization. However, most existing approaches perform adaptation within predefined learning or optimization structures, which may become unsuitable when wireless tasks and operating conditions change. In this article, we investigate the integration of large language models (LLMs) and Bayesian optimization (BO) to extend wireless DTs from online adaptation towards algorithm-level self-evolution. We introduce an LLM-assisted BO framework in which BO provides a stable and sample-efficient optimization backbone, while the LLM determines whether selected BO components should be retained or adapted based on the current task and accumulated optimization experience. In simulations, we apply the framework to Gaussian process (GP) kernel discovery for a multi-user wireless beam-selection problem. Simulation results show that the LLM-discovered kernel improves the final BO performance by 19.7% on the training tasks compared with the strongest standard kernel baseline. The results demonstrate the potential of combining LLM flexibility with structured BO for self-evolving wireless DTs.

translation.title: 大语言模型与贝叶斯优化的结合：迈向自演化无线数字孪生
translation.abstract: 无线数字孪生（DT）正日益与人工智能结合，以支持在线建模、预测和网络优化。然而，大多数现有方法在预定义的学习或优化结构内进行自适应，当无线任务和运行条件变化时这些结构可能不再适用。本文研究大语言模型（LLM）与贝叶斯优化（BO）的融合，将无线数字孪生从在线自适应扩展到算法级自演化。我们提出一个 LLM 辅助的 BO 框架：BO 提供稳定且样本高效的优化骨干，而 LLM 根据当前任务和积累的优化经验决定所选 BO 组件应保留还是调整。在仿真中，我们将该框架应用于多用户无线波束选择问题的高斯过程（GP）核发现。仿真结果表明，LLM 发现的核在训练任务上相比最强的标准核基线将最终 BO 性能提升 19.7%。结果展示了结合 LLM 灵活性与结构化 BO 实现自演化无线数字孪生的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对无线数字孪生难以在任务与条件变化时自适应的问题，提出 LLM 辅助的贝叶斯优化框架，由 LLM 动态调整 BO 组件（如 GP 核）实现算法级自演化。

papers.title: When More Metadata Misleads: Probing Field-Level Grounding in LLM-Generated Museum Descriptions
papers.abstract: Metadata-conditioned generation is often framed as a data-to-text task in which additional input fields should improve grounding. Museum description generation challenges this assumption because catalogue records are heterogeneous, partially visual, and unevenly documented across geographic regions. We study how metadata composition shapes the generation of artefact descriptions through a two-phase framework. Phase 1 analyses natural metadata variation in a large museum collection, where field count, field type, image availability, and Place co-vary. Phase 2 introduces controlled field probes that hold object identity fixed while varying metadata quantity, field type, and image access. Our results show that metadata quantity alone does not explain generation behaviour. Field type determines whether models ground, omit, or infer information, while images can both support visual grounding and increase unsupported interpretation. More broadly, our findings show that metadata-conditioned data-to-text evaluation should assess field- and claim-level support, rather than relying only on aggregate input coverage or reference similarity.

translation.title: 当更多元数据反而误导时：探究 LLM 生成的博物馆描述中的字段级接地能力
translation.abstract: 元数据条件生成通常被框定为数据到文本任务，即额外的输入字段应能改善接地。博物馆描述生成挑战了这一假设，因为馆藏记录是异构的、部分依赖视觉信息，且在不同地理区域的记录完整度不均。我们通过一个两阶段框架研究元数据构成如何影响器物描述的生成。第一阶段分析大型博物馆馆藏中自然存在的元数据变化，其中字段数量、字段类型、图像可用性和地点共同变化。第二阶段引入受控字段探针，在保持器物身份不变的情况下改变元数据数量、字段类型和图像访问。结果表明，仅凭元数据数量无法解释生成行为。字段类型决定模型是接地、省略还是推断信息，而图像既能支持视觉接地，也会增加无依据的解读。更广泛地说，我们的发现表明，元数据条件的数据到文本评估应评估字段级和声明级的支持程度，而不是仅依赖聚合的输入覆盖率或参考相似度。
translation.brief: 研究元数据构成如何影响 LLM 生成博物馆器物描述的接地行为，通过自然元数据分析和受控字段探针揭示字段类型与图像对生成质量的作用。

papers.title: Investigating Multi-Cultural Value Selection Biases in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) serve users whose cultural identities are multi-layered, yet cultural evaluations commonly reduce identity to one label. In this work, we study LLMs under simultaneous identity cues, with a country persona in the system prompt and a second identity signaled in the user turn, either by naming a country (explicit cue) or through the query language (implicit cue). We test World Values Survey (WVS) multiple-choice probing and open-ended sociopolitical generation. In multiple-choice probing, language cues shift answers about three times more than explicit cues but away from the associated country's distribution, and explicit cues do not consistently move answers toward the named country. Across 1.6 million open-ended responses, naming a country closes 30-44% of the gap to the model's own responses for that country, and explicit cues produce more differentiated value changes than language cues. Our results suggest that country and language cues should be evaluated as distinct signals rather than interchangeable proxies for culture.

translation.title: 探究 LLM 中的多文化价值选择偏差
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务的用户具有多层次的文化身份，但文化评估通常将身份简化为单一标签。在本工作中，我们研究 LLM 在同时接收身份线索时的表现：系统提示中给出国家角色设定，用户轮次中通过命名国家（显式线索）或查询语言（隐式线索）传递第二种身份。我们测试了 World Values Survey（WVS）多选题探查和开放式社会政治生成。在多选题探查中，语言线索对答案的影响约为显式线索的三倍，但答案偏离相应国家的分布，而显式线索并不能稳定地将答案推向所命名国家。在 160 万条开放式回复中，命名国家能弥合模型自身回复与该国家分布之间差距的 30-44%，且显式线索产生的价值变化比语言线索更具区分度。我们的结果表明，国家和语言线索应作为不同的信号来评估，而非可互换的文化代理。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 在国家与语言双重文化身份线索下的价值选择偏差，通过 WVS 探查和大规模开放式生成比较两类线索的影响差异。

papers.title: Trion-1: Unifying Language, Protein Sequence, and Structure with Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: We envision a general-purpose protein foundation model as a unified, interactive model of sequence, structure, and function, capable of understanding, generation, and cross-modal translation while retaining the instruction-following and reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs. Toward this vision, we introduce Trion-1, the first native, unified, multimodal diffusion language model (dLLM) for proteins. Trion-1 is built on two key design choices: (1) a unified discrete token space that jointly represents sequence, structure, and natural language; (2) a dLLM backbone that replaces strict left-to-right factorization with bidirectional or semi-bidirectional token interactions, enabling global residue communication and long-range contact modeling that are naturally suited to structure modeling. This formulation unifies six core capabilities: folding, inverse folding, sequence understanding, structure understanding, sequence design, and structure design, while retaining the native language capabilities of general-purpose LLMs. On established benchmarks, Trion-1 achieves broadly competitive performance. In folding, Trion-1 achieves a TM-score above 0.8 with a single sample under strict homology control, matching or exceeding the existing tri-modal model using 200 samples. For sequence understanding, Trion-1 performs on par with top-tier LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.7 (62.37%). These results support well-aligned sequence-structure-language representations and strong cross-modal generative capabilities.

translation.title: Trion-1：用扩散语言模型统一语言、蛋白质序列与结构
translation.abstract: 我们设想一个通用蛋白质基础模型，作为序列、结构和功能的统一交互模型，能够进行理解、生成和跨模态翻译，同时保留现代 LLM 的指令遵循和推理能力。为实现这一愿景，我们提出 Trion-1，首个面向蛋白质的原生统一多模态扩散语言模型（dLLM）。Trion-1 基于两个关键设计选择：（1）统一的离散 token 空间，联合表示序列、结构和自然语言；（2）dLLM 骨干网络，以双向或半双向 token 交互取代严格的从左到右分解，实现全局残差通信和长程接触建模，天然适合结构建模。这一设计统一了六项核心能力：折叠、逆折叠、序列理解、结构理解、序列设计和结构设计，同时保留通用 LLM 的原生语言能力。在既有基准上，Trion-1 取得了广泛具有竞争力的表现。在折叠任务中，Trion-1 在严格同源控制下单次采样即达到 0.8 以上的 TM-score，与使用 200 次采样的现有三模态模型相当或更优。在序列理解上，Trion-1 与 Claude Opus 4.7（62.37%）等顶级 LLM 表现相当。这些结果支持了良好对齐的序列-结构-语言表示和强大的跨模态生成能力。
translation.brief: 提出 Trion-1，首个统一蛋白质序列、结构与语言的扩散语言模型，通过统一离散 token 空间和双向 dLLM 骨干实现折叠、设计等六项跨模态能力。

papers.title: IndoNutriQA: An Indonesian Clinical Nutrition Question Answering Benchmark
papers.abstract: Clinical Question Answering (QA) underpins Clinical Intelligent Decision Support Systems, but progress is severely limited for low-resource languages such as Indonesian by the absence of public domain-specific data. We introduce IndoNutriQA, an expert-curated Indonesian clinical QA benchmark of 911 question-answer pairs built from real clinical-nutrition reports. Rather than a large-scale training corpus, it is positioned as a high-quality evaluation resource: every pair is grounded in a clinically relevant context, enriched with structured metadata (anthropometric assessment, medical diagnosis, document provenance, chunk segmentation). Eight standardised question types following the Nutrition Care Process (NCP), including the Problem, Etiology, Sign and Symptom (PES) diagnosis statement, are answered for every report, which was written by a graduate-level dietetic intern, by one of three nutritionists. Answers are free-form clinical prose rather than extractive spans, and an expert validation study finds 6-10% of reference answers contestable. The dataset supports generative, extractive and retrieval-augmented QA as well as zero- and few-shot LLM evaluation. We report fine-tuned baselines (IndoBERT variants, mT5, RAG) with 5-fold cross-validation, learning curves and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, and benchmark eight contemporary LLMs zero- and five-shot. We further calibrate our LLM-as-judge rubric against three expert raters (one RD, two nutritionists), finding it human-comparable on factuality and completeness but unreliable on clinical safety, and a human error analysis shows it misses unsupported content that the raters identify. IndoNutriQA is released to foster research in Indonesian clinical NLP and nutritional decision support.

translation.title: IndoNutriQA：印尼语临床营养问答基准
translation.abstract: 临床问答（QA）是临床智能决策支持系统的基础，但印尼语等低资源语言因缺乏公开的领域专用数据而进展严重受限。我们提出 IndoNutriQA，一个由专家精心构建的印尼语临床 QA 基准，包含 911 个基于真实临床营养报告构建的问答对。它并非大规模训练语料，而是定位为高质量评估资源：每个问答对都基于临床相关上下文，并辅以结构化元数据（人体测量评估、医学诊断、文档来源、分块切分）。每份报告由研究生水平的营养学实习生撰写，并由三位营养师之一按照营养护理流程（NCP）的八种标准化问题类型作答，包括问题、病因、体征和症状（PES）诊断陈述。答案为自由格式的临床散文而非抽取式片段，专家验证研究发现 6-10% 的参考答案存在争议。该数据集支持生成式、抽取式和检索增强 QA，以及零样本和少样本 LLM 评估。我们报告了微调基线（IndoBERT 变体、mT5、RAG）的 5 折交叉验证、学习曲线和 bootstrap 95% 置信区间，并对八个当代 LLM 进行零样本和五样本基准测试。我们进一步将 LLM-as-judge 评分标准与三位专家评分者（一名注册营养师、两名营养师）进行校准，发现其在事实性和完整性上与人类相当，但在临床安全性上不可靠；人工错误分析显示它遗漏了评分者能识别的无依据内容。IndoNutriQA 已发布，以促进印尼语临床 NLP 和营养决策支持研究。
translation.brief: 构建印尼语临床营养问答基准 IndoNutriQA，基于真实临床报告由专家标注 911 个问答对，用于评估生成式、抽取式和检索增强 QA 系统。

papers.title: Memory-Aware Reward Modeling: Learning Human Preferences for LLM Memory Use
papers.abstract: Memory enables language model assistants to maintain continuity across sessions and generate personalized responses, but knowing more about a user does not necessarily produce responses they prefer. Existing evaluations assess memory capabilities without directly establishing whether memory use benefits the user. To study this gap, we collect approximately 1,000 pairwise judgments from 87 participants using their own ChatGPT queries and personal memories. We find that memory-conditioned responses are not consistently preferred over responses generated without memory and in some cases, users strongly prefer the latter. Automatic evaluators also show limited agreement with users and favor memory-conditioned responses substantially more often than users do. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce a memory-aware reward model that learns from user judgments, achieving 72.8\% preference prediction accuracy and outperforming the existing baselines. Our findings motivate evaluation and optimization objectives that align memory use with the preferences of the people whose information is being used.

translation.title: 记忆感知奖励建模：学习人类对 LLM 记忆使用的偏好
translation.abstract: 记忆使语言模型助手能够跨会话保持连续性并生成个性化回复，但更了解用户并不一定产生用户更偏好的回复。现有评估只衡量记忆能力，而未直接确认记忆使用是否让用户受益。为研究这一空白，我们收集了 87 名参与者使用其自己的 ChatGPT 查询和个人记忆产生的约 1,000 个成对判断。我们发现，基于记忆的回复并不总是比无记忆生成的回复更受偏好，某些情况下用户强烈偏好后者。自动评估器与用户的一致性也有限，且明显比用户更频繁地偏好基于记忆的回复。基于这些差距，我们提出一个从用户判断中学习的记忆感知奖励模型，达到 72.8% 的偏好预测准确率，优于现有基线。我们的发现促使人们建立将记忆使用与信息被使用者的偏好对齐的评估和优化目标。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 记忆使用是否真正符合用户偏好，通过收集真实用户成对判断训练记忆感知奖励模型来预测用户对记忆条件回复的偏好。

papers.title: RIPPLE: Recovery Internalization through Process-Level Policy Learning and Effect-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Agentic Coding
papers.abstract: Long-horizon coding agents can observe a failure and generate a plausible critique yet continue along the same incorrect trajectory. We call this the Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap. We introduce RIPPLE, a recovery-oriented training framework that internalizes process-level guidance into a single self-recovering policy. A prefix-only teacher provides evidence-grounded recovery supervision without access to future actions or terminal outcomes. After lightweight distillation, reinforcement learning assigns stage-specific credit to reflection triggering, diagnosis, and corrective action. Local validity signals gate trajectory advantages so that intermediate recovery decisions do not indiscriminately inherit terminal outcomes. Across four repository-level software-engineering benchmarks, RIPPLE improves the base policy by an arithmetic mean of 4.8 score points, with no auxiliary critic at deployment. Controlled ablations isolate the benefits of local, stage-aligned credit, and matched-prefix interventions show that critique semantics affect subsequent correction. Recovery gains concentrate where the prefix contains sufficient diagnostic evidence and the repository state remains reversible within the remaining budget.

translation.title: RIPPLE：面向长程智能体编程的基于过程级策略学习与效果感知信用分配的恢复内化
translation.abstract: 长程编程智能体能够观察到失败并生成看似合理的批评，却仍沿着同样的错误轨迹继续执行。我们将这一现象称为“批评到行动的交接鸿沟”（Critique-to-Action Handoff Gap）。我们提出 RIPPLE，一个面向恢复的训练框架，将过程级指导内化到单一的自恢复策略中。一个仅使用前缀的教师提供有证据支撑的恢复监督，且无法访问未来动作或最终结果。在轻量级蒸馏之后，强化学习为反思触发、诊断和纠正行动分配阶段特定的信用。局部有效性信号对轨迹优势进行门控，使中间恢复决策不会不加区分地继承最终结果。在四个仓库级软件工程基准上，RIPPLE 将基础策略平均提升 4.8 分，且部署时无需辅助 critic。受控消融实验分离了局部、阶段对齐信用的收益，匹配前缀干预表明批评语义会影响后续纠正。恢复收益集中在以下情形：前缀包含足够的诊断证据，且仓库状态在剩余预算内仍可逆转。
translation.brief: 解决智能体虽能批评错误却无法纠正行动的交接鸿沟问题，核心方法是通过仅前缀教师蒸馏与阶段特定信用分配的强化学习将恢复能力内化到单一策略中。

papers.title: CoWriter: Guiding Methodological and Synergetic Human-LLM Co-Authoring
papers.abstract: While LLMs have transformed text generation, standard chat-and-canvas interfaces often reduce human authoring to quite passive supervision, causing review fatigue, over-reliance on AI, and the sidelining of the human role in long-form, source-grounded writing. Prior systems typically address isolated writing phases, leaving comprehensive end-to-end human-LLM collaboration largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CoWriter, a proactive agentic scheme that adapts expert human (co-)authoring methodologies from cognitive science to flexibly steer the entire writing workflow while actively encouraging the user to engage. In an exploratory user study, compared to a standard LLM baseline, authors using CoWriter better expressed their perspectives and maintained a higher sense of document ownership, supported quantitatively by $2.2\times$ more successful agent engagements. Furthermore, external reader judges rated the resulting texts higher in "human touch" qualities like storytelling and integrating unique personal experiences. Overall, our results demonstrate that proactively engaging users through established human practices is beneficial for effective LLM-supported co-authoring, providing useful methodologies, techniques and insights for future research on collaborative agents.

translation.title: CoWriter：引导方法论性与协同性的人-LLM 共同写作
translation.abstract: 尽管 LLM 已经改变了文本生成，但标准的聊天与画布界面往往将人类写作降格为相当被动的监督，导致审阅疲劳、对 AI 的过度依赖，以及在长篇、有据可依的写作中人类角色的边缘化。现有系统通常只处理孤立的写作阶段，端到端的人-LLM 全面协作在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文提出 CoWriter，一种主动式智能体方案，将认知科学中的专家级人类（共同）写作方法论加以适配，灵活引导整个写作工作流，同时积极鼓励用户参与。在一项探索性用户研究中，与标准 LLM 基线相比，使用 CoWriter 的作者能更好地表达自己的观点，并保持更高的文档主人翁感，定量上体现为成功智能体参与次数提升 2.2 倍。此外，外部读者评审认为由此产生的文本在叙事性和融入独特个人经历等“人情味”特质上得分更高。总体而言，我们的结果表明，通过既有人类实践主动吸引用户有利于有效的 LLM 辅助共同写作，为协作智能体的未来研究提供了有用的方法论、技术与洞见。
translation.brief: 解决现有 LLM 写作工具使用户沦为被动监督者的问题，核心方法是将认知科学中的人类写作方法论融入主动式智能体方案以引导端到端协作写作。

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Disentangling Decomposition from Typed-State Quality Assurance in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM pipelines are often credited with gains in software engineering tasks, but it is rarely clear whether a gain stems from the typed contract between agents or from the specialized prompts that decomposition enables. We study this attribution problem in Requirements Engineering, comparing three architectures for classifying requirements as functional or non-functional and then prioritizing them with MoSCoW: a single-call baseline; a two-call variant that reuses the pipeline's specialized prompts but passes an unvalidated intermediate; and a pipeline with a Pydantic-validated typed state. The 18 conditions cover PROMISE NFR+ (625 requirements), three locally hosted small language models, and two languages. The F1 gain over the baseline is associated with the two-call, specialized-prompt variant (up to +0.075), whereas the typed state adds a small difference (-0.003 to +0.013) that is significant in one of six comparisons. Beyond accuracy, the typed pipeline contains out-of-range model outputs at the agent boundary, while the unvalidated variant fails later and drops the requirement, and it shows a small, reproducible increase in inter-model MoSCoW consistency whose cause our design cannot isolate. The study is associative: the contrasts bundle prompts, call count, and staged context, and the results come from three 7--8B models on one dataset. The implementation and replication package are archived on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23380444).

translation.title: 超越准确率：在多智能体 LLM 流水线中解耦任务分解与类型化状态质量保障
translation.abstract: 多智能体 LLM 流水线常被认为能在软件工程任务中带来收益，但收益究竟来自智能体之间的类型化契约，还是来自任务分解所支持的专门化提示，往往并不清楚。我们在需求工程领域研究这一归因问题，比较三种将需求分类为功能性/非功能性并用 MoSCoW 进行优先级排序的架构：单次调用基线；复用流水线专门化提示但传递未经验证中间结果的两阶段调用变体；以及使用 Pydantic 验证的类型化状态的流水线。18 个实验条件覆盖 PROMISE NFR+（625 条需求）、三个本地托管的小型语言模型和两种语言。相对基线的 F1 提升与两阶段专门化提示变体相关（最高 +0.075），而类型化状态带来的差异很小（-0.003 到 +0.013），且仅在六组比较中的一组显著。除准确率外，类型化流水线能在智能体边界拦截超出范围的模型输出，而未验证变体会在更晚阶段失败并丢弃该需求；此外它还带来小幅且可复现的模型间 MoSCoW 一致性提升，但其原因我们的设计无法分离。该研究是关联性的：各对比条件捆绑了提示、调用次数和分阶段上下文，且结果来自单一数据集上的三个 7–8B 模型。实现与复现包已存档于 Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23380444）。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体 LLM 流水线收益归因不清的问题，核心方法是通过对比单次调用、专门化提示两阶段调用与 Pydantic 类型化状态三种架构来分离任务分解与类型化质量保障的贡献。

papers.title: RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.

translation.title: RecallGS：面向在线语义 Gaussian Splatting 的几何接地召回
translation.abstract: 在线语义 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）能够从流式观测中实现开放词汇场景理解。然而，现有方法需要额外学习一个 3D 网络来恢复图像派生语义特征中缺失的几何上下文，带来额外的训练与运行时开销。我们观察到，这类几何-语义证据可能已经存在于智能体的观测历史中，可以被检索而非学习得到。基于这一洞见，我们提出 RecallGS（面向在线语义 Gaussian Splatting 的几何接地召回），一种轻量级、免训练的机制，将过去的观测视为非参数化的几何-语义先验。RecallGS 遵循“召回-接地-融合”流水线：CLIP 检索相关观测，alpha 合成权重识别几何上受支持视角，并在每个 Gaussian 的渲染足迹上聚合其语义特征。在 ScanNet 和 ScanNet++ 上，RecallGS 以 2.48 FPS 实现了强大的语义分割性能，表明几何-语义上下文可以从观测历史中有效恢复，而无需额外的可学习 3D 分支。
translation.brief: 解决在线语义 3DGS 需额外训练 3D 网络恢复几何上下文的问题，核心方法是将历史观测作为非参数化几何-语义先验，通过检索-接地-融合流水线免训练地聚合语义特征。

papers.title: The Value of Memory in Language Agents
papers.abstract: Memory enables language agents to carry useful distinctions from past experience into future decisions. Its value depends on which distinctions survive, whether a bounded agent can use them, and what can be recovered or revised as demands evolve. We develop a decision-theoretic framework that follows this value from raw history through persistent state, operational use, and costly recovery and revision. Original and retained value are expressed in units of avoided task loss; risk-cost frontiers describe attainable recovery and preservation across uses. Unknown demand yields value profiles, while interactive feedback changes the distribution of future work. A cost-aware simulation condition and five minimal counterexamples expose the roles of information timing, retrieval access, component interaction, feedback and demand uncertainty. In particular, a pointer with zero mutual information about the answer can still reduce the cost of exact recovery. Diagnostics on LoCoMo, a two-project update task and longitudinal cases exhibit failures of preservation, use and measurement. At fixed retrieved evidence, a saved ledger changes subsequent answers; at fixed agent outputs, an evaluator revision changes scores. The framework connects these distinctions to operational risk bounds and testable principles for allocating memory, preserving recovery options and revising evidence dependencies.

translation.title: 语言智能体中记忆的价值
translation.abstract: 记忆使语言智能体能够将过去经验中有用的区分带入未来决策。其价值取决于哪些区分得以保留、有界智能体能否使用它们，以及随着需求演变可以恢复或修订什么。我们构建了一个决策论框架，追踪这一价值从原始历史到持久状态、操作使用以及代价高昂的恢复与修订的全过程。原始价值与保留价值以避免的任务损失为单位表达；风险-成本前沿刻画了跨用途可实现的恢复与保留。未知需求产生价值画像，而交互式反馈会改变未来工作的分布。一个成本感知的仿真条件和五个最小反例揭示了信息时序、检索访问、组件交互、反馈与需求不确定性的作用。特别地，一个对答案互信息为零的指针仍能降低精确恢复的成本。在 LoCoMo、一个双项目更新任务和纵向案例上的诊断展示了保留、使用与测量方面的失败。在检索证据固定时，保存的账本会改变后续答案；在智能体输出固定时，评估器的修订会改变分数。该框架将这些区分与操作风险界限以及用于分配记忆、保留恢复选项和修订证据依赖的可检验原则联系起来。
translation.brief: 解决语言智能体记忆价值缺乏理论刻画的问题，核心方法是构建一个决策论框架，从原始历史到持久状态、使用与恢复修订全过程量化记忆的价值。

papers.title: Superintelligent Software Engineering: Governance That Scales with Capability
papers.abstract: Software agents are being trained to exceed human engineers; we argue that capability alone does not produce better software engineering. We define superintelligent software engineering as the discipline of building and evolving software with agents whose capability exceeds that of human engineers, in which governance (gates, contracts, decisions and decay control) scales with capability. The argument rests on three claims. First, correctness in a project rests on decisions and contracts that the code does not carry. Second, knowledge decays. Third, once an agent outpaces its reviewers, reading catches a shrinking share of the changes built on stale knowledge. A simple model shows that, past a fixed review capacity, escaping changes grow linearly with throughput while the share that reading catches falls toward zero; governance can lower the slope, capability alone cannot. An exploratory snapshot of 452 of the most-starred public GitHub repositories finds a root-level or .github agent context file in 48.67% (95% confidence interval 44.1 to 53.3); in the median file that names repository paths, 9.5% to 22% of those paths do not resolve, depending on how a reference is read. We then present OSTEON, a discipline for the regime, released with a DOI (10.5281/zenodo.23436020): each project gets a governed knowledge repository of decisions and contracts, every change is checked mechanically against it, and the knowledge itself is checked for decay at every session start; planning is gated, and sessions record what they learn without writing rules. We report no measured effect of OSTEON, mark claims about its mechanisms as opinion and the author's practice heuristics as design rationale, and state the questions that would falsify the thesis.

translation.title: 超智能软件工程：随能力扩展的治理
translation.abstract: 软件智能体正在被训练得超越人类工程师；我们认为仅凭能力并不能带来更好的软件工程。我们将超智能软件工程定义为用能力超过人类工程师的智能体来构建和演化软件的学科，其中治理（门禁、契约、决策与衰减控制）随能力同步扩展。该论点基于三个主张。第一，项目的正确性依赖于代码本身不承载的决策与契约。第二，知识会衰减。第三，一旦智能体的速度超过其审查者，阅读所能捕获的、建立在过时知识之上的变更比例会不断缩小。一个简单模型表明，在固定的审查容量下，逃逸的变更随吞吐量线性增长，而阅读能捕获的比例趋近于零；治理可以降低斜率，而仅凭能力不能。对452个star数最多的公开GitHub仓库的探索性快照发现，48.67%（95%置信区间44.1至53.3）的仓库存在根目录或.github下的智能体上下文文件；在命名了仓库路径的中位文件中，取决于引用的解读方式，9.5%至22%的路径无法解析。随后我们提出OSTEON，一种面向该体制的规范，并以DOI（10.5281/zenodo.23436020）发布：每个项目获得一个受治理的决策与契约知识库，每次变更都对其进行机械化检查，且知识本身在每次会话开始时检查衰减；规划受门禁控制，会话记录所学内容而不编写规则。我们未报告OSTEON的实测效果，将其机制相关主张标注为观点、作者实践启发标注为设计依据，并陈述了可能证伪该论点的问题。
translation.brief: 针对智能体能力超越审查者后知识衰减导致软件质量失控的问题，提出以受治理的知识库和机械化检查为核心的OSTEON治理规范。

papers.title: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
papers.abstract: GUI agents aim to automate complex user tasks by interacting with mobile interfaces, but ef- fective decision-making in long-horizon set- tings requires reusing prior experience rather than relying solely on the environment ob- servations. Existing memory-based methods typically store experience either at the single- action level or as entire trajectories. Single- step actions are often too fine-grained to carry meaningful semantics, since the success of an individual action does not necessarily imply progress towards the overall goal. In contrast, whole trajectories are often too coarse-grained and difficult to reuse across different tasks. We propose a subgoal-aware memory graph that distils past trajectories into structured, reusable evidence at the level of subgoals. We define a subgoal as consecutive actions shar- ing a single intent, the granularity at which progress toward the task becomes meaning- ful. To reduce redundancy and support cross- task reuse, we organise subgoal experiences as nodes in a graph, where related memories can be merged, extended, and retrieved based on the environment observation. On SPA-Bench, our method improves success rate by 11.11% over the baseline.

translation.title: 面向GUI智能体的子目标感知记忆图
translation.abstract: GUI智能体旨在通过与移动界面交互来自动化复杂的用户任务，但在长时程场景中进行有效决策需要复用先前经验，而非仅依赖环境观测。现有的基于记忆的方法通常在单动作层面或以整条轨迹的形式存储经验。单步动作往往过于细粒度而缺乏有意义的语义，因为单个动作的成功并不一定意味着朝总体目标取得进展。相比之下，整条轨迹往往过于粗粒度，且难以跨任务复用。我们提出一种子目标感知记忆图，将过去的轨迹提炼为子目标层面的结构化、可复用证据。我们将子目标定义为共享单一意图的连续动作，这是任务进展变得有意义的粒度。为减少冗余并支持跨任务复用，我们将子目标经验组织为图中的节点，相关记忆可以基于环境观测进行合并、扩展和检索。在SPA-Bench上，我们的方法将成功率比基线提升11.11%。
translation.brief: 针对现有记忆方法粒度过细或过粗、难以复用的问题，提出将轨迹提炼为子目标级结构化记忆图以支持跨任务检索复用。

papers.title: When LLMs Forget What They Believe: Characterizing State Integrity Collapse in Long-Horizon Dialogues
papers.abstract: Large language models can repeat an instruction while failing to keep obeying it. We study this recall-compliance dissociation in long-horizon dialogue and define State Integrity Collapse: a model preserves a stated constraint in memory but stops applying it to later turns. We introduce StateTrack-Bench, a controlled suite of conversations covering numerical, format, role/persona, factual-memory, and logical-rule constraints. Across seven provider-pinned model snapshots and five dialogue-depth probes, strict joint retention ranges from 62.4% to 100.0%, with degradation concentrated in symbolic constraints and in one especially brittle model. A forked recall audit shows that 88.6% of observed failures are behavioral-drift failures rather than ordinary forgetting; excluding the brittle outlier preserves this diagnosis (84.4% of failures). Extended evaluations at depths up to 50 turns confirm that the dissociation persists beyond the core benchmark, while Structured State Anchoring recovers up to 24.4 points on immutable constraints. The results show that reliability cannot be inferred from single-turn instruction following alone; evaluation must track whether remembered constraints remain operational as dialogue state grows. Code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack.

translation.title: 当LLM忘记自己所信奉的：刻画长时程对话中的状态完整性崩塌
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以复述一条指令却无法继续遵守它。我们在长时程对话中研究这种回忆-服从分离现象，并定义状态完整性崩塌（State Integrity Collapse）：模型在记忆中保留了已声明的约束，但停止在后续轮次中应用它。我们引入StateTrack-Bench，一个涵盖数值、格式、角色/人设、事实记忆和逻辑规则约束的受控对话套件。在七个固定供应商的模型快照和五个对话深度探测中，严格的联合保持率介于62.4%至100.0%之间，退化集中在符号型约束和一个特别脆弱的模型上。一项分叉回忆审计显示，88.6%的观测失败是行为漂移失败而非普通遗忘；排除脆弱的离群模型后该诊断依然成立（84.4%的失败）。深度达50轮的扩展评估证实这种分离在核心基准之外仍然存在，而结构化状态锚定（Structured State Anchoring）在不可变约束上最多可恢复24.4个百分点。结果表明，可靠性不能仅凭单轮指令遵循来推断；评估必须追踪随着对话状态增长，被记住的约束是否仍然有效。代码与工件见：https://github.com/xzzvsxd/StateTrack。
translation.brief: 针对LLM在长对话中记住约束却不再执行的状态完整性崩塌问题，构建StateTrack-Bench基准加以刻画并提出结构化状态锚定缓解方法。

papers.title: Consistent but Biased: Chair Personas Trade Noise for Bias in Multi-Agent Clinical Decisions
papers.abstract: In clinical systems built from several large language model (LLM) agents, one agent often chairs the discussion and makes the final decision. Whether the chair's persona prompt changes that decision, or the agreement between repeated runs that some systems treat as reliability, has not been tested with the case held constant. We ask whether the persona changes the decision or only its timing, how it affects agreement between runs, and which behaviors appear when the prompt describes only personality traits. A simulated department of seven agents discussed 20 published cases of degenerative cervical myelopathy, with the case reports replayed unchanged in every run. Only the prompts of the chair and its deputy changed (no persona, or a consultative, autocratic or avoidant one), written either as rules of conduct or as personality traits. With personas written as rules, the chair chose to operate now in 93% of runs when autocratic and in 2% when avoidant, against 57% without a persona. Surgery was still planned in nearly all decisions, so the personas mainly changed whether to operate now or after more tests. These effects held with a second model and reworded prompts. The autocratic and avoidant personas made the three runs of a case agree more often, but only about as often as chance predicts, and Fleiss $\kappa$ did not rise. Prompts that described only personality traits kept more than half of the autocratic and avoidant effects on operating now. They reproduced quick decisions, delays and extra tests, but not ignoring red flags, dropping backup plans or passing the decision to the family. Studies should report and vary the chair's persona as they do the model, and correct agreement between runs for chance before calling it reliability.

translation.title: 一致但有偏：主席人设在多智能体临床决策中以噪声换偏差
translation.abstract: 在由多个大语言模型（LLM）智能体构建的临床系统中，通常由一个智能体主持讨论并做出最终决策。主席的人设提示是否会改变该决策，或改变某些系统视为可靠性的重复运行间一致性，尚未在病例保持不变的情况下得到检验。我们探究人设是改变了决策还是仅改变其时机，它如何影响运行间一致性，以及当提示仅描述性格特质时会出现哪些行为。一个由七个智能体组成的模拟科室讨论了20个已发表的退行性颈脊髓病病例，病例报告在每次运行中均原样重放。仅主席及其副手的提示发生变化（无人设，或咨询型、独断型、回避型），且以行为规则或性格特质两种方式书写。当人设以规则书写时，主席在独断型下93%的运行中选择立即手术，回避型下仅2%，无人设时为57%。几乎所有决策中仍计划手术，因此人设主要改变的是立即手术还是更多检查后再手术。这些效应在第二个模型和改写提示下依然成立。独断型和回避型人设使同一病例的三次运行更常达成一致，但仅与随机预期相当，Fleiss $\kappa$并未上升。仅描述性格特质的提示保留了独断型和回避型对立即手术影响的一半以上。它们复现了快速决策、延迟和额外检查，但未复现忽视危险信号、放弃备用方案或将决策交给家属。研究应像报告和变换模型一样报告和变换主席人设，并在将运行间一致性称为可靠性之前先对随机因素进行校正。
translation.brief: 针对LLM多智能体临床系统中主席人设对最终决策及运行间一致性的影响，通过固定病例变换人设提示的实验揭示人设引入系统性偏差且一致性提升仅为随机水平。

papers.title: AgenticEvolve: Evolutionary Program Search with Persistent Language Model Agents that Design and Run Experiments
papers.abstract: Evolutionary program search with large language models keeps the structure of an evolutionary algorithm and uses the model as its variation operator. Typically, the model generates each candidate program in a single request from parent programs and their scores. We present AgenticEvolve, an evolutionary program search framework in which each island is run by a persistent large language model agent. Between evaluations, the agent designs and runs experiments on the candidate program. To measure the contribution of experimentation, we compare AgenticEvolve with No-analysis, an otherwise identical configuration with experiments disabled. On two heuristic design tasks with three large language models, AgenticEvolve produces better programs than No-analysis and OpenEvolve on both hidden and unseen instances. It reaches the baselines' final quality with far fewer evaluations and comparable cost. On twelve equation discovery problems, it recovers the ground-truth structure of more equations than No-analysis and existing language-model and genetic programming baselines.

translation.title: AgenticEvolve：具有持久语言模型智能体的进化程序搜索，可设计并运行实验
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型的进化程序搜索保留进化算法的结构，并将模型作为其变异算子。通常，模型在单次请求中从父程序及其分数生成每个候选程序。我们提出AgenticEvolve，一个进化程序搜索框架，其中每个岛由一个持久的大语言模型智能体运行。在评估之间，智能体为候选程序设计并运行实验。为衡量实验的贡献，我们将AgenticEvolve与No-analysis（除禁用实验外完全相同的配置）进行比较。在使用三个大语言模型的两个启发式设计任务上，AgenticEvolve在隐藏和未见实例上均产生优于No-analysis和OpenEvolve的程序。它以少得多的评估次数和相当的成本达到基线的最终质量。在十二个方程发现问题上，它比No-analysis以及现有的语言模型和遗传编程基线恢复了更多方程的真实结构。
translation.brief: 针对LLM进化程序搜索中候选生成缺乏实验验证的问题，提出由持久智能体在评估间设计并运行实验的AgenticEvolve框架。

papers.title: Typed Template Fuzzing
papers.abstract: Fuzzing software with complex inputs has been a longstanding challenge. Traditionally, fuzzers either programmatically encode language constraints, requiring significant engineering effort, or rely on users to declare grammars and constraints. Recent LLM-based fuzzers address these drawbacks but introduce new issues. Some use LLMs for test generation, sacrificing throughput and producing invalid inputs when the LLM makes mistakes. Others rely on language-specific parsers, static analysis, and AST manipulation libraries. We introduce Typed Template Fuzzing (TTF), a lightweight LLM-based fuzzing methodology. The key idea is to use LLMs in a preprocessing step to transform seeds into typed templates. The typed templates then enable semantically aware, mutation-based fuzzing without language-specific parsers, type checkers, or further LLM queries during fuzzing. By exploiting the correspondence between seeds and templates, TTF can moreover repair LLM mistakes. We have implemented TTF in our tool Typos, which we evaluate across 21 input languages, including C, C++, Go, Rust, SystemVerilog, Scala, and Java, as well as libraries such as PyTorch and Qiskit. In a six-month fuzzing campaign, we reported 135 bugs, 128 of which were previously unknown. Perhaps most notably, on average 96% of Typos's mutants are valid, coming close to the validity rates of domain-specific fuzzers. Our evaluation further shows Typos's benefits over the state of the art.

translation.title: 类型化模板模糊测试
translation.abstract: 对具有复杂输入的软件进行模糊测试一直是一个长期挑战。传统上，模糊测试器要么以编程方式编码语言约束（需要大量工程投入），要么依赖用户声明文法和约束。近期基于 LLM 的模糊测试器解决了这些缺点，但也引入了新问题：一些使用 LLM 生成测试，牺牲了吞吐量，且当 LLM 出错时会产生无效输入；另一些则依赖特定语言的解析器、静态分析和 AST 操作库。我们提出了类型化模板模糊测试（Typed Template Fuzzing, TTF），一种轻量级的基于 LLM 的模糊测试方法。其核心思想是在预处理步骤中使用 LLM 将种子转换为类型化模板。类型化模板随后支持语义感知的、基于变异的模糊测试，而无需特定语言的解析器、类型检查器，也无需在模糊测试过程中进一步查询 LLM。通过利用种子与模板之间的对应关系，TTF 还能修复 LLM 的错误。我们在工具 Typos 中实现了 TTF，并在 21 种输入语言上进行了评估，包括 C、C++、Go、Rust、SystemVerilog、Scala 和 Java，以及 PyTorch 和 Qiskit 等库。在为期六个月的模糊测试活动中，我们报告了 135 个 bug，其中 128 个是此前未知的。最值得注意的是，Typos 的变异体平均 96% 是有效的，接近领域专用模糊测试器的有效率。我们的评估进一步表明 Typos 相对于现有技术的优势。
translation.brief: 针对复杂输入模糊测试中工程量大或 LLM 生成低效的问题，提出在预处理阶段用 LLM 将种子转为类型化模板，从而实现无需语言专用解析器和运行时 LLM 查询的语义感知变异模糊测试。

papers.title: Automating Feature Flag Cleanup at Scale with Multi-Agent LLM Systems: An Industrial Experience at DoorDash
papers.abstract: Feature flags are runtime configuration mechanisms used for gradual feature rollouts, experimentation, and kill switches. Once a feature is fully rolled out, the flag and its gated code become technical debt and can introduce operational risk through inadvertently enabling dormant code paths. At DoorDash, over 56,000 feature flags span 623 repositories, with 1,659 currently stale as of May 2026, with internal estimates of one to two hours per manual cleanup. Existing rule-based cleanup tools proved insufficient in DoorDash's codebases. Our contribution is an end-to-end automated LLM-based feature flag cleanup system that integrates querying live feature flag rollout data using MCP, Jira ticket processing, and end-to-end pull request creation. Our system successfully produced engineer-approved flag removal PRs for 45 (90%) of the 50 stale flags it was evaluated on, proving the system's operational viability at scale with each cleanup averaging only $4.79 and 13.8 minutes. We evaluated the system's quality and reliability boundary based on success rates, cost per cleanup and time metrics. Furthermore, we discuss our lessons learned when architecting this system, to provide practical guidance for developing similar multi-agent systems.

translation.title: 基于多智能体 LLM 系统的大规模特性开关自动化清理：DoorDash 的工业实践
translation.abstract: 特性开关（feature flag）是一种运行时配置机制，用于渐进式功能发布、实验和紧急开关。一旦功能完全发布，开关及其门控代码就会成为技术债务，并可能因意外启用休眠代码路径而带来运维风险。在 DoorDash，超过 56,000 个特性开关分布在 623 个代码仓库中，截至 2026 年 5 月有 1,659 个处于过期状态，内部估计每次人工清理需要一到两个小时。现有的基于规则的清理工具在 DoorDash 的代码库中被证明不够用。我们的贡献是一个端到端自动化的基于 LLM 的特性开关清理系统，它集成了使用 MCP 查询实时特性开关发布数据、Jira 工单处理以及端到端创建 pull request。在被评估的 50 个过期开关中，该系统成功产出了 45 个（90%）获得工程师批准的开关移除 PR，证明了该系统在大规模场景下的可运营性，每次清理平均仅需 4.79 美元和 13.8 分钟。我们基于成功率、每次清理成本和时间指标评估了系统的质量与可靠性边界。此外，我们讨论了在架构设计该系统时的经验教训，为开发类似的多智能体系统提供实践指导。
translation.brief: 针对大规模过期特性开关人工清理成本高的问题，构建了一个集成 MCP 数据查询、Jira 处理和 PR 创建的多智能体 LLM 端到端自动化清理系统。

papers.title: ClinGuard: a governance framework for reliable, transparent, and auditable clinical coordination
papers.abstract: ClinGuard is a model-agnostic governance framework that treats clinical coordination as patient-scoped, policy-bound transactions rather than free text. An independent sentinel layer validates and governs agent-proposed actions, escalates when needed, and executes approved actions through limited-privilege connectors. Each transaction is linked to a tamper-evident audit record, while an outcomes monitor informs future autonomy decisions. Using MIMIC-IV-FHIR and skilled-nursing-facility placement, we distinguish retrospective demonstration from proposed prospective evaluation in this work.

translation.title: ClinGuard：面向可靠、透明、可审计临床协调的治理框架
translation.abstract: ClinGuard 是一个模型无关的治理框架，它将临床协调视为以患者为范围、受策略约束的事务，而非自由文本。一个独立的哨兵层验证并治理智能体提出的动作，在需要时进行升级，并通过受限权限的连接器执行已批准的动作。每个事务都关联一条防篡改的审计记录，同时结果监控器为未来的自主性决策提供信息。基于 MIMIC-IV-FHIR 和技术护理机构安置场景，我们在本工作中区分了回顾性演示与提出的前瞻性评估。
translation.brief: 针对智能体临床协调缺乏可靠治理的问题，提出将临床协调建模为受策略约束的事务，并由独立哨兵层验证、升级和执行动作，同时生成防篡改审计记录。

papers.title: Muffin - A Shared Memory Buffer for Asynchronous AI Agents
papers.abstract: The rise of Agentic AI systems has changed the landscape of artificial intelligence by enabling strong reasoning capabilities through specialized multi-agent interaction with structured self-reflection. However, in target-driven reasoning tasks, single- and multi-agent systems are often on par in terms of performance gains. A major challenge is that failures often arise from an ineffective exchange of critical information during inter-agent interaction and coordination. Different from existing multi-agent debate paradigms that rely on synchronous turn-taking and sharing information across different agents, we propose an inter-agent protocol based on shared Memory bUFFer INference - referred to as MUFFIN - in an asynchronous agentic framework. In the first step, an orchestrator routes queries based on their reasoning demands and delegates demanding ones to a multi-agent setting, where a shared memory buffer provides asynchronous exchange of intermediate findings while an agent's private reasoning remains local. Our experiments show that our framework Muffin outperforms established competitors, achieving the best accuracy in 17 out of 20 of our benchmark settings, and provides a better quality-cost trade-off than multi-agent debate: Muffin improves accuracy by 19.2 accuracy points while using 77.4% fewer tokens, without requiring full-trace sharing.

translation.title: Muffin——面向异步 AI 智能体的共享内存缓冲区
translation.abstract: Agentic AI 系统的兴起改变了人工智能的格局，通过带有结构化自我反思的专门多智能体交互实现了强大的推理能力。然而，在目标驱动的推理任务中，单智能体与多智能体系统在性能提升方面往往不相上下。一个主要挑战是，失败往往源于智能体间交互与协调过程中关键信息的低效交换。与现有依赖同步轮转和跨智能体共享信息的多智能体辩论范式不同，我们提出了一种基于共享内存缓冲区推理（shared Memory bUFFer INference）的智能体间协议，称为 MUFFIN，运行在异步智能体框架中。第一步，编排器根据查询的推理需求进行路由，将高需求查询委派给多智能体设置，其中共享内存缓冲区提供中间发现的异步交换，而智能体的私有推理保持在本地。我们的实验表明，我们的框架 Muffin 优于既有竞争者，在 20 个基准设置中的 17 个取得最佳准确率，并比多智能体辩论提供更好的质量-成本权衡：Muffin 在使用少 77.4% 的 token 的情况下将准确率提升 19.2 个百分点，且无需完整轨迹共享。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统中因同步轮转式信息交换低效导致性能不佳的问题，提出基于共享内存缓冲区的异步智能体间协议 MUFFIN，实现中间发现的异步交换。

papers.title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. Crucially, recovery does not require a surviving verbatim copy: when the complete secret string is absent and only separately stored components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction succeeds in 62-99% of cases across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. We also show that the response interface is part of the measurement system: target-bearing replies can be scored as failures when the requested format and parser are misaligned. Finally, we separate reconstruction from write-back and fresh-session recall. Provenance-aware closure eliminates observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings, whereas an exact-literal write filter blocks reinsertion but cannot erase information already present. Together, these results show that source deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the level of the agent and its memory system, not only as a storage operation.

translation.title: AfterDeleteBench：审计 LLM 智能体删除后信息持久性
translation.abstract: 许多 LLM 智能体维护外部持久记忆，并从过去的交互中派生额外状态（如摘要）。因此，删除原始记忆记录并不一定移除其派生内容所携带的信息。我们提出 AfterDeleteBench，一个针对固定权重 LLM 智能体中这一失效模式的受控行为审计。对于每个合成秘密，我们将一个先暴露后删除的智能体与一个从未接触该秘密的其他方面匹配的智能体进行比较，从而将删除后的信息恢复归因于最初的暴露。在我们的主要设置中，单次查询即可在大约三分之二的情况下从 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 恢复已删除的秘密，而匹配的从未暴露对照组的恢复率为零。关键的是，恢复并不需要存活的逐字副本：当完整秘密字符串不存在、仅在公开组合规则下保留单独存储的组件时，在 Qwen、Mistral 和 Phi-3 上精确重建的成功率为 62-99%。我们还表明，响应接口是测量系统的一部分：当请求的格式与解析器不匹配时，包含目标的回复可能被误判为失败。最后，我们将重建与回写及新会话召回区分开来。在测试的阳性基线设置中，溯源感知的闭包消除了观察到的恢复，而精确字面量写入过滤器可以阻止重新插入，但无法擦除已存在的信息。这些结果共同表明，源删除应在智能体及其记忆系统层面进行行为评估，而不仅仅是作为存储操作。
translation.brief: 针对删除记忆源记录后信息仍可通过派生内容恢复的问题，提出受控行为审计基准 AfterDeleteBench，通过暴露-删除组与从未暴露对照组的对比来量化删除后的信息泄漏。

papers.title: RIDAR: Safeguarding Research Integrity in Autonomous Research Agents via Automated Detection and Runtime Intervention
papers.abstract: Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process. We present RIDAR, a framework for automated RIV detection and runtime intervention. First, we introduce RIVT, a comprehensive taxonomy of 14 RIV types spanning the full research lifecycle. Building on RIVT, we present RIDAR-post-hoc, a framework to detect RIVs within agent trajectories. RIDAR-post-hoc achieves 85.2% F1 performance on RIV-Gold, a benchmark for RIV detection with 60 expert-annotated trajectories. Applying RIDAR-post-hoc to RIV-Wild, a dataset of 300 agent trajectories across 50 distinct research tasks, we detect 3,964 RIV instances in 99.7% of trajectories, revealing the prevalence of RIVs in current agents. Finally, we present RIDAR-runtime, a framework for dynamically detecting and correcting RIVs during agent runtime. RIDAR-runtime effectively reduces agent RIVs remaining at task completion by 36.8%. We will release our code and data to facilitate future research.

translation.title: RIDAR：通过自动检测与运行时干预保障自主研究智能体的研究诚信
translation.abstract: 自主研究智能体越来越多地被用于自动化科学研究的大部分环节，但它们容易出现研究诚信违规（RIV）：即损害研究过程有效性、可复现性或忠实性的行为。我们提出RIDAR，一个用于RIV自动检测与运行时干预的框架。首先，我们引入RIVT，一个覆盖完整研究生命周期、包含14种RIV类型的综合分类体系。基于RIVT，我们提出RIDAR-post-hoc，一个在智能体轨迹中检测RIV的框架。RIDAR-post-hoc在RIV-Gold（一个包含60条专家标注轨迹的RIV检测基准）上达到85.2%的F1。将RIDAR-post-hoc应用于RIV-Wild（一个涵盖50个不同研究任务的300条智能体轨迹数据集），我们在99.7%的轨迹中检测到3,964个RIV实例，揭示了RIV在当前智能体中的普遍性。最后，我们提出RIDAR-runtime，一个在智能体运行时动态检测并纠正RIV的框架。RIDAR-runtime有效将任务完成时残留的智能体RIV减少36.8%。我们将发布代码和数据以促进后续研究。
translation.brief: 针对自主研究智能体的研究诚信违规问题，提出包含14类违规分类体系RIVT及事后检测与运行时干预框架RIDAR。

papers.title: Certified Execution Harness for Agentic AI: Safe and Least-Intrusive Petri-Net Supervisory Control Between Reasoning and Action
papers.abstract: This paper studies the problem of safe tool execution for large language model (LLM) agents under prompt injection. Using Petri nets, we formalize the execution harness between the LLM and its tools as a supervisory control problem, in which marks represent capabilities, approvals and budgets. Since a transition fires only if the marks it needs are present, an injected request whose preconditions are unmet or already spent is refused regardless of its wording. Treating tool outcomes as uncontrollable, we enforce safety by the conventional maximally permissive supervisor, and this safety transfers to the running system under four assumptions. Moreover, to capture an agent that may propose again after a refusal, we introduce the notion of a replanning closed loop, in which each retry costs an inference call. We show that, in this loop, the conventional supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one. Furthermore, for a given proposer model, the maximally permissive least-intrusive supervisor is characterized as a value-threshold refinement of the conventional one. Under precise conditions, this refinement orders two concurrent actions by at most one monitor place. On an autonomous release agent, we find by synthesis that safe deployment requires a step that the supervisor can refuse after a rollout starts.

translation.title: 面向智能体AI的认证执行框架：推理与动作之间安全且最小侵入的Petri网监督控制
translation.abstract: 本文研究提示注入下大语言模型（LLM）智能体工具执行的安全问题。我们使用Petri网将LLM与其工具之间的执行框架形式化为监督控制问题，其中令牌（marks）表示能力、审批和预算。由于只有所需令牌存在时变迁才会触发，前置条件未满足或已耗尽的注入请求无论措辞如何都会被拒绝。将工具结果视为不可控对象，我们通过常规的最大容许监督器来强制安全性，且该安全性在四个假设下可传递到运行中的系统。此外，为刻画被拒绝后可能再次提议的智能体，我们引入重规划闭环的概念，其中每次重试消耗一次推理调用。我们证明，在该闭环中，常规监督器可能比更严格的安全监督器具有任意大的侵入性。进一步地，对于给定的提议模型，最大容许的最小侵入监督器被刻画为常规监督器的值阈值细化。在精确条件下，该细化至多用一个监控库所对两个并发动作进行排序。在一个自主发布智能体上，我们通过综合发现安全部署需要一个监督器可在rollout开始后拒绝的步骤。
translation.brief: 针对提示注入下LLM智能体工具执行安全问题，用Petri网将执行框架形式化为监督控制问题并刻画最小侵入安全监督器。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Large Language Models to a Low-Resource Agglutinative Language: A Corpus, Datasets, and a Reproducible Benchmark for the Bashkir Language
papers.abstract: Bashkir is a low-resource agglutinative language written in Cyrillic and remains poorly represented in modern LLMs. We present an open resource suite and a systematic benchmark of adaptation methods: the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9M tokens, 16 sources) and three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel text classification; the benchmark covers the first two. Experiments use eight architectures (82M-8B: DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base/medium, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, mBERT, XLM-R) and three adaptation groups (full fine-tuning, QLoRA, in-context learning), plus continual pretraining (CPT). (1) QLoRA on 3.8-8B models outperforms encoder-only fine-tuning on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches macro-F1 0.748 vs 0.653 (XLM-R) and 0.650 (mBERT); pairwise differences are significant after Holm correction (p<0.001). (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly outperforms Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini on multiclass classification, BPB and native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 vs 2.52 and 2.22; n=100; alpha=0.69-0.77; p<0.05); on binary classification its QLoRA advantage is not significant (p>=0.084). (3) CPT effects depend on model and task: perplexity improves for Phi-3-mini (+0.58) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (+0.33) but worsens for Mistral-7B (-1.15, p<0.001); on binary classification CPT helps Mistral-7B most (+4.0 macro-F1). (4) Tokeniser fertility on Bashkir varies 2.67x (2.92-7.80) and tracks adaptation quality, while perplexity across tokenisers is not comparable. Cyrillic tokenisers with Russian pretraining are preferable; LLM judges reproduce native ratings for grammar and coherence (rho=0.33-0.46) but not language correctness (rho=0.16, p=0.11); native evaluation remains necessary. All artefacts are open-licensed.

translation.title: 大语言模型向低资源黏着语的参数高效适配：巴什基尔语的语料库、数据集与可复现基准
translation.abstract: 巴什基尔语是一种使用西里尔字母书写的低资源黏着语，在现代LLM中的表示仍然匮乏。我们提出一套开放资源套件和适配方法的系统基准：巴什基尔网络语料库（71,567篇文档，4690万词元，16个来源）以及用于二分类、多分类和多标签文本分类的三个标注数据集；基准涵盖前两类。实验使用八种架构（82M-8B：DistilGPT2、GPT-2 base/medium、Phi-3-mini、Mistral-7B、YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B、mBERT、XLM-R）和三种适配方式（全量微调、QLoRA、上下文学习），外加持续预训练（CPT）。(1) 在3.8-8B模型上使用QLoRA在二分类上优于仅编码器微调：YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B加CPT达到macro-F1 0.748，而XLM-R为0.653、mBERT为0.650；经Holm校正后成对差异显著（p<0.001）。(2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B在多分类、BPB和母语者评分上显著优于Mistral-7B和Phi-3-mini（平均3.28 vs 2.52和2.22；n=100；alpha=0.69-0.77；p<0.05）；在二分类上其QLoRA优势不显著（p>=0.084）。(3) CPT的效果取决于模型和任务：Phi-3-mini（+0.58）和YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B（+0.33）的困惑度改善，但Mistral-7B恶化（-1.15，p<0.001）；在二分类上CPT对Mistral-7B帮助最大（+4.0 macro-F1）。(4) 巴什基尔语上的分词器fertility差异达2.67倍（2.92-7.80）并与适配质量相关，而不同分词器间的困惑度不可比。带俄语预训练的西里尔分词器更优；LLM评判在语法和连贯性上能复现母语者评分（rho=0.33-0.46），但在语言正确性上不能（rho=0.16，p=0.11）；母语评估仍然必要。所有资源均以开放许可发布。
translation.brief: 针对巴什基尔语等低资源黏着语在LLM中表示不足的问题，构建开放语料库与标注数据集并系统评测全量微调、QLoRA和上下文学习等适配方法。

papers.title: AgentPhishing: A Benchmark of LLM Email Agents Under Adaptive Attack
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly handle private information and act on users' behalf across desktop and web applications, including email. Phishing therefore poses privacy and security risks that depend not only on whether agents recognize malicious messages, but also on how they respond. Existing phishing datasets were developed primarily for conventional detection, leaving agent susceptibility to persuasive malicious requests insufficiently characterized. To expose vulnerabilities that pre-existing datasets may miss, we introduce AgentPhishing, a benchmark for evaluating whether persuasive phishing attacks can evade detection and induce LLM email agents to comply with malicious requests. We develop PhishOpt, which optimizes reusable email-generation skills against individual agents under fixed benchmark constraints and a realism constraint. We analyze the generated emails using Cialdini's persuasion principles to identify strategies associated with agent failures and use these findings to construct a universal generation skill. Our evaluation shows that agents can handle pre-existing phishing emails safely yet remain susceptible to attacks adapted to agent behavior, while in an AgentPhishing evaluation of nine agents, four exhibit phishing-detection rates below $10\%$ and malicious-request compliance rates above $45\%$. These results highlight the limits of inferring agent safety from conventional phishing evaluations and the need to assess how agents respond to persuasive malicious requests.

translation.title: AgentPhishing：自适应攻击下LLM邮件智能体基准
translation.abstract: 计算机使用智能体越来越多地在桌面和Web应用（包括邮件）中处理私人信息并代表用户执行操作。因此，钓鱼攻击带来的隐私和安全风险不仅取决于智能体是否识别恶意消息，还取决于它们如何响应。现有钓鱼数据集主要为传统检测而开发，对智能体面对有说服力的恶意请求时的易感性刻画不足。为暴露现有数据集可能遗漏的漏洞，我们提出AgentPhishing，一个评估有说服力的钓鱼攻击能否规避检测并诱导LLM邮件智能体服从恶意请求的基准。我们开发了PhishOpt，它在固定基准约束和真实性约束下针对单个智能体优化可复用的邮件生成技能。我们使用Cialdini说服原理分析生成的邮件，以识别与智能体失败相关的策略，并利用这些发现构建通用生成技能。我们的评估表明，智能体能够安全处理既有钓鱼邮件，但对针对智能体行为自适应的攻击仍然易感；在对九个智能体的AgentPhishing评估中，四个智能体的钓鱼检测率低于10%，恶意请求服从率高于45%。这些结果凸显了从传统钓鱼评估推断智能体安全性的局限，以及评估智能体如何响应有说服力的恶意请求的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对现有钓鱼数据集无法刻画LLM邮件智能体易感性的问题，构建自适应攻击基准AgentPhishing并开发PhishOpt优化针对智能体的钓鱼邮件生成技能。

papers.title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
papers.abstract: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
authors: Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa

translation.title: SQuAT：球面格向量量化感知训练
translation.abstract: 向量量化（VQ），尤其是基于格的方法，为低比特大语言模型（LLM）提供了强大的率失真权衡，但其在量化感知训练（VQ-QAT）下的行为仍知之甚少。我们将格VQ-QAT扩展到十亿参数级LLM和数十亿词元的训练规模，并提出SQuAT，一种形状-增益VQ-QAT方法，为形状和增益分别使用独立的直通估计器（STE）。SQuAT将权重分解为方向和幅度：归一化方向使用E8导出的球面码本量化，而增益用低比特标量量化器独立量化。我们证明，与应用于完整量化器、忽略形状-增益结构的标准STE不同，这些分离的STE为方向诱导切空间更新，产生一种隐式的球面（黎曼）优化形式。为实现可扩展性，我们开发了分布式精确最近邻分配方案，其中各工作节点量化不相交的权重块并仅通信离散索引，将VQ-QAT训练时间减少12.8倍，使其可扩展到100亿词元。在指令微调的LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3-4B和基座Qwen3-1.7B上，SQuAT在相同量化器和初始化下始终优于标准VQ-QAT STE，并达到SOTA的VQ-QAT精度。
translation.brief: 针对格向量量化在量化感知训练中行为不明的问题，提出形状-增益分解加分离STE的SQuAT方法及分布式最近邻分配方案以扩展至十亿参数级LLM。

papers.title: Major Revision, Minor Accountability: LLMs as Reviewers of Published Articles in Top-Tier Journals
papers.abstract: With the growth of scientific output, the peer review system is approaching a breaking point: reviewers are increasingly hard to secure, and turnaround times lengthen accordingly. LLM-assisted or LLM-generated peer review has been proposed as a remedy, but how such models would treat manuscripts already published in top-tier journals, the closest thing the current system has to a gold standard of scientific validity, is not known. Here we assembled a corpus of 200 articles, each released under a CC BY 4.0 license and published in 2026, from 20 general-science, life-science, and clinical-medicine journals including Nature, Science, and Cell, and asked four current LLMs (two proprietary, two open-weight) to produce independent peer-review reports of each one under a blinded protocol. Their decisions were overwhelmingly harsh and starkly inconsistent with each other: 605 of 800 reviews (75.6%) recommended major revision or rejection, but the rate at which any single model did so ranged from 17.5% to 100% (p < 0.001), disagreement on manuscripts that had, by construction, already survived real editorial review at the journals in question. When the same manuscripts were doctored with one deliberately planted, field-specific methodological or statistical flaw, detection rates varied from 17.0% to 60.5% across models (p < 0.001). Recommending revision for papers that had already passed editorial review (low specificity) while missing flaws deliberately placed in front of them (low sensitivity), these models produce output that should be read for what it is: an uneven, framing- and model-dependent signal.

translation.title: 大修，小问责：LLM作为顶级期刊已发表论文的审稿人
translation.abstract: 随着科学产出的增长，同行评审体系正接近崩溃点：审稿人越来越难找，周转时间也随之延长。LLM辅助或LLM生成的同行评审被提出作为补救措施，但此类模型会如何对待已发表于顶级期刊的稿件——即当前体系中最接近科学有效性黄金标准的东西——尚不清楚。我们构建了一个包含200篇文章的语料库，每篇文章均以CC BY 4.0许可发布并于2026年发表，来自20本综合科学、生命科学和临床医学期刊，包括Nature、Science和Cell，并让四个当前LLM（两个专有、两个开放权重）在盲评协议下为每篇文章生成独立的同行评审报告。它们的决定压倒性地严苛且彼此明显不一致：800份评审中有605份（75.6%）建议大修或拒稿，但单个模型这样做的比例从17.5%到100%不等（p < 0.001），而这些稿件按构造本已通过了相关期刊的真实编辑评审。当同一稿件被故意植入一个特定领域的方法学或统计学缺陷时，检测率在不同模型间从17.0%到60.5%不等（p < 0.001）。这些模型对已通过编辑评审的论文建议修改（低特异性），却漏掉故意摆在面前的缺陷（低敏感性），其输出应被如实看待：一种不均匀的、依赖框架和模型的信号。
translation.brief: 研究LLM对已发表于顶级期刊论文的盲评表现，发现其评审严苛且不一致、特异性与敏感性均低。

papers.title: SyRA-CS: Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation for Code-Switched ASR with Meta-Learning
papers.abstract: Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 of 16, with relative macro WER reductions of 17.7% for XLS-R and 5.3-5.8% for the other three models. The gains hold across the tested models but vary in size across architectures, language pairs and metrics.

translation.title: SyRA-CS：基于元学习的码切换ASR合成到真实自适应
translation.abstract: 码切换（CS）自动语音识别（ASR）仍然困难，因为真实的CS语音稀缺，而合成语音不能完全匹配它。我们研究合成CS语音是否更适合用于学习一个易于自适应的初始化，而非普通的持续微调。我们提出SyRA-CS，一个基于Reptile元学习的、针对特定语言对的合成到真实自适应框架。对于每个语言对和预训练模型，我们在相应的合成CS-FLEURS子集上进行元训练，然后使用一小时有标注的真实目标语音进行自适应。我们评估四种架构设置：Encoder-CTC、FastConformer-RNN-T、Attention Encoder-Decoder（AED）和Speech-LLM。实验涵盖阿拉伯语-英语、法语-英语、德语-英语和印地语-英语，与仅合成迁移、仅真实微调和持续微调进行对比。SyRA-CS在全部16个模型-语言对比较中WER优于持续微调，在16个中的15个CER上占优，XLS-R的相对macro WER降低17.7%，其他三个模型降低5.3-5.8%。增益在所测试的模型上均成立，但在不同架构、语言对和指标间幅度不同。
translation.brief: 针对码切换ASR真实数据稀缺问题，提出基于Reptile元学习的合成到真实自适应框架SyRA-CS。

papers.title: Predictable performance is suboptimal, and what it means for model routing
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) differ in capabilities and costs, motivating routing methods that adaptively choose a model for each query. These methods rely on performance prediction: given a query, estimate whether a model will answer it correctly. Most routing methods train separate predictors of candidate models' performance to guide model selection. Our work shows that performance prediction only beats a simple baseline when the candidate model is suboptimal on the task or the performance predictor adds significant capacity relative to the candidate model. Specifically, we take a model's self-confidence, the probability it assigns to its chosen answer, as a baseline and study how much a performance predictor can improve on it. First, we show that any performance predictor that outperforms a model's self-confidence can be used to improve the model's loss: the predictor's advantage transfers exactly in log loss through recalibration. Second, accounting for the predictor's additional parameters, we bound its advantage by the model's suboptimality plus the gain from those parameters. Third, we extend our theoretical results to two-model cascades, which route queries to a more capable model when the first model is predicted to fail. Experiments with 16 language models on four benchmarks show that predictors gain a larger advantage over self-confidence on more suboptimal models. This advantage shrinks as models improve through finetuning. Cascading exhibits the same two patterns: predictor-based routing offers larger gains over confidence-based routing for more suboptimal models, and these gains diminish after finetuning.

translation.title: 可预测的性能是次优的，及其对模型路由的意义
